a bout of coughing｜一陣咳嗽
words.tip: 一陣病痛或活動用a bout of；也指拳擊等比賽。

tr: a. 空間的, 受空間條件限制的, 佔地位的
[醫] 隙的, 間隙的, 腔的; 空間的, 立體的
空間的；空間關係的
def: a. pertaining to or involving or having the nature of space
relating to space and the positions of objects within it

ex.en: Building with blocks helps children develop their spatial awareness.
ex.zh: 搭積木有助於孩子培養空間意識。

ex.en: Urban planners examine the spatial distribution of housing to ensure residents can access essential services.
ex.zh: 城市規劃者研究住房的空間分佈，以確保居民能獲得基本服務。

words.tip: spatial指空間關係；spacious指地方寬敞。

tr: n. 母體, 子宮, 基質, 脈石, 模型, 矩陣
[計] 矩陣
def: n. (mathematics) a rectangular array of quantities or expressions set out by rows and columns; treated as a single element and manipulated according to rules
n. (geology) amass of fine-grained rock in which fossils, crystals, or gems are embedded
n. an enclosure within which something originates or develops (from the Latin for womb)

tr: n. 圓錐體, 球果
vt. 使成錐形
def: n. any cone-shaped artifact
n. a shape whose base is a circle and whose sides taper up to a point
n. cone-shaped mass of ovule- or spore-bearing scales or bracts

tr: n. 閒逛, 漫步
v. 閒逛, 漫步
悠閒地散步
漫步；散步
def: v. walk leisurely and with no apparent aim
to walk slowly and comfortably for pleasure
a slow, relaxed walk taken for pleasure

ex.en: We strolled along the river after our evening meal.
ex.zh: 晚飯後，我們沿著河邊悠閒地散步。

ex.en: Accessible urban parks allow residents to stroll outdoors, supporting both physical health and mental wellbeing.
ex.zh: 交通便利的城市公園讓居民能夠在戶外散步，有益於身心健康。

col: stroll along the beach｜沿海灘漫步
words.tip: 強調悠閒、不趕時間；名詞常搭配take或go for。

tr: n. 整體, 積分, 整數
a. 固有的, 整體的, 整數的, 積分的
[計] 積分
不可或缺的
內置的；一體的
def: n. the result of a mathematical integration; F(x) is the integral of f(x) if dF/dx = f(x)
s. constituting the undiminished entirety; lacking nothing essential especially not damaged
a. of or denoted by an integer

ex.en: Music is an integral part of our family celebrations.
ex.zh: 音樂是我們家庭慶祝活動中不可或缺的一部分。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is integral to sustainable urban development because it reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通對城市可持續發展至關重要，因為它能減少對私家車的依賴。

col: an integral part of｜……不可或缺的一部分
integral to success｜成功所必需的
an integral component｜不可缺少的組成部分
words.tip: 常用an integral part of或be integral to。

tr: vt. 取...最大值, 使增加(或擴大)到最大限度
[計] 最大化
使最大化；充分利用
def: v. make as big or large as possible
v. make the most of
to increase something as much as possible or use it fully

ex.en: We added shelves to maximize space in our tiny kitchen.
ex.zh: 我們加裝了架子，以充分利用小廚房的空間。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to maximize access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市應改善公共交通，儘可能增加就業機會的可及性，同時減少對私家車的依賴。

col: maximize efficiency｜最大限度提高效率
words.tip: 及物動詞；英式也常拼作maximise。

tr: n. 插, 戳, 刺, 猛推, 口頭攻擊, 推力
vt. 插入, 猛推, 刺, 戳, 強加, 延伸
vi. 插, 刺, 戳, 延伸, (用力)推
猛推；猛塞；插入
推力；猛推
def: n. verbal criticism
v. push forcefully
v. press or force

ex.en: He thrust his hands deep into his coat pockets.
ex.zh: 他猛地把雙手插進大衣口袋深處。

ex.en: The main thrust of the proposal is to improve public transport rather than build additional roads.
ex.zh: 這項提案的重點是改善公共交通，而非增建道路。

col: thrust something into｜把某物猛塞進
the main thrust of｜……的主要重點
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為thrust；要旨常用the thrust of。

tr: n. 相似, 類似
[計] 模擬
類比；相似之處
def: n. an inference that if things agree in some respects they probably agree in others
n. drawing a comparison in order to show a similarity in some respect
A comparison used to explain something through a similar example

ex.en: Her analogy compared our busy kitchen to a train station.
ex.zh: 她把我們忙碌的廚房比作火車站。

ex.en: Teachers often draw an analogy between electrical circuits and flowing water to explain unfamiliar scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教師常將電路與流水作類比，以解釋學生不熟悉的科學概念。

col: an analogy between｜兩者之間的類比
words.tip: 常用draw an analogy between A and B。

tr: n. 居民, 居住者
[醫] 居民
居民；棲居動物
def: n. a person who inhabits a particular place
A person or animal that lives in a particular place.

ex.en: Every inhabitant of the village helped repair the bridge.
ex.zh: 村裡的每一位居民都幫忙修了橋。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth can place pressure on housing and reduce access to green spaces for local inhabitants.
ex.zh: 城市快速擴張可能增加住房壓力，並減少當地居民享用綠地的機會。

col: the inhabitants of a city｜一座城市的居民
words.tip: 常用inhabitants of＋地點；不等於具有公民身份的citizens。

tr: vt. 加強
vi. 強化
增強；加劇；使強化
def: v. make more intense, stronger, or more marked
v. become more intense
v. make the chemically affected part of (a negative) denser or more opaque in order produce a stronger contrast between light and dark

ex.en: The rain intensified as we hurried towards the station.
ex.zh: 我們匆忙趕往車站時，雨下得更大了。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may intensify water shortages in regions that already experience long periods of drought.
ex.zh: 氣溫上升可能加劇長期遭受乾旱地區的缺水問題。

words.tip: 可直接接賓語，也可不接：壓力本身也會加劇。

tr: n. 搖擺, 影響力, 支配
vt. 搖動, 支配, 弄歪, 使傾斜, 使動搖, 影響
vi. 搖動, 搖擺, 傾斜, 動搖, 統治, 轉向
搖擺；使搖晃
影響；左右
def: n. controlling influence
To move slowly from side to side, or cause this movement.
To influence someone's opinion, choice, or decision.

ex.en: The branches swayed gently as we ate outside.
ex.zh: 我們在戶外吃飯時，樹枝輕輕搖曳。

ex.en: Emotional advertising can sway consumers' decisions even when competing products offer better value for money.
ex.zh: 即使競爭產品更划算，情感廣告仍可能左右消費者的決定。

col: sway public opinion｜左右公眾輿論
words.tip: sway既可指身體搖擺，也可指影響觀點或決定。

tr: n. 上坡, 升級, 上升
adv. 往上
vt. 使升級, 提升, 改良品種
vi. 升級
[計] 升級
def: n. software that provides better performance than an earlier version did
n. a reservation that is improved
n. the property possessed by a slope or surface that rises

ex.en: We upgraded our old computer with a faster processor.
ex.zh: 我們給舊電腦換上了更快的處理器。

ex.en: Governments should upgrade ageing water systems to reduce waste and provide reliable supplies for growing urban populations.
ex.zh: 政府應升級老舊供水系統，以減少浪費，併為不斷增長的城市人口提供可靠供水。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後，名詞重音在前。

tr: n. 載貨單, 運貨單, 旅客名單
a. 顯然的, 明白的
vi. 顯示, 出現
vt. 表明, 表現, 證明
def: n. a customs document listing the contents put on a ship or plane
v. record in a ship's manifest
v. reveal its presence or make an appearance

tr: n. 流溢, 面紅, 旺盛, 發燒, 驚飛的鳥, 同花牌
a. 豐足的, 齊平的, 滿盈的, 氾濫的
adv. 齊平地, 直接地
vi. 臉發紅, 奔湧, 旺盛, 驚飛
vt. 淹沒, 沖洗, 使臉紅, 使激動, 使齊平, 使驚飛
def: n. a poker hand with all 5 cards in the same suit
n. a sudden rapid flow (as of water)
v. flow freely

ex.en: Please flush the toilet before you leave the bathroom.
ex.zh: 離開衛生間之前，請衝一下馬桶。

ex.en: Modern buildings can reduce water consumption by using collected rainwater to flush toilets instead of drinking water.
ex.zh: 現代建築可以使用收集的雨水而非飲用水沖廁所，從而減少用水量。

col: flush with the wall｜與牆面齊平
a flush of colour｜一陣紅暈
words.tip: flush with可指與表面齊平，也可指錢充裕。

tr: vi. 排列, 排成一行, 結盟
vt. 使結盟, 使成一行, 校正
def: v. place in a line or arrange so as to be parallel or straight
v. be or come into adjustment with
v. align oneself with a group or a way of thinking

tr: n. 有勢力的人
a. 有勢力的, 強大的, 有力的
adv. 很, 極
強大的；巨大的
非常；很
def: s. having or showing great strength or force or intensity
r. (Southern regional intensive) very; to a great degree
Very strong, powerful, or large.

ex.en: A mighty oak stood in the middle of the field.
ex.zh: 田野中央矗立著一棵高大的橡樹。

ex.en: Although mighty rivers provide valuable renewable energy, building large dams can seriously disrupt surrounding ecosystems.
ex.zh: 儘管大河能提供寶貴的可再生能源，修建大型水壩仍可能嚴重擾亂周邊生態系統。

words.tip: 形容詞常帶文學色彩；副詞義“很”較口語化。

tr: n. 缺點
[醫] 缺損, 缺陷
缺陷；瑕疵
叛離；投奔另一方
def: n. an imperfection in a bodily system
n. a failing or deficiency
n. an imperfection in an object or machine

ex.en: A small defect in the kettle caused it to leak.
ex.zh: 水壺上的一處小缺陷導致它漏水。

ex.en: Manufacturers should identify any design defect before a product reaches consumers, particularly when safety is at risk.
ex.zh: 製造商應在產品到達消費者手中前發現設計缺陷，尤其是在涉及安全風險時。

col: defect to the opposition｜轉投反對派
words.tip: 名詞重音在前；動詞讀/dɪˈfekt/。

tr: n. 活瓣, 閥, 活門
v. 裝閥, 用閥調節
閥；閥門
瓣膜
def: n. a structure in a hollow organ (like the heart) with a flap to insure one-way flow of fluid through it
n. device in a brass wind instrument for varying the length of the air column to alter the pitch of a tone
n. control consisting of a mechanical device for controlling the flow of a fluid

ex.en: Turn this valve to stop water entering the tank.
ex.zh: 轉動這個閥門，阻止水流入水箱。

ex.en: Replacing damaged heart valves can improve patients' quality of life and reduce the risk of serious complications.
ex.zh: 更換受損的心臟瓣膜可以改善患者的生活質量，並降低嚴重併發症的風險。

words.tip: 工程中指閥門，人體中可指心臟等部位的瓣膜。

tr: n. 貓頭鷹
[法] 走私
def: n. nocturnal bird of prey with hawk-like beak and claws and large head with front-facing eyes

tr: n. 請願, 訴狀, 陳情書, 申請, 祈求, 禱文
v. 正式請求, 懇求, 請願
請願書
向…請願；正式請求
def: v. write a petition for something to somebody; request formally and in writing
A formal written request, often supported by many people's signatures.
To formally ask an authority to do something.

ex.en: Our neighbours signed a petition to save the playground.
ex.zh: 鄰居們在請願書上簽名，希望保住這座遊樂場。

ex.en: Residents submitted a petition asking the council to improve public transport in areas outside the city centre.
ex.zh: 居民提交了請願書，要求市政委員會改善市中心以外地區的公共交通。

col: sign a petition｜在請願書上簽名
petition for reform｜請願要求改革
words.tip: 動詞常用petition somebody to do something。

tr: n. 動脈, 幹道, 要道
[醫] 動脈
動脈
交通幹道；要道
def: n. a blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the body
n. a major thoroughfare that bears important traffic
A blood vessel carrying blood away from the heart.

ex.en: The doctor explained how blood flows through an artery.
ex.zh: 醫生解釋了血液如何流經動脈。

ex.en: The new railway will become a major transport artery connecting rural communities with regional markets.
ex.zh: 這條新鐵路將成為連接鄉村社區與區域市場的交通大動脈。

words.tip: 動脈將血液送離心臟；靜脈是vein。

tr: n. 靜電, 靜電干擾
a. 靜態的, 靜止的, 固有的, 靜電的
靜止的；不變的
靜電的
靜電干擾；靜電
def: n. a crackling or hissing noise caused by electrical interference
n. angry criticism
s. showing little if any change

ex.en: The television picture stayed static while the sound continued.
ex.zh: 電視畫面停住不動了，但聲音還在繼續。

ex.en: Wages have remained static for several years, while housing costs have risen steadily in major cities.
ex.zh: 工資多年來一直沒有變化，而大城市的住房成本卻持續上漲。

words.tip: static強調不動或不變；靜電用static electricity。

tr: n. 管理者, 經理, 主管人, 掌管者, 館長, 大學學監, 監護人, 保護人
[經] 臨時監護人
def: n. the custodian of a collection (as a museum or library)

tr: a. 低下的, 謙遜的, 粗陋的
vt. 使...卑下, 降低...地位, 貶抑
謙遜的
簡陋的；地位低微的
使謙遜；使認識到不足
def: v. cause to be unpretentious
s. low or inferior in station or quality
a. marked by meekness or modesty; not arrogant or prideful

ex.en: Despite winning the prize, she remained humble and thanked everyone.
ex.zh: 儘管獲了獎，她依然謙遜，並向所有人表示感謝。

ex.en: Effective leaders remain humble enough to acknowledge mistakes and learn from colleagues with different backgrounds and experiences.
ex.zh: 優秀的領導者保持謙遜，願意承認錯誤，並向背景和經歷不同的同事學習。

col: in my humble opinion｜依我拙見
words.tip: 謙遜是humble；不要與“羞辱”humiliate混淆。

tr: n. 樹膠, 橡皮, 橡皮糖, 牙床, 老天
vt. 塗以樹膠, 用膠粘, 使有粘性
vi. 分泌樹膠, 發粘
口香糖
牙齦
def: n. any of various substances (soluble in water) that exude from certain plants; they are gelatinous when moist but harden on drying
v. cover, fill, fix or smear with or as if with gum
v. become sticky

ex.en: She offered me a piece of mint gum.
ex.zh: 她給了我一片薄荷口香糖。

ex.en: Regular dental checkups can help detect gum disease before it causes serious damage.
ex.zh: 定期進行牙科檢查有助於在牙齦疾病造成嚴重損害前發現問題。

col: a piece of gum｜一片口香糖
words.tip: 口香糖不可數；牙齦通常用複數gums。

tr: n. 漁業
[法] 捕魚, 捕魚權
def: n. a workplace where fish are caught and processed and sold

tr: n. 論題, 論文
學位論文
論點；命題
def: n. an unproved statement put forward as a premise in an argument
A long research paper written for a university degree.
A central claim that someone presents and supports with evidence.

ex.en: Leila spent the weekend checking references for her thesis.
ex.zh: 萊拉整個週末都在核對學位論文的參考文獻。

ex.en: His thesis examines how access to public transport influences employment opportunities in disadvantaged urban communities.
ex.zh: 他的學位論文探討了公共交通的可及性如何影響城市弱勢社區的就業機會。

col: write a thesis｜撰寫學位論文
submit a thesis｜提交學位論文
words.tip: 複數是theses；既可指學位論文，也可指核心論點。

tr: a. 宇宙的, 宇宙航行的, 無限的, 有秩序的
[醫] 宇宙的
def: a. of or from or pertaining to or characteristic of the cosmos or universe
s. inconceivably extended in space or time

tr: a. 有資格的
[經] 合格的, 有條件的, 有限制的
有資格的；能勝任的
有限度的；有保留的
def: a. meeting the proper standards and requirements and training for an office or position or task
a. limited or restricted; not absolute
having the training, skills, or experience needed for something

ex.en: Only a qualified electrician should repair that damaged socket.
ex.zh: 只有具備資質的電工才應該修理那個損壞的插座。

ex.en: Governments should invest in teacher training to ensure that every school has enough qualified staff.
ex.zh: 政府應投入資金培訓教師，確保每所學校都有足夠的合格教職人員。

col: qualified for the job｜能勝任這份工作
words.tip: qualified for＋名詞；qualified to do表示有資格做。

tr: v. 沉思, 考慮
仔細考慮；沉思
def: v reflect deeply on a subject
to think carefully about something for some time

ex.en: She pondered the menu before ordering vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 她仔細看了看菜單，才點了蔬菜湯。

ex.en: Policymakers must ponder the long-term consequences of replacing public transport services with privately operated alternatives.
ex.zh: 政策制定者必須仔細考慮用私營服務取代公共交通服務的長期後果。

col: ponder a question｜認真思考問題
ponder the implications｜仔細考慮可能的影響
ponder over something｜反覆思量某事
words.tip: 可直接接賓語，也可用ponder on/over。

tr: vt. 弄複雜, 使錯綜, 使惡化
vi. 變複雜
使複雜化；使更難處理
def: v. make more complicated
v. make more complex, intricate, or richer
to make something harder to understand or deal with

ex.en: Changing the date now would only complicate our plans.
ex.zh: 現在改日期只會讓我們的計劃更難安排。

ex.en: Unclear regulations can complicate efforts to establish small businesses, particularly in rapidly developing urban areas.
ex.zh: 不明確的法規會增加創辦小企業的難度，在快速發展的城市地區尤其如此。

col: complicate the situation｜使局勢複雜化
complicate the process｜使過程複雜化
words.tip: 及物動詞，後接被弄複雜的事物。

tr: vt. 告發, 抨擊, 譴責
[法] 譴責, 斥責, 告發
def: v. speak out against
v. announce the termination of, as of treaties
v. give away information about somebody

tr: a. 可信的, 可靠的
[法] 可信的, 可靠的
def: a. capable of being believed
s. (a common but incorrect usage where `credulous' would be appropriate) credulous
s. appearing to merit belief or acceptance

tr: n. 授權, 正當理由, 根據, 證明, 批准, 憑證, 令狀, 委任狀
vt. 授權給, 保證, 擔保, 批准, 使有正當理由
搜查令；逮捕令
使有必要；足以支持
正當理由；依據
def: n. a writ from a court commanding police to perform specified acts
n. a type of security issued by a corporation (usually together with a bond or preferred stock) that gives the holder the right to purchase a certain amount of common stock at a stated price
An official document allowing police to take a particular action.

ex.en: The officers obtained a warrant before searching the apartment.
ex.zh: 警員在搜查這套公寓前取得了搜查令。

ex.en: The potential environmental risks warrant further investigation before the government approves construction of the new industrial facility.
ex.zh: 在政府批准建設新的工業設施之前，潛在的環境風險值得進一步調查。

col: warrant further investigation｜值得進一步調查
words.tip: 動詞常指值得或有必要，如warrant attention。

tr: n. 水平線, 水平面, 水平位置
a. 水平線的, 平坦的, 橫的
n. 水平
[計] 水平
水平的；橫向的
def: n. something that is oriented horizontally
a. parallel to or in the plane of the horizon or a base line
Flat or level, running parallel to the ground

ex.en: Keep the shelf horizontal while I tighten the screws.
ex.zh: 我擰緊螺絲時，請讓架板保持水平。

ex.en: The horizontal axis shows time, allowing readers to compare changes in employment across the period.
ex.zh: 橫軸表示時間，方便讀者比較該時期內的就業變化。

words.tip: horizontal是水平的，vertical是垂直的。

tr: n. 床墊, 空氣墊, 沉床
[醫] 褥子, 床墊
def: n. a large thick pad filled with resilient material and often incorporating coiled springs, used as a bed or part of a bed

tr: a. 例外的, 異常的, 特別的
傑出的；非凡的
罕見的；特殊的
def: s. deviating widely from a norm of physical or mental ability; used especially of children below normal in intelligence
far better than usual
unusual and outside normal circumstances

ex.en: The young violinist gave an exceptional performance last night.
ex.zh: 那位年輕的小提琴手昨晚的演奏十分出色。

ex.en: Students with exceptional ability may require additional challenges to remain engaged in classroom learning.
ex.zh: 能力出眾的學生可能需要更有挑戰性的任務，才能持續投入課堂學習。

words.tip: 常指特別優秀；exceptional circumstances指特殊情況。

tr: a. 謹慎的, 小心的, 機警的, 周到的, 唯恐的
def: a. marked by keen caution and watchful prudence

tr: a. 飽和的, 滲透的
[醫] 飽和的
def: a. being the most concentrated solution possible at a given temperature; unable to dissolve still more of a substance
a. used especially of organic compounds; having all available valence bonds filled
a. (of color) being chromatically pure; not diluted with white or grey or black

tr: vt. 使插入, 使嵌入, 使深留腦中
[計] 嵌入
使嵌入；使牢固置入
嵌入數字內容
使根植；使融入
def: v. attach to, as a journalist to a military unit when reporting on a war
to fix something firmly inside a surrounding material
to place digital content within a webpage or document

ex.en: The artist embedded small shells in the wet clay.
ex.zh: 藝術家把小貝殼嵌入溼黏土中。

ex.en: Schools should embed environmental awareness in everyday lessons rather than discuss sustainability only on special occasions.
ex.zh: 學校應將環保意識融入日常課程，而不是隻在特殊場合討論可持續發展。

words.tip: 過去式embedded，分詞embedding均雙寫d。

tr: n. 亞麻布, 亞麻線, 亞麻製品
a. 亞麻布制的, 亞麻的
亞麻布
床單、桌布等家用織物
def: n. a fabric woven with fibers from the flax plant
n. a high-quality paper made of linen fibers or with a linen finish
n. white goods or clothing made with linen cloth

ex.en: I wore a linen shirt on the hot afternoon.
ex.zh: 那個炎熱的下午，我穿了一件亞麻襯衫。

ex.en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse towels and change bed linen less frequently.
ex.zh: 酒店可以鼓勵住客重複使用毛巾並降低床上用品的更換頻率，以減少用水量。

col: fresh linen｜乾淨的床單等織物
words.tip: 通常不可數；bed linen不一定由亞麻製成。

tr: vt. 舉起, 提拔, 鼓舞
抬高；舉起
提升地位；提高水平
使情緒高昂
def: v give a promotion to or assign to a higher position
v raise from a lower to a higher position
v raise in rank or condition

ex.en: The nurse used a pillow to elevate my ankle.
ex.zh: 護士用枕頭墊高了我的腳踝。

ex.en: Access to advanced training can elevate professional standards and improve the quality of public services.
ex.zh: 獲得進階培訓的機會能夠提升專業標準，並改善公共服務質量。

col: elevate someone to a position｜將某人提拔至某職位
words.tip: 及物動詞；elevate A to B可表示將A提升至B。

tr: vt. 放鬆, 鬆開, 解除
vi. 變鬆, 鬆弛
鬆開；使變鬆
放寬；放鬆限制
def: v. make loose or looser
v. make less dense
v. become loose or looser or less tight

ex.en: He loosened his scarf as the room grew warmer.
ex.zh: 房間漸漸暖和起來，他鬆了鬆圍巾。

ex.en: Governments may loosen restrictions on foreign investment to encourage business growth and create more employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 政府可能放寬對外國投資的限制，以促進企業發展並創造更多就業機會。

words.tip: loosen是動詞；loose是形容詞，勿混淆lose。

tr: n. 獎券, 彩票, 運氣
[經] 抽彩給獎法
彩票；抽獎
抽籤；靠運氣的事
def: n. something that is regarded as a chance event
n. players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
a game where randomly chosen tickets win prizes

ex.en: My uncle bought a lottery ticket at the shop.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在商店買了一張彩票。

ex.en: Allocating school places by lottery may reduce favouritism, but it can also create uncertainty for families.
ex.zh: 通過抽籤分配學位或許能減少偏袒，卻也可能給家庭帶來不確定性。

words.tip: by lottery指通過抽籤，不一定涉及購買彩票。

tr: n. 零工, 家務
[經] 零工
def: n a specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee

tr: n. 邊緣, 端, 流蘇, 穗, 初步
vt. 加穗於, 加飾邊於
a. 邊緣的, 附加的
邊緣；外圍
劉海
def: n. one of the light or dark bands produced by the interference and diffraction of light
n. a social group holding marginal or extreme views
n. an ornamental border consisting of short lengths of hanging threads or tassels

ex.en: Their cottage stands on the fringe of the forest.
ex.zh: 他們的小屋位於森林邊緣。

ex.en: Affordable housing on the urban fringe often leaves residents dependent on cars for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 城市外圍的經濟適用住房往往使居民的日常出行依賴汽車。

col: on the fringes of society｜在社會邊緣
a fringe of trees｜一圈樹木
words.tip: “劉海”英式用fringe，美式通常用bangs。

tr: n. 樹籬, 障礙, 套頭交易
vt. 用樹籬圍, 套期保值, 妨礙, 兩面下注以防...的損失
vi. 築樹籬, 躲閃, 兩面下注以防損失
a. 樹籬的, 偷偷摸摸的
樹籬
def: n. a fence formed by a row of closely planted shrubs or bushes
n. any technique designed to reduce or eliminate financial risk; for example, taking two positions that will offset each other if prices change
n. an intentionally noncommittal or ambiguous statement

ex.en: A thick hedge separates our garden from the pavement.
ex.zh: 一道茂密的樹籬將我們的花園與人行道隔開。

ex.en: Some investors purchase gold as a hedge against inflation, although its value can also fluctuate.
ex.zh: 一些投資者購買黃金以防範通貨膨脹，儘管黃金的價值也可能波動。

col: a hedge against inflation｜對沖通脹的手段
hedge your bets｜多方下注以分散風險
words.tip: 金融義常用 a hedge against，表示防範某種風險。

tr: n. 租約, 租期, 租
vt. 出租, 租出, 租得
租約；租賃合同
租用；出租
def: n. property that is leased or rented out or let
n. a contract granting use or occupation of property during a specified time for a specified payment
n. the period of time during which a contract conveying property to a person is in effect

ex.en: We signed a lease for a sunny upstairs flat.
ex.zh: 我們簽下了樓上一套陽光充足的公寓的租約。

ex.en: Small businesses often lease equipment rather than purchase it outright, allowing them to manage initial costs more effectively.
ex.zh: 小企業往往租用設備而非一次性買下，從而更有效地控制初期成本。

words.tip: lease from指租入；lease to指租給別人。

tr: n. 低語, 低聲的怨言
vi. 低語, 低聲而言
vt. 低聲說
低聲說；喃喃道
低語聲；輕柔持續的聲音
def: v. speak softly or indistinctly
v. make complaining remarks or noises under one's breath
To speak in a quiet, gentle voice.

ex.en: She murmured a quiet thank you and smiled.
ex.zh: 她輕聲道了謝，露出微笑。

ex.en: A murmur of concern spread through the audience as the proposed library closures were announced.
ex.zh: 擬議的圖書館關閉計劃公佈時，聽眾中傳出一陣擔憂的低語。

col: a murmur of approval｜低聲贊同
words.tip: 強調輕柔低聲；mutter常帶不滿或含糊的意味。

tr: n. 標準度量, 計量器
vt. 精確計量, 估計
[計] 線規
估計；判斷；測量
測量儀；計量器
def: n. a measuring instrument for measuring and indicating a quantity such as the thickness of wire or the amount of rain etc.
n. accepted or approved instance or example of a quantity or quality against which others are judged or measured or compared
n. the distance between the rails of a railway or between the wheels of a train

ex.en: I dipped a toe in to gauge the water temperature.
ex.zh: 我把一隻腳趾伸進水裡，試了試水溫。

ex.en: Governments often use household surveys to gauge public satisfaction with healthcare, education, and other essential services.
ex.zh: 政府常通過住戶調查瞭解公眾對醫療、教育及其他基本服務的滿意程度。

col: gauge public opinion｜瞭解公眾意見
words.tip: 讀音同gage；既可用儀器測量，也可憑信息判斷。

tr: n. 戶口普查
vt. 實施統計調查
人口普查
def: n. a periodic count of the population
v. conduct a census
an official count of people that collects information about them

ex.en: We completed the census form at our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我們在廚房餐桌旁填好了人口普查表。

ex.en: Census data help governments plan housing, schools and healthcare services according to changing population needs.
ex.zh: 人口普查數據幫助政府根據不斷變化的人口需求規劃住房、學校和醫療服務。

col: conduct a census｜開展人口普查
a national census｜全國人口普查
words.tip: census調查全部人口，sample survey只抽樣。

tr: vt. 居住於, 佔據, 棲息
居住於；棲息於
def: v. be present in
To live in a particular place or environment

ex.en: Tiny crabs inhabit the rock pools near our house.
ex.zh: 我們家附近的岩石潮池裡棲息著小螃蟹。

ex.en: Many species that inhabit tropical forests face increasing pressure as agricultural expansion reduces the area of suitable habitat.
ex.zh: 隨著農業擴張使適宜棲息地縮小，許多棲息在熱帶森林中的物種面臨越來越大的壓力。

col: inhabit coastal waters｜棲息於近海水域
densely inhabited areas｜人口密集地區
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接地點，不加in。

tr: n. 配額, 限額
[化] 定額
配額；限額
def: n. a prescribed number
n. a proportional share assigned to each participant
n. a limitation on imports

ex.en: Our team reached its monthly sales quota yesterday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們團隊昨天下午完成了本月的銷售指標。

ex.en: Fishing quotas can protect marine populations, provided that governments monitor catches and enforce the limits consistently.
ex.zh: 只要政府監測捕撈量並始終嚴格執行限額，捕撈配額就能保護海洋生物種群。

col: meet a quota｜完成配額指標
words.tip: 既可指允許的上限，也可指必須完成的指標。

tr: n. 大步, 步幅, 步態, 進步
v. 邁大步走, 跨過, 跨
大步走
大步；步幅
顯著進展
def: n. significant progress (especially in the phrase "make strides")
v. walk with long steps
v. cover or traverse by taking long steps

ex.en: Leila strode across the platform to catch her train.
ex.zh: 萊拉大步穿過站臺去趕火車。

ex.en: Many countries have made significant strides in improving access to primary education over recent decades.
ex.zh: 近幾十年來，許多國家在擴大初等教育機會方面取得了顯著進展。

col: stride across a room｜大步穿過房間
make great strides｜取得巨大進展
take something in your stride｜從容應對某事
words.tip: 過去式strode，過去分詞stridden；進展常用strides。

tr: n. 摘錄
v. 引用, 摘錄
def: n. a passage selected from a larger work
v. take out of a literary work in order to cite or copy

tr: n. 縮圖, 小畫像
a. 小規模的, 纖小的
微型的；縮小的
微縮模型；微型畫
def: n. painting or drawing included in a book (especially in illuminated medieval manuscripts)
n. a copy that reproduces a person or thing in greatly reduced size
s. being on a very small scale

ex.en: My cousin built a miniature castle from spare wood.
ex.zh: 我表親用剩餘木料做了一座微型城堡。

ex.en: Architects often use miniature models to demonstrate how proposed buildings will fit into existing urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 建築師常用微縮模型展示擬建建築將如何融入現有城市街區。

words.tip: in miniature 表示“以縮小的形式”。

tr: n. 勘漏, 失察, 失敗, 照料
[經] 監督權
疏忽；遺漏
監督；監管
def: n. an unintentional omission resulting from failure to notice something
n. a mistake resulting from inattention
A mistake caused by failing to notice or consider something.

ex.en: Through an oversight, I left your lunch at home.
ex.zh: 由於一時疏忽，我把你的午餐落在家裡了。

ex.en: Independent oversight of public spending can reduce corruption and strengthen citizens' confidence in government institutions.
ex.zh: 對公共支出進行獨立監督可以減少腐敗，並增強公民對政府機構的信任。

col: an unfortunate oversight｜令人遺憾的疏忽
words.tip: 作“疏忽”通常可數；作“監督”通常不可數。

tr: n. 一致, 調和, 協定
vt. 給與, 使一致
vi. 相符合
正式協議
一致；協調
def: n. concurrence of opinion
n. sympathetic compatibility
v. allow to have

ex.en: The two clubs reached an accord over sharing equipment.
ex.zh: 兩傢俱樂部就共用器材達成了協議。

ex.en: An international accord on emissions could encourage countries to adopt cleaner technologies and protect vulnerable ecosystems.
ex.zh: 一項關於排放的國際協議可以鼓勵各國採用更清潔的技術，並保護脆弱的生態系統。

col: accord equal rights｜給予平等權利
words.tip: of your own accord意為自願地，無需別人要求。

tr: n. 棲木, 高位, 杆, 河鱸
v. (使)棲息, 就位, 位於, (使)暫歇
def: n. support consisting of a branch or rod that serves as a resting place (especially for a bird)
n. a linear measure of 16.5 feet
n. a square rod of land

tr: n. 聖地, 神龕, 廟
vt. 將...置於神龕內
def: n. a place of worship hallowed by association with some sacred thing or person

tr: conj. 儘管, 雖然
def: conj. Even though; although; notwithstanding.

tr: n. 模子, 模型, 黴
v. 形成, 塑造, 發黴
模具；鑄模
塑造；使成形
黴；黴菌
def: n. container into which liquid is poured to create a given shape when it hardens
n. loose soil rich in organic matter
n. a fungus that produces a superficial growth on various kinds of damp or decaying organic matter

ex.en: Pour the melted chocolate into the mold carefully.
ex.zh: 把融化的巧克力小心倒入模具中。

ex.en: Early experiences can mold children's attitudes towards education and influence their confidence throughout their school years.
ex.zh: 早期經歷能夠塑造兒童對教育的態度，並影響他們整個求學階段的自信心。

words.tip: 美式拼寫mold，英式通常寫mould；也指黴菌。

tr: vt. 使沉溺, 使上癮
n. 入迷的人, 上癮者
def: n. someone who is so ardently devoted to something that it resembles an addiction
n. someone who is physiologically dependent on a substance; abrupt deprivation of the substance produces withdrawal symptoms
v. to cause (someone or oneself) to become dependent (on something, especially a narcotic drug)

tr: a. 邊緣的, 最低限度的, 有旁註的
[醫] 緣的
微小的；不重要的
邊緣的；非核心的
勉強合格的
def: s. producing at a rate that barely covers production costs
very small in amount, effect, or importance
outside the main or central part of something

ex.en: The new tyres made only a marginal difference.
ex.zh: 新輪胎帶來的變化微乎其微。

ex.en: Despite substantial investment, the programme produced only marginal improvements in public transport reliability across the city.
ex.zh: 儘管投入了大量資金，該項目對全市公共交通可靠性的改善仍十分有限。

words.tip: 表示變化時指幅度很小，不是完全沒有變化。

tr: n. 冰雹, 致敬, 歡呼, 招呼
vt. 向...歡呼, 致敬, 招呼, 使象下雹樣落下
vi. 招呼, 下雹
interj. 萬歲, 歡迎
冰雹
def: n. precipitation of ice pellets when there are strong rising air currents
n. many objects thrown forcefully through the air
n. enthusiastic greeting

ex.en: Hail rattled against the windows during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨中，冰雹打在窗戶上，發出噼啪聲。

ex.en: Scientists hailed the new irrigation system as a breakthrough that could help farmers conserve water during droughts.
ex.zh: 科學家稱讚這套新灌溉系統是一項突破，能幫助農民在乾旱期間節約用水。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租車
be hailed as a breakthrough｜被譽為一項突破
words.tip: 下冰雹用it hails；hail A as B指稱讚A為B。

tr: a. 天真的, 純真的, 幼稚的
天真的；輕信的
def: a. marked by or showing unaffected simplicity and lack of guile or worldly experience
s. inexperienced
Too willing to trust because of limited experience.

ex.en: I was naive to believe the repair would cost nothing.
ex.zh: 我竟以為維修不用花錢，真是太天真了。

ex.en: It would be naive to assume that economic growth alone can solve every social problem.
ex.zh: 認為單靠經濟增長就能解決所有社會問題，是不切實際的。

words.tip: 常含缺乏經驗、容易輕信之意，並非單純褒義。

tr: vt. 發揮, 運用, 施以影響
[法] 施加, 產生, 行使
施加；運用
使自己努力；盡力
def: v. put to use
v. make a great effort at a mental or physical task
To apply force, influence, or authority.

ex.en: You must exert steady pressure to open this lid.
ex.zh: 你得持續用力才能打開這個蓋子。

ex.en: Parents can exert considerable influence on children's eating habits by preparing balanced meals at home.
ex.zh: 父母可以通過在家準備營養均衡的飯菜，對孩子的飲食習慣產生很大影響。

words.tip: 常接pressure、influence；exert oneself意為盡力。

tr: n. 證明
[經] 證明
認證；資格證明
def: n. the act of certifying or bestowing a franchise on
Official confirmation that someone or something meets required standards.

ex.en: The swimming instructor proudly showed us her new certification.
ex.zh: 游泳教練自豪地向我們展示了她新取得的資格證明。

ex.en: Independent certification helps consumers identify products that meet recognised environmental standards throughout the production process.
ex.zh: 獨立認證幫助消費者識別在整個生產過程中符合公認環保標準的產品。

words.tip: certification重認證；certificate常指證書本身。

tr: n. 大圓石
[機] 圓石, 漂石
def: n. a large smooth mass of rock detached from its place of origin
n. a town in north central Colorado; Rocky Mountains resort center and university town

tr: n. 穀類食品, 穀類植物
a. 穀類的
早餐麥片
穀物；穀類作物
def: n. grass whose starchy grains are used as food: wheat; rice; rye; oats; maize; buckwheat; millet
n. a breakfast food prepared from grain
a. made of grain or relating to grain or the plants that produce it

ex.en: She poured cold milk over her bowl of cereal.
ex.zh: 她把冷牛奶倒進盛著早餐麥片的碗裡。

ex.en: Farmers may need to grow different cereal crops as changing rainfall patterns affect agricultural production.
ex.zh: 隨著降雨模式變化影響農業生產，農民可能需要種植不同的穀類作物。

col: a bowl of cereal｜一碗麥片
words.tip: 早餐食品泛指時常不可數；指穀物種類可用cereals。

tr: n. 破碎, 骨折
v. (使)破碎, (使)破裂
def: n. breaking of hard tissue such as bone
n. the act of cracking something
v. violate or abuse

tr: a. 有感覺的, 敏感的, 明智的
[醫] 可感覺的
明智的；合乎情理的
def: a. able to feel or perceive
s. readily perceived by the senses
s. aware intuitively or intellectually of something sensed

ex.en: Taking an umbrella was sensible in this weather.
ex.zh: 這種天氣帶把傘是明智的。

ex.en: Investing in preventive healthcare is a sensible way to reduce pressure on public hospitals over time.
ex.zh: 投資預防性醫療是逐步減輕公立醫院壓力的明智之舉。

words.tip: sensible指明智的；sensitive指敏感的。

tr: n. 大片土地, 地帶, 小冊子
[醫] 束, 道
大片土地；地帶
道；束等身體結構
宣教或政論小冊子
def: n. an extended area of land
n. a system of body parts that together serve some particular purpose
n. a brief treatise on a subject of interest; published in the form of a booklet

ex.en: They bought a small cottage beside a vast tract of woodland.
ex.zh: 他們在一大片林地旁買了一棟小屋。

ex.en: Large tracts of forest must be protected to preserve biodiversity and regulate the global climate.
ex.zh: 必須保護大片森林，以維護生物多樣性並調節全球氣候。

col: a tract of land｜一大片土地
vast tracts of forest｜大片森林
words.tip: 土地義常用a tract of；勿與track“軌道”混淆。

tr: n. 後裔, 子孫
a. 傳下的, 下降的
後裔；子孫
衍生事物；後繼形式
def: n. a person considered as descended from some ancestor or race
s. going or coming down
s. proceeding by descent from an ancestor

ex.en: Her descendants still live in the old family farmhouse.
ex.zh: 她的後代仍住在家族的老農舍裡。

ex.en: Preserving traditional crafts allows descendants of local communities to maintain meaningful connections with their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 保護傳統工藝能讓當地社區的後代與自身文化遺產保持有意義的聯繫。

words.tip: descendant是後代；ancestor是祖先。

tr: n. 塊, 瘤, 很多, 腫塊, 笨人
vt. 使成塊狀, 混在一起
vi. 結塊
塊；團
腫塊
def: v. put together indiscriminately
A solid piece without a regular shape.
A swelling under the skin or in body tissue.

ex.en: She dropped a lump of clay onto the table.
ex.zh: 她把一團黏土放到了桌子上。

ex.en: Policymakers should not lump all unemployed people together, as their circumstances and support needs vary considerably.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不應把所有失業者一概而論，因為他們的處境和援助需求差異很大。

col: a lump of clay｜一團黏土
a lump sum｜一次性支付的款項
lump together｜不加區別地歸為一類
a lump in your throat｜哽咽感
words.tip: lump together常暗示忽略差異，籠統歸類。

tr: n. 衝突, 撞擊聲, 牴觸
vi. 衝突, 牴觸
vt. 使發出撞擊聲
[計] 對撞
衝突；時間撞期
def: n. a state of conflict between persons
n. a state of conflict between colors
v. be incompatible; be or come into conflict

ex.en: My dentist appointment clashes with our weekly team meeting.
ex.zh: 我預約的看牙時間與每週的團隊會議撞期了。

ex.en: A clash between economic priorities and environmental goals can delay decisions about major infrastructure projects.
ex.zh: 經濟優先事項與環境目標之間的衝突可能延誤重大基礎設施項目的決策。

col: a clash of interests｜利益衝突
a clash of cymbals｜鐃鈸撞擊聲
words.tip: clash with可指時間衝突、意見相左或顏色不搭。

tr: n. 哺乳動物
[化] 哺乳動物
哺乳動物
def: n. any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk
A warm-blooded animal whose females produce milk for their young.

ex.en: A dolphin is a mammal, even though it lives underwater.
ex.zh: 海豚雖然生活在水下，卻是哺乳動物。

ex.en: Protecting marine mammals requires international cooperation because these animals often migrate across the waters of several countries.
ex.zh: 保護海洋哺乳動物需要國際合作，因為這些動物經常跨越多個國家的水域遷徙。

words.tip: 鯨和海豚也是哺乳動物；不能按棲息地判斷。

tr: n. 結構, 表面配置, 外形, 配置
[計] 配置
def: n. an arrangement of parts or elements

tr: a. 聲名狼藉的, 臭名昭著的, 眾人皆知的
臭名昭著的；聲名狼藉的
def: s known widely and usually unfavorably;
widely known for something bad or undesirable

ex.en: That road is notorious for its deep potholes.
ex.zh: 那條路因坑窪很深而出了名。

ex.en: Cities notorious for severe air pollution often struggle to attract skilled workers and develop sustainable tourism.
ex.zh: 因嚴重空氣汙染而臭名昭著的城市往往難以吸引技術人才和發展可持續旅遊業。

words.tip: 通常含貶義；著名但非負面用famous，不宜用notorious。

tr: n. 混合物, 堆肥
vt. 施堆肥於
def: n. a mixture of decaying vegetation and manure; used as a fertilizer
v. convert to compost

tr: a. 致命的
n. 致死因子
致命的
def: s of an instrument of certain death
able to cause death

ex.en: Some wild mushrooms contain toxins that can be lethal.
ex.zh: 有些野生蘑菇含有可能致命的毒素。

ex.en: Exposure to lethal concentrations of air pollutants highlights the importance of strict industrial safety regulations.
ex.zh: 接觸致命濃度的空氣汙染物，凸顯了嚴格工業安全法規的重要性。

words.tip: 通常作形容詞；lethal 強調具有致死能力。

tr: vt. 使成為必需, 需要, 使承擔, 遺傳給
n. 限定繼承
必然涉及；需要
def: n. land received by fee tail
n. the act of entailing property; the creation of a fee tail from a fee simple
v. have as a logical consequence

ex.en: This new job entails working some evenings and weekends.
ex.zh: 這份新工作需要在一些晚上和週末上班。

ex.en: Expanding public transport will entail substantial initial costs, although the environmental and social benefits may justify this investment.
ex.zh: 擴建公共交通必然涉及大量前期費用，但其環境和社會效益可能使這項投資值得。

words.tip: 後接名詞或動名詞：entail doing，不接to do。

tr: n. 漩渦, 渦動
vt. 使成漩渦
vi. 打漩, 盤繞, 眩暈
旋轉；使打旋
旋渦；螺旋狀圖案
def: n the shape of something rotating rapidly
v turn in a twisting or spinning motion
v flow in a circular current, of liquids

ex.en: Dry leaves swirled around my feet in the wind.
ex.zh: 乾枯的樹葉在風中繞著我的腳打轉。

ex.en: Dust can swirl through urban streets during construction, reducing air quality and causing discomfort for nearby residents.
ex.zh: 施工時，灰塵可能在城市街道中盤旋，降低空氣質量，並讓附近居民感到不適。

col: a swirl of smoke｜一縷盤旋的煙
words.tip: 可作及物或不及物動詞，強調流動中的旋轉。

tr: n. 繼承人, 嗣子, 後嗣
[法] 繼承人, 後嗣
def: n. a person who is entitled by law or by the terms of a will to inherit the estate of another

tr: n. 抵消, 把...並列, 旁系, 支管, 用膠印法印
vt. 彌補, 抵消, 膠印
vi. 裝支管
n. 偏移量
[計] 偏移量
def: n. a plate makes an inked impression on a rubber-blanketed cylinder, which in turn transfers it to the paper
v. compensate for or counterbalance
v. cause (printed matter) to transfer or smear onto another surface

ex.en: My shorter commute offsets the higher rent here.
ex.zh: 通勤時間縮短彌補了這裡租金較高的不足。

ex.en: Planting trees can offset some carbon emissions, but reducing fossil fuel consumption remains essential.
ex.zh: 植樹可以抵消一部分碳排放，但減少化石燃料消耗仍然至關重要。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞仍為offset；現在分詞為offsetting。

tr: n. 聯繫, 從屬關係
[醫] 父權(判定私生兒的父親)
def: n. a social or business relationship
n. the act of becoming formally connected or joined

tr: n. 小行星, 海盤車
a. 星狀的
def: n. any of numerous small celestial bodies composed of rock and metal that move around the sun (mainly between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter)
s. shaped like a star

tr: n. 沉思, 冥想
冥想；靜坐
沉思；深思
def: n. continuous and profound contemplation or musing on a subject or series of subjects of a deep or abstruse nature
n. (religion) contemplation of spiritual matters (usually on religious or philosophical subjects)
The practice of focusing attention to calm and train the mind.

ex.en: Ten minutes of meditation helps me relax before bed.
ex.zh: 睡前冥想十分鐘能幫助我放鬆。

ex.en: Some schools offer meditation sessions to help students manage stress and improve their ability to concentrate.
ex.zh: 一些學校開設冥想課程，幫助學生緩解壓力並提高專注力。

words.tip: 指冥想練習時通常不可數；meditation on可指對某事的沉思。

tr: n. 傾覆, 破滅, 革命
vt. 推翻, 顛倒
vi. 翻倒
def: n. an improbable and unexpected victory
v. turn from an upright or normal position
v. cause to overturn from an upright or normal position

tr: a. 緊湊的, 緊密的, 簡潔的
vt. 使緊密結合, 壓縮
vi. 變堅實
def: n. a small cosmetics case with a mirror; to be carried in a woman's purse
n. a small and economical car
v. have the property of being packable or of compacting easily

tr: vt. 授予權力, 允許, 使能夠
[法] 授權, 准許, 轉委
使有能力；增強自主權
授權
def: v. give or delegate power or authority to
Give someone confidence or control over their own life.
Give someone official authority to take particular action.

ex.en: Learning to cook empowered him to live independently.
ex.zh: 學會做飯讓他能夠獨立生活。

ex.en: Access to reliable information can empower citizens to make informed decisions about their health.
ex.zh: 獲取可靠信息可以使公民有能力對自身健康作出明智決定。

col: empower communities｜增強社區自主能力
empower someone to act｜授權某人採取行動
words.tip: 常用empower sb to do sth，表示賦能或授權。

tr: vi. 繁榮, 茂盛, 活躍, 手舞足蹈
vt. 揮舞, 誇耀
n. 揮舞, 炫耀, 茂盛, 興旺, 華麗詞藻
繁榮；茁壯成長
揮舞以引人注意
def: n. a showy gesture
n. an ornamental embellishment in writing
n. a display of ornamental speech or language

ex.en: These herbs flourish on our warm, sunny kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 這些香草在我們廚房溫暖、陽光充足的窗臺上長得很旺。

ex.en: Small businesses are more likely to flourish when local governments provide affordable premises and reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 地方政府提供價格合理的經營場所和可靠的公共交通時，小企業更容易蓬勃發展。

col: a flourishing business｜生意興隆的企業
with a flourish｜以誇張的動作
words.tip: 表繁榮時是不及物動詞，不直接接賓語。

tr: n. 團結, 團結一致, 共同一致
[法] 團結, 共同責任
團結；相互支持
def: n. a union of interests or purposes or sympathies among members of a group
Unity and mutual support among people with shared interests.

ex.en: Neighbours showed solidarity by repairing the damaged playground together.
ex.zh: 鄰居們一起修復受損的遊樂場，體現了團結精神。

ex.en: Community projects can strengthen social solidarity by bringing residents from different backgrounds together to solve shared problems.
ex.zh: 社區項目能讓不同背景的居民共同解決問題，從而增強社會凝聚力。

words.tip: 常接with，表示與某人或群體團結一致。

tr: vt. 卸下, 放出, 解僱, 拔染, 履行, 放電
vi. 卸貨, 流出
n. 卸貨, 流出, 放電
def: n. the sudden giving off of energy
n. the act of venting
n. a substance that is emitted or released

tr: n. 發現, 察覺, 探測
[計] 檢波; 檢測
發現；探測；檢測
def: n. the perception that something has occurred or some state exists
n. the act of detecting something; catching sight of something
n. a police investigation to determine the perpetrator

ex.en: Early detection of the leak saved us expensive repairs.
ex.zh: 及早發現漏水，省去了我們高昂的維修費用。

ex.en: Advances in medical imaging have improved the early detection of diseases, allowing patients to receive treatment sooner.
ex.zh: 醫學影像技術的進步改善了疾病的早期檢測，使患者能夠更早接受治療。

words.tip: 通常不可數；detection of後接被發現或檢測的對象。

tr: n. 鞍, 馬鞍, 車座, 鞍狀物
vt. 裝以馬鞍, 使負擔
vi. 跨上馬鞍
馬鞍；自行車座
給馬裝鞍
def: n. a seat for the rider of a horse or camel
n. cut of meat (especially mutton or lamb) consisting of part of the backbone and both loins
n. a piece of leather across the instep of a shoe

ex.en: I lowered the saddle before riding my new bicycle.
ex.zh: 騎新自行車之前，我把車座調低了。

ex.en: Excessive university fees can saddle graduates with debts that limit their career choices for many years.
ex.zh: 過高的大學學費可能讓畢業生揹負債務，多年來限制他們的職業選擇。

col: be saddled with debt｜揹負債務
words.tip: saddle someone with指使某人承擔不想要的負擔。

tr: a. 永久的, 永恆的, 持久的
n. 厚實斜紋織物
持久的；長久的
def: s. lasting a long time without change
continuing to exist or have an effect for a long time

ex.en: Our camping trip left me with lasting memories.
ex.zh: 那次露營給我留下了長久難忘的回憶。

ex.en: Investment in early childhood education can bring lasting benefits to individuals and society as a whole.
ex.zh: 投資幼兒教育可以為個人和整個社會帶來長遠益處。

words.tip: lasting強調持續很久，不一定像permanent那樣永久。

tr: n. 發生, 事件, 出現
[醫] 發生
發生的事；事件
發生；出現
def: n. an instance of something occurring
something that happens, especially something noticeable
the fact of something happening or being present

ex.en: Power cuts are a rare occurrence in our village.
ex.zh: 我們村很少停電。

ex.en: Improved drainage systems can reduce the occurrence of flooding in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 改進排水系統可以減少人口稠密城區的洪澇發生。

col: a frequent occurrence｜經常發生的事
the occurrence of disease｜疾病的發生
words.tip: 事件義可數；發生義不可數；注意雙寫rr。

tr: n. 黨羽, 虔誠信徒, 同黨, 游擊隊員
a. 黨派的, 偏袒的, 效忠的, 獻身的, 盲目推崇的
def: n. a fervent and even militant proponent of something
n. a pike with a long tapering double-edged blade with lateral projections; 16th and 17th centuries
a. devoted to a cause or party

tr: a. 俯伏的, 面向下的, 有...傾向的
[醫] 旋前的, 伏的, 俯的
易於遭受的；有傾向的
俯臥的
def: s. having a tendency (to); often used in combination
s. lying face downward
Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way

ex.en: My skin is prone to dryness in cold weather.
ex.zh: 我的皮膚在寒冷天氣裡容易乾燥。

ex.en: Coastal settlements are increasingly prone to flooding as sea levels rise and extreme storms become more frequent.
ex.zh: 隨著海平面上升和極端風暴日益頻繁，沿海居民區越來越容易遭受洪災。

words.tip: prone to後接名詞或動名詞，通常指不好的情況。

tr: a. 巨大的, 優秀的, 可怕的, 艱難的
def: s. extremely impressive in strength or excellence
s. inspiring fear

tr: a. 精力充沛的, 元氣旺盛的, 茁壯的, 有力的
def: s. characterized by forceful and energetic action or activity
s. strong and active physically or mentally

tr: n. 平衡, 均衡, 姿勢, 鎮靜, 安靜, 砝碼
vt. 使平衡, 使懸著, 保持...姿勢
vi. 平衡, 懸著, 準備好
def: n. a cgs unit of dynamic viscosity equal to one dyne-second per square centimeter; the viscosity of a fluid in which a force of one dyne per square centimeter maintains a velocity of 1 centimeter per second
n. a state of being balanced in a stable equilibrium
v. be motionless, in suspension

tr: a. 丈夫的, 婚姻的, 夫婦間的
[醫] 婚姻的
def: a. of or relating to the state of marriage

tr: a. 邪惡的, 墮落的, 品性不端的, 惡毒的, 惡性的, 有錯誤的
[醫] 缺點的, 惡的
兇猛的；殘暴的
惡毒的；惡意的
def: s (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
s having the nature of vice
s bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

ex.en: A vicious dog growled behind the tall metal fence.
ex.zh: 一隻兇猛的狗在高高的金屬圍欄後低吼。

ex.en: Vicious comments on social media can damage young people's confidence and discourage participation in online discussions.
ex.zh: 社交媒體上的惡毒評論可能損害年輕人的自信，使他們不願參與網上討論。

words.tip: vicious circle指問題互相加劇的“惡性循環”。

tr: a. 藥學的, 製藥的, 藥用的, 藥物的, 藥劑師的, 藥師的
n. 藥品, 成藥, 藥劑
製藥的；藥物的
藥品
def: n. drug or medicine that is prepared or dispensed in pharmacies and used in medical treatment
a. of or relating to pharmacy or pharmacists
a. of or relating to drugs used in medical treatment

ex.en: My sister works in a pharmaceutical research laboratory.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家藥物研究實驗室工作。

ex.en: Pharmaceutical companies should ensure that essential medicines remain affordable for patients in poorer communities.
ex.zh: 製藥公司應確保較貧困社區的患者仍能負擔得起基本藥物。

words.tip: 作名詞常用複數 pharmaceuticals，泛指藥品。

tr: n. 原型
[計] 樣機; 原型
原型；樣機
製作原型
def: n. a standard or typical example
An early model used to test and develop a product.
To create an early model for testing and improvement.

ex.en: The designer showed us a prototype of her folding chair.
ex.zh: 設計師向我們展示了她設計的摺疊椅樣品。

ex.en: Testing a prototype allows engineers to identify design weaknesses before a product enters mass production.
ex.zh: 測試原型讓工程師能在產品投入大規模生產前發現設計缺陷。

col: a working prototype｜可運行的原型
words.tip: 通常指用於測試改進的早期模型，並非最終產品。

tr: vt. 發出, 放射, 發表(意見等), 散發, 發行
[化] 放射
排放；發出
def: v. expel (gases or odors)
v. give off, send forth, or discharge; as of light, heat, or radiation, vapor, etc.
to release gas, heat, light, or sound

ex.en: These small lamps emit a soft, warm light.
ex.zh: 這些小燈發出柔和溫暖的光。

ex.en: Factories that emit harmful gases should install cleaner technology to reduce their impact on public health.
ex.zh: 排放有害氣體的工廠應安裝更清潔的技術設備，以減少對公眾健康的影響。

col: emit greenhouse gases｜排放溫室氣體
words.tip: 過去式 emitted，進行式 emitting，均雙寫 t。

tr: n. 輕視, 輕蔑
[法] 藐視, 侮辱, 輕視
輕蔑；鄙視
藐視法庭
def: n. lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
n. a manner that is generally disrespectful and contemptuous
n. open disrespect for a person or thing

ex.en: He showed contempt for my suggestion by laughing.
ex.zh: 他用嘲笑來表示對我建議的輕蔑。

ex.en: When officials treat public concerns with contempt, trust in democratic institutions can decline significantly.
ex.zh: 當官員輕視公眾的關切時，人們對民主制度的信任可能顯著下降。

col: treat someone with contempt｜輕蔑地對待某人
words.tip: contempt for指鄙視某人或某事；通常不可數。

tr: n. 功效, 效力
[醫] 效能, 功效, 效驗
def: n. capacity or power to produce a desired effect

tr: n. 人類學家
def: n. a social scientist who specializes in anthropology

tr: v. 大叫, 呼喊, 大聲叫
驚叫；大聲說
def: v. utter aloud; often with surprise, horror, or joy
to say something suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion

ex.en: “What a beautiful rainbow!” she exclaimed, pointing towards the hills.
ex.zh: “多美的彩虹啊！”她指著群山驚歎道。

ex.en: Visitors often exclaim in surprise when museum displays reveal the impressive engineering skills of ancient societies.
ex.zh: 當博物館展品展現古代社會令人讚歎的工程技藝時，參觀者往往驚歎不已。

words.tip: 強調因強烈情緒突然出聲，常用於引述話語。

tr: n. 獸穴, 洞穴
[法] 匪巢, 賊窩
def: n. a unit of 8 to 10 cub scouts
n. a room that is comfortable and secluded

tr: a. 不利的, 敵對的, 相反的, 逆的
[法] 相反的, 敵對的, 逆的
不利的；有害的；惡劣的
def: s. contrary to your interests or welfare
s. in an opposing direction
Harmful or making success and progress more difficult.

ex.en: Our ferry was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
ex.zh: 由於天氣惡劣，我們的渡輪航班取消了。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can have adverse effects on residents' sleep and mental health.
ex.zh: 長期接觸交通噪聲可能對居民的睡眠和心理健康產生不良影響。

col: adverse weather conditions｜惡劣天氣狀況
words.tip: adverse指不利的；averse指反感的，常接to。

tr: n. 外地人, 粗野的人
a. 省的, 外地的, 偏狹的
省的；省級的
外省的；地方的
狹隘守舊的
def: n. (Roman Catholic Church) an official in charge of an ecclesiastical province acting under the superior general of a religious order
a. of or associated with a province
a. characteristic of the provinces or their people

ex.en: She works at the provincial hospital near our home.
ex.zh: 她在我們家附近的省立醫院工作。

ex.en: Provincial governments can adapt national education policies to meet the specific needs of local communities.
ex.zh: 省級政府可以調整國家教育政策，以滿足當地社區的具體需求。

words.tip: 指省級時中性；形容人的觀念時可含貶義。

tr: v. 誇大, 誇張
def: v to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
v do something to an excessive degree

tr: n. 油酥點心, 麵粉糕餅
油酥麵糰；酥皮
酥皮糕點
def: n. a dough of flour and water and shortening
n. any of various baked foods made of dough or batter
Dough made with flour and fat for pies and similar foods.

ex.en: Roll the pastry thinly before covering the apple filling.
ex.zh: 先把酥皮擀薄，再蓋到蘋果餡上。

ex.en: Culinary courses teach students to prepare pastry while developing practical skills for careers in hospitality.
ex.zh: 烹飪課程教授學生製作酥皮，同時培養酒店餐飲業所需的實用技能。

col: roll out pastry｜擀開酥皮面團
words.tip: 指酥皮面團時不可數；指單個糕點時可數。

tr: n. 咯咯的笑聲, 輕笑
vi. 咯咯的笑, 咕咕叫
def: v. laugh quietly or with restraint

tr: n. 沼澤, 進退兩難的困境
vt. 淹沒, 擊潰, 清除, 使陷於沼澤
vi. 陷於沼澤, 淹沒
def: n. low land that is seasonally flooded; has more woody plants than a marsh and better drainage than a bog
n. a situation fraught with difficulties and imponderables
v. drench or submerge or be drenched or submerged

tr: a. 深思熟慮的, 故意的, 從容的
v. 仔細考慮
故意的；有意的
從容謹慎的
仔細考慮；商議
def: s. carefully thought out in advance
Done intentionally rather than by accident.
Slow and careful, rather than hurried.

ex.en: Leaving my phone at home was a deliberate choice.
ex.zh: 把手機留在家裡是我有意做出的選擇。

ex.en: Local authorities should deliberate carefully before approving developments that could permanently damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 地方政府在批准可能永久破壞自然棲息地的開發項目之前，應仔細斟酌。

col: deliberate on a proposal｜仔細考慮提案
words.tip: 形容詞末尾讀/ət/，動詞末尾讀/eɪt/。

tr: n. 餌
vt. 以餌引誘, 欺負
vi. 中途休息
餌；誘餌
給……放餌
def: n. anything that serves as an enticement
n. something used to lure fish or other animals into danger so they can be trapped or killed
v. lure, entice, or entrap with bait

ex.en: We used small pieces of bread as bait.
ex.zh: 我們用小塊麵包作魚餌。

ex.en: Some online advertisements use free gifts as bait to encourage consumers to share their personal information.
ex.zh: 一些網絡廣告用免費禮品作誘餌，誘使消費者分享個人信息。

words.tip: take the bait既可指魚咬鉤，也可比喻中計。

tr: n. 誓約, 誓言, 咒罵
[法] 誓言, 誓約, 宣誓
誓言；宣誓
def: n. a commitment to tell the truth (especially in a court of law); to lie under oath is to become subject to prosecution for perjury
n. a solemn promise, usually invoking a divine witness, regarding your future acts or behavior
A formal promise to tell the truth or fulfil a duty.

ex.en: The witness took an oath before answering any questions.
ex.zh: 證人在回答任何問題之前先宣了誓。

ex.en: Public officials who swear an oath to serve society should remain accountable for their decisions and conduct.
ex.zh: 宣誓為社會服務的公職人員應對自己的決策和行為負責。

words.tip: under oath指已宣誓說真話，常用於法庭語境。

tr: n. 封港令, 禁運
vt. 禁止出入港口, 禁運
def: n. a government order imposing a trade barrier
v. ban the publication of (documents), as for security or copyright reasons
v. prevent commerce

tr: a. 直立的, 豎立的, 筆直的
vt. 使豎立, 使直立, 樹立, 建立
vi. 勃起
搭建；豎立
直立的；挺直的
def: a. upright in position or posture
to build something or put it in an upright position
standing straight up rather than bending or lying down

ex.en: We erected our tent beside the lake before sunset.
ex.zh: 日落前，我們在湖邊搭好了帳篷。

ex.en: Local authorities plan to erect temporary shelters for families whose homes were damaged by severe flooding.
ex.zh: 地方政府計劃搭建臨時住所，安置房屋因嚴重洪災受損的家庭。

words.tip: 動詞比 build 正式；形容詞常見於 stand erect。

tr: vt. 深植, 灌輸, 嵌入
n. 植入物, 植入管
def: n. a prosthesis placed permanently in tissue
v. fix or set securely or deeply
v. become attached to and embedded in the uterus

tr: n. 缺乏, 不足
[醫] 缺乏, 不足
缺乏；不足
缺陷；不足之處
def: n the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable
n lack of an adequate quantity or number
A lack of enough of something necessary.

ex.en: A blood test revealed that I had an iron deficiency.
ex.zh: 驗血結果顯示我缺鐵。

ex.en: Nutritional deficiency among children can affect physical growth and reduce their ability to concentrate at school.
ex.zh: 兒童營養不足可能影響身體發育，並降低他們在學校集中注意力的能力。

words.tip: 缺某物用deficiency in；具體缺陷常用複數。

tr: vt. 使模糊, 弄髒
vi. 弄髒, 模糊
使模糊；變模糊
模糊的影像；模糊的記憶
def: n. a hazy or indistinct representation
v. to make less distinct or clear
v. make dim or indistinct

ex.en: Tears blurred my vision as the train pulled away.
ex.zh: 火車駛離時，淚水模糊了我的視線。

ex.en: Working from home can blur the boundary between professional responsibilities and personal life, increasing stress.
ex.zh: 居家辦公可能模糊工作職責與個人生活之間的界限，增加壓力。

col: a blur of colour｜一片模糊的色彩
words.tip: 常指視線或界限模糊；不是“汙點”的常用譯法。

tr: n. 肥料, 促進發展者, 受精媒介物
[化] 肥料
肥料
def: n. any substance such as manure or a mixture of nitrates used to make soil more fertile
a substance added to soil to help plants grow

ex.en: We added fertilizer to help the tomato plants grow.
ex.zh: 我們施了肥，幫助番茄植株生長。

ex.en: Excessive use of chemical fertilizer can pollute nearby rivers and damage the ecosystems that depend on them.
ex.zh: 過量使用化肥會汙染附近河流，破壞依賴這些河流的生態系統。

words.tip: 英式也拼作fertiliser；泛指肥料時常不可數。

tr: n. 斜視眼, 斜著
a. 斜視的
vt. 使變斜視眼
vi. 斜視, 傾向, 斜行
def: n. the act of squinting; looking with the eyes partly closed
v. cross one's eyes as if in strabismus
v. be cross-eyed; have a squint or strabismus

tr: v. 區別, 區分
區分；辨別
使有別於
def: v. calculate a derivative; take the derivative
v. become different during development
v. become distinct and acquire a different character

ex.en: Can you differentiate these two birds by their songs?
ex.zh: 你能根據鳴叫聲分辨這兩種鳥嗎？

ex.en: Schools should teach students to differentiate between reliable evidence and unsupported claims in online media.
ex.zh: 學校應教學生區分網絡媒體中可靠的證據和缺乏依據的說法。

col: differentiate A from B｜區分甲與乙
words.tip: 常用differentiate between A and B。

tr: vi. 合作, 勾結
[法] 合作, 合著, 通敵
合作；協作
與敵方勾結
def: v. work together on a common enterprise of project
v. cooperate as a traitor
work with others to create or achieve something

ex.en: We collaborate on recipes for our weekend cooking club.
ex.zh: 我們一起為週末烹飪俱樂部設計食譜。

ex.en: Universities should collaborate with local businesses to develop practical solutions to regional environmental problems.
ex.zh: 大學應與當地企業合作，為區域環境問題制定切實可行的解決方案。

col: collaborate on a project｜合作開展項目
words.tip: 與某人合作用with；合作做某項目用on。

tr: n. 剩餘, 零料, 遺蹟
a. 剩餘的, 殘餘的
殘餘部分；遺蹟
布頭；零頭布料
def: n a small part or portion that remains after the main part no longer exists
n a piece of cloth that is left over after the rest has been used or sold
a small part remaining after most has disappeared or been removed

ex.en: Only a remnant of the old wall still stands.
ex.zh: 那堵舊牆只剩下一小段還立著。

ex.en: Protecting remnants of ancient woodland can preserve habitats that support rare species and maintain local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 保護古老林地的殘存部分，可以保留珍稀物種的棲息地並維護當地生物多樣性。

col: a remnant of the past｜過去的遺存
words.tip: 常用a remnant of；複數remnants強調殘留的各部分。

tr: n. 水泥, 膠結劑
vt. 膠合, 用水泥塗
vi. 黏牢
水泥
鞏固；加強
def: n. concrete pavement is sometimes referred to as cement
n. a building material that is a powder made of a mixture of calcined limestone and clay; used with water and sand or gravel to make concrete and mortar
n. something that hardens to act as adhesive material

ex.en: The builder mixed cement and water in a bucket.
ex.zh: 建築工人在桶裡攪拌水泥和水。

ex.en: Joint research projects can cement relationships between universities and encourage the exchange of scientific knowledge.
ex.zh: 聯合研究項目可以鞏固大學之間的關係，並促進科學知識的交流。

col: a bag of cement｜一袋水泥
words.tip: cement是水泥；concrete是含水泥、砂石的混凝土。

tr: a. 公有的, 公社的
[法] 公共的, 自治體的, 巴黎公社的
def: s. for or by a group rather than individuals
a. relating to a small administrative district or community

tr: n. 衝突, 干涉
[計] 干擾
干涉；干預
妨礙；干擾
信號干擾
def: n. (American football) blocking a player's path with your body
unwanted involvement in someone else's affairs or decisions
an action or influence that disrupts an activity or process

ex.en: I wanted to choose my clothes without anyone's interference.
ex.zh: 我想自己挑選衣服，不受任何人干涉。

ex.en: Universities need protection from political interference to ensure that research findings remain independent and credible.
ex.zh: 大學需要免受政治干預，以確保研究成果保持獨立和可信。

col: interference in domestic affairs｜干涉內政
interference with sleep｜對睡眠的干擾
words.tip: in多接事務指干涉；with多接活動指妨礙。

tr: n. 戰利品, 贓物, 獎品, 變質, 次品
vt. 損壞, 破壞, 溺愛
vi. 腐壞, 掠奪
破壞；糟蹋
溺愛；寵壞
def: n. (usually plural) valuables taken by violence (especially in war)
n. the act of spoiling something by causing damage to it
n. the act of stripping and taking by force

ex.en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
ex.zh: 請別告訴你姐姐，免得破壞這份驚喜。

ex.en: Poorly planned construction can spoil natural landscapes and reduce their appeal to both residents and tourists.
ex.zh: 規劃不當的建設會破壞自然景觀，降低其對居民和遊客的吸引力。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均可用spoiled或spoilt。

tr: n. 成熟, 完備, 到期
[醫] 成熟, 成熟期, 發育期
心智成熟；穩重
發育成熟
金融產品到期
def: n. state of being mature; full development
n. the date on which an obligation must be repaid
The ability to behave responsibly and make sensible judgments.

ex.en: Lena showed maturity by calmly admitting her mistake.
ex.zh: 莉娜冷靜地承認自己的錯誤，表現得很成熟。

ex.en: Schools can foster emotional maturity by encouraging students to resolve disagreements respectfully and consider different perspectives.
ex.zh: 學校可以鼓勵學生尊重他人地解決分歧並考慮不同觀點，從而促進其情緒成熟。

words.tip: 通常不可數；金融語境中at maturity表示到期時。

tr: vt. 毀壞
[法] 使荒廢, 毀滅, 掠奪
嚴重破壞；摧毀
使極度悲痛；使震驚
def: v. overwhelm or overpower
To cause very severe damage to a place or thing
To make someone feel extremely upset or shocked

ex.en: The storm devastated the village, leaving many homes damaged.
ex.zh: 暴風雨重創了村莊，許多房屋受損。

ex.en: Prolonged droughts can devastate agricultural communities by destroying crops and reducing the income available to farming households.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱會毀壞莊稼、減少農戶收入，給農業社區帶來沉重打擊。

col: devastate a region｜重創一個地區
devastate the economy｜嚴重破壞經濟
words.tip: 比damage程度重；也可指使人精神上受到重創。

tr: n. 子句, 條款
[計] 子句
條款
分句；從句
def: n. (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence
A separate condition or requirement in a legal document.
A group of words containing a subject and a verb.

ex.en: One clause in our lease allows us to keep pets.
ex.zh: 我們的租約中有一項條款允許養寵物。

ex.en: Employment contracts should include a clause that clearly defines workers' rights to paid leave and flexible working.
ex.zh: 勞動合同應包含明確規定員工帶薪休假和彈性工作權利的條款。

col: a clause in a contract｜合同中的條款
include a clause｜加入一項條款
words.tip: 語法中clause含主語和謂語；phrase通常不含。

tr: vi. 航行
vt. 航行於, 駕駛, 操縱, 使通過
導航；確定路線
瀏覽；查找信息
應對；設法處理
def: v. act as the navigator in a car, plane, or vessel and plan, direct, plot the path and position of the conveyance
v. direct carefully and safely
to find or direct the way to a destination

ex.en: We used a map to navigate the narrow streets.
ex.zh: 我們藉助地圖在狹窄的街道間找路。

ex.en: Clear website design helps users navigate public services and access essential information without unnecessary delays.
ex.zh: 清晰的網站設計幫助用戶查找公共服務並獲取必要信息，避免不必要的耽擱。

col: navigate through traffic｜穿行於車流中
navigate unfamiliar terrain｜在陌生地形中找路
words.tip: 可直接接地點或網站，也可用 navigate through。

tr: a. 獻身於某種事業的
[計] 委託的
def: a. bound or obligated, as under a pledge to a particular cause, action, or attitude

tr: a. 健康的, 強健的, 要用力氣的, 堅定的, 粗野的
[計] 健壯性
強健的；結實的
穩健可靠的
def: a. sturdy and strong in form, constitution, or construction
s. strong enough to withstand or overcome intellectual challenges or adversity
s. rough and crude

ex.en: These robust boots survived years of muddy country walks.
ex.zh: 這雙結實的靴子經受住了多年鄉間泥路行走的考驗。

ex.en: Governments need robust evidence before introducing policies that could significantly affect public health and household spending.
ex.zh: 政府在推行可能顯著影響公眾健康和家庭開支的政策前，需要有可靠的證據。

words.tip: 既形容身體或物品結實，也形容證據、系統可靠。

tr: n. 附件, 零件, 附加物, 從犯, 同謀
a. 附屬的, 補充的, 同謀的, 幫兇的, 非主要的, 副的
[計] 附件
配件；附件
服飾配件
def: n. clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing
n. a supplementary component that improves capability
n. someone who helps another person commit a crime

ex.en: This small camera accessory keeps my photos steady.
ex.zh: 這個小巧的相機配件能讓我拍照時保持穩定。

ex.en: Consumers often replace electronic accessories unnecessarily, increasing waste and demand for raw materials worldwide.
ex.zh: 消費者常常在沒有必要的情況下更換電子配件，增加了廢棄物和全球對原材料的需求。

col: an accessory to a crime｜犯罪的從犯
words.tip: 配件常用複數accessories；從犯後常接to。

tr: vt. 憤恨, 憎惡, 怨恨
def: v. feel bitter or indignant about

tr: n. 階地, 梯田, 房屋之平頂, 陽臺, 沿岸防地, 露臺
a. 疊層式的
vt. 使成梯田, 使成有平臺屋頂
露臺；室外平臺
梯田；階地
def: n. a level shelf of land interrupting a declivity (with steep slopes above and below)
n. a row of houses built in a similar style and having common dividing walls (or the street on which they face)
v. provide (a house) with a terrace

ex.en: We had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the garden.
ex.zh: 我們在俯瞰花園的露臺上吃了早餐。

ex.en: Farmers maintain each terrace carefully to reduce soil erosion and grow crops on steep mountain slopes.
ex.zh: 農民精心維護每一級梯田，以減少水土流失，並在陡峭的山坡上種植作物。

col: a sunny terrace｜陽光充足的露臺
a terrace of houses｜一排連棟房屋
words.tip: 露臺通常是較大的室外平臺，不等同於balcony。

tr: a. 瑣碎的, 小規模的, 小氣的, 委瑣的
[經] 小額的, 微小的, 小規模的
瑣碎的；不重要的
小心眼的；斤斤計較的
輕微的；小規模的
def: s. contemptibly narrow in outlook
Too small or unimportant to deserve much attention.
Unkindly concerned with small, unimportant matters.

ex.en: We wasted the afternoon arguing over petty details.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都浪費在爭論瑣碎細節上了。

ex.en: Investment in youth services may help reduce petty crime by providing constructive activities and support.
ex.zh: 投資青少年服務，為他們提供有益活動和支持，可能有助於減少輕微犯罪。

words.tip: 形容人時常含貶義，指小心眼，不只是小氣。

tr: n. (鋼等的)硬度, 脾氣, 心情, 中和劑, 傾向, 回火
vt. 使回火, 鍛鍊, 調和, 使緩和
vi. 回火
脾氣；易怒的性情
緩和；節制
def: n. a characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling
n. a disposition to exhibit uncontrolled anger
n. the elasticity and hardness of a metal object; its ability to absorb considerable energy before cracking

ex.en: He lost his temper when the drawer jammed again.
ex.zh: 抽屜又卡住了，他大發脾氣。

ex.en: Governments should temper enthusiasm for new technologies with careful consideration of their potential social consequences.
ex.zh: 政府應認真考慮新技術可能帶來的社會後果，避免一味熱衷於推廣。

col: temper enthusiasm with caution｜以謹慎節制熱情
words.tip: lose your temper 是發脾氣；動詞常用 temper A with B。

tr: n. 花, 花開的狀態, 興旺期
vi. 開花, 興旺, 發展
樹木的花；花簇
開花
發展；興盛
def: v. develop or come to a promising stage
a flower or mass of flowers on a tree or bush
to produce flowers

ex.en: Pink blossom covered the cherry tree outside our kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房外的櫻桃樹開滿了粉紅色的花。

ex.en: Creative talent can blossom when schools provide supportive teaching and regular opportunities for artistic expression.
ex.zh: 學校提供支持性的教學和經常性的藝術表達機會時，創造性才能便能蓬勃發展。

words.tip: 多指樹木的花；blossom into可比喻成長為。

tr: a. 著迷的；無法擺脫的
def: s. influenced or controlled by a powerful force such as a strong emotion

tr: a. 屬類的, 一般的
[計] 一般的
通用的；非特定的
無品牌的；非專利的
def: n. a wine that is a blend of several varieties of grapes with no one grape predominating; a wine that does not carry the name of any specific grape
n. any product that can be sold without a brand name
a. relating to or common to or descriptive of all members of a genus

ex.en: The website sent me a generic reply about delivery.
ex.zh: 網站就配送問題給我發了一封千篇一律的回覆。

ex.en: Generic medicines can reduce healthcare costs while providing the same active ingredients as their branded equivalents.
ex.zh: 仿製藥可以降低醫療費用，同時提供與對應品牌藥相同的活性成分。

words.tip: generic強調非特定；generic medicine通常指仿製藥。

tr: a. 享有聲望的
def: s. exerting influence by reason of high status or prestige

tr: n. 大屠殺
vt. 大屠殺, 殘殺
大屠殺
屠殺
def: v. kill a large number of people indiscriminately
The deliberate killing of many people, especially those unable to defend themselves.
To deliberately kill many people, especially those unable to defend themselves.

ex.en: We visited a memorial to victims of the massacre.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了一座紀念大屠殺遇難者的紀念碑。

ex.en: Teaching about a historical massacre requires sensitivity, reliable evidence, and respect for victims and their communities.
ex.zh: 講授歷史上的大屠殺事件，需要謹慎體察、可靠證據，以及對遇難者及其群體的尊重。

col: a brutal massacre｜殘酷的大屠殺
commemorate a massacre｜紀念大屠殺事件
words.tip: 指大規模殘殺，語氣極重；勿用於一般傷亡事件。

tr: n. 馬刺, 刺激物, 鼓舞
vt. 刺激, 激勵, 用馬刺策(馬)前進
vi. 用馬刺驅馬, 疾馳
激勵；促進
刺激；推動力
def: n. any sharply pointed projection
n. tubular extension at the base of the corolla in some flowers
n. a sharp prod fixed to a rider's heel and used to urge a horse onward

ex.en: Her friend's encouragement spurred her to finish the race.
ex.zh: 朋友的鼓勵激勵她跑完了比賽。

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can spur economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
ex.zh: 投資可靠的公共交通可以讓勞動者接觸到更多就業機會，從而促進經濟增長。

col: spur economic growth｜促進經濟增長
spur someone into action｜促使某人行動
a spur to innovation｜創新的推動力
on the spur of the moment｜一時興起
words.tip: 常用spur sb to do；過去式spurred雙寫r。

tr: n. 渠, 溝渠, 戰壕
vt. 在...開溝, 挖戰壕於, 用戰壕圍住
vi. 挖戰壕, 開溝
溝；壕溝；戰壕
海溝
def: n. a ditch dug as a fortification having a parapet of the excavated earth
n. a long steep-sided depression in the ocean floor
n. any long ditch cut in the ground

ex.en: Workers dug a trench to repair the broken pipe.
ex.zh: 工人們挖了一條溝來修理破裂的管道。

ex.en: Before laying underground cables, engineers must ensure that each trench is stable and safe for workers.
ex.zh: 鋪設地下電纜之前，工程師必須確保每條溝槽穩固，並保障工人安全。

words.tip: 地面上的trench是溝或戰壕，海底的則是海溝。

tr: n. 背離
[化] 偏差; 誤差; 偏斜
偏離；背離
偏差
def: n. a variation that deviates from the standard or norm
n. the difference between an observed value and the expected value of a variable or function
n. the error of a compass due to local magnetic disturbances

ex.en: A small deviation from our route revealed a quiet beach.
ex.zh: 我們稍稍偏離原定路線，發現了一片安靜的海灘。

ex.en: Any significant deviation from established safety procedures should be investigated to prevent accidents in the workplace.
ex.zh: 任何嚴重偏離既定安全程序的行為都應得到調查，以防止工作場所事故。

col: deviation from the norm｜偏離常態
words.tip: 常用 deviation from；standard deviation 是“標準差”。

tr: n. 統治, 統轄, 管理
[法] 統治, 管理, 支配
def: n the persons (or committees or departments etc.) who make up a body for the purpose of administering something
n the act of governing; exercising authority

tr: a. 患精神病的, 極愚蠢的
[醫] 神經錯亂的
極不理智的；荒唐的
精神失常的
def: a. afflicted with or characteristic of mental derangement
Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous.
Severely mentally ill; an outdated term except in legal contexts.

ex.en: Driving through that storm would be an insane risk.
ex.zh: 在那場暴風雨中開車會是極不理智的冒險。

ex.en: Critics described the proposal as insane because its enormous costs would outweigh any potential benefits.
ex.zh: 批評者認為這項提案荒唐至極，因為其巨大成本會超過任何潛在收益。

col: an insane risk｜極不理智的冒險
words.tip: 口語可指荒唐；用於精神疾病已過時且可能冒犯。

tr: n. 花名冊
def: n a list of names

tr: n. 骨骼, 骨瘦如柴的人, 梗概, 骨幹, 殘骸
a. 骨骼的, 概略的, 基層的, 骨幹的
[計] 骨架
骨骼；骨架
基本框架；梗概
def: n. something reduced to its minimal form
n. a scandal that is kept secret
n. the internal supporting structure that gives an artifact its shape

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
ex.zh: 我們在博物館看到了一具巨大的恐龍骨架。

ex.en: Studying the skeleton of an ancient animal can reveal how it moved and adapted to its environment.
ex.zh: 研究古代動物的骨骼可以揭示它的運動方式以及它如何適應環境。

col: skeleton staff｜最低限度的工作人員
words.tip: skeleton staff指維持運轉所需的最少人員。

tr: n. (魚)卵, 產物
vt. 產卵, 釀成, 大量生產
vi. 產卵, 大量生產
def: n. the mass of eggs deposited by fish or amphibians or molluscs
v. lay spawn

tr: vt. 施以, 加害, 使承受
[法] 處, 加, 予以
使遭受；造成（傷害）
def: v. impose something unpleasant
to cause someone or something to suffer harm

ex.en: The storm inflicted serious damage on our garden fence.
ex.zh: 暴風雨嚴重損壞了我們花園的圍欄。

ex.en: Unregulated industrial activity can inflict lasting damage on ecosystems and threaten the livelihoods of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 不受監管的工業活動可能對生態系統造成持久破壞，並威脅附近社區居民的生計。

words.tip: 搭配為inflict傷害on對象，不能說inflict sb。

tr: a. 有記號的, 顯著的, 醒目的
[化] 有記號的; 顯著的
顯著的；明顯的
有記號的；有標記的
def: s. strongly marked; easily noticeable
s. singled out for notice or especially for a dire fate
a. having or as if having an identifying mark or a mark as specified; often used in combination

ex.en: There is a marked difference between these two cakes.
ex.zh: 這兩塊蛋糕有明顯的差別。

ex.en: The introduction of dedicated cycle lanes led to a marked increase in bicycle use among urban commuters.
ex.zh: 專用自行車道的啟用使城市通勤者騎車出行的數量顯著增加。

words.tip: 學術寫作中常表示“顯著的”；詞尾讀/t/。

tr: vt. 起訴, 控告, 指控
[法] 控告, 揭發, 對...起訴
def: v. accuse formally of a crime

tr: n. 三重唱
def: n. a musical composition for three performers
n. three performers or singers who perform together
n. a set of three similar things considered as a unit

tr: n. 騷動, 混亂
def: n a violent disturbance
n violent agitation
n disturbance usually in protest

tr: a. 持續的, 持久不變的, 持久的, 不懈的
[計] 持續的
def: s. maintained at length without interruption or weakening

tr: n. 儀式, 典禮, 慣例, 禮拜式
def: n. an established ceremony prescribed by a religion

tr: n. 子孫, 後代, 產物
[法] 後輩, 子孫, 後裔
子女；後代；幼崽
def: n. the immediate descendants of a person
n. something that comes into existence as a result
The children or young of a person, animal, or plant.

ex.en: The mother duck led her offspring safely across the path.
ex.zh: 鴨媽媽帶著小鴨們安全地穿過小路。

ex.en: Many species invest considerable energy in protecting their offspring, which increases the young animals' chances of survival.
ex.zh: 許多物種投入大量精力保護後代，從而提高幼崽的存活機會。

col: protect their offspring｜保護它們的幼崽
words.tip: 單複數同形；談人的子女時比children正式。

tr: n. 東方, 東方諸國
a. 東方的
vi. 向東
vt. 使朝東, 使適應, 確定方向
def: v. be oriented
v. determine one's position with reference to another point
v. cause to point

tr: vt. 把...存檔
n. 檔案館, 檔案文件
[計] 擋案庫, 存檔
def: n. a depository containing historical records and documents
v. put into an archive

tr: vi. 依附, 粘著, 堅持, 追隨, 擁護
vt. 使粘附
遵守；堅持
黏附；附著
def: v. be compatible or in accordance with
v. follow through or carry out a plan without deviation
v. be a devoted follower or supporter

ex.en: Everyone must adhere to the rules in this pool.
ex.zh: 每個人都必須遵守這個游泳池的規定。

ex.en: Researchers must adhere to strict ethical standards when collecting personal information from participants in health studies.
ex.zh: 研究人員在收集健康研究參與者的個人信息時，必須遵守嚴格的倫理標準。

col: adhere to guidelines｜遵循指導原則
adhere to a surface｜黏附於表面
words.tip: 兩種常見義都用adhere to；to是介詞。

tr: n. 便利設施, 適意, 禮儀
[法] 舒適, 方便, 優雅
def: n pleasantness resulting from agreeable conditions

tr: n. 柱子, 棟梁, 臺柱, 重要的支持者
[醫] 柱, 腳
柱子；支柱
棟梁；核心支撐
def: n. a fundamental principle or practice
n. a prominent supporter
A strong upright structure that supports part of a building.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain behind a stone pillar.
ex.zh: 我們躲在一根石柱後面避雨。

ex.en: Accessible education is a central pillar of social development because it expands opportunities across generations.
ex.zh: 普及教育是社會發展的核心支柱，因為它能為一代又一代人拓展機會。

col: a central pillar of｜……的核心支柱
a pillar of the community｜社區的中堅人物
words.tip: pillar of可比喻某體系的支柱或群體的中堅。

tr: n. 火炮, 炮兵, 炮術
[機] 火炮, 炮兵
def: n. large but transportable armament
n. an army unit that uses big guns

tr: n. 保持, 留置, 保留, 保持力, 保留物, 記憶, 停滯, 固位
[計] 保貿, 保持
保留；留住
記憶；記憶保持
滯留；瀦留
def: n. the act of retaining something
the act of keeping something or preventing someone from leaving
the ability to keep information in your memory

ex.en: Our manager improved staff retention by offering flexible hours.
ex.zh: 我們的經理通過提供彈性工作時間，提高了員工留任率。

ex.en: Regular revision and adequate sleep can improve the retention of information among students preparing for examinations.
ex.zh: 定期複習和充足睡眠能幫助備考學生更好地記住所學信息。

words.tip: 通常不可數；動詞形式為retain。

tr: n. 中肯；關聯；相關性
def: n. the relation of something to the matter at hand

tr: n. 主題, 基調, 動機, 基本圖案
[法] 主旨, 主題, 動機
def: n. a design or figure that consists of recurring shapes or colors, as in architecture or decoration
n. a theme that is repeated or elaborated in a piece of music

tr: n. 爭論, 爭辯, 所持的論點
[計] 爭用
def: n. a point asserted as part of an argument

tr: n. 速度, 迅速
[化] 速度
速度；速率
def: n distance travelled per unit time
Speed of movement, including direction in physics.

ex.en: The ball gained velocity as it rolled downhill.
ex.zh: 球向坡下滾動時速度越來越快。

ex.en: Engineers measure the velocity of flowing water to determine whether a site is suitable for generating electricity.
ex.zh: 工程師測量水流速度，以判斷某處是否適合發電。

words.tip: 物理中velocity含方向，speed只表示快慢。

tr: vt. 使和解, 調停, 使和諧, 使一致, 使聽從
[經] 對帳, 使一致
使協調；使一致
使和解
使接受不愉快的現實
def: v. come to terms
To make conflicting ideas, needs, or facts compatible
To restore friendly relations after a disagreement

ex.en: We reconciled our different tastes by choosing a buffet.
ex.zh: 我們選擇了自助餐，兼顧了彼此不同的口味。

ex.en: Governments must reconcile the demand for affordable housing with the need to protect valuable green spaces.
ex.zh: 政府必須協調可負擔住房需求與保護寶貴綠地的需要。

col: reconcile A with B｜使A與B協調
be reconciled with someone｜與某人和解
words.tip: 協調兩者用with；接受現實用reconcile oneself to。

tr: n. 分隔間, 臥車包房, 防水艙隔
[醫] 隔室, 隔間
隔層；隔間；車廂包間
def: n. a space into which an area is subdivided
n. a partitioned section, chamber, or separate room within a larger enclosed area
A separate section within a container, vehicle, or building.

ex.en: Keep your keys in the small compartment inside your bag.
ex.zh: 把鑰匙放在包裡的小隔層中。

ex.en: Separate compartments on trains can provide passengers with greater privacy during long journeys.
ex.zh: 火車上的獨立包間能讓乘客在長途旅行中享有更多隱私。

words.tip: 指較大空間內分隔出的部分，如包內隔層。

tr: n. 轂, 木片, 中心
[計] 插座; 插孔; 集線器, 集中器, 連接器, 中繼站
活動中心；樞紐
輪轂
網絡集線器
def: n. the central part of a car wheel (or fan or propeller etc) through which the shaft or axle passes
n. a center of activity or interest or commerce or transportation; a focal point around which events revolve
A central place for a particular activity or transport network.

ex.en: The kitchen is the hub of our family life.
ex.zh: 廚房是我們家庭生活的中心。

ex.en: Investment in reliable rail connections could transform this coastal city into a major regional transport hub.
ex.zh: 投資建設可靠的鐵路交通，可以將這座沿海城市轉變為重要的區域交通樞紐。

words.tip: 中心義常用a hub for或the hub of。

tr: n. 哮喘
[醫] 氣喘
哮喘
def: n. respiratory disorder characterized by wheezing; usually of allergic origin
A condition that can narrow airways and make breathing difficult

ex.en: My brother carries an inhaler to manage his asthma.
ex.zh: 我哥哥隨身帶著吸入器來控制哮喘。

ex.en: Reducing urban air pollution can help prevent asthma attacks and improve the quality of life for residents.
ex.zh: 減少城市空氣汙染有助於預防哮喘發作，提高居民的生活質量。

words.tip: 不可數名詞；th不發音，英美中間輔音不同。

tr: n. 憤怒, 狂暴, 狂怒的人
[醫] 狂亂, 狂暴, 狂怒
狂怒；暴怒
猛烈；狂暴
def: n. a feeling of intense anger
n. (classical mythology) the hideous snake-haired monsters (usually three in number) who pursued unpunished criminals
An extremely strong feeling of anger.

ex.en: He shook with fury when he discovered the damage.
ex.zh: 發現東西遭到損壞時，他氣得渾身發抖。

ex.en: The sudden closure of the local hospital provoked fury among residents who depended on its services.
ex.zh: 當地醫院突然關閉，激起了依賴其服務的居民的強烈憤怒。

col: the fury of the storm｜風暴的猛烈
words.tip: 比anger語氣強；in a fury表示“勃然大怒”。

tr: a. 自然的, 自發的, 未經琢磨的
[醫] 自發的, 特發的, 自生的
自發的；未經安排的
隨性的；自然率真的
def: a. happening or arising without apparent external cause
Happening naturally without being planned or deliberately caused
Acting freely on feelings rather than following plans

ex.en: We made a spontaneous trip to the beach yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我們臨時起意，去了一趟海邊。

ex.en: Spontaneous conversations between colleagues can generate creative ideas that formal meetings sometimes fail to produce.
ex.zh: 同事間自發的交談可以激發創意，而正式會議有時反倒做不到。

words.tip: 強調非預先安排，不等於“無意識的”。

tr: n. 周長, 周界, 邊緣
[醫] 周, 周邊, 周界線; 周長; 視野計
def: n. a line enclosing a plane areas

tr: n. 顯示, 證明, 示威運動
[醫] 表現, 表示
def: n. a clear appearance
n. a manifest indication of the existence or presence or nature of some person or thing

tr: n. 支柱, 曲柄, 支撐, 一對
vt. 緊縛, 支撐, 激勵
vi. 打起精神
[計] 花括號
def: n. a support that steadies or strengthens something else
n. either of two punctuation marks ({ or }) used to enclose textual material
n. a rope on a square-rigged ship that is used to swing a yard about and secure it

tr: n. 獸群, 鳥群, 一群人, 大量, 棉束
vi. 成群而行, 聚集
vt. 用棉束填滿
鳥群；羊群
蜂擁；成群聚集
def: n. a church congregation guided by a pastor
n. a group of birds
n. a group of sheep or goats

ex.en: A flock of geese landed beside the quiet lake.
ex.zh: 一群鵝落在了寧靜的湖邊。

ex.en: Visitors flock to coastal towns during summer, bringing income but also placing pressure on local infrastructure.
ex.zh: 遊客夏季蜂擁至海濱城鎮，帶來收入的同時，也給當地基礎設施造成壓力。

words.tip: 鳥群、羊群常用flock；牛群通常用herd。

tr: n. 競爭, 對抗
[醫] 拮抗
競爭；對抗
def: n the act of competing as for profit or a prize
Competition between people or groups seeking the same success.

ex.en: There is friendly rivalry between our two football teams.
ex.zh: 我們兩支足球隊之間存在友好的競爭。

ex.en: Commercial rivalry can encourage innovation, although excessive competition may discourage companies from sharing valuable research findings.
ex.zh: 商業競爭可以促進創新，但過度競爭可能使企業不願分享有價值的研究成果。

col: sibling rivalry｜兄弟姐妹間的競爭
rivalry between teams｜隊伍之間的競爭
words.tip: 強調持續的競爭關係，雙方之間常用between。

tr: n. 火器, 槍炮
槍支；火器
def: n. a portable gun
A weapon that fires bullets using an explosive charge.

ex.en: The antique firearm was displayed behind thick museum glass.
ex.zh: 那支古董槍陳列在博物館的厚玻璃後面。

ex.en: Strict firearm storage regulations can help prevent accidents and improve safety in homes and communities.
ex.zh: 嚴格的槍支存放規定有助於預防事故，提高家庭和社區的安全性。

words.tip: 可數名詞，常見覆數firearms，語體較正式。

tr: n. 說教, 啟示, 佈道
佈道；講道
說教；訓誡
def: n. an address of a religious nature (usually delivered during a church service)
n. a moralistic rebuke
a religious talk given during a service

ex.en: The sermon encouraged everyone to help their neighbours.
ex.zh: 這場佈道鼓勵大家幫助鄰居。

ex.en: A sermon can strengthen community ties by encouraging listeners to support vulnerable people and participate in local projects.
ex.zh: 佈道可以鼓勵聽眾幫助弱勢群體、參與本地項目，從而加強社區聯繫。

col: a sermon on kindness｜關於善意的佈道
words.tip: 本義為宗教講道；比喻“說教”時常帶不滿。

tr: a. 揮發性的, 可變的, 不穩定的, 飛行的, 輕快的, 爆炸性的
n. 有翅動物, 揮發物
[計] 易失的
不穩定的；易突變的
易怒的；情緒多變的
def: n. a volatile substance; a substance that changes readily from solid or liquid to a vapor
a. evaporating readily at normal temperatures and pressures
s. tending to vary often or widely

ex.en: Fuel prices have been unusually volatile this month.
ex.zh: 這個月燃油價格波動異常劇烈。

ex.en: Volatile food prices make it difficult for low-income households to plan their spending and maintain a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 食品價格波動不定，使低收入家庭難以規劃開支並維持均衡飲食。

words.tip: 既可描述市場波動，也可指情緒易變或物質易揮發。

tr: n. 障礙, 跳欄, 臨時活動籬笆
vt. 用籬笆圍, 越過, 克服
def: n. a light movable barrier that competitors must leap over in certain races
n. an obstacle that you are expected to overcome
v. jump a hurdle

tr: a. 強健的, 健全的
[醫] 羊暈倒病, 羊蹣跚病
結實的；強健的
def: s. substantially made or constructed
Strongly built and not easily damaged or weakened.

ex.en: These sturdy boots keep my feet dry on muddy walks.
ex.zh: 穿著這雙結實的靴子走泥路，我的雙腳也能保持乾爽。

ex.en: Schools in earthquake-prone regions need sturdy buildings that can protect students during periods of intense shaking.
ex.zh: 地震多發地區的學校需要堅固的建築，以便在劇烈震動時保護學生。

words.tip: 常形容鞋、傢俱、建築結實，也可形容人強健。

tr: n. 限定詞
a. 限定的, 決定性的
def: s. clearly defined or formulated
s. supplying or being a final or conclusive settlement

tr: vt. 推進, 驅使
[機] 推進
def: v. cause to move forward with force

tr: vt. 扭曲, 歪曲
[法] 歪區, 曲解, 纂改
歪曲；曲解
使變形；使失真
def: v make false by mutilation or addition; as of a message or story
v form into a spiral shape
v twist and press out of shape

ex.en: That edited clip distorts what I actually said.
ex.zh: 那段剪輯過的視頻歪曲了我實際說的話。

ex.en: Selective reporting can distort public understanding of environmental issues and weaken support for necessary reforms.
ex.zh: 選擇性報道可能歪曲公眾對環境問題的理解，並削弱人們對必要改革的支持。

col: distort public perception｜扭曲公眾認知
words.tip: 既可指歪曲事實，也可指圖像、聲音失真。

tr: n. 鏟子, 勺子, 穴, 口, 獨家新聞
vt. 汲取, 舀取, 挖空, 搶先報道
def: n. the quantity a scoop will hold
n. a hollow concave shape made by removing something
n. the shovel or bucket of a dredge or backhoe

tr: n. 無, 全無, 零
[法] 無, 零, 無有
def: n a quantity of no importance

tr: n. 莖, 追蹤, 高視闊步
vi. 悄悄靠近, 躡手躡腳地走近, 蔓延, 高視闊步
vt. 追蹤, 搜索
def: n. a slender or elongated structure that supports a plant or fungus or a plant part or plant organ
n. a hunt for game carried on by following it stealthily or waiting in ambush
n. the act of following prey stealthily

tr: vt. 威脅, 恐嚇
[法] 恐嚇, 威脅, 使恐懼
恐嚇；威脅
使膽怯；使失去信心
def: v. make timid or fearful
v. to compel or deter by or as if by threats
To frighten someone, often to make them obey

ex.en: The large audience intimidated her before her first performance.
ex.zh: 首次演出前，龐大的觀眾群讓她有些膽怯。

ex.en: Employers should never intimidate workers into accepting unsafe conditions or giving up their legal rights.
ex.zh: 僱主絕不應脅迫員工接受不安全的工作條件或放棄合法權利。

col: intimidate someone into doing something｜脅迫某人做某事
words.tip: intimidate sb into doing sth表示脅迫某人做某事。

tr: n. 邊緣, 邊界, 起始點
vi. 處在邊緣, 接近, 下沉, 趨向
邊緣；臨界點
路邊草地
接近；近乎
def: n. the limit beyond which something happens or changes
n. a grass border along a road
v. border on; come close to

ex.en: She was on the verge of tears after losing her ring.
ex.zh: 她丟了戒指，幾乎要哭出來了。

ex.en: Several native species are on the verge of extinction because their habitats have been severely damaged.
ex.zh: 幾種本地物種因棲息地遭到嚴重破壞而瀕臨滅絕。

col: on the verge of extinction｜瀕臨滅絕
on the verge of doing something｜即將做某事
verge on the absurd｜近乎荒謬
words.tip: on the verge of後接名詞或動名詞；動詞常接on。

tr: n. 瘟疫, 天罰, 麻煩, 災禍
vt. 折磨, 使苦惱, 使得災禍
鼠疫；瘟疫
不斷困擾；使受折磨
大規模災害；禍患
