def: n. a serious (sometimes fatal) infection of rodents caused by Yersinia pestis and accidentally transmitted to humans by the bite of a flea that has bitten an infected animal
n. any epidemic disease with a high death rate
n. any large scale calamity (especially when thought to be sent by God)

ex.en: The museum has an exhibition about plague in medieval towns.
ex.zh: 博物館有一個關於中世紀城鎮瘟疫的展覽。

ex.en: Poor drainage continues to plague rapidly growing cities, increasing flood risks and threatening the health of local residents.
ex.zh: 排水不良持續困擾著快速發展的城市，增加了洪災風險，並威脅當地居民的健康。

col: an outbreak of plague｜鼠疫暴發
be plagued by problems｜飽受問題困擾
words.tip: 動詞常用be plagued by，表示長期反覆受困擾。

tr: n. 一次所烘的麵包, 一次所制之量, 一組, 批, 成批, 分批
v. 成批, 分批處理
[計] 一批
一批；一爐
分批處理
def: n. all the loaves of bread baked at the same time
n. (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent
n. a collection of things or persons to be handled together

ex.en: The first batch of bread is cooling on the counter.
ex.zh: 第一爐麵包正放在臺面上晾涼。

ex.en: Testing each batch of food before distribution helps manufacturers maintain consistent quality and protect public health.
ex.zh: 食品配送前對每一批進行檢測，有助於生產商保持質量穩定並保護公眾健康。

words.tip: batch強調一起生產或處理的一批，常接of。

tr: n. 飾帶, 花邊, 緞帶, 鞋帶
vt. 結帶子, 飾以花邊
vi. 繫帶子
[計] 全穿孔
def: n. a cord that is drawn through eyelets or around hooks in order to draw together two edges (as of a shoe or garment)
n. a delicate decorative fabric woven in an open web of symmetrical patterns
v. do lacework

tr: vt. 制止, 嚇住, 威懾
阻止；使打消念頭
def: v. try to prevent; show opposition to
To discourage an action by making it seem difficult or risky.

ex.en: The heavy rain did not deter our determined hikers.
ex.zh: 大雨沒有讓我們堅定的徒步者打退堂鼓。

ex.en: Higher parking fees may deter commuters from driving into city centres during peak hours.
ex.zh: 提高停車費可能使通勤者不願在高峰時段開車進入市中心。

col: deter someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
deter potential customers｜使潛在顧客卻步
words.tip: 用deter sb from doing；過去式為deterred。

tr: vi. 期滿, 呼氣, 斷氣
vt. 呼出
到期；失效
def: v lose validity
v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
v expel air

ex.en: My passport expires next month, so I must renew it.
ex.zh: 我的護照下個月到期，所以必須換髮。

ex.en: When temporary work permits expire, employees may face uncertainty about their future employment and residence.
ex.zh: 臨時工作許可到期時，僱員的未來就業和居留可能面臨不確定性。

words.tip: 是不及物動詞：合同到期用expires，不用is expired。

tr: a. 毗連的, 鄰近的, 連接的
[機] 相鄰的, 鄰位的, 交界的
相鄰的；毗連的
def: s. nearest in space or position; immediately adjoining without intervening space
s. having a common boundary or edge; abutting; touching; Massachusetts and Conncecticut"
s. near or close to but not necessarily touching

ex.en: We booked adjacent rooms so the children could stay nearby.
ex.zh: 我們訂了相鄰的房間，孩子們就能住在旁邊。

ex.en: Residents in areas adjacent to the airport often experience high levels of noise pollution.
ex.zh: 機場鄰近地區的居民經常受到嚴重的噪聲汙染。

words.tip: 表示“與……相鄰”用 adjacent to。

tr: vt. 使停止, 扣留, 保留, 拒給
vi. 剋制, 忍住
def: v. hold back; refuse to hand over or share
v. retain and refrain from disbursing; of payments

tr: n. 象牙, 乳白色
a. 象牙制的, 乳白色的
def: n. a hard smooth ivory colored dentine that makes up most of the tusks of elephants and walruses

tr: vi. 一致, 符合
[化] 重合
同時發生
相符；一致
def: v. go with, fall together
v. be the same
to happen at the same time

ex.en: My days off rarely coincide with my sister's.
ex.zh: 我的休息日很少和姐姐的重合。

ex.en: Government investment should coincide with local priorities to ensure that public funds address genuine community needs.
ex.zh: 政府投資應與地方優先事項相一致，以確保公共資金滿足社區的真實需求。

col: coincide with｜與……同時發生；與……相符
words.tip: 不及物動詞，接對象用with，不直接接賓語。

tr: a. 僵硬的, 完全的, 刻板的, 明顯的, 荒涼的, 結實的
adv. 突出地, 簡直, 全然
def: s. complete or extreme
r. completely

tr: a. 有利益的, 獲利的, 合算的
def: s. producing a sizeable profit

tr: vt. 超越, 勝過
超越；突破界限
def: v be greater in scope or size than some standard
v be superior or better than some standard
To go beyond ordinary limits, differences, or expectations.

ex.en: Their friendship transcended the distance between their homes.
ex.zh: 他們的友誼超越了兩地相隔的距離。

ex.en: International cooperation on climate change must transcend national interests to protect the planet for future generations.
ex.zh: 應對氣候變化的國際合作必須超越國家利益，為後代保護地球。

col: transcend cultural differences｜超越文化差異
transcend national interests｜超越國家利益
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語，不加beyond。

tr: n. 護送者, 護衛者, 護航艦
vt. 護衛, 護送
護送；陪同
護送者；陪同人員
def: n. the act of accompanying someone or something in order to protect them
n. an attendant who is employed to accompany someone
v. accompany as an escort

ex.en: A staff member escorted us to the waiting room.
ex.zh: 一名工作人員陪同我們去了候診室。

ex.en: Trained volunteers can escort elderly residents to medical appointments, improving access to essential healthcare services.
ex.zh: 受過培訓的志願者可以陪同老年居民就醫，從而改善他們獲得基本醫療服務的機會。

col: escort someone to｜陪同某人前往
a police escort｜警方護送人員
words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞英/ˈeskɔːt/，美/ˈeskɔːrt/。

tr: n. 廄, 停車處, 牧師職位, 貨攤, 託辭, 拖延
vt. 關入廄, 停頓, 推託, 支吾, 使陷於泥中
vi. 被關在廄內, 陷於泥中, 停止, 支吾
貨攤；攤位
使停滯；拖延
def: n. a compartment in a stable where a single animal is confined and fed
n. a booth where articles are displayed for sale
n. a malfunction in the flight of an aircraft in which there is a sudden loss of lift that results in a downward plunge

ex.en: We bought fresh peaches from a small roadside stall.
ex.zh: 我們在路邊的一個小攤買了新鮮桃子。

ex.en: Negotiations may stall if governments cannot agree on how to share the costs of reducing emissions.
ex.zh: 如果各國政府無法就如何分擔減排成本達成一致，談判可能會陷入停滯。

col: stall an engine｜使發動機熄火
words.tip: 作動詞可指發動機熄火，也可指談判等陷入停滯。

tr: vt. 引出, 推導出, 引起
引出；誘發
def: v. derive by reason
to cause someone to give information or show a reaction

ex.en: Her unexpected question elicited a smile from the normally quiet guide.
ex.zh: 她出人意料的問題讓平時寡言的導遊露出了笑容。

ex.en: Teachers can use open questions to elicit detailed responses and encourage independent thinking in the classroom.
ex.zh: 教師可以用開放式問題引導學生詳細回答，並鼓勵他們在課堂上獨立思考。

words.tip: 常接response等賓語；勿與illicit（非法的）混淆。

tr: n. 契約, 協定, 條約
[化] 合同
def: n a written agreement between two states or sovereigns

tr: n. 殼, 皮, 船體
vt. 去殼
船體
穀殼；果實外殼
去殼；去果蒂
def: n. dry outer covering of a fruit or seed or nut
n. persistent enlarged calyx at base of e.g. a strawberry or raspberry
n. United States naval officer who commanded the `Constitution' during the War of 1812 and won a series of brilliant victories against the British (1773-1843)

ex.en: We painted the boat's hull blue before launching it.
ex.zh: 我們把船體漆成藍色，然後才將船下水。

ex.en: Improved hull designs can reduce fuel consumption by allowing ships to move through water with less resistance.
ex.zh: 改進船體設計可以減小船舶在水中航行的阻力，從而降低燃料消耗。

words.tip: 船體是hull；整艘船用ship或boat。

tr: vt. 強制, 施恩惠於, 使感激
vi. 施恩惠, 幫忙
迫使；使負有義務
幫忙；滿足請求
def: v. bind by an obligation; cause to be indebted
v. provide a service or favor for someone
Require someone to act because of rules or circumstances

ex.en: The sudden storm obliged us to stay indoors.
ex.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨迫使我們待在室內。

ex.en: Environmental regulations oblige manufacturers to reduce harmful emissions and report their progress to public authorities.
ex.zh: 環境法規要求製造商減少有害排放，並向政府部門報告進展。

col: be obliged to do something｜不得不做某事
words.tip: be obliged to do表示被迫或有義務做某事。

tr: n. 半身像, 胸部, 失敗, 毆打
vt. 使爆裂, 使破產
vi. 爆裂, 破產
[計] 操作錯
半身像；胸像
def: n. a sculpture of the head and shoulders of a person
n. an occasion for excessive eating or drinking
a sculpture showing a person's head, shoulders, and upper chest

ex.en: A marble bust stood beside the museum entrance.
ex.zh: 博物館入口旁立著一尊大理石半身像。

ex.en: Displaying a bust of a local artist can help museums connect visitors with their community's cultural history.
ex.zh: 展出當地藝術家的半身像，有助於博物館讓參觀者瞭解所在社區的文化歷史。

col: a marble bust｜大理石半身像
words.tip: 指雕像時是可數名詞，通常只有頭、肩和胸部。

tr: vt. 象徵, 預示
vi. 要緊, 重要
表示；意味著
示意；表達
def: v. convey or express a meaning
v. make known with a word or signal
to mean something or be a sign of it

ex.en: These dark clouds usually signify that rain is coming.
ex.zh: 這些烏雲通常意味著快要下雨了。

ex.en: Rising literacy rates may signify improvements in educational access, especially among previously disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 識字率上升可能意味著受教育機會有所改善，尤其是在原本處於弱勢的群體中。

words.tip: signify較正式，常接名詞或that從句。

tr: n. 聲望, 威望, 威信
[經] 商譽, 聲譽
聲望；威望
def: n. a high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.
Respect and admiration gained through achievement, quality, or high status.

ex.en: Winning the award brought considerable prestige to her small bakery.
ex.zh: 獲獎為她的小麵包店帶來了很高的聲譽。

ex.en: Some students choose universities for their international prestige rather than the suitability of individual courses.
ex.zh: 一些學生選擇大學看重的是其國際聲望，而非具體課程是否適合自己。

col: a matter of prestige｜關乎聲望的事
words.tip: prestige不可數；形容詞用prestigious。

tr: n. 支持, 長枕
vt. 支持, 支撐
def: n. a pillow that is often put across a bed underneath the regular pillows
v. support and strengthen
v. prop up with a pillow or bolster

tr: a. 語言的, 語言學的
[計] 語言的, 語言學的
def: a. consisting of or related to language
a. of or relating to the scientific study of language

tr: a. 振動的, 戰慄的, 響亮的, 活躍的
def: s. vigorous and animated
s. of sounds that are strong and resonating
s. of colors that are bright and striking

tr: n. 背景幕, 背景
def: n. scenery hung at back of stage

tr: a. 即將來臨的, 逼近的
即將發生的；迫近的
def: s close in time; about to occur
Expected to happen very soon.

ex.en: The dark clouds made a heavy downpour seem imminent.
ex.zh: 烏雲密佈，眼看就要下大雨了。

ex.en: Coastal communities need reliable warning systems when severe flooding is imminent, allowing residents enough time to evacuate.
ex.zh: 嚴重洪水即將來襲時，沿海社區需要可靠的預警系統，讓居民有足夠時間撤離。

words.tip: 強調即將發生，不等於urgent（需緊急處理）。

tr: n. 箔, 烘托, 襯托
vt. 貼箔於, 襯托, 阻止, 擋開, 挫敗
def: n. a piece of thin and flexible sheet metal
n. anything that serves by contrast to call attention to another thing's good qualities
n. picture consisting of a positive photograph or drawing on a transparent base; viewed with a projector

tr: n. 舉止, 軸承, 忍受, 關係, 意義, 方向, 生育
[化] 軸承
def: n. relevant relation or interconnection
n. the direction or path along which something moves or along which it lies
n. dignified manner or conduct

tr: a. 活生生的, 能活動的, 活潑的, 歡快的
def: a. having life or vigor or spirit
s. made to appear to move as living creatures do

tr: a. 持久的, 忍耐的
def: s. patiently bearing continual wrongs or trouble

tr: n. 抑制, 勒馬繩, 邊石
vt. 抑制, 束縛, 勒住
控制；抑制
限制；約束
路緣石（美式）
def: n. an edge between a sidewalk and a roadway consisting of a line of curbstones (usually forming part of a gutter)
n. a horse's bit with an attached chain or strap to check the horse
v. keep to the curb

ex.en: I try to curb my spending by cooking at home.
ex.zh: 我儘量在家做飯，以控制開支。

ex.en: Cities can curb air pollution by improving public transport and encouraging residents to cycle.
ex.zh: 城市可以通過改善公共交通和鼓勵居民騎車來抑制空氣汙染。

col: a curb on emissions｜對排放的限制
words.tip: 作動詞指抑制；路緣石在英式英語中拼作kerb。

tr: a. 暗示的, 含蓄的, 固有的, 絕對的
[經] 不講明的, 含蓄的
含蓄的；未明說的
內含的；固有的
完全的；無疑問的
def: a. implied though not directly expressed; inherent in the nature of something
s. being without doubt or reserve
Suggested or understood without being directly stated.

ex.en: Her welcoming smile was an implicit invitation to join.
ex.zh: 她熱情的笑容是在默默邀請我們加入。

ex.en: Many workplaces have implicit expectations about overtime, which can make employees reluctant to leave on time.
ex.zh: 許多工作場所對加班有不成文的期待，這可能讓員工不敢準時下班。

col: implicit agreement｜默契；未明說的協議
words.tip: implicit指未明說；explicit指清楚明確。

tr: vt. 克服, 征服, 戰勝
vi. 得勝
征服；攻佔
克服；戰勝
def: v. overcome by conquest
Take control of a country or place by force.
Successfully deal with a fear, difficulty, or challenge.

ex.en: She conquered her fear and climbed onto the diving board.
ex.zh: 她克服了恐懼，爬上了跳板。

ex.en: Throughout history, powerful states have sought to conquer neighbouring territories to gain resources and expand their influence.
ex.zh: 縱觀歷史，強大的國家一直試圖征服鄰近領土，以獲取資源並擴大影響力。

col: conquer a territory｜征服一片領土
conquer a mountain｜征服一座高山
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語：conquer a fear。

tr: n. 蹲伏, 蜷縮
vi. 蹲下, 蜷著, 縮著
vt. 低頭
def: n. the act of bending low with the limbs close to the body
v. bend one's back forward from the waist on down

tr: n. 命令者, 獨裁者
def: n. a speaker who dictates to a secretary or a recording machine
n. a ruler who is unconstrained by law

tr: a. 治療的, 有益於健康的
[醫] 治療的; 治療學的
def: a. relating to or involved in therapy

tr: vt. 吸入
vi. 吸氣
def: v. draw deep into the lungs in by breathing
v. draw in (air)

tr: a. 圓形的, 循環的, 間接的
[醫] 環狀的, 循環的
圓形的；環形的
循環的
通知；通函
def: n. an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution
s. describing a circle; moving in a circle
Shaped like a circle or following a round path.

ex.en: We placed a circular rug under the coffee table.
ex.zh: 我們在茶几下面鋪了一塊圓形地毯。

ex.en: A circular economy aims to reduce waste by keeping materials in use for as long as possible.
ex.zh: 循環經濟旨在通過儘可能延長材料的使用時間來減少浪費。

words.tip: circular argument指用結論證明自身的循環論證。

tr: n. 女海妖, 妖女, 警報器, 汽笛, 迷人的美女
a. 誘惑的
vi. 響著警報器前進
警報器；警報聲
def: n. a sea nymph (part woman and part bird) supposed to lure sailors to destruction on the rocks where the nymphs lived
n. a warning signal that is a loud wailing sound
n. an acoustic device producing a loud often wailing sound as a signal or warning

ex.en: An ambulance siren woke me early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天一大早，救護車的警報聲把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Emergency sirens can help coastal communities respond quickly when severe storms threaten their safety.
ex.zh: 當強風暴威脅沿海社區的安全時，應急警報器能幫助居民迅速作出反應。

words.tip: 可指發聲的警報器，也可指其發出的警報聲。

tr: a. 疲倦的, 萎靡的, 厭倦的, 厭煩的
vt. 使疲倦, 使厭煩
vi. 疲乏, 生厭, 不耐煩
疲憊的；疲倦的
厭倦的；不耐煩的
def: v exhaust or get tired through overuse or great strain or stress
v lose interest or become bored with something or somebody
s physically and mentally fatigued

ex.en: The weary hikers rested beside a stream before sunset.
ex.zh: 日落前，疲憊的徒步者們在溪邊休息。

ex.en: Commuters who endure long journeys often arrive home too weary to exercise or spend quality time with family.
ex.zh: 通勤路途漫長的人到家後往往疲憊不堪，無力鍛鍊或好好陪伴家人。

words.tip: weary是疲倦的；wary是警惕的，注意拼寫。

tr: a. 蒼翠繁茂的, 多青草的, 豐富的
n. 酒, 酒鬼
v. 飲
def: s. full of juice

tr: a. 大慈大悲的, 寬厚的, 慈善的
[法] 慈善的, 慷慨的, 寬恕的
def: a. relating to or characterized by charity
a. full of love and generosity
s. showing or motivated by sympathy and understanding and generosity

tr: n. 包圍, 圍攻, 再三的努力
vt. 包圍, 圍攻
def: n. the action of an armed force that surrounds a fortified place and isolates it while continuing to attack

tr: n. 似非而是的論點, 自相矛盾的話, 悖論, 怪人怪事
[化] 佯謬
悖論；看似矛盾的事物
def: n. (logic) a statement that contradicts itself
A statement or situation that seems contradictory but may be true.

ex.en: It seems a paradox that resting helps me accomplish more.
ex.zh: 休息反而能讓我完成更多事情，這似乎很矛盾。

ex.en: Modern technology creates a paradox: people can communicate instantly yet still experience deep social isolation.
ex.zh: 現代技術帶來一種看似矛盾的現象：人們能即時交流，卻仍感到深深的社會孤立。

col: present a paradox｜呈現看似矛盾的情況
words.tip: 強調看似矛盾卻可能成立，不等於普通錯誤。

tr: a. 明確的, 一定的
[法] 明確的, 確切的, 一定的
明確的；確定的
確實的；明顯的
def: a. precise; explicit and clearly defined
s. known for certain
Clearly decided or known, without uncertainty.

ex.en: We need a definite answer before booking the tickets.
ex.zh: 訂票之前，我們需要一個明確的答覆。

ex.en: Reliable public transport offers definite advantages for cities seeking to reduce congestion and improve air quality.
ex.zh: 對於尋求緩解擁堵和改善空氣質量的城市來說，可靠的公共交通具有明顯優勢。

words.tip: definite是形容詞；definitely是副詞，意為肯定地。

tr: vi. 統轄, 當主人, 主持
[法] 主持, 負責, 指揮
主持；擔任主席
def: v. act as president
To lead a formal meeting, ceremony, or other official event

ex.en: Our club elected Nina to preside over the next meeting.
ex.zh: 我們俱樂部推選妮娜主持下一次會議。

ex.en: An independent expert should preside over the public hearing to ensure that all participants receive fair treatment.
ex.zh: 公開聽證會應由獨立專家主持，以確保所有參與者都得到公平對待。

col: preside over a meeting｜主持會議
preside at a ceremony｜主持典禮
words.tip: 不直接接會議等賓語，通常用preside over。

tr: v. 區別, 差別待遇
歧視；區別對待
辨別；區分
def: v. recognize or perceive the difference
v. treat differently on the basis of sex or race
v. distinguish

ex.en: Our club does not discriminate against anyone because of age.
ex.zh: 我們的俱樂部不會因年齡而歧視任何人。

ex.en: Employers must not discriminate against applicants on the basis of disability, gender, or cultural background.
ex.zh: 僱主不得基於殘障、性別或文化背景歧視求職者。

col: discriminate on the basis of age｜基於年齡區別對待
words.tip: 歧視某人用against；區分兩者用between。

tr: vt. 移置, 替換, 轉移
迫使離開家園
取代；替代
移開；排開
def: v. cause to move, usually with force or pressure
v. terminate the employment of; discharge from an office or position
Force people to leave their homes or usual surroundings.

ex.en: The flood displaced several families living near the river.
ex.zh: 洪水使住在河邊的幾戶人家被迫離開家園。

ex.en: Although automation may displace some workers, investment in retraining can help them find alternative employment.
ex.zh: 雖然自動化可能取代部分工人，但投資再培訓可以幫助他們找到其他工作。

words.tip: displace常指被迫遷離；也可指新事物取代舊事物。

tr: n. 沼澤, 溼地
a. 沼澤的
def: n. low-lying wet land with grassy vegetation; usually is a transition zone between land and water
n. United States painter (1898-1954)
n. New Zealand writer of detective stories (1899-1982)

tr: a. 兩極的, 極地的, 正好相反的, 極性的
n. 極線, 極面
極地的
完全相反的
def: s. having a pair of equal and opposite charges
a. located at or near or coming from the earth's poles
a. of or existing at or near a geographical pole or within the Arctic or Antarctic Circles

ex.en: We watched a film about animals in polar regions.
ex.zh: 我們看了一部關於極地動物的影片。

ex.en: Rising global temperatures threaten polar ecosystems by reducing the sea ice that many species depend on.
ex.zh: 全球氣溫升高使許多物種賴以生存的海冰減少，威脅著極地生態系統。

col: polar opposites｜截然相反的人或事物
words.tip: polar指兩極地區；polar opposites表示截然相反。

tr: n. 獨居者
a. 孤獨的, 獨居的
獨處的；獨居的
單個的；唯一的
def: n confinement of a prisoner in isolation from other prisoners
n one who lives in solitude
s characterized by or preferring solitude

ex.en: A solitary walker followed the quiet path through the woods.
ex.zh: 一位獨行者沿著林間幽靜的小路前行。

ex.en: While solitary study allows deep concentration, collaborative learning helps students develop communication skills and consider alternative perspectives.
ex.zh: 獨自學習有助於專注，而合作學習能幫助學生培養溝通能力並考慮不同觀點。

col: a solitary tree｜孤零零的一棵樹
words.tip: solitary強調獨自，不一定像lonely那樣感到寂寞。

tr: n. 暴跌, 垂頭彎腰的姿態
vi. 猛然掉落, 陷入, 衰落(經濟等)
def: n. a noticeable deterioration in performance or quality
v. assume a drooping posture or carriage
v. fall or sink heavily

tr: n. 剩餘物, 其他人, 殘餘, 餘數
v. 削價出售(圖書)
a. 剩餘的, 出售削價剩書的
[計] 餘數
剩餘部分；其餘的人
def: n. something left after other parts have been taken away
n. the part of the dividend that is left over when the dividend is not evenly divisible by the divisor
n. the number that remains after subtraction; the number that when added to the subtrahend gives the minuend

ex.en: We ate half the cake and refrigerated the remainder.
ex.zh: 我們吃了半個蛋糕，把剩下的放進了冰箱。

ex.en: After funding essential services, the council allocated the remainder of its budget to improving public parks.
ex.zh: 在為基本服務撥款後，地方議會將剩餘預算用於改善公共公園。

col: for the remainder of｜在……餘下的時間裡
words.tip: 常用the remainder of；謂語單複數取決於所指內容。

tr: a. 未決定的, 待決的, 行將發生的, 向外伸出的
prep. 在等待...之際, 直到...時為止, 在...期間, 在...過程中
待定的；待處理的
在等待…期間；直到…為止
def: s. awaiting conclusion or confirmation
Waiting for a decision or for something to happen
Until something happens or while waiting for it

ex.en: Our application is still pending, so we cannot book flights.
ex.zh: 我們的申請仍在審批中，所以還不能訂機票。

ex.en: Construction should remain suspended pending a thorough assessment of its potential impact on the surrounding environment.
ex.zh: 在全面評估施工對周邊環境的潛在影響之前，工程應繼續暫停。

col: a pending application｜待處理的申請
words.tip: 核心是尚未決定或完成，不要誤當作urgent（緊迫的）。

tr: n. 徽章, 標記
[計] 標記
徽章；身份標識
def: n. an emblem (a small piece of plastic or cloth or metal) that signifies your status (rank or membership or affiliation etc.)
n. any feature that is regarded as a sign of status (a particular power or quality or rank)
v. put a badge on

ex.en: She pinned her new badge onto her jacket.
ex.zh: 她把新徽章別在了夾克上。

ex.en: Requiring visitors to wear a visible badge can improve security in schools and other public buildings.
ex.zh: 要求訪客佩戴醒目的身份徽章，有助於提高學校及其他公共建築的安全性。

col: a badge of honour｜榮譽的象徵
words.tip: 通常指佩戴的小徽章；獎牌一般用medal。

tr: n. 空虛, 空間, 空白, 空隙, 空虛感
a. 空的, 無效的, 無人的, 沒有的, 無用的
[計] 脫墨; 空白點
def: n. an empty area or space
v. clear (a room, house, place) of occupants or empty or clear (a place or receptacle) of something
s. containing nothing

tr: n. 花崗岩
[化] 花崗岩
def: n. plutonic igneous rock having visibly crystalline texture; generally composed of feldspar and mica and quartz
n. something having the quality of granite (unyielding firmness)

tr: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束縛
[法] 抑制, 遏制, 制止
制止；限制行動
剋制；抑制
def: v. keep under control; keep in check
v. to close within bounds, limit or hold back from movement
v. hold back

ex.en: She gently restrained the dog from chasing a squirrel.
ex.zh: 她輕輕拉住狗，不讓它去追松鼠。

ex.en: Governments may use tighter lending rules to restrain excessive borrowing and reduce risks in the housing market.
ex.zh: 政府可以通過收緊貸款規定來遏制過度借貸，降低住房市場風險。

col: restrain someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
words.tip: 常用restrain sb from doing，表示阻止某人做某事。

tr: n. 飲料
[化] 飲料(如牛奶、茶、咖啡、啤酒等)
飲料
def: n. any liquid suitable for drinking
A drink, such as tea, juice, or coffee.

ex.en: Would you like a hot beverage with your sandwich?
ex.zh: 你想來杯熱飲配三明治嗎？

ex.en: Reducing the consumption of sugary beverages could help lower obesity rates among young people.
ex.zh: 減少含糖飲料的攝入可能有助於降低年輕人的肥胖率。

words.tip: beverage較正式，多用於餐飲或學術語境；日常用drink。

tr: v. 初次公演, 首次露面
n. 初次的演出
a. 首次的, 首位的
def: n. the first public performance of a play or movie

tr: a. 模仿的, 摹擬的
n. 效顰者, 模仿者, 小丑, 仿製品
vt. 模仿, 摹擬
模仿；模擬
善於模仿他人者
def: n. someone who mimics (especially an actor or actress)
v. imitate (a person or manner), especially for satirical effect
s. constituting an imitation

ex.en: Our parrot mimics the sound of the doorbell perfectly.
ex.zh: 我們家的鸚鵡把門鈴聲模仿得惟妙惟肖。

ex.en: Engineers increasingly mimic natural structures to develop lighter materials that require less energy to manufacture.
ex.zh: 工程師越來越多地模擬自然結構，以開發製造時耗能更低的輕質材料。

col: mimic someone's voice｜模仿某人的聲音
mimic natural processes｜模擬自然過程
a talented mimic｜有天賦的模仿者
words.tip: 過去式mimicked，進行時mimicking，均加k。

tr: vt. 刺穿, 穿透, 打眼於, 洞悉, (聲音)響徹, (亮光)照進, 深深地打動
vi. 刺入, 穿入, 透入, 進入
刺穿；扎破
穿透；劃破
def: n. 14th President of the United States (1804-1869)
v. cut or make a way through
v. move or affect (a person's emotions or bodily feelings) deeply or sharply

ex.en: Use a fork to pierce the potato before baking.
ex.zh: 烘烤前，用叉子在土豆上扎幾個孔。

ex.en: Powerful artificial lights pierce the darkness around coastal developments, potentially disturbing the behaviour of nesting birds.
ex.zh: 沿海開發區周圍的強烈人造光穿透黑暗，可能干擾築巢鳥類的行為。

words.tip: 打耳洞常說have/get your ears pierced。

tr: n. 混血兒, 雜種, 混合物
a. 混合的, 雜種的, 混合語的
[計] NetWare的主機實用程序, 雙重用戶建立程序
def: n. a composite of mixed origin
n. (genetics) an organism that is the offspring of genetically dissimilar parents or stock; especially offspring produced by breeding plants or animals of different varieties or breeds or species
s. produced by crossbreeding

tr: vt. 縱情於, 使高興, 放任, 遷就
vi. 沉溺
def: v. give free rein to
v. enjoy to excess

tr: a. 暫時的, 臨時的, 間歇的
n. 過渡時期
臨時的；過渡期間的
過渡期間；間隔時期
def: n. the time between one event, process, or period and another
s. serving during an intermediate interval of time
Intended to last until a permanent arrangement is made.

ex.en: Our interim manager will stay until we find a replacement.
ex.zh: 我們的臨時經理會留任，直到我們找到接替者。

ex.en: The council introduced interim housing measures while permanent accommodation was being built for families displaced by flooding.
ex.zh: 在為因洪災失去住所的家庭建造永久住房期間，地方議會推出了臨時住房措施。

words.tip: 形容詞常置於名詞前；in the interim意為在此期間。

tr: n. 快速的輕打, 輕打聲, 彈開
v. 輕彈, 輕輕拂去, 忽然搖動
輕彈；迅速拂去
輕彈；快速輕動
電影（非正式）
def: n. a light sharp contact (usually with something flexible)
n. a short stroke
v. look through a book or other written material

ex.en: He flicked a crumb off his sleeve before leaving.
ex.zh: 他離開前輕輕彈掉了袖子上的一粒麵包屑。

ex.en: Digital interfaces allow readers to flick through articles quickly, but this convenience may encourage superficial reading habits.
ex.zh: 數字界面讓讀者能夠快速瀏覽文章，但這種便利可能助長淺層閱讀習慣。

col: flick through a magazine｜快速翻閱雜誌
a flick of the wrist｜手腕輕輕一動
a comedy flick｜一部喜劇電影
words.tip: flick through指快速翻閱，不表示仔細閱讀。

tr: n. 分期連載作品, 連載小說
a. 連續的, 一連串的, 連載的, 分期償還的
[計] 連續的; 串行的
def: n. a serialized set of programs
a. pertaining to or composed in serial technique
a. pertaining to or occurring in or producing a series

tr: n. 矮子, 侏儒
v. (使)變矮小
使相形見絀
矮小動植物；傳說中矮人
矮生的；小型的
def: n. a person who is markedly small
n. a plant or animal that is atypically small
v. check the growth of

ex.en: The new tower dwarfs every house on our street.
ex.zh: 新建的高塔讓我們街上所有房屋都顯得很矮小。

ex.en: The long-term costs of environmental damage may dwarf the immediate profits generated by industrial expansion.
ex.zh: 環境破壞的長期成本可能遠遠超過工業擴張帶來的眼前利潤。

col: be dwarfed by｜與……相比顯得渺小
words.tip: 動詞常表對比懸殊；名詞指人可能冒犯，應謹慎。

tr: vt. 超越, 凌駕, 勝過
超過；勝過
def: v. be or do something to a greater degree
to be greater or better than someone or something

ex.en: Your homemade cakes surpass anything sold at our local bakery.
ex.zh: 你自制的蛋糕比我們附近麵包店賣的任何蛋糕都好。

ex.en: Demand for renewable energy may surpass current forecasts as governments introduce stronger measures to reduce carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 隨著各國政府採取更有力的減碳措施，可再生能源需求可能超過目前的預測。

col: surpass previous levels｜超過以往水平
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語，不加than。

tr: a. 強壯的, 肌肉發達的, 有力的
[醫] 肌的; 肌肉發達的
肌肉發達的；強壯的
肌肉的
def: a. of or relating to or consisting of muscle
s. having or suggesting great physical power or force
Having large, strong muscles.

ex.en: The muscular swimmer lifted the heavy box easily.
ex.zh: 那位肌肉發達的游泳運動員輕鬆舉起了沉重的箱子。

ex.en: Regular resistance training can improve muscular strength and help older adults maintain their independence.
ex.zh: 定期進行抗阻訓練可以增強肌肉力量，幫助老年人保持獨立生活的能力。

words.tip: 既可指肌肉發達，也可僅表示與肌肉有關。

tr: n. 垃圾堆；垃圾填埋地
垃圾填埋場
垃圾填埋
def: n. a low area that has been filled in
A place where waste is buried in the ground.
The disposal of waste by burying it in the ground.

ex.en: The truck carried our rubbish to a nearby landfill.
ex.zh: 卡車把我們的垃圾運到了附近的填埋場。

ex.en: Expanding recycling services could reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill each year.
ex.zh: 擴大回收服務範圍可以減少每年送去填埋的生活垃圾量。

col: send waste to landfill｜將垃圾送去填埋
words.tip: 指填埋場時可數；指填埋處理時通常不可數。

tr: vt. 交換, 折償, 減輕
vi. 代償, 經常乘車來往
通勤；往返上班
通勤路程
減輕刑罰
def: n. a regular journey of some distance to and from your place of work
v. exchange positions without a change in value
v. travel back and forth regularly, as between one's place of work and home

ex.en: I commute by train and usually read a book.
ex.zh: 我坐火車上下班，路上通常會看書。

ex.en: Employees who commute long distances may experience greater stress and have less time for family activities.
ex.zh: 長距離通勤的員工可能承受更大壓力，陪伴家人的時間也更少。

words.tip: 通勤用 commute to work；減刑用 commute a sentence。

tr: a. 時間的, 暫時的, 現世的, 世俗的, 顳的, 太陽穴的
n. 世間萬物, 教會財產
時間的
世俗的；非宗教的
顳部的
def: s. not eternal
a. of or relating to or limited by time
a. of or relating to the temples (the sides of the skull behind the orbit)

ex.en: We arranged the family photos in temporal order.
ex.zh: 我們把家庭照片按時間順序排列。

ex.en: Understanding temporal patterns in electricity demand can help cities manage their energy supplies more efficiently.
ex.zh: 瞭解用電需求隨時間變化的規律，有助於城市更高效地管理能源供應。

words.tip: temporal指時間的；temporary才表示暫時的。

tr: n. 勇氣, 猛拉, 動物內臟
vt. 摘, 猛拉, 拔, 拉, 扯, 採
vi. 拉, 拽
def: n. the act of pulling and releasing a taut cord
v. pull or pull out sharply
v. pull lightly but sharply with a plucking motion

tr: a. 陰曆的, 月的, 微亮的(指光)
[醫] 月的, 銀的
月球的；月亮的
按月相制定的；陰曆的
def: a. of or relating to or associated with the moon
Relating to the moon.
Based on the changing phases of the moon.

ex.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden.
ex.zh: 我們在花園裡觀看了月食。

ex.en: Research on lunar rocks helps scientists understand how the moon and the early solar system developed.
ex.zh: 對月球岩石的研究有助於科學家瞭解月球及早期太陽系的演變。

words.tip: lunar指月亮的；solar指太陽的。

tr: n. 不符合, 差異, 不相符之處
[化] 不符值; 偏差值
不一致；差異
def: n. a difference between conflicting facts or claims or opinions
n. an event that departs from expectations
A difference between things that should match.

ex.en: We noticed a discrepancy between the two shopping receipts.
ex.zh: 我們發現兩張購物小票上的內容不一致。

ex.en: The discrepancy between official figures and survey results raises concerns about the accuracy of employment statistics.
ex.zh: 官方數據與調查結果的差異引發了人們對就業統計準確性的擔憂。

words.tip: 常指本應一致卻不符，搭配 between 或 in。

tr: a. 全然的, 絕對的, 完全的
vt. 發出聲音, 做聲, 發表, 發射, 流通
完全的；徹底的
說出；發出聲音
def: v. express audibly; utter sounds (not necessarily words)
v. put into circulation
Complete or total, used to emphasise something

ex.en: The kitchen was in utter chaos after we baked.
ex.zh: 我們烘焙完後，廚房徹底亂成了一團。

ex.en: Without adequate planning, rapid urban expansion can result in utter confusion over land ownership and infrastructure responsibilities.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏充分規劃，快速的城市擴張可能導致土地所有權與基礎設施責任劃分完全混亂。

words.tip: 形容詞utter只放名詞前；副詞用utterly。

tr: a. 誠實的, 正直的, 真摯的, 純淨的
真誠的；誠摯的
def: a. open and genuine; not deceitful
Honestly expressing what you really feel or believe

ex.en: Her sincere apology helped us become friends again.
ex.zh: 她真誠的道歉讓我們重新成為了朋友。

ex.en: Sincere efforts to consult local residents can strengthen public trust in major urban development projects.
ex.zh: 真誠徵求當地居民意見的努力，可以增強公眾對重大城市開發項目的信任。

words.tip: sincere強調不虛假；sincerely常用於信件結尾。

tr: n. 崩, 薨, 死亡
vt. 讓渡, 遺贈, 轉讓
def: v. transfer by a lease or by a will

tr: a. 早產的, 過早的, 不成熟的
n. 早產兒, 過早發生的事物
過早的；時機未到的
早產的
def: a. born after a gestation period of less than the normal time
s. uncommonly early or before the expected time
happening before the expected or appropriate time

ex.en: Our celebration was premature; the match wasn't over yet.
ex.zh: 我們慶祝得太早了，比賽還沒結束。

ex.en: It would be premature to conclude that the policy has succeeded without examining its long-term effects.
ex.zh: 在考察這項政策的長期影響之前，就斷定它已取得成功，為時尚早。

col: premature to conclude｜下結論為時過早
words.tip: premature強調過早；immature常指不成熟。

tr: vi. 招徠顧客, 兜售物品
vt. 招徠, 刺探...情報
n. 兜售者, 偵查者
def: n. someone who buys tickets to an event in order to resell them at a profit
n. someone who advertises for customers in an especially brazen way
v. advertize in strongly positive terms

tr: n. 火山口, 環行山, 彈坑
[化] 焊口; 火山石; 弧坑; 焰口
def: n. a faint constellation in the southern hemisphere near Hydra and Corvus
n. a bowl-shaped depression formed by the impact of a meteorite or bomb

tr: n. 小丑, 鄉下人
小丑
愛耍寶的人
耍寶；逗樂
def: n. a rude or vulgar fool
n. a person who amuses others by ridiculous behavior
v. act as or like a clown

ex.en: The clown made a tiny dog from a balloon.
ex.zh: 小丑用一個氣球做出了一隻小狗。

ex.en: A trained clown can help young patients feel more comfortable during their stay in hospital.
ex.zh: 受過訓練的小丑演員能幫助住院兒童放鬆心情。

words.tip: clown around意為耍寶；稱人clown也可能帶貶義。

tr: n. 溝渠
vt. 在...開溝
vi. 開溝
溝；排水溝
拋棄；放棄
def: n. a long narrow excavation in the earth
n. any small natural waterway
v. forsake

ex.en: Rainwater flowed through the ditch beside our vegetable garden.
ex.zh: 雨水流過我們菜園旁的排水溝。

ex.en: Cities should ditch outdated planning policies that encourage car dependence and invest instead in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 城市應摒棄鼓勵依賴汽車的過時規劃政策，轉而投資可靠的公共交通。

words.tip: 作動詞表示拋棄或放棄時偏口語。

tr: vt. 理解, 包括
def: v get the meaning of something
v to become aware of through the senses
v include in scope; include as part of something broader; have as one's sphere or territory

tr: vt. 處理, 排列, 佈置
vi. 處置
處理；丟棄
使傾向於；使願意
def: v. give, sell, or transfer to another
v. make receptive or willing towards an action or attitude or belief
v. place or put in a particular order

ex.en: Where can I dispose of these old batteries safely?
ex.zh: 我可以在哪裡安全地處理這些舊電池？

ex.en: Local authorities should provide convenient facilities so residents can dispose of household waste responsibly.
ex.zh: 地方政府應提供便利的設施，讓居民能夠負責任地處理生活垃圾。

col: dispose of unwanted items｜處理不需要的物品
be disposed to agree｜傾向於同意
words.tip: 表示丟棄必須用dispose of，不能直接接物品。

tr: n. 皇室, 王族成員, 王權, 特權階層, 莊嚴
[經] 特許權, 使用費, 使用稅
王室成員；王族
版稅；特許權使用費
def: n. payment to the holder of a patent or copyright or resource for the right to use their property
n. royal persons collectively
people who belong to a royal family

ex.en: The palace once served as a home for royalty.
ex.zh: 這座宮殿曾是王室成員的住所。

ex.en: Authors often rely on royalties from book sales to support themselves while developing new creative projects.
ex.zh: 作家在開展新的創作項目時，往往依靠圖書銷售的版稅維持生活。

col: a member of royalty｜王室成員
words.tip: 指王族時不可數；指版稅收入時常用複數royalties。

tr: a. 回答的, 應答的, 易感應的
def: a. containing or using responses; alternating
a. readily reacting or replying to people or events or stimuli; showing emotion

tr: v. 疏散, 撤出, 排洩
def: v. move out of an unsafe location into safety
v. empty completely
v. move people from their homes or country

tr: n. 擠壓, 壓碎的東西, 南瓜屬植物, 擁擠的人群
vt. 壓扁, 鎮壓, 壓制
vi. 被壓扁, 發濺潑聲, 擠入
壓扁；擠進
壁球
def: n. any of numerous annual trailing plants of the genus Cucurbita grown for their fleshy edible fruits
n. edible fruit of a squash plant; eaten as a vegetable
n. a game played in an enclosed court by two or four players who strike the ball with long-handled rackets

ex.en: Don't squash the bread under those heavy shopping bags.
ex.zh: 別把麵包壓在那些沉重的購物袋下面。

ex.en: Playing squash regularly can improve cardiovascular fitness, although beginners should increase the intensity of exercise gradually.
ex.zh: 經常打壁球可以增強心肺功能，不過初學者應逐步提高運動強度。

words.tip: 英式英語中還可指需加水稀釋的濃縮果汁飲料。

tr: vt. 使緊密聯繫, 使附屬, 接納, 收養
vi. 發生聯繫, 參加
使隸屬；加入組織
附屬機構；關聯公司
def: n. a subordinate or subsidiary associate; a person who is affiliated with another or with an organization
n. a subsidiary or subordinate organization that is affiliated with another organization
v. join in an affiliation

ex.en: Our local cycling club is affiliated with a national organisation.
ex.zh: 我們當地的自行車俱樂部隸屬於一個全國性組織。

ex.en: Small research institutes often affiliate with universities to gain access to specialist equipment and academic expertise.
ex.zh: 小型研究機構常與大學建立隸屬關係，以獲得使用專業設備和藉助學術專長的機會。

col: be affiliated with｜與……有隸屬關係
a local affiliate｜地方附屬機構
words.tip: 名詞詞尾讀 /ət/，動詞詞尾讀 /eɪt/。

tr: a. 難懂的, 易忘的, 難以捉摸的
def: s. difficult to describe
s. skillful at eluding capture
s. difficult to detect or grasp by the mind or analyze

tr: v. 避開, 躲避
n. 詭計, 躲藏
閃開；躲避
逃避；迴避
逃避的花招
def: n. a quick evasive movement
n. a statement that evades the question by cleverness or trickery
v. make a sudden movement in a new direction so as to avoid

ex.en: I dodged a puddle and nearly dropped my shopping.
ex.zh: 我躲開一個水坑，差點把買的東西掉在地上。

ex.en: Public officials who dodge difficult questions may weaken citizens' trust in the institutions they represent.
ex.zh: 公職人員迴避棘手問題，可能會削弱公民對其所代表機構的信任。

words.tip: 可直接接賓語：dodge a question表示迴避問題。

tr: n. 免疫, 免疫性, 免除
[化] 免疫性
def: n. (medicine) the condition in which an organism can resist disease
n. the quality of being unaffected by something

tr: n. 信任, 信賴, 受信賴的人(或事)
[法] 信任, 信賴, 信心
依賴；信賴
def: n. certainty based on past experience
n. the state of relying on something
The state of depending on or trusting someone or something.

ex.en: Cycling to work has reduced my reliance on buses.
ex.zh: 騎車上班減少了我對公交車的依賴。

ex.en: Reducing reliance on fossil fuels requires sustained investment in renewable energy and improvements to public transport infrastructure.
ex.zh: 減少對化石燃料的依賴，需要持續投資可再生能源，並改善公共交通基礎設施。

col: heavy reliance on｜對……的嚴重依賴
reduce reliance on｜減少對……的依賴
words.tip: reliance是不可數名詞，通常與on搭配。

tr: n. 核心, 核子, 原子核, 起點
[計] 核心程序
細胞核
原子核
核心；中心
def: n. a part of the cell containing DNA and RNA and responsible for growth and reproduction
n. the positively charged dense center of an atom
n. (astronomy) the center of the head of a comet; consists of small solid particles of ice and frozen gas that vaporizes on approaching the sun to form the coma and tail

ex.en: The cell's nucleus looked purple under our classroom microscope.
ex.zh: 在教室的顯微鏡下，這個細胞的細胞核呈紫色。

ex.en: Damage to genetic material in the nucleus can affect how a cell functions and divides.
ex.zh: 細胞核中的遺傳物質受損會影響細胞的功能和分裂。

col: form the nucleus of｜構成……的核心
words.tip: 複數為nuclei；可指細胞核或原子核。

tr: n. 旋風, 龍捲風, 大雷雨
龍捲風
def: n. a localized and violently destructive windstorm occurring over land characterized by a funnel-shaped cloud extending toward the ground
a violently rotating column of air reaching down from a cloud

ex.en: We watched the tornado from a safe underground shelter.
ex.zh: 我們在安全的地下避難處觀察那場龍捲風。

ex.en: Effective warning systems can reduce injuries when a tornado approaches a densely populated area.
ex.zh: 當龍捲風接近人口密集地區時，有效的預警系統能夠減少人員受傷。

col: a powerful tornado｜強烈的龍捲風
tornado damage｜龍捲風造成的破壞
words.tip: 複數可寫tornadoes或tornados。

tr: vt. 使一致, 使遵守, 使符合
vi. 一致, 符合, 適應
遵守；符合
順從；隨俗
def: v. be similar, be in line with
to follow rules or meet required standards
to behave as others in a group expect

ex.en: These new helmets conform to the latest safety standards.
ex.zh: 這些新頭盔符合最新的安全標準。

ex.en: Pressure to conform can discourage young people from expressing original ideas or questioning established traditions.
ex.zh: 要求隨大流的壓力可能使年輕人不願表達獨創想法，也不敢質疑既有傳統。

col: pressure to conform｜要求隨大流的壓力
words.tip: 常用conform to rules或standards，不直接接賓語。

tr: n. 袖口, 一巴掌
vt. 用巴掌打
vi. 毆鬥
def: n. the lap consisting of a turned-back hem encircling the end of the sleeve or leg
v. hit with the hand

tr: n. 芽, 花蕾
vi. 發芽, 萌芽
vt. 使發芽
芽；花蕾
發芽；長出花蕾
def: n. a partially opened flower
n. a swelling on a plant stem consisting of overlapping immature leaves or petals
v. develop buds

ex.en: A tiny green bud appeared on the bare branch.
ex.zh: 光禿禿的樹枝上冒出了一個小小的綠芽。

ex.en: Warmer spring temperatures can cause trees to bud earlier, leaving new growth vulnerable to sudden frost.
ex.zh: 春季氣溫升高會使樹木提前發芽，導致新芽容易受到突發霜凍的損害。

col: nip something in the bud｜將某事扼殺在萌芽中
words.tip: 動詞過去式budded，現在分詞budding，雙寫d。

tr: vt. 抵住, 頂住, 經得起
承受；抵擋；經受住
def: v resist or confront with resistance
v stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
To resist damage or remain strong under pressure

ex.en: These boots can withstand rain, mud, and rough paths.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子經得起雨水、泥濘和崎嶇道路的考驗。

ex.en: Coastal infrastructure must be designed to withstand stronger storms as climate change increases the frequency of extreme weather.
ex.zh: 隨著氣候變化使極端天氣更加頻繁，沿海基礎設施的設計必須能抵禦更強的風暴。

col: withstand extreme temperatures｜耐受極端溫度
words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為withstood；後直接接賓語。

tr: n. 耳環, 耳飾
def: n. jewelry to ornament the ear; usually clipped to the earlobe or fastened through a hole in the lobe

tr: vt. 驅逐, 逐出, 排出, 開除
[醫] 排除, 迫出
def: v. force to leave or move out

tr: n. 消失, 消滅, 廢止
[化] 消光; 熄滅
滅絕；消亡
def: n. no longer active; extinguished
n. no longer in existence
n. the reduction of the intensity of radiation as a consequence of absorption and radiation

ex.en: These rare birds face extinction if their forest disappears.
ex.zh: 如果這片森林消失，這些珍稀鳥類就會面臨滅絕。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential to preventing the extinction of species threatened by intensive farming and urban expansion.
ex.zh: 保護自然棲息地對於防止受集約化農業和城市擴張威脅的物種滅絕至關重要。

col: on the brink of extinction｜瀕臨滅絕
words.tip: extinct是形容詞；extinction是通常不可數的名詞。

tr: n. 裝置, 器具, 器官
[化] 儀器; 器械
def: n. equipment designed to serve a specific function
n. (anatomy) a group of body parts that work together to perform a given function

tr: n. 鬆弛, 鬆懈, 淡季, 閒散, 家常褲
a. 鬆弛的, 不流暢的, 疏忽的, 無力的, 呆滯的, 軟弱的, 漏水的
adv. 馬虎地, 緩慢地
vt. 放鬆, 使緩慢
vi. 鬆懈, 減弱, 鬆弛
def: n. dust consisting of a mixture of small coal fragments and coal dust and dirt that sifts out when coal is passed over a sieve
n. a stretch of water without current or movement
n. the quality of being loose (not taut)

ex.en: The tent rope was slack after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨過後，帳篷的繩子鬆了。

ex.en: When demand is slack, manufacturers may reduce working hours rather than dismiss experienced employees immediately.
ex.zh: 需求疲軟時，製造商可能會縮短工作時間，而不是立即解僱有經驗的員工。

col: take up the slack｜收緊鬆弛部分；補位
words.tip: slack指鬆弛或懈怠；slacks是寬鬆長褲。

tr: n. 木材, 破舊傢俱, 廢物, 隆隆聲
vt. 砍伐木材, 亂堆
vi. 笨拙地移動, 喧鬧地向前走, 隆隆地移動
木材；鋸好的木料
笨重地緩慢移動
def: n. the wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material
v. move heavily or clumsily
Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English.

ex.en: We bought some lumber to build a garden bench.
ex.zh: 我們買了些木料，準備做一張花園長椅。

ex.en: Demand for sustainably sourced lumber can encourage forest owners to adopt more responsible management practices.
ex.zh: 對可持續來源木材的需求可以促使林場主採取更負責任的管理方式。

col: a stack of lumber｜一堆木料
words.tip: 木材義多用於美式英語，英式通常用timber。

tr: a. 善良的, 良性的
[醫] 良性的
def: a. not dangerous to health; not recurrent or progressive (especially of a tumor)
a. pleasant and beneficial in nature or influence
s. kindness of disposition or manner

tr: n. 奉獻, 獻身, 獻辭
[計] 專用
def: n. complete and wholehearted fidelity
n. a ceremony in which something (as a building) is dedicated to some goal or purpose
n. a short message (as in a book or musical work or on a photograph) dedicating it to someone or something

tr: vt. 綁架, 誘拐, 拐騙
[法] 拐帶, 誘拐, 綁架
綁架；劫持
def: v. take away to an undisclosed location against their will and usually in order to extract a ransom
To take someone away illegally and hold them captive

ex.en: In the film, criminals kidnap a wealthy businessman.
ex.zh: 電影中，犯罪分子綁架了一位富商。

ex.en: International cooperation helps police investigate criminal groups that kidnap people and demand money for their release.
ex.zh: 國際合作有助於警方調查綁架他人並索要贖金的犯罪團伙。

col: kidnap someone for ransom｜綁架某人索取贖金
words.tip: 不限於兒童；常用過去式kidnapped，分詞kidnapping。

tr: a. 有...傾向的, 易於的, 恰當的, 聰明的
[計] 自動數控語言, 自動圖象傳輸, 自動程序控制, 自動程序設計工具
def: s. (usually followed by `to') naturally disposed toward
s. at risk of or subject to experiencing something usually unpleasant
s. mentally quick and resourceful

tr: n. 定金, 誠摯, 認真
a. 認真的, 熱心的, 重要的
def: n. something of value given by one person to another to bind a contract
s. characterized by a firm and humorless belief in the validity of your opinions

tr: a. 互相耦合的, 清晰的, 明瞭的，凝聚性的, 連貫的
連貫的；條理清楚的
def: a. marked by an orderly, logical, and aesthetically consistent relation of parts
s. capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner
a. (physics) of waves having a constant phase relation

ex.en: After some practice, he gave a clear, coherent explanation.
ex.zh: 經過一些練習，他給出了清晰而有條理的解釋。

ex.en: A coherent transport policy should connect investment in public services with long-term environmental and economic goals.
ex.zh: 一項協調一致的交通政策應將公共服務投資與長期環境和經濟目標聯繫起來。

col: a coherent argument｜條理清楚的論證
a coherent explanation｜連貫清晰的解釋
a coherent strategy｜協調一致的策略
words.tip: 強調內容邏輯連貫；cohesive更強調各部分銜接緊密。

tr: n. 主要產物, 常用品, 主要要素, 原料, 訂書釘, 鉤環
a. 主要的, 重要的
vt. 分級, 釘住
def: n. a natural fiber (raw cotton, wool, hemp, flax) that can be twisted to form yarn
n. a short U-shaped wire nail for securing cables
n. paper fastener consisting of a short length of U-shaped wire that can fasten papers together

tr: n. 匾, 飾板, 名牌, 勳章, 胸襟飾物, 血小板
def: n. (pathology) a small abnormal patch on or inside the body

tr: n. 自傳
自傳
def: n. a biography of yourself
a book about someone's life written by that person

ex.en: My grandmother is writing her autobiography at the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我祖母正在廚房桌旁寫自傳。

ex.en: An autobiography offers insights into personal experience, although its account of historical events may be selective.
ex.zh: 自傳有助於深入瞭解個人經歷，但其中對歷史事件的敘述可能有所取捨。

words.tip: autobiography是本人寫的自傳；biography是傳記。

tr: a. 能共處的, 可並立的, 適合的
[計] 相容的; 兼容的
兼容的；可並存的
合得來的
def: a. able to exist and perform in harmonious or agreeable combination
a. capable of being used with or connected to other devices or components without modification
s. capable of forming a homogeneous mixture that neither separates nor is altered by chemical interaction

ex.en: This charger is compatible with both of our tablets.
ex.zh: 這個充電器兼容我們的兩臺平板電腦。

ex.en: Economic growth can be compatible with environmental protection if governments encourage cleaner production and responsible resource use.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓勵更清潔的生產方式和負責任的資源利用，經濟增長就能與環境保護並行。

words.tip: 固定搭配是compatible with，不用compatible to。

tr: n. 沙丘
def: n. a ridge of sand created by the wind; found in deserts or near lakes and oceans

tr: n. 清洗, 染髮, 染髮劑
vt. 以清水沖洗, 漱, 漂清
vi. 被漂淨
def: n. a liquid preparation used on wet hair to give it a tint
n. the removal of soap with clean water in the final stage of washing
n. the act of giving a light tint to the hair

tr: a. 易受影響的, 易感動的, 容許...的
[法] 易感的, 易受影響的, 容許
易受影響的；易患病的
def: a. (often followed by `of' or `to') yielding readily to or capable of
s. easily impressed emotionally
easily affected or harmed by something

ex.en: These young plants are particularly susceptible to frost damage.
ex.zh: 這些幼苗特別容易遭受霜凍損害。

ex.en: Children may be more susceptible to online advertising because they lack experience in evaluating commercial claims.
ex.zh: 兒童可能更容易受到網絡廣告影響，因為他們缺乏評估商業宣傳的經驗。

words.tip: 常用susceptible to，to後接名詞。

tr: a. 無情的, 冷酷的, 殘酷的
持續不減的；不懈的
冷酷無情的
def: s not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty
s never-ceasing
continuing strongly without stopping or becoming less intense

ex.en: The relentless rain kept us indoors all weekend.
ex.zh: 雨下個不停，我們整個週末都待在屋裡。

ex.en: Relentless pressure to achieve high grades can undermine students' confidence and damage their mental health.
ex.zh: 持續不斷的高分壓力會削弱學生的信心，並損害他們的心理健康。

words.tip: 不限於“無情的”，也常形容雨、壓力等持續不減。

tr: v. (使)粉碎, (使)成為碎屑, 瓦解, 崩潰, 敗落
碎裂；弄碎
逐漸崩潰；衰敗
def: v. fall apart
v. break or fall apart into fragments
to break, or make something break, into small pieces

ex.en: The dry biscuit crumbled as I picked it up.
ex.zh: 我拿起那塊幹餅乾時，它碎了。

ex.en: Without regular maintenance, historic buildings may crumble, causing communities to lose an important part of their heritage.
ex.zh: 如果沒有定期維護，歷史建築可能逐漸坍塌，使社區失去重要的文化遺產。

col: crumble under pressure｜在壓力下崩潰
words.tip: 既可指實物碎裂，也可指信心、權力等崩潰。

tr: n. 吸血鬼
[醫] 吸血蝙蝠
def: n. (folklore) a corpse that rises at night to drink the blood of the living

tr: n. 天篷, 遮篷, 蒼穹
vt. 用天蓬遮蓋
def: n. the transparent covering of an aircraft cockpit
n. the umbrellalike part of a parachute that fills with air
n. a covering (usually of cloth) that serves as a roof to shelter an area from the weather

tr: a. 母親的, 母系的, 母方的
[醫] 屬母的, 母的, 母性的
def: a. characteristic of a mother
a. relating to or derived from one's mother

tr: a. 鈍的, 坦率的, 麻痺的
鈍的；不鋒利的
直言不諱的；生硬的
使變鈍；削弱
def: v. make less intense
v. make less sharp
s. having a broad or rounded end

ex.en: This blunt knife cannot even cut a ripe tomato.
ex.zh: 這把鈍刀連熟透的番茄都切不開。

ex.en: Although blunt feedback can feel uncomfortable, it sometimes helps students identify weaknesses in their work.
ex.zh: 雖然直白的反饋可能讓人不舒服，但有時能幫助學生髮現作業中的不足。

words.tip: 形容言語時指直接甚至冒犯，不一定是褒義。

tr: vt. 勝過, 優於, 擅長
vi. 勝過其他
def: v. distinguish oneself

tr: n. 感激之情
感激；感恩
def: n. a feeling of thankfulness and appreciation
A feeling of thankfulness for help or kindness received.

ex.en: She brought fresh flowers to express her gratitude.
ex.zh: 她帶來鮮花表達感激之情。

ex.en: Schools can encourage gratitude by helping students recognise the contributions that others make to their daily lives.
ex.zh: 學校可以幫助學生認識到他人對自己日常生活的貢獻，從而培養感恩之心。

col: gratitude to someone｜對某人的感激
gratitude for something｜對某事的感激
a token of gratitude｜一點謝意
words.tip: 對人感激用to，對某事感激用for；通常不可數。

tr: a. 天文學的, 龐大的
極其巨大的；天文數字的
天文學的
def: a relating or belonging to the science of astronomy
s inconceivably large
Extremely large, especially when describing prices, costs, or amounts.

ex.en: The hotel charged an astronomical price for one night.
ex.zh: 這家酒店一晚的收費高得驚人。

ex.en: The astronomical cost of housing in major cities can prevent young adults from achieving financial independence.
ex.zh: 大城市高得驚人的住房成本可能使年輕人無法實現經濟獨立。

col: astronomical sums｜天文數字般的金額
words.tip: 談費用時常表示高得驚人；也可表示天文學的。

tr: a. 獨裁的, 獨裁主義的
def: n. a person who behaves in a tyrannical manner
s. characteristic of an absolute ruler or absolute rule; having absolute sovereignty
s. expecting unquestioning obedience

tr: n. 樣子, 色度, 色彩, 叫聲, 色調
[計] 色調
def: n. the quality of a color as determined by its dominant wavelength
v. take on color or become colored

tr: n. 酶
[化] 酶
def: n. any of several complex proteins that are produced by cells and act as catalysts in specific biochemical reactions

tr: n. 不一致
[醫] 差異, 不等
def: n. inequality or difference in some respect

tr: n. 截取, 妨礙, 截距
vt. 攔截, 阻止, 截取
def: n. the point at which a line intersects a coordinate axis
v. seize on its way

tr: n. 圓筒, 圓筒狀物, 汽缸, 柱面
[計] 柱面
def: n. a solid bounded by a cylindrical surface and two parallel planes (the bases)
n. a surface generated by rotating a parallel line around a fixed line
n. a chamber within which piston moves

tr: a. 可怕的, 悲慘的, 陰沉的, 極端的
def: s fraught with extreme danger; nearly hopeless
s causing fear or dread or terror

tr: n. 薄膜, 膜, 羊皮紙
[化] 膜; 隔膜
def: n. a thin pliable sheet of material
n. a pliable sheet of tissue that covers or lines or connects the organs or cells of animals or plants

tr: vt. 拆除...的設備, 分解, 去除覆蓋物
def: v tear down so as to make flat with the ground
v take apart into its constituent pieces
v take off or remove

tr: n. 滑動, 滑過, 流水
vi. 滑動, 滑翔, 溜走, 流逝
vt. 使滑動
平穩滑行；輕盈移動
滑翔
def: n. the activity of flying a glider
v. move smoothly and effortlessly
v. fly in or as if in a glider plane

ex.en: The swan glided across the pond towards the reeds.
ex.zh: 天鵝平穩地遊過池塘，朝蘆葦叢靠近。

ex.en: Large birds conserve energy by gliding on rising air currents rather than continuously flapping their wings.
ex.zh: 大型鳥類藉助上升氣流滑翔，而不是持續拍打翅膀，以此節省能量。

col: glide through the air｜在空中滑翔
words.tip: 強調移動平穩輕盈；空中滑翔也用glide。

tr: n. 開始, 攻擊, 進攻
[醫] 起始, 開始
開始；發作
def: n. the beginning or early stages
The beginning of something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: The sudden onset of rain sent us running indoors.
ex.zh: 突然下起雨來，我們趕緊跑進屋裡。

ex.en: Regular physical activity may delay the onset of certain chronic diseases and improve overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 經常進行體育活動可能延緩某些慢性病的發生，並改善整體健康狀況。

col: the onset of symptoms｜症狀的出現
the onset of winter｜冬季的來臨
words.tip: 常用the onset of，多指疾病或不利情況的開始。

tr: n. 廣場, 市場, 購物區
def: n. a public square with room for pedestrians

n. mercantile establishment consisting of a carefully landscaped complex of shops representing leading merchandisers; usually includes restaurants and a convenient parking area; a modern version of the traditional marketplace

tr: n. 陶器, 陶器廠
[化] 陶器
陶器
製陶；陶藝
陶器作坊；陶器廠
def: n. ceramic ware made from clay and baked in a kiln
n. the craft of making earthenware
n. a workshop where clayware is made

ex.en: The market stall displayed pottery in soft earthy colours.
ex.zh: 市場攤位上陳列著色調柔和、帶有泥土色澤的陶器。

ex.en: Traditional pottery can reveal how earlier societies stored food, traded goods, and expressed their cultural identity.
ex.zh: 傳統陶器能夠揭示早期社會如何儲存食物、交易商品以及表達文化身份。

words.tip: 指陶器統稱時不可數；一件用a piece of pottery。

tr: n. 敬畏
vt. 使敬畏
def: n. an overwhelming feeling of wonder or admiration
v. inspire awe in

tr: n. 無數, 無數的人(或物)
a. 無數的, 種種的
def: n. a large indefinite number

tr: a. 不夠的, 不能勝任的, 不充足的
[法] 不足的, 不充分的, 不能勝任的
不足的；不充分的
def: a. of a quantity not able to fulfill a need or requirement
not enough for a particular need or purpose

ex.en: We had insufficient paint to finish the kitchen walls.
ex.zh: 我們的油漆不夠，無法刷完廚房的牆。

ex.en: Insufficient funding prevents many rural schools from providing students with reliable internet access and modern learning materials.
ex.zh: 資金不足使許多鄉村學校無法為學生提供可靠的網絡連接和現代學習資料。

col: insufficient to meet demand｜不足以滿足需求
words.tip: 較正式；常用insufficient for或insufficient to do。

tr: n. 文件夾, 摺紙機, 摺疊式書本, 卷宗
[計] 文件夾
文件夾；紙夾
電腦文件夾
def: n. covering that is folded over to protect the contents
A folded cover used to hold loose papers.
A place on a computer where files are grouped together.

ex.en: Keep your receipts in this folder beside the desk.
ex.zh: 把收據放在桌子旁的這個文件夾裡。

ex.en: Organising digital resources into clearly named folders can help students locate information efficiently during research projects.
ex.zh: 將數字資源整理到命名清晰的文件夾中，可以幫助學生在研究項目中高效查找信息。

col: save files in a folder｜將文件存入文件夾
words.tip: file是文件；folder是存放文件的文件夾。

tr: n. 天線, 觸鬚, 觸角
[化] 天線
def: n. an electrical device that sends or receives radio or television signals
n. sensitivity similar to that of a receptor organ
n. one of a pair of mobile appendages on the head of e.g. insects and crustaceans; typically sensitive to touch and taste

tr: a. 貌似真實的, 貌似合理的, 說得煞有其事的
[法] 花言巧語的, 似乎有理的
貌似合理的；可信的
def: a. apparently reasonable and valid, and truthful
s. given to or characterized by presenting specious arguments
Seeming reasonable or likely to be true

ex.en: His explanation sounded plausible, but I still checked.
ex.zh: 他的解釋聽起來很合理，但我還是核實了一下。

ex.en: Although remote working offers a plausible solution to congestion, its long-term effects require further investigation.
ex.zh: 雖然遠程辦公似乎是緩解擁堵的合理方案，但其長期影響仍需進一步研究。

col: plausible excuse｜聽起來可信的藉口
plausible solution｜看似可行的解決方案
words.tip: 表示聽起來合理，不保證真實，也不一定暗指虛假。

tr: a. 惡言謾罵的, 被濫用的, 腐敗的, 虐待的
def: s. expressing offensive reproach
s. characterized by physical or psychological maltreatment

tr: a. 升空的, 空運的, 空中傳播的, 空降的
def: s. moved or conveyed by or through air

tr: vt. 使困擾, 使煩惱, 折磨
def: v. annoy continually or chronically
v. exhaust by attacking repeatedly

tr: a. 表示實在的, 有實質的, 獨立存在的, 大量的, 重大的, 堅實的, 名詞的
n. 名詞性實詞, 名詞
def: n. any word or group of words functioning as a noun
a. defining rights and duties as opposed to giving the rules by which rights and duties are established

tr: vt. 授予, 帶來
vi. 協商
商議；協商
授予；賦予
def: v. have a conference in order to talk something over
v. present
Discuss something with others before making a decision.

ex.en: The coaches conferred quietly before choosing the final team.
ex.zh: 教練們低聲商議後才確定最終的隊伍陣容。

ex.en: Universities often confer honorary degrees on individuals who have made outstanding contributions to science or public service.
ex.zh: 大學常向在科學或公共服務領域作出傑出貢獻的人士授予榮譽學位。

col: confer a degree on someone｜授予某人學位
words.tip: 商議用confer with；授予用confer sth on sb。

tr: vt. 使癱瘓, 使麻痺
[醫] 使麻痺, 使癱瘓
使癱瘓；使麻痺
使停擺；使無法行動
def: v. make powerless and unable to function
v. cause to be paralyzed and immobile
Make someone unable to move all or part of their body.

ex.en: Some spinal injuries can paralyze both of a person's legs.
ex.zh: 某些脊柱損傷會導致雙腿癱瘓。

ex.en: Severe flooding can paralyze urban transport networks, preventing workers from reaching essential services and workplaces.
ex.zh: 嚴重洪災會使城市交通網絡癱瘓，導致勞動者無法前往基本服務場所和工作地點。

col: paralyzed by fear｜嚇得無法動彈
words.tip: 美式拼寫paralyze；英式通常寫paralyse。

tr: a. 熱的, 熱量的, 溫泉的
n. 上升溫暖氣流
熱的；與熱量有關的
保暖的；保溫的
上升熱氣流
def: n. rising current of warm air
a. relating to or associated with heat
a. of or relating to a hot spring

ex.en: Our thermal camera shows where heat escapes the house.
ex.zh: 我們的熱成像相機能顯示房屋哪些地方在散熱。

ex.en: Improving thermal insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and make homes more comfortable during winter.
ex.zh: 改善老舊建築的隔熱性能可以減少能源消耗，讓住宅在冬季更加舒適。

words.tip: thermal可指與熱有關，也可指衣物保暖。

tr: vt. 喚醒, 鼓勵, 引起
vi. 醒來
激起；引起
喚醒
def: v. call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses)
v. to begin moving, "As the thunder started the sleeping children began to stir"
v. stimulate sexually

ex.en: The locked wooden box aroused my curiosity immediately.
ex.zh: 那個上鎖的木盒立刻引起了我的好奇。

ex.en: Proposals to replace public parks with commercial buildings are likely to arouse strong opposition among local residents.
ex.zh: 用商業建築取代公共公園的提案很可能激起當地居民的強烈反對。

words.tip: arouse 後接賓語；arise 表示“出現”，不接賓語。

tr: n. 矮樹, 灌木, 果汁甜酒
灌木
def: n. a low woody perennial plant usually having several major stems
A woody plant with several stems, usually smaller than a tree

ex.en: A small bird was hiding beneath the flowering shrub.
ex.zh: 一隻小鳥躲在開花的灌木下面。

ex.en: Planting native shrubs in urban parks provides shelter for wildlife and can reduce the need for irrigation.
ex.zh: 在城市公園種植本地灌木能為野生動物提供棲息處，還能減少灌溉需求。

words.tip: 可數名詞，指灌木植株；一片灌木可用shrubbery。

tr: n. 小樹林
小樹林；果樹林
def: n. a small growth of trees without underbrush
n. garden consisting of a small cultivated wood without undergrowth
a small group of trees, often planted together

ex.en: We spread our picnic blanket in a shady grove.
ex.zh: 我們在一片綠蔭濃密的小樹林裡鋪開了野餐毯。

ex.en: Traditional olive groves support rural livelihoods while providing valuable habitats for birds and other wildlife.
ex.zh: 傳統橄欖園既維繫農村居民的生計，也為鳥類和其他野生動物提供寶貴的棲息地。

col: a grove of trees｜一片小樹林
words.tip: grove是一小片樹木，常用於橄欖、柑橘等果樹林。

tr: a. 緊迫的, 迫切的, 熱切的
n. 壓, 壓榨, 沖壓件, 唱片

s. compelling immediate action

tr: vt. 鞏固, 使聯合, 統一
vi. 鞏固
[計] 合併計算
鞏固；加強
合併；整合
def: v. unite into one
v. make firm or secure; strengthen
v. bring together into a single whole or system

ex.en: I review my notes each evening to consolidate my learning.
ex.zh: 我每晚複習筆記，以鞏固所學內容。

ex.en: Regular practical exercises help students consolidate their knowledge and apply theoretical concepts to unfamiliar situations.
ex.zh: 定期的實踐練習有助於學生鞏固知識，並將理論概念應用於陌生情境。

words.tip: 既可指鞏固已有成果，也可指合併多個部分。

tr: n. 法庭, 法官席, 裁決
[法] 法庭, 裁判所, 裁判
def: n an assembly (including one or more judges) to conduct judicial business

tr: a. 豐富的, 富裕的
n. 支流, 富人
def: n. an affluent person; a person who is financially well off
s. having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value

tr: vt. 使惡化, 使增劇, 激怒, 使加劇
def: v. exasperate or irritate

tr: n. 可觸知的東西, 有形資產
a. 可觸摸的, 有實體的, 非相像的, 有形的, 明確的
def: a. perceptible by the senses especially the sense of touch
a. (of especially business assets) having physical substance and intrinsic monetary value

tr: n. 壯舉, 功績, 技藝表演
a. 靈巧的, 合適的, 整潔的
壯舉；非凡成就
def: n. a notable achievement
An achievement requiring great skill, strength, or courage.

ex.en: Carrying that huge sofa upstairs was quite a feat.
ex.zh: 把那張大沙發搬上樓可真不容易。

ex.en: Building a railway across mountainous terrain remains an impressive feat of engineering, even with modern technology.
ex.zh: 即使有現代技術，在山區修建鐵路仍是一項令人讚歎的工程壯舉。

col: an impressive feat｜令人讚歎的壯舉
a feat of engineering｜工程壯舉
no mean feat｜了不起的成就
words.tip: 與feet同音；no mean feat意為很了不起。

tr: n. 呻吟, 嘆息
vi. 呻吟, 抱怨, 受壓迫
vt. 呻吟地說
def: n. an utterance expressing pain or disapproval
v. indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure

tr: a. 好戰的
def: n. a militant reformer
s. disposed to warfare or hard-line policies

tr: n. 潛伏, 潛行
vi. 暗藏, 潛伏, 埋伏
[計] 隱匿閱讀
潛伏；鬼祟地躲藏
暗藏；潛在
def: v. lie in wait, lie in ambush, behave in a sneaky and secretive manner
stay hidden, often waiting to do something
exist unnoticed and potentially cause trouble

ex.en: A cat lurked behind the sofa, watching my shoelaces.
ex.zh: 一隻貓躲在沙發後面，盯著我的鞋帶。

ex.en: Security risks may lurk in outdated software, making regular system updates essential for protecting personal information.
ex.zh: 過時的軟件中可能暗藏安全風險，因此定期更新系統對保護個人信息至關重要。

col: lurk in the shadows｜潛伏在暗處
words.tip: 通常作不及物動詞；可用危險等抽象事物作主語。

tr: a. 有結尾的, (可)結束的
vi. 結束, 終止, 滿期
vt. 使停止, 使結束, 使終止
[計] 終止
終止；結束
def: v bring to an end or halt
v have an end, in a temporal, spatial, or quantitative sense; either spatial or metaphorical
v be the end of; be the last or concluding part of

ex.en: We decided to terminate our gym membership last month.
ex.zh: 我們上個月決定終止健身房會員資格。

ex.en: Employers should not terminate contracts without providing clear reasons and allowing workers sufficient time to respond.
ex.zh: 僱主終止合同時，應提供明確理由，並給予員工充足的回應時間。

col: terminate at a station｜在某站終到
words.tip: 正式用詞；可及物或不及物，列車終到用at。

tr: n. 雜亂一團, 混亂, 擁擠
vt. 把...擠在一起, 亂堆, 草率了事, 蜷曲
vi. 擠作一團, 蜷縮
擠在一起；蜷縮
擠在一起的人群
def: n. (informal) a quick private conference
n. a disorganized and densely packed crowd
v. crowd or draw together

ex.en: We huddled under one umbrella until the rain stopped.
ex.zh: 我們擠在同一把傘下，直到雨停。

ex.en: Without adequate shelter, displaced families may huddle together outdoors, increasing their exposure to cold and illness.
ex.zh: 缺乏足夠住所時，流離失所的家庭可能只好在戶外擠作一團，更容易受寒和生病。

col: huddle for warmth｜擠在一起取暖
huddle around a fire｜圍著火堆擠在一起
words.tip: huddle強調緊靠，常為取暖、避險或私下商議。

tr: n. 閣樓, 頂樓
[醫] 鼓室上隱窩
def: n. the dialect of Ancient Greek spoken and written in Attica and Athens and Ionia
n. informal terms for a human head
n. (architecture) a low wall at the top of the entablature; hides the roof

tr: n. 星座, 薈萃
[化] 構象
def: n. a configuration of stars as seen from the earth

tr: n. 演習, 調遣, 策略
v. 調遣, 演習, 用計
def: n. a military training exercise
n. a deliberate coordinated movement requiring dexterity and skill
n. a move made to gain a tactical end

tr: n. 海盜, 盜印者, 侵犯專利權者
vt. 盜印, 掠奪, 翻印
vi. 做海盜, 從事劫掠
海盜
盜版；非法複製
def: n. someone who robs at sea or plunders the land from the sea without having a commission from any sovereign nation
n. a ship that is manned by pirates
v. copy illegally; of published material

ex.en: The pirate in the story sailed a wooden ship.
ex.zh: 故事裡的海盜駕駛著一艘木船。

ex.en: When companies pirate educational software, they undermine the income that developers need to improve their products.
ex.zh: 企業盜版教育軟件，會損害開發者改進產品所需的收入。

words.tip: pirated強調被非法複製；piracy是對應名詞。

tr: n. 碎屑, 麵包屑, 少許
vt. 捏碎, 弄碎
麵包屑；糕餅屑
少許；點滴
def: n. a very small quantity of something
n. small piece of e.g. bread or cake
v. coat with bread crumbs

ex.en: A crumb fell from my toast onto the table.
ex.zh: 一粒麵包屑從我的吐司上掉到了桌上。

ex.en: Even small food scraps, such as bread crumbs, can attract pests when waste is poorly managed.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾處理不當，即使是麵包屑這樣的小塊食物殘渣，也會招來害蟲。

col: a crumb of comfort｜一絲安慰
words.tip: 可數名詞；表示麵包屑時常用複數crumbs。

tr: n. 性情, 處置, 處理, 佈置
[醫] 素因, 性情
性情；性格
傾向；意願
部署；排列
def: n. your usual mood
n. a natural or acquired habit or characteristic tendency in a person or thing
a person's usual mood and way of behaving

ex.en: Her cheerful disposition makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
ex.zh: 她開朗的性格讓陰雨天的早晨也顯得明亮起來。

ex.en: Children with a cautious disposition may benefit from gradual exposure to unfamiliar classroom activities.
ex.zh: 性格謹慎的孩子逐步接觸陌生的課堂活動，可能會從中受益。

col: a disposition to help｜樂於助人的傾向
a disposition towards anxiety｜容易焦慮的傾向
words.tip: 性情義常用單數；a disposition to do表示做某事的傾向。

tr: n. 變應性, 反感, 厭惡
[化] 變態反應; 變應性
過敏；過敏症
def: n. hypersensitivity reaction to a particular allergen; symptoms can vary greatly in intensity
A condition causing illness after contact with a normally harmless substance

ex.en: My brother has an allergy to peanuts and walnuts.
ex.zh: 我哥哥對花生和核桃過敏。

ex.en: Schools should have clear procedures for helping children who experience a severe food allergy reaction.
ex.zh: 學校應制定明確流程，為出現嚴重食物過敏反應的兒童提供幫助。

words.tip: 常用have an allergy to；to後接引起過敏的物質。

tr: n. 飛鏢, 投射
vt. 投射
vi. 疾走, 突進
猛衝；飛奔
飛鏢
def: n. a small narrow pointed missile that is thrown or shot
n. a tapered tuck made in dressmaking
v. run or move very quickly or hastily

ex.en: A squirrel darted across the path ahead of us.
ex.zh: 一隻松鼠在我們前方飛快地穿過小路。

ex.en: When animals dart across busy roads, wildlife crossings can provide safer routes and help protect local populations.
ex.zh: 當動物飛快地穿越繁忙道路時，野生動物通道可以提供更安全的路線，幫助保護當地種群。

col: dart across the road｜飛快地穿過馬路
dart a glance at｜迅速瞥一眼
words.tip: 飛鏢運動用darts；作主語時謂語用單數。

tr: n. 忠貞, 效忠
忠誠；效忠
def: n. the loyalty that citizens owe to their country (or subjects to their sovereign)
Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.

ex.en: Despite moving abroad, he kept his allegiance to his hometown club.
ex.zh: 儘管移居國外，他仍忠於家鄉的俱樂部。

ex.en: Political allegiance can influence how voters interpret economic policies and assess the performance of elected officials.
ex.zh: 政治立場上的忠誠會影響選民如何解讀經濟政策，以及如何評價當選官員的表現。

words.tip: 效忠對象用to引出：allegiance to a country。

tr: n. 重罪
[法] 重罪, 重刑罪
def: n. a serious crime (such as murder or arson)

tr: n. 熔合物, 結合, 熔合
[化] 熔融; 熔化; 聚變
融合；結合
核聚變
def: n. an occurrence that involves the production of a union
n. the merging of adjacent sounds or syllables or words
n. a nuclear reaction in which nuclei combine to form more massive nuclei with the simultaneous release of energy

ex.en: Her cooking is a fusion of different regional styles.
ex.zh: 她的烹飪融合了不同地區的風格。

ex.en: Scientists are investigating nuclear fusion as a potential source of abundant energy with low carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 科學家正在研究核聚變，將其視為一種潛在的、供應充足且碳排放低的能源。

col: a fusion of styles｜多種風格的融合
words.tip: 核聚變用fusion；核裂變用fission，注意區分。

tr: n. 小教堂, 禮拜式
def: n. a place of worship that has its own altar

tr: n. 王座, 君主
王座；寶座
王位；王權
def: n. the chair of state for a monarch, bishop, etc.
n. the position and power of an exalted person (a sovereign or bishop) who is entitled to sit in a chair of state on ceremonial occasions
v. sit on the throne as a ruler

ex.en: The queen sat on a throne beside the window.
ex.zh: 女王坐在窗邊的王座上。

ex.en: Her accession to the throne marked a significant change in the country's political relationship with its neighbours.
ex.zh: 她登基標誌著該國與鄰國的政治關係發生了重大變化。

col: sit on a throne｜坐在王座上
heir to the throne｜王位繼承人
words.tip: the throne可指王位，不一定指實體座椅。

tr: a. 複雜的, 錯綜的, 纏結的, 難懂的
def: s. having many complexly arranged elements; elaborate

tr: n. 牧歌, 田園詩
a. 牧人的, 田園生活的, 牧師的, 田園式的
def: n. a letter from a pastor to the congregation
n. a literary work idealizing the rural life (especially the life of shepherds)
a. of or relating to a pastor

tr: n. 果園, 果樹林
def: n garden consisting of a small cultivated wood without undergrowth

tr: a. 壁的, 壁上的, 壁似的
n. 壁畫
def: n. a painting that is applied to a wall surface
a. of or relating to walls

tr: n. 弦, 和音
[醫] 索, 帶
def: n. a straight line connecting two points on a curve
n. a combination of three or more notes that blend harmoniously when sounded together
v. play chords on (a string instrument)

tr: n. 瘋狂, 狂暴, 狂怒
[醫] 暴怒, 狂亂
def: n state of violent mental agitation

tr: n. 否決權
vt. 否決, 禁止
否決權；否決
否決；禁止
def: n. a vote that blocks a decision
n. the power or right to prohibit or reject a proposed or intended act (especially the power of a chief executive to reject a bill passed by the legislature)
v. vote against; refuse to endorse; refuse to assent

ex.en: The club president used her veto to stop the purchase.
ex.zh: 俱樂部主席行使否決權，叫停了這次購買。

ex.en: Giving every member a veto can protect minority interests but may also delay urgent collective decisions.
ex.zh: 賦予每位成員否決權可以保護少數群體的利益，但也可能拖延緊迫的集體決策。

words.tip: 複數vetoes；動詞過去式vetoed。

tr: n. 陋屋, 棚屋
vi. 居住, 暫住
def: n small crude shelter used as a dwelling
v make one's home in a particular place or community
v move, proceed, or walk draggingly or slowly

tr: a. 謀叛的, 起義的, 澎湃的
n. 起義者, 叛亂者
def: n. a person who takes part in an armed rebellion against the constituted authority (especially in the hope of improving conditions)
s. in opposition to a civil authority or government

tr: a. 蕭瑟的, 荒涼的, 陰冷的
黯淡的；無望的
荒涼的；陰冷的
def: s. unpleasantly cold and damp
offering little hope of improvement or success
cold, bare, and unwelcoming

ex.en: Without enough rain, the farm faces a bleak future.
ex.zh: 如果雨水不足，這座農場的前景就很黯淡。

ex.en: Employment prospects remain bleak in rural areas where traditional industries have declined and investment is limited.
ex.zh: 在傳統產業衰退且投資有限的農村地區，就業前景依然黯淡。

words.tip: 既可描述荒涼陰冷的環境，也可描述無望的前景。

tr: n. 挫折, 退步, 逆流
def: n an unfortunate happening that hinders or impedes; something that is thwarting or frustrating

tr: n. 面紗, 面罩, 藉口, 幕, 帳, 遮蔽物
vt. 戴面紗, 隱藏, 遮蔽, 掩飾
vi. 蒙上面紗
面紗；面罩
遮蔽物；掩飾
def: n. a membranous covering attached to the immature fruiting body of certain mushrooms
v. to obscure, or conceal with or as if with a veil
a thin piece of material covering the face or head

ex.en: She lifted her veil to take a sip of water.
ex.zh: 她掀起面紗，喝了一小口水。

ex.en: A veil of secrecy around major planning decisions can weaken public trust in local government.
ex.zh: 重大規劃決策被秘密籠罩，會削弱公眾對地方政府的信任。

col: a veil of secrecy｜神秘的掩蓋
thinly veiled criticism｜幾乎不加掩飾的批評
words.tip: a veil of可比喻一層遮掩；veiled也表示含蓄的。

tr: a. 不安靜的, 慌張的, 休息不充分的
[醫] 不安靜的, 不寧的
坐立不安的；難以休息的
不滿足現狀的
def: s. worried and uneasy
s. ceaselessly in motion
a. lacking or not affording physical or mental rest

ex.en: The restless child kept swinging her legs under the table.
ex.zh: 那個坐不住的孩子不停地在桌下晃腿。

ex.en: Students may become restless during lengthy lectures if they have few opportunities to participate actively.
ex.zh: 如果缺少積極參與的機會，學生在長時間的講座中可能會坐立不安。

col: a restless spirit｜不甘安定的性情
words.tip: restless指難以安靜；restful指令人放鬆的。

tr: n. 改革運動, 十字軍東侵

def: n. any of the more or less continuous military expeditions in the 11th to 13th centuries when Christian powers of Europe tried to recapture the Holy Land from the Muslims
v. exert oneself continuously, vigorously, or obtrusively to gain an end or engage in a crusade for a certain cause or person; be an advocate for
v. go on a crusade; fight a holy war

tr: n. 免職, 作證, 沉澱
[化] 沉積
def: n. the natural process of laying down a deposit of something
n. (law) a pretrial interrogation of a witness; usually conducted in a lawyer's office
n. the act of deposing someone; removing a powerful person from a position or office

tr: n. 軀幹, 裸體軀幹雕像
[醫] 軀幹
def: n. the body excluding the head and neck and limbs

tr: n. 姜, 精力, 薑黃色
a. 薑黃色的
vt. 用姜調味, 使活潑, 使有生氣
def: n. perennial plants having thick branching aromatic rhizomes and leafy reedlike stems
n. dried ground gingerroot
n. pungent rhizome of the common ginger plant; used fresh as a seasoning especially in Asian cookery

tr: n. 用力的投擲
vt. 用力投擲, 發射, 憤慨地說出, 丟下
vi. 猛投, 猛擲
def: n. a violent throw
v. throw forcefully
v. utter with force; utter vehemently

tr: a. 空中的, 航空的, 空氣的, 空想的
n. 天線
空中的；從空中進行的
天線
def: a. existing or living or growing or operating in the air
Happening in the air or done from above the ground.
A device that receives or sends radio or television signals.

ex.en: The aerial photograph showed our house beside the river.
ex.zh: 這張航拍照片拍出了我們河邊的房子。

ex.en: Aerial surveys allow researchers to monitor forest loss across remote regions without disturbing wildlife.
ex.zh: 航空調查讓研究人員能夠監測偏遠地區的森林流失，而不驚擾野生動物。

words.tip: 作“天線”主要用於英式英語；美式常用antenna。

tr: n. 親戚, 同族, 血緣關係, 家族
a. 有親屬關係的, 性質類似的, 同類的
def: n. a person having kinship with another or others
n. group of people related by blood or marriage

tr: a. 成功的, 繁盛的, 幸運的
[經] 繁榮的, 昌盛的
繁榮的；富裕的
def: s in fortunate circumstances financially; moderately rich
s very lively and profitable
s marked by peace and prosperity

ex.en: The once quiet village is now a prosperous market town.
ex.zh: 這個曾經安靜的村莊如今已成為繁榮的集鎮。

ex.en: A prosperous economy can generate the resources needed to improve education, healthcare, and public infrastructure.
ex.zh: 繁榮的經濟能夠創造改善教育、醫療和公共基礎設施所需的資源。

words.tip: 常修飾國家、地區或經濟，強調經濟上的興旺。

tr: a. 辯論的, 法院的, 關於法庭的
n. 辯論練習
法醫的；司法鑑定的
細緻嚴密的
def: s. of, relating to, or used in public debate or argument
s. used or applied in the investigation and establishment of facts or evidence in a court of law
relating to scientific methods used to investigate crime

ex.en: The forensic team carefully examined fingerprints on the window.
ex.zh: 司法鑑定團隊仔細檢查了窗戶上的指紋。

ex.en: Advances in forensic science can help courts assess evidence more accurately and reduce wrongful convictions.
ex.zh: 司法鑑定科學的進步能幫助法庭更準確地評估證據，減少錯誤定罪。

col: forensic examination｜法醫檢驗；細緻審查
words.tip: forensic通常作形容詞；學科名詞常用forensics。

tr: n. 樹葉, 植物
def: n the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants
n (architecture) leaf-like architectural ornament

tr: vt. 解開...的皮帶, 發出, 發動
def: v. release or vent
v. release from a leash
v. turn loose or free from restraint

tr: v. 吃吃地笑, 咯咯地笑
n. 咯咯笑, 傻笑
咯咯地笑
咯咯的笑聲
