v. laugh nervously
laugh in a light, often nervous or silly way

ex.en: The children giggled when the puppy chased its tail.
ex.zh: 小狗追著自己的尾巴轉，孩子們咯咯地笑了起來。

ex.en: Young learners may giggle during unfamiliar activities, but this reaction does not necessarily indicate a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 年幼的學習者進行不熟悉的活動時可能會咯咯笑，但這種反應不一定表明他們缺乏興趣。

col: giggle at a joke｜聽到笑話咯咯笑
words.tip: 強調輕輕咯咯笑，可因好玩或緊張；笑某事用at。

tr: n. 關稅, 關稅表, 價格表, 收費表
vt. 課以關稅
[計] 價目表
關稅
收費標準；價目表
def: v. charge a tariff
a tax charged on goods entering or leaving a country
a set of charges for a service

ex.en: The new tariff made imported cheese much more expensive.
ex.zh: 新關稅使進口奶酪貴了很多。

ex.en: Although tariffs may protect domestic manufacturers, they can also raise consumer prices and provoke trade disputes.
ex.zh: 關稅雖然可能保護國內製造商，但也可能推高消費價格並引發貿易爭端。

words.tip: 關稅用tariff on goods；複數tariffs常指多項關稅。

tr: n. 支配, 控制, 管轄
def: n. social control by dominating
n. power to dominate or defeat

tr: a. 無知識的, 不知道的, 由無知產生的
[法] 無知的, 愚昧的, 不知情的
不瞭解的；不知道的
無知的；缺乏教養的
def: s. uneducated in general; lacking knowledge or sophistication
s. uneducated in the fundamentals of a given art or branch of learning; lacking knowledge of a specific field
s. unaware because of a lack of relevant information or knowledge

ex.en: I was ignorant of the rules until someone explained them.
ex.zh: 直到有人解釋，我才瞭解這些規則。

ex.en: Consumers who remain ignorant of online privacy risks may share sensitive information without considering the consequences.
ex.zh: 不瞭解網絡隱私風險的消費者，可能會在未考慮後果的情況下分享敏感信息。

col: ignorant of the facts｜不瞭解事實
words.tip: 常用be ignorant of；直接形容人可能帶貶義。

tr: vt. 派遣
n. 派遣, 急件
[計] 調度
派遣；發送
發送；派遣
def: n. an official report (usually sent in haste)
n. the act of sending off something
n. the property of being prompt and efficient

ex.en: The shop dispatched my new shoes this morning.
ex.zh: 商店今天早上寄出了我的新鞋。

ex.en: Local authorities should dispatch emergency teams quickly when severe flooding threatens homes and essential infrastructure.
ex.zh: 當嚴重洪災威脅住宅和關鍵基礎設施時，地方政府應迅速派出應急隊伍。

words.tip: despatch也是正確拼寫，但dispatch更常見。

tr: n. 假面目, 假裝
vt. 假裝, 隱瞞
喬裝；掩飾
偽裝；喬裝用品
def: n. an outward semblance that misrepresents the true nature of something
n. any attire that modifies the appearance in order to conceal the wearer's identity
n. the act of concealing the identity of something by modifying its appearance

ex.en: Nadia disguised herself with a wig and oversized glasses.
ex.zh: 娜迪婭戴上假髮和超大眼鏡，把自己喬裝起來。

ex.en: Attractive packaging can disguise poor product quality, making it harder for consumers to make informed choices.
ex.zh: 精美包裝可能掩蓋產品質量問題，使消費者更難作出明智選擇。

col: disguise yourself as｜把自己裝扮成
disguise the fact that｜掩蓋……的事實
a blessing in disguise｜因禍得福的事
words.tip: disguise oneself as後接所扮角色。

tr: a. 居間的, 間接的
vt. 斡旋, 調停
vi. 處於中間, 調解
調解；斡旋
def: v. occupy an intermediate or middle position or form a connecting link or stage between two others
a. acting through or dependent on an intervening agency
To help opposing sides reach an agreement.

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to mediate when we argued about parking.
ex.zh: 我們因停車問題爭吵時，鄰居主動提出調解。

ex.en: Independent organisations can mediate between employers and workers to resolve disputes before they disrupt essential public services.
ex.zh: 獨立機構可以在僱主與員工之間進行調解，在糾紛影響基本公共服務之前將其解決。

col: mediate between two sides｜在雙方之間調解
mediate a settlement｜調解達成和解
words.tip: mediate側重促成協議；arbitrate可指作出仲裁。

tr: vt. 修改, 改善, 改良
vi. 改過自新
修訂；修改
def: v. make amendments to
To change a document, rule, or plan to improve it.

ex.en: Please amend the booking to include one extra guest.
ex.zh: 請修改預訂，增加一位客人。

ex.en: Parliament may amend existing legislation to ensure that remote workers receive the same protections as office employees.
ex.zh: 議會可能修訂現行法律，確保遠程工作者獲得與辦公室員工相同的保護。

words.tip: 常指修改文件或法律；修理實物通常用mend。

tr: n. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 贗品
[醫] 模仿, 仿製, 仿製品
模仿；仿效
仿製品
仿製的；人造的
def: n. the doctrine that representations of nature or human behavior should be accurate imitations
n. something copied or derived from an original
n. copying (or trying to copy) the actions of someone else

ex.en: His imitation of a sleepy cat made us laugh.
ex.zh: 他模仿睏倦貓咪的樣子逗得我們大笑。

ex.en: Young children acquire many social skills through imitation, making positive adult behaviour especially important in early education.
ex.zh: 幼兒通過模仿習得許多社交技能，因此成人的積極行為在早期教育中尤為重要。

col: learn by imitation｜通過模仿學習
a poor imitation｜拙劣的模仿；劣質仿品
words.tip: 模仿行為通常不可數；一件仿製品用an imitation。

tr: n. 關節炎
[醫] 關節炎
def: n. inflammation of a joint or joints

tr: [化] 基因組
[醫] 染色體組
def: n. the ordering of genes in a haploid set of chromosomes of a particular organism; the full DNA sequence of an organism

tr: vt. 塞滿, 填滿, 猛吃
vi. 貪吃
n. 極度擁擠, 死記硬背
塞滿；擠入
考前突擊學習
def: v. put something somewhere so that the space is completely filled
v. study intensively, as before an exam
v. prepare (students) hastily for an impending exam

ex.en: She crammed three sweaters into her tiny overnight bag.
ex.zh: 她把三件毛衣硬塞進了小小的過夜旅行包。

ex.en: Students who cram for examinations may remember facts briefly but struggle to develop a deeper understanding.
ex.zh: 考前突擊的學生可能暫時記住知識，卻難以形成更深入的理解。

col: cram into a bag｜硬塞進包裡
cram a room with people｜讓房間擠滿人
cram for an exam｜考前突擊複習
words.tip: 過去式crammed；複習考試用cram for。

tr: n. 長釘, 鞋釘, 釘狀物, 尖峰狀物, 穗
vt. 以大釘釘牢, 用尖物刺穿, 阻止, 棄置不用
[計] 尖峰信號
def: n. a transient variation in voltage or current
n. sports equipment consisting of a sharp point on the sole of a shoe worn by athletes
n. (botany) an indeterminate inflorescence bearing sessile flowers on an unbranched axis

tr: n. 調色板, 顏料
[計] 調色板
def: n. the range of colour characteristic of a particular artist or painting or school of art
n. board that provides a flat surface on which artists mix paints and the range of colors used

tr: n. 悲嘆, 悔恨, 慟哭, 輓歌, 悼詞
vt. 哀悼
vi. 悔恨, 悲嘆
悲嘆；哀悼
哀嘆；輓歌
def: n. a cry of sorrow and grief
v. express grief verbally
To express sadness or regret about something.

ex.en: My grandparents often lament the loss of local shops.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母常為附近小店的消失而嘆息。

ex.en: Many residents lament the destruction of historic buildings, arguing that redevelopment weakens the city's cultural identity.
ex.zh: 許多居民為歷史建築遭到拆除而惋惜，認為改建削弱了城市的文化特色。

col: lament the loss of｜為失去……而悲嘆
a lament for｜為……而作的哀歌
words.tip: 較正式；動詞可直接接賓語，也可接that從句。

tr: vt. 點燃, 使灼熱, 使興奮
點燃；燃燒
激起；引發
def: v. cause to start burning; subject to fire or great heat
To start burning or cause something to burn.
To cause a strong feeling or situation to begin.

ex.en: A tiny spark ignited the dry wood in the fireplace.
ex.zh: 一顆小火星點燃了壁爐裡的幹木柴。

ex.en: Practical science lessons can ignite students' curiosity and encourage them to explore unfamiliar ideas independently.
ex.zh: 科學實踐課能夠激發學生的好奇心，鼓勵他們獨立探索陌生的概念。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物；還可比喻激起興趣或爭論。

tr: a. 交替的, 輪流的, 間隔的
v. 輪流, (使)交替
def: v. go back and forth; swing back and forth between two states or conditions
v. exchange people temporarily to fulfill certain jobs and functions
v. do something in turns

tr: n. 欺凌弱小者, 土霸
vt. 威脅, 恐嚇, 欺負
vi. 欺負
a. 特好的, 第一流的
adv. 十分
def: n. a cruel and brutal fellow
n. a hired thug

tr: n. 兵工廠, 軍械庫
[機] 兵工廠
def: n. all the weapons and equipment that a country has
n. a military structure where arms and ammunition and other military equipment are stored and training is given in the use of arms

tr: n. 手鐲
[醫] 手鐲, 腕帶, 腕紋(掌側橫列腕部的線紋)
手鐲；手鍊
def: n. jewelry worn around the wrist for decoration
A piece of jewellery worn around the wrist.

ex.en: She wears a silver bracelet that her grandmother gave her.
ex.zh: 她戴著祖母送給她的一條銀手鍊。

ex.en: A handmade bracelet can reflect local artistic traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.
ex.zh: 手工手鍊既能體現當地藝術傳統，又能為農村社區的手藝人帶來收入。

words.tip: bracelet戴在手腕；anklet戴在腳踝。

tr: vt. 弄汙, 弄髒, 汙染, 毒害
[化] 汙染
汙染；使受汙染
def: v. make radioactive by adding radioactive material
make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful substances

ex.en: Dirty hands can contaminate food while you cook.
ex.zh: 做飯時，不乾淨的手可能會汙染食物。

ex.en: Industrial chemicals can contaminate groundwater, threatening both agricultural production and the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 工業化學品可能汙染地下水，威脅農業生產及附近社區居民的健康。

col: contaminated with chemicals｜受到化學品汙染
words.tip: 常用be contaminated with表示被某物汙染。

tr: vt. 禁止, 抑制
vi. 起抑制作用
抑制；阻礙
使拘謹；使不敢表達
def: v. limit the range or extent of
v. limit, block, or decrease the action or function of
v. control and refrain from showing; of emotions, desires, impulses, or behavior

ex.en: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of these plants.
ex.zh: 寒冷天氣會抑制這些植物的生長。

ex.en: Fear of making mistakes can inhibit students from participating actively in classroom discussions and collaborative tasks.
ex.zh: 害怕犯錯可能使學生不敢積極參與課堂討論和合作任務。

words.tip: inhibit側重抑制或阻礙；prohibit指明令禁止。

tr: n. 困境, 窘境
vt. 宣誓, 保證
def: n. a solemn pledge of fidelity

tr: n. 違約, 不履行責任, 缺席, 默認值
v. 疏怠職責, 缺席, 拖欠, 默認
[計] 默認; 默認值; 缺省值
默認設置；默認選項
違約；拖欠
def: n. loss due to not showing up
n. act of failing to meet a financial obligation
v. fail to pay up

ex.en: This app uses a dark background by default.
ex.zh: 這個應用默認使用深色背景。

ex.en: Borrowers are more likely to default on their loans when unemployment rises and household incomes fall.
ex.zh: 當失業率上升、家庭收入下降時，借款人更容易拖欠貸款。

col: default on a loan｜拖欠貸款
words.tip: by default 表示默認；拖欠貸款用 default on a loan。

tr: vt. 分散, 傳播, 散開
vi. 分散
a. 分散的
[計] 分散
散開；驅散
def: v. to cause to separate and go in different directions
v. move away from each other;
v. separate (light) into spectral rays

ex.en: The crowd began to disperse when the rain started.
ex.zh: 雨一下起來，人群就開始散去。

ex.en: Planting trees can help disperse strong winds and protect exposed farmland from soil erosion.
ex.zh: 植樹有助於分散強風，保護無遮擋的農田免受土壤侵蝕。

words.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：驅散人群或人群散去。

tr: a. 未醉的, 穩重的, 節制的, 嚴肅的, 不誇大的, 合理的, 樸素的
vt. 使醒酒, 使嚴肅
vi. 從醉裡醒來, 變嚴肅
清醒的；未醉的
嚴肅冷靜的；素淡的
def: v. cause to become sober
a. not affected by a chemical substance (especially alcohol)
Not drunk or affected by alcohol.

ex.en: My uncle stayed sober and drove everyone home safely.
ex.zh: 我叔叔沒有喝醉，開車把大家安全送回了家。

ex.en: A sober assessment of environmental risks is essential before governments approve major construction projects.
ex.zh: 政府批准大型建設項目之前，必須冷靜評估環境風險。

words.tip: sober up表示醒酒；sober也可形容冷靜的判斷。

tr: vi. 偷看, 窺視
n. 偷看, 看一眼
def: n. a secret look

tr: vi. 使...不活躍, 變平
vt. 弄平, 打倒, 使失去光澤
弄平；變平
摧毀；夷為平地
def: v. make flat or flatter
v. become flat or flatter
v. lower the pitch of (musical notes)

ex.en: Flatten the dough gently with the palm of your hand.
ex.zh: 用手掌輕輕把麵糰壓平。

ex.en: Developers sometimes flatten existing buildings rather than renovate them, increasing construction waste and destroying local heritage.
ex.zh: 開發商有時會拆平現有建築而非翻修，增加建築垃圾並破壞當地遺產。

words.tip: flatten out也可指價格、曲線等趨於平穩。

tr: a. 白熱的, 灼熱的, 通紅的, 鮮豔的
[化] 輝光
def: s. highly enthusiastic

tr: vt. 損害, 減少, 削弱
[法] 損害, 傷害, 減少
def: v. make worse or less effective

tr: a. 狂亂的, 瘋狂的
焦急萬分的；慌亂的
緊張忙亂的
def: s. excessively agitated; distraught with fear or other violent emotion
Extremely worried or frightened and unable to stay calm
Done very quickly with intense, often uncontrolled activity

ex.en: I grew frantic when I couldn't find my passport.
ex.zh: 找不到護照時，我急得不知所措。

ex.en: The frantic pace of urban life can increase stress and leave residents with little time for relaxation.
ex.zh: 城市生活的緊張節奏會增加壓力，讓居民幾乎沒有時間放鬆。

col: a frantic pace｜緊張忙亂的節奏
frantic with worry｜擔心得心急如焚
words.tip: 強調焦急失控或忙亂，不等於精神失常。

tr: vt. 開墾, 改造, 感化, 糾正, 回收
vi. 喊叫, 抗議
取回；收回
開墾；使土地可用
回收利用
def: v. claim back
v. reuse (materials from waste products)
v. make useful again; transform from a useless or uncultivated state

ex.en: I returned to the station to reclaim my suitcase.
ex.zh: 我回到車站取回自己的行李箱。

ex.en: Coastal cities sometimes reclaim land from the sea to create space for housing and transport.
ex.zh: 沿海城市有時通過填海造地，為住房和交通設施騰出空間。

col: reclaim land｜開墾土地；填海造地
words.tip: reclaim強調收回或恢復利用，不只是收集。

tr: n. 下水道, 陰溝, 裁縫師
vt. 用下水道排, 鋪設下水道於
下水道；汙水管道
def: n. a waste pipe that carries away sewage or surface water
n. someone who sews
An underground pipe that carries away sewage and wastewater

ex.en: Workers cleared the blocked sewer beneath our street.
ex.zh: 工人疏通了我們街道下面堵塞的下水道。

ex.en: Investment in modern sewer systems can reduce water pollution and improve public health in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 投資建設現代汙水管網可以減少水汙染，改善快速發展城市的公共衛生狀況。

words.tip: sewer是管道，sewage是汙水，sewerage指排汙系統。

tr: a. 可繁殖的, 肥沃的, 生產多的
[醫] 能生育的
def: a. capable of reproducing

tr: vt. 揮舞, 運用
def: v. have and exercise
v. handle effectively

tr: n. 平板, 厚片
vt. 切成厚板, 以平板蓋上
def: n. block consisting of a thick piece of something

tr: a. 及時的, 適時的
adv. 及時地
def: s. before a time limit expires
s. done or happening at the appropriate or proper time

tr: n. 厭惡, 嫌惡
vi. 令人厭惡
vt. 使作嘔
厭惡；反感
使厭惡；使反感
def: n. strong feelings of dislike
v. fill with distaste
v. cause aversion in; offend the moral sense of

ex.en: She wrinkled her nose in disgust at the rotten fruit.
ex.zh: 看到腐爛的水果，她厭惡地皺起鼻子。

ex.en: Residents expressed disgust at the illegal dumping of household waste beside the local river.
ex.zh: 居民對在當地河邊非法傾倒生活垃圾的行為表示厭惡。

words.tip: disgusted形容人的感受；disgusting形容令人厭惡的事物。

tr: n. 散文
v. 寫散文
a. 散文的, 平凡的
散文；非韻文
def: n. ordinary writing as distinguished from verse
n. matter of fact, commonplace, or dull expression
Ordinary written language, rather than poetry

ex.en: Her clear prose makes this book easy to enjoy.
ex.zh: 她清晰流暢的文筆讓這本書讀起來輕鬆愉快。

ex.en: Reading well-crafted prose can help students develop a wider vocabulary and express complex ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 閱讀精心寫就的散文可以幫助學生擴大詞彙量，更清晰地表達複雜觀點。

words.tip: 不可數；不限於文學散文，也包括小說等非韻文。

tr: n. 冠, 飾毛, 頭盔的頂部
vi. 到達絕頂
vt. 加以頂飾
def: n. the top line of a hill, mountain, or wave
n. (heraldry) in medieval times, an emblem used to decorate a helmet
n. a showy growth of e.g. feathers or skin on the head of a bird or other animal

tr: n. 喃喃而語, 咕噥
v. 喃喃而語, 咕噥
def: n. a soft indistinct utterance
v. talk indistinctly; usually in a low voice
v. grind with the gums; chew without teeth and with great difficulty

tr: n. 槓桿, 似槓桿之工具
vt. 撬開
vi. 使用槓桿
槓桿；操縱桿
用槓桿撬動
def: n. a rigid bar pivoted about a fulcrum
n. a simple machine that gives a mechanical advantage when given a fulcrum
n. a flat metal tumbler in a lever lock

ex.en: Pull this lever to raise the seat a little.
ex.zh: 拉這個操縱桿，把座位稍微升高一點。

ex.en: Tax policy can serve as a powerful lever for encouraging businesses to invest in cleaner technologies.
ex.zh: 稅收政策可以成為鼓勵企業投資更清潔技術的有力手段。

col: a lever for change｜推動變革的手段
words.tip: 英式首音節讀/liː/，美式通常讀/lev/。

tr: a. 正直的, 誠實的, 公正的, 垂直的, 豎式的
[化] 立杆
def: n. a vertical structural member as a post or stake
n. a piano with a vertical sounding board
s. in a vertical position; not sloping

tr: n. 固執, 堅持不懈, 持續(性), 存留(狀態)
[電] 持久
堅持不懈；毅力
持續存在；存留
def: n the property of a continuous and connected period of time
n persistent determination
n the act of persisting or persevering; continuing or repeating behavior

ex.en: After weeks of practice, his persistence finally paid off.
ex.zh: 經過幾週練習，他的堅持終於有了回報。

ex.en: The persistence of poverty suggests that economic growth alone cannot guarantee better living conditions for every household.
ex.zh: 貧困的持續存在表明，僅靠經濟增長無法保證每個家庭的生活條件都得到改善。

col: persistence pays off｜堅持終有回報
the persistence of poverty｜貧困的持續存在
words.tip: 既可指人的毅力，也可指問題或現象持續存在。

tr: n. 快艇, 遊艇
vi. 駕遊艇, 乘遊艇
遊艇；帆船
def: n. an expensive vessel propelled by sail or power and used for cruising or racing
v. travel in a yacht
A boat used for pleasure trips or racing.

ex.en: We watched a white yacht sail across the bay.
ex.zh: 我們看著一艘白色帆船駛過海灣。

ex.en: The growing popularity of yacht tourism can generate income for coastal communities but may damage marine habitats.
ex.zh: 遊艇旅遊日益流行，能為沿海社區創造收入，但也可能破壞海洋棲息地。

words.tip: ch不發音；通常指休閒或競賽用船。

tr: n. 堡壘, 要塞, 易貨站
vt. 設要塞保衛
vi. 設要塞
堡壘；要塞
def: v. gather in, or as if in, a fort, as for protection or defense
v. station (troops) in a fort
A strong building or enclosed place built for military defence.

ex.en: We climbed the hill to explore the old fort.
ex.zh: 我們爬上山去探索那座古老的堡壘。

ex.en: Restoring the coastal fort could attract tourists while preserving an important part of the region's military history.
ex.zh: 修復這座海岸堡壘既能吸引遊客，也能保留該地區重要的軍事歷史遺產。

words.tip: fort側重軍事防禦；castle常兼作貴族住所。

tr: n. 匿名, 姓氏不明
[計] 匿名信件
def: n. the state of being anonymous

tr: vt. 推翻, 顛覆
vi. 倒塌, 搖搖欲墜
def: v. cause to topple or tumble by pushing

tr: a. 次等的, 較差的, 下方的, 下級的
n. 部下, 次品, 下標(符號)
較差的；劣等的
級別較低的
下屬；級別較低者
def: n. one of lesser rank or station or quality
a. of or characteristic of low rank or importance
a. of low or inferior quality

ex.en: The cheaper bag felt inferior to the leather one.
ex.zh: 那個便宜包摸起來不如皮包好。

ex.en: Schools in disadvantaged areas should not receive inferior equipment simply because local funding is limited.
ex.zh: 弱勢地區的學校不應僅因當地資金有限就獲得較差的設備。

words.tip: 比較用inferior to，不用than；feel inferior指自卑。

tr: n. 士氣, 道德
士氣；集體信心
def: n. a state of individual psychological well-being based upon a sense of confidence and usefulness and purpose
the confidence and enthusiasm of a group

ex.en: Our coach's cheerful speech lifted morale before the match.
ex.zh: 教練充滿活力的講話鼓舞了大家賽前的士氣。

ex.en: Recognising employees' achievements can improve workplace morale and encourage greater cooperation across different departments.
ex.zh: 認可員工的成就可以提升工作士氣，並促進不同部門之間的合作。

words.tip: 不可數；morale指士氣，moral指道德的。

tr: n. 杏仁
[化] 杏仁
扁桃仁；扁桃樹
def: n. small bushy deciduous tree native to Asia and North Africa having pretty pink blossoms and highly prized edible nuts enclosed in a hard green hull; cultivated in southern Australia and California
n. oval-shaped edible seed of the almond tree
an edible oval nut, or the tree that produces it

ex.en: She sprinkled chopped almonds over her bowl of porridge.
ex.zh: 她在那碗燕麥粥上撒了些切碎的扁桃仁。

ex.en: Almond production requires substantial irrigation in some regions, raising concerns about the sustainability of local water supplies.
ex.zh: 一些地區的扁桃種植需要大量灌溉，引發了對當地供水可持續性的擔憂。

words.tip: 通常指扁桃仁（巴旦木），並非杏核中的杏仁。

tr: n. 子公司, 附件, 輔助者
a. 輔助的, 次要的, 津貼的
def: n an assistant subject to the authority or control of another
n a company that is completely controlled by another company
s functioning in a supporting capacity

tr: n. 預言者, 先知, 提倡者
先知
預言者
def: n. an authoritative person who divines the future
n. someone who speaks by divine inspiration; someone who is an interpreter of the will of God
Someone believed to communicate messages from a god.

ex.en: The old painting shows a prophet addressing a crowd.
ex.zh: 這幅古畫描繪了一位先知向人群講話的情景。

ex.en: Throughout history, religious communities have preserved the teachings of prophets through oral traditions and written accounts.
ex.zh: 縱觀歷史，宗教群體通過口述傳統和書面記載保存了先知的教誨。

col: a prophet of doom｜災難預言者
the teachings of a prophet｜先知的教誨
words.tip: 與profit（利潤）同音；動詞為prophesy。

tr: vt. 使有效, 使生效, 確認, 證實, 驗證
[計] 驗證
def: v. declare or make legally valid
v. prove valid; show or confirm the validity of something
v. give evidence for

tr: a. 忙碌的, 愛管閒事的, 自負的, 固執己見的, 實際的, 務實的, 國事的, 國務的
[法] 閒斷的, 固執己見的, 實用主義的
務實的；講求實效的
def: a. of or concerning the theory of pragmatism
Choosing what works in practice rather than following ideals.

ex.en: We took a pragmatic approach and repaired the old sofa.
ex.zh: 我們採取了務實的辦法，把舊沙發修好了。

ex.en: A pragmatic housing policy should balance environmental goals with the immediate needs of local residents.
ex.zh: 務實的住房政策應兼顧環保目標和當地居民的迫切需求。

col: pragmatic solution｜切實可行的解決辦法
words.tip: 強調實際可行和效果，而非理論或理想。

tr: n. 吃草, 放牧, 擦傷, 輕擦
v. (使)吃草, 放牧, 輕擦, 擦傷
吃草；放牧
擦傷；擦過
擦傷
def: n. a superficial abrasion
n. the act of grazing
v. break the skin (of a body part) by scraping

ex.en: Sheep graze quietly beside the river every summer morning.
ex.zh: 每個夏日清晨，羊群都在河邊安靜地吃草。

ex.en: Allowing cattle to graze too intensively can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 讓牛群過度放牧會破壞植被，並增加水土流失的風險。

words.tip: 動物吃草可說graze on grass；graze cattle指放牛。

tr: n. 卷軸, 一卷, 紡車, 旋轉, 蹣跚
vt. 卷...於軸上, 繞, 使旋轉
vi. 蹣跚地走, 旋轉, 眩暈, 搖晃, 退縮
[計] 卷; 盤
卷軸；一卷膠片等
def: n. a roll of photographic film holding a series of frames to be projected by a movie projector
n. music composed for dancing a reel
n. winder consisting of a revolving spool with a handle; attached to a fishing rod

ex.en: She wound the loose fishing line onto the reel.
ex.zh: 她把鬆散的釣魚線繞到了卷線輪上。

ex.en: Local businesses continued to reel from the sudden closure of the region's largest factory.
ex.zh: 該地區最大工廠突然關閉，當地企業持續受到嚴重衝擊。

col: a reel of film｜一卷膠片
reel from the shock｜因震驚而不知所措
reel off a list｜一口氣列舉
words.tip: reel from表示受衝擊；reel off表示一口氣說出。

tr: vt. 減輕, 使緩和
減輕；緩解
def: v provide physical relief, as from pain
v make easier
to make pain, suffering, or a problem less severe

ex.en: A warm bath helped alleviate the ache in my shoulders.
ex.zh: 洗個熱水澡幫助緩解了我的肩膀痠痛。

ex.en: Expanding affordable housing could alleviate pressure on low-income families and reduce the risk of homelessness.
ex.zh: 增加可負擔住房可以減輕低收入家庭的壓力，並降低無家可歸的風險。

words.tip: 直接接痛苦或問題；表示減輕，不一定徹底消除。

tr: n. 主人公, 主角, 領導者
def: n. the principal character in a work of fiction

tr: a. 蔓生的, 不規則地伸展的
def: s. spreading out in different directions

tr: n. 嘲笑, 戲弄, 模仿
a. 假的, 偽造的, 模擬的
adv. 虛偽地
vt. 嘲弄, 模仿, 使失望, 欺騙, 挫敗
vi. 嘲弄
def: n. the act of mocking or ridiculing
v. treat with contempt
v. imitate with mockery and derision

ex.en: Please don't mock my dancing; I'm still learning.
ex.zh: 請別嘲笑我的舞姿，我還在學呢。

ex.en: Mock interviews allow students to practise explaining their skills before they apply for their first professional positions.
ex.zh: 模擬面試讓學生在申請第一份專業工作前，練習如何介紹自己的技能。

col: mock someone's accent｜嘲笑某人的口音
words.tip: mock作動詞直接接賓語，不加at。

tr: vi. 逐步擴大, 逐步升高, 逐步增強
vt. 使逐步上升
def: v. increase in extent or intensity

tr: n. 無花果, 無價值的東西, 少許, 服裝
vt. 打扮, 使馬跑快
def: n. Mediterranean tree widely cultivated for its edible fruit
n. fleshy sweet pear-shaped yellowish or purple multiple fruit eaten fresh or preserved or dried

tr: n. 慎重, 辨別力, 考慮, 處理權
[法] 有決定權的
謹慎；審慎
自行決定權
def: n. freedom to act or judge on one's own
n. knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress
n. the trait of judging wisely and objectively

ex.en: Please use discretion when discussing her private life.
ex.zh: 談論她的私生活時，請注意分寸。

ex.en: Teachers need some discretion to adapt classroom activities to the needs of individual learners.
ex.zh: 教師需要一定的自主決定權，以根據每位學習者的需求調整課堂活動。

col: exercise discretion｜謹慎行事；行使酌處權
at your discretion｜由你酌情決定
words.tip: at someone's discretion表示“由某人酌情決定”。

tr: n. 用力擦洗, 矮樹, 矮人, 渺小之物
vt. 用力擦洗, 擦掉, 摩擦
vi. 擦洗乾淨, 進行手臂消毒
a. 次等的, 矮小的, 非正規球隊的, 臨時湊合的
def: n. dense vegetation consisting of stunted trees or bushes
n. the act of cleaning a surface by rubbing it with a brush and soap and water
v. clean with hard rubbing

tr: n. 粗石, 碎磚, 粗石堆
def: n the remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up

tr: vt. 轉開, 避免, 防止
def: v. turn away or aside

tr: n. 洞, 空穴, 腔
[化] 空穴
def: n. space that is surrounded by something
n. soft decayed area in a tooth; progressive decay can lead to the death of a tooth
n. (anatomy) a natural hollow or sinus within the body

tr: n. 連接詞, 聯合, 結合
[計] 合取
連詞
結合；同時發生
def: n. an uninflected function word that serves to conjoin words or phrases or clauses or sentences
n. the grammatical relation between linguistic units (words or phrases or clauses) that are connected by a conjunction
n. (astronomy) apparent meeting or passing of two or more celestial bodies in the same degree of the zodiac

ex.en: Our teacher used coloured cards to explain conjunctions.
ex.zh: 老師用彩色卡片講解連詞。

ex.en: Public transport improvements work best in conjunction with policies that discourage unnecessary car journeys.
ex.zh: 公共交通的改善與減少不必要駕車出行的政策相結合時，效果最佳。

col: in conjunction with｜與……結合；與……共同
words.tip: in conjunction with常表示“與……共同或結合”。

tr: vt. 扣留, 扣押, 耽擱
[法] 拘留, 扣押, 留住
def: v deprive of freedom; take into confinement
v stop or halt
v cause to be slowed down or delayed

tr: n. 新手, 初學者
新手；初學者
def: n. someone new to a field or activity
someone with little experience in a particular activity

ex.en: As a gardening novice, I often forget to water seedlings.
ex.zh: 作為園藝新手，我常常忘記給幼苗澆水。

ex.en: Structured mentoring can help a novice develop the confidence needed to manage a classroom effectively.
ex.zh: 有系統的指導能幫助新手建立有效管理課堂所需的信心。

words.tip: 表示某方面的新手，常用a novice at/in。

tr: n. 稱讚, 恭維, 敬意
vt. 稱讚, 褒揚, 恭維
讚美；稱讚
稱讚；讚美
def: n. a remark (or act) expressing praise and admiration
v. say something to someone that expresses praise
v. express respect or esteem for

ex.en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
ex.zh: 她對我廚藝的稱讚讓我笑了。

ex.en: Teachers who compliment students on specific improvements can strengthen motivation and encourage continued effort.
ex.zh: 教師若針對學生的具體進步給予表揚，就能增強學習動力，鼓勵他們繼續努力。

col: pay someone a compliment｜稱讚某人
compliment someone on something｜稱讚某人的某方面
words.tip: compliment是讚美；complement是補充、相輔相成。

tr: n. 藍圖, 設計圖, (周詳的)計劃
vt. 製成藍圖, 計劃
def: n. something intended as a guide for making something else
n. photographic print of plans or technical drawings etc.
v. make a blueprint of

tr: n. 活潑, 生氣, 激勵, 卡通製作
[計] 動畫
def: n. the condition of living or the state of being alive
n. the property of being able to survive and grow
n. quality of being active or spirited or alive and vigorous

tr: a. 裸的, 肉色的, 無裝飾的
n. 裸體畫, 裸體
def: n. a painting of a naked human figure
n. without clothing (especially in the phrase `in the nude')
n. a naked person

tr: n. 殘渣, 剩餘, 餘數
[化] 殘基; 殘渣; 殘液; 釜液
殘留物；殘渣
def: n. matter that remains after something has been removed
A substance left behind after a process or removal.

ex.en: The sticker left a sticky residue on the jar.
ex.zh: 貼紙在罐子上留下了黏黏的殘留物。

ex.en: Industrial processes can leave toxic residue in soil, creating long-term risks for nearby ecosystems and communities.
ex.zh: 工業生產過程可能在土壤中留下有毒殘留物，給附近的生態系統和社區帶來長期風險。

words.tip: 常指過程結束後的物質殘留；不同種類可用複數。

tr: n. 極大的痛苦, 掙扎
[醫] 瀕死苦悶; 劇痛
def: n. intense feelings of suffering; acute mental or physical pain
n. a state of acute pain

tr: a. 合適的, 可應用的
[法] 適用的, 適應的
def: s. capable of being applied; having relevance

tr: n. 移情作用, 共鳴
[醫] 移情, 神入
def: n. understanding and entering into another's feelings

tr: v. (使)惡化
def: v. become worse or disintegrate

tr: n. 王室守林人, 騎警, 漫遊者
def: n a member of the Texas state highway patrol; formerly a mounted lawman who maintained order on the frontier
n an official who is responsible for managing and protecting an area of forest
n a member of a military unit trained as shock troops for hit-and-run raids

tr: vt. 收割, 收穫, 獲得
vi. 收割, 得到報應
獲得；收穫成果
收割莊稼
def: v. gather, as of natural products
v. get or derive
to receive results or rewards from previous actions

ex.en: After months of practice, she finally reaped the rewards.
ex.zh: 經過幾個月的練習，她終於收穫了回報。

ex.en: Countries that invest consistently in early education often reap long-term economic and social benefits.
ex.zh: 持續投資幼兒教育的國家往往能獲得長期的經濟和社會效益。

words.tip: 抽象義常搭配benefits或rewards，強調付出後的收穫。

tr: a. 能實行的, 可行的, 適宜的
[法] 可行的, 可執行的, 可完成的
可行的；行得通的
def: s. capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
possible and practical to achieve with available resources

ex.en: Cycling to work is feasible now that I live nearby.
ex.zh: 現在我住得近，騎車上班行得通了。

ex.en: Solar power becomes more economically feasible when installation costs fall and reliable energy storage is available.
ex.zh: 當安裝成本下降且可靠的儲能設施可用時，太陽能在經濟上就更可行。

col: a feasible solution｜可行的解決辦法
a feasible alternative｜可行的替代方案
words.tip: 指條件允許、實際可行，不等於“可信”。

tr: a. 自大的, 傲慢的
def: s. having or showing feelings of unwarranted importance out of overbearing pride

tr: a. 可疑的, 不確定的
懷疑的；拿不準的
可疑的；不可靠的
def: s. not convinced
feeling uncertain or doubtful about something
probably dishonest, unsafe, or not worth trusting

ex.en: I felt dubious about buying a bicycle without brakes.
ex.zh: 對於買一輛沒有剎車的自行車，我心存疑慮。

ex.en: Consumers should remain dubious about health claims that are not supported by reliable scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 消費者應對沒有可靠科學證據支持的健康功效宣稱保持懷疑。

words.tip: 人感到懷疑用dubious about；事物可疑也可用dubious。

tr: n. 建築物的正面, 外觀, 表面
def: n. the face or front of a building
n. a showy misrepresentation intended to conceal something unpleasant

tr: n. 排氣口, 出口, 通風孔, 發洩
vt. 發洩, 排出, 給...開孔
def: n. a hole for the escape of gas or air
n. external opening of urinary or genital system of a lower vertebrate
n. a fissure in the earth's crust (or in the surface of some other planet) through which molten lava and gases erupt

tr: n. 危險, 冒...之險, 險境, 險因
vt. 置...於險境, 冒險, 危及
嚴重危險；險境
def: n a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune
n a state of danger involving risk
n a venture undertaken without regard to possible loss or injury

ex.en: The sudden storm put the small boat in peril.
ex.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨使小船陷入險境。

ex.en: Coastal communities face increasing peril as rising sea levels threaten their homes and essential infrastructure.
ex.zh: 隨著海平面上升威脅到住宅和關鍵基礎設施，沿海社區面臨的危險日益加劇。

col: put someone in peril｜使某人陷入險境
words.tip: 比danger更正式，常用in peril表示身處險境。

tr: n. 支架, 括弧, 托架
vt. 裝托架, 括入括弧
[計] 方括號; 括號
def: n. a category falling within certain defined limits
n. either of two punctuation marks (`<' or `>') used in computer programming and sometimes used to enclose textual material
n. either of two punctuation marks ([ or ]) used to enclose textual material

tr: n. 青腫, 挫傷, 擦傷
vi. 受傷, 擦傷
vt. 使受傷, 研碎
淤青；挫傷
使淤青；碰傷
def: n. an injury that doesn't break the skin but results in some discoloration
v. injure the underlying soft tissue or bone of
v. break up into small pieces for food preparation

ex.en: I have a purple bruise on my knee.
ex.zh: 我的膝蓋上有一塊紫色的淤青。

ex.en: Soft fruit can bruise during transport, so producers need packaging that provides adequate protection.
ex.zh: 軟質水果在運輸中容易碰傷，因此生產者需要使用能提供充分保護的包裝。

words.tip: bruise通常不破皮；cut指割破皮膚的傷口。

tr: vi. 跋涉
vt. 涉水
n. 跋涉, 淺灘
def: n. English tennis player who won many women's singles titles (born in 1945)
v. walk (through relatively shallow water)

tr: v. 為王，為君；當政；統治
n. 為王，為君；當政；統治
君主統治時期
當政；統治
盛行；佔主導地位
def: n. a period during which something or somebody is dominant or powerful
n. the period during which a monarch is sovereign
n. royal authority; the dominion of a monarch

ex.en: This castle was built during a young queen's reign.
ex.zh: 這座城堡建於一位年輕女王在位期間。

ex.en: During the king's reign, investment in public libraries made education more accessible to ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 在這位國王統治期間，對公共圖書館的投入讓普通民眾更容易獲得教育。

col: during the reign of｜在……統治期間
a long reign｜漫長的統治時期
words.tip: 與rain同音；reign指統治，rein指韁繩。

tr: n. 隊伍, 連續, 列隊行進, 湧出
def: n. the group action of a collection of people or animals or vehicles moving ahead in more or less regular formation

tr: n. 遺傳學
[化] 遺傳學
def: n. the branch of biology that studies heredity and variation in organisms

tr: vt. 使永存, 使不朽, 保持
def: v. cause to continue or prevail

tr: n. 呻吟, 悲嘆
vi. 呻吟, 抱怨, 悲嘆
vt. 呻吟著說
呻吟
抱怨；發牢騷
def: n an utterance expressing pain or disapproval
v indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
To make a low sound expressing pain or unhappiness.

ex.en: He moaned softly as the nurse examined his ankle.
ex.zh: 護士檢查他的腳踝時，他輕輕呻吟著。

ex.en: Rather than moan about unreliable buses, residents could ask local authorities to improve public transport.
ex.zh: 居民與其抱怨公交車不準時，不如向地方政府提出改善公共交通的訴求。

col: let out a moan｜發出一聲呻吟
words.tip: 表示抱怨時較口語化，常用moan about。

tr: n. 戰勝, 征服, 戰利品
[法] 征服, 贏得, 獲得
征服；攻佔
征服的領土
def: n. the act of conquering
n. success in mastering something difficult
the act of taking control of a country by force

ex.en: The castle fell after months of fighting and conquest.
ex.zh: 經過數月的戰鬥與征服，這座城堡陷落了。

ex.en: Military conquest often reshaped trade networks and introduced new languages to regions under foreign rule.
ex.zh: 軍事征服往往重塑貿易網絡，並將新語言帶入受外來統治的地區。

words.tip: 表示征服行為可不可數；指徵服的領土時可數。

tr: n. 邊緣, 陡岸
緊要關頭；邊緣
陡邊；崖邊
def: n. a region marking a boundary
n. the edge of a steep place
A point just before something happens, especially something bad.

ex.en: Their little shop was on the brink of closing.
ex.zh: 他們的小店差一點就關門了。

ex.en: Prolonged drought has pushed several rural communities to the brink of a severe food crisis.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱已將幾個農村社區推到嚴重糧食危機的邊緣。

col: on the brink of collapse｜瀕臨崩潰
bring back from the brink｜從危急邊緣挽回
push to the brink｜逼至危急關頭
words.tip: on the brink of後接名詞或動名詞，常指危機。

tr: vi. 向後退, 退卻, 收回, 降低, 減弱
[醫] 退縮
def: v. become faint or more distant

tr: vi. 大量存在, 富於, 充滿
大量存在；充滿
def: v. be abundant or plentiful; exist in large quantities
v. be in a state of movement or action
To exist in large quantities or be very common

ex.en: Wildflowers abound in the fields behind our house each spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天，我們屋後的田野裡都開滿野花。

ex.en: Opportunities for renewable energy development abound in regions with consistent sunshine and strong coastal winds.
ex.zh: 在日照穩定且沿海風力強勁的地區，可再生能源的發展機會十分豐富。

col: abound in wildlife｜野生動物豐富
words.tip: 不及物動詞；某地充滿某物用abound in/with。

tr: n. 測深錘, 鉛墜
vi. 垂直落下
暴跌；驟降
急速墜落
def: v. drop sharply
To decrease very quickly and sharply.
To fall suddenly and quickly from a high position.

ex.en: Temperatures plummeted overnight, leaving ice on the garden pond.
ex.zh: 氣溫一夜間驟降，花園池塘結了冰。

ex.en: Demand for private cars could plummet if cities offered reliable, affordable public transport throughout the day.
ex.zh: 如果城市全天提供可靠且價格合理的公共交通，私家車需求可能會大幅下降。

col: plummet to a record low｜跌至歷史最低點
words.tip: 常作不及物動詞；to接終值，by接降幅。

tr: n. 貪慾, 慾望, 色慾
vi. 貪求, 渴望, 動淫念
def: n. self-indulgent sexual desire (personified as one of the deadly sins)

tr: n. 迷宮, 迷惘
vt. 使迷惘, 使混亂, 迷失
def: n. complex system of paths or tunnels in which it is easy to get lost

tr: n. 流域, 分水嶺
[醫] 分水界, 分水嶺
def: n. a ridge of land that separates two adjacent river systems

tr: a. 發出音的, 讀出來的, 顯著的, 斷然的, 明顯的
[法] 顯著的, 明顯的, 明確的
def: v speak, pronounce, or utter in a certain way
v pronounce judgment on
s strongly marked; easily noticeable

tr: n. 排水
[醫] 引流[法], 導液[法], 排水[設備]
def: n emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it

tr: vt. 涉及, 含意, 暗示, 牽連
n. 包含的東西
def: v. bring into intimate and incriminating connection

tr: n. 嚴酷考驗, 痛苦經歷, 煎熬
[法] 神裁判法, 嚴酷的考驗, 痛苦的經驗
痛苦的經歷；嚴峻考驗
def: n. a severe or trying experience

n. a primitive method of determining a person's guilt or innocence by subjecting the accused person to dangerous or painful tests believed to be under divine control; escape was usually taken as a sign of innocence
A difficult or frightening experience that lasts for some time.

ex.en: Getting home through the storm was a real ordeal.
ex.zh: 穿過暴風雨回家真是一次痛苦的經歷。

ex.en: For displaced families, finding secure housing can become a prolonged ordeal without adequate public support.
ex.zh: 對於流離失所的家庭，若缺乏充分的公共支持，尋找安全住房可能成為漫長的煎熬。

col: go through an ordeal｜經歷磨難
a traumatic ordeal｜造成心理創傷的經歷
words.tip: 指令人痛苦或恐懼的經歷，不用於普通的小麻煩。

tr: a. 逐字的, 字面上的, 文字的, 字母的
n. 印刷錯誤
[計] 文字; 直接量; 字面量; 句節
字面的；非比喻的
逐字的
def: s. without interpretation or embellishment
a. limited to the explicit meaning of a word or text
s. avoiding embellishment or exaggeration (used for emphasis)

ex.en: I meant cold feet in the literal sense.
ex.zh: 我說的就是腳冷，沒有什麼比喻含義。

ex.en: A literal translation may preserve individual words while failing to convey the cultural meaning of an expression.
ex.zh: 逐字翻譯可能保留每個詞，卻無法傳達某種表達背後的文化含義。

words.tip: literal指字面義；literary指文學的，注意區別。

tr: a. 滑的, 光滑的, 靠不住的, 圓滑的, 不穩固的
[法] 狡猾的, 不可靠的, 不安定的
def: a. causing or tending to cause things to slip or slide
s. not to be trusted

tr: n. 網孔, 網絲, 網眼, 網狀物, 圈套, 陷阱, 齧合
vt. 以網捕捉, 齧合, 使纏住
vi. 落網, 相齧合
def: n. the number of openings per linear inch of a screen; measures size of particles
n. the act of interlocking or meshing
v. work together in harmony

tr: v. 辨別, 看清楚, 瞭解
察覺；辨認出
def: v detect with the senses
To notice or recognise something that is difficult to detect.

ex.en: Through the fog, I could barely discern the distant bridge.
ex.zh: 隔著濃霧，我幾乎辨認不出遠處的橋。

ex.en: Without reliable evidence, consumers may find it difficult to discern whether environmental claims are genuinely credible.
ex.zh: 缺乏可靠證據時，消費者可能難以判斷環保宣傳是否真正可信。

words.tip: 較正式，強調費力看出或察覺不明顯的事物。

tr: a. 汙穢的, 邪惡的, 惡臭的, 骯髒的, 惡劣的, 淤塞的
vt. 弄髒, 妨害, 汙衊, 犯規, 淤塞
vi. 腐爛, 犯規, 纏結
adv. 違反規則地, 不正當地
n. 犯規, 纏繞
def: n. an act that violates the rules of a sport
v. hit a foul ball
v. commit a foul; break the rules

ex.en: A foul smell drifted from the forgotten rubbish bin.
ex.zh: 一股惡臭從那個被遺忘的垃圾桶裡飄了出來。

ex.en: Untreated industrial waste can foul rivers, threatening aquatic wildlife and the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 未經處理的工業廢物會汙染河流，威脅水生野生動物和附近居民的健康。

words.tip: 體育中犯規用commit a foul；惡劣天氣也可用foul。

tr: v. 請求, 乞求, 招攬, 徵求
def: v. make a solicitation or entreaty for something; request urgently or persistently
v. incite, move, or persuade to some act of lawlessness or insubordination
v. make a solicitation or petition for something desired

tr: a. 鼻的, 鼻聲的, 尖銳的
n. 鼻音, 鼻音字
def: n. an elongated rectangular bone that forms the bridge of the nose

tr: n. 蹣跚, 躊躇
vi. 蹣跚, 猶豫
vt. 使搖擺, 使躊躇, 交錯, 錯開
a. 交錯的, 錯開的
踉蹌；蹣跚
def: v. walk as if unable to control one's movements
v. walk with great difficulty
v. to arrange in a systematic order

ex.en: He staggered backwards as the heavy suitcase swung towards him.
ex.zh: 沉重的行李箱朝他擺來時，他踉蹌著往後退。

ex.en: Employers could stagger working hours to ease congestion and reduce pressure on public transport.
ex.zh: 僱主可以錯開工作時間，以緩解擁堵並減輕公共交通的壓力。

col: stagger to one's feet｜踉蹌著站起來
stagger working hours｜錯開工作時間
words.tip: stagger作動詞；staggering常指驚人之大。

tr: n. 用肘輕推, 推動, 討厭傢伙
def: n. a slight push or shake
v. to push against gently
v. push into action by pestering or annoying gently

tr: vt. 唸咒文召喚, 變戲法, 想像
vi. 變戲法, 施魔法
def: v summon into action or bring into existence, often as if by magic
v ask for or request earnestly
v engage in plotting or enter into a conspiracy, swear together

tr: n. 軌道, 彈道, 軌線
[化] 軌道
def: n. the path followed by an object moving through space

tr: a. 壞的, 邪惡的, 缺德的, 刻毒的, 惡劣的, 淘氣的
邪惡的；缺德的
淘氣的；惡作劇的
def: a. morally bad in principle or practice
Morally very bad and deliberately harmful.
Playfully naughty, often in an amusing way.

ex.en: The wicked queen locked every garden gate in the kingdom.
ex.zh: 邪惡的王后鎖上了王國裡所有花園的大門。

ex.en: Traditional stories often contrast wicked characters with kind heroes to help children understand the consequences of moral choices.
ex.zh: 傳統故事常將邪惡角色與善良主人公作對比，幫助兒童理解道德選擇的後果。

col: a wicked grin｜淘氣的咧嘴笑
a wicked sense of humour｜愛捉弄人的幽默感
words.tip: 通常比bad語氣強；形容笑容時可指淘氣而非邪惡。

tr: a. 見多識廣的
def: a. having much knowledge or education

tr: n. 天文臺, 氣象臺, 瞭望臺
def: n. a building designed and equipped to observe astronomical phenomena

tr: vt. 強迫, 限制, 關押
def: v hold back
v restrict

tr: n. 捏, 擰, 撮, 少量, 收縮, 擠壓, 夾痛, 苦惱, 逮捕, 指控, 匱乏, 緊急關頭
vt. 捏, 擰, 掐, 擠壓, 修剪, 使困苦, 使萎縮, 節制, 少量加入, 逮捕, 勒索
vi. 收縮, 節省, 擠壓, 引起苦惱
捏；掐；夾痛
一小撮
def: n. a painful or straitened circumstance
n. an injury resulting from getting some body part squeezed
n. a squeeze with the fingers

ex.en: Pinch the pastry edges together to seal the pie.
ex.zh: 把麵皮邊緣捏合，將餡餅封好。

ex.en: As food prices rise, families on low incomes increasingly feel the pinch and reduce nonessential spending.
ex.zh: 隨著食品價格上漲，低收入家庭越來越感到經濟拮据，並減少非必要支出。

col: a pinch of salt｜一小撮鹽
feel the pinch｜感到經濟拮据
words.tip: a pinch of表少量；feel the pinch指手頭緊。

tr: n. 休息, 休會, 放假, 凹進處, 深處
vt. 使凹進
vi. 休假, 休息
def: n. a small concavity
n. an enclosure that is set back or indented
v. put into a recess

tr: a. 廚房的, 烹調用的
def: a. of or relating to or used in cooking

tr: n. 傳說, 英雄傳奇, 冒險故事
def: n. a narrative telling the adventures of a hero or a family; originally (12th to 14th centuries) a story of the families that settled Iceland and their descendants but now any prose narrative that resembles such an account

tr: n. 降格, 墮落, 退化
[計] 降級
惡化；退化
降解
受辱；尊嚴喪失
def: n. changing to a lower state (a less respected state)
The process of becoming damaged or poorer in quality.
The breakdown of a substance into simpler substances.

ex.en: The farmer noticed soil degradation across his dry fields.
ex.zh: 農民發現他乾燥的田地普遍出現了土壤退化。

ex.en: Environmental degradation often affects poorer communities most severely because they depend directly on local natural resources.
ex.zh: 環境惡化往往對較貧困社區影響最嚴重，因為它們直接依賴當地自然資源。

words.tip: 環境話題常指惡化，化學或生物語境可指降解。

tr: n. 優越, 高傲
[化] 優越性
優越性；優勢
優越感；高傲
def: n. the quality of being superior
n. the quality of being at a competitive advantage
n. displaying a sense of being better than others

ex.en: The newer camera showed its superiority in low light.
ex.zh: 這臺較新的相機在弱光下展現了優勢。

ex.en: The technological superiority of larger firms can make it difficult for small businesses to compete effectively.
ex.zh: 大公司的技術優勢可能使小企業難以有效參與競爭。

words.tip: 表示相對優勢用superiority over，不用than。

tr: n. 庇護, 收容所
[醫] 養育院
政治庇護；避難保護
舊時的精神病院
def: n a shelter from danger or hardship
n a hospital for mentally incompetent or unbalanced person
Protection a country gives people escaping danger in another country.

ex.en: Her family sought asylum after fleeing their home country.
ex.zh: 她的家人逃離祖國後尋求庇護。

ex.en: Governments should assess asylum applications fairly while ensuring that vulnerable applicants have access to legal advice.
ex.zh: 政府應公平審理庇護申請，同時確保弱勢申請人能夠獲得法律諮詢。

words.tip: 表示庇護時不可數；指精神病院是過時用法。

tr: vt. 例證, 例示
[法] 製作經公章證明的謄本, 例證
是…的典型；例證
舉例說明
def: v. be characteristic of
v. clarify by giving an example of
to be a clear example of something

ex.en: Her handmade bowls exemplify the beauty of simple design.
ex.zh: 她手工製作的碗體現了簡約設計之美。

ex.en: These community gardens exemplify how urban residents can improve local biodiversity while producing fresh food.
ex.zh: 這些社區花園展示了城市居民如何在種植新鮮食物的同時改善當地生物多樣性。

col: exemplify a trend｜是某種趨勢的典型
exemplify a principle｜例證某項原則
exemplify the benefits of｜體現…的益處
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接名詞；舉例時也可用be exemplified by。

tr: n. 踏板, 腳蹬子
a. 腳的, 腳踏的
vt. 用腳踏動
vi. 踩踏板, 騎車
踏板；腳蹬
def: n. a lever that is operated with the foot
v. operate the pedals on a keyboard instrument
a. of or relating to the feet

ex.en: My foot slipped off the pedal in the rain.
ex.zh: 雨中，我的腳從腳蹬上滑了下來。

ex.en: More residents would pedal to work if cities provided safer cycling routes and secure bicycle parking.
ex.zh: 如果城市提供更安全的騎行路線和安全的自行車停車設施，更多居民會騎車上班。

words.tip: 英式過去式常寫pedalled，美式寫pedaled。

tr: n. 噓聲, 嘶嘶聲
vi. 發出噓聲, 發嘶嘶聲
vt. 發嘶嘶聲表示
發出嘶嘶聲
嘶嘶聲
def: n. a fricative sound (especially as an expression of disapproval)
v. make a sharp hissing sound, as if to show disapproval
v. move with a whooshing sound

ex.en: The cat hissed when the puppy came too close.
ex.zh: 小狗靠得太近時，貓發出了嘶嘶聲。

ex.en: Engineers investigated a persistent hiss from the heating system to identify possible leaks and prevent energy waste.
ex.zh: 工程師檢查了供暖系統持續發出的嘶嘶聲，以查明可能的洩漏並防止能源浪費。

col: hiss at someone｜衝某人發出嘶嘶聲
a faint hiss｜微弱的嘶嘶聲
a hiss of steam｜蒸汽的嘶嘶聲
words.tip: hiss at可表示沖人嘶叫或發噓聲。

tr: n. 全部劇目, 全部技能, 全部節目, 全部作品
全部演出曲目或劇目
全部技能；方法儲備
def: n. a collection of works (plays, songs, operas, ballets) that an artist or company can perform and do perform for short intervals on a regular schedule
All the pieces a performer or group is prepared to perform.
The range of skills or methods someone can use.

ex.en: The singer added three new songs to her repertoire.
ex.zh: 那位歌手在自己的演唱曲目中加入了三首新歌。

ex.en: Teachers need a broad repertoire of strategies to meet the needs of students with different learning preferences.
ex.zh: 教師需要掌握豐富的教學策略，以滿足學習偏好不同的學生的需求。

col: expand your repertoire｜擴充曲目或技能儲備
a wide repertoire｜豐富的曲目儲備
a repertoire of skills｜一整套技能
words.tip: 不只指演出曲目，也可指某人掌握的全部技能。

tr: vt.vi. 細看, 仔細檢查, 審查, 細閱
[法] 細看, 細閱, 仔細檢查
def: v to look at critically or searchingly, or in minute detail
v examine carefully for accuracy with the intent of verification

tr: vt. 預演, 排演, 使熟練掌握, 練習, 複述
vi. 排練, 練習, 演習
排練；預演
def: v. engage in a rehearsal (of)
to practise a performance or activity before doing it publicly

ex.en: We rehearsed our dance in the empty school hall.
ex.zh: 我們在空蕩蕩的學校禮堂裡排練舞蹈。

ex.en: Students who rehearse their presentations with classmates often develop greater confidence and communicate their ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 與同學一起預演展示的學生，往往會更自信，也能更清晰地表達觀點。

col: rehearse for a performance｜為演出排練
words.tip: rehearse後直接接排練內容；為演出排練用for。

tr: n. 拖著腳走, 曳步, 混亂, 矇混, 洗紙牌
v. 拖曳, 馬虎地做, 笨手笨腳地穿(脫)衣, 推諉, 洗牌
[計] 混洗
def: n. the act of mixing cards haphazardly
v. walk by dragging one's feet
v. move about, move back and forth

tr: n. 靈魂, 精神, 普賽克(希臘神話中人類靈魂的化身)
[醫] 精神, 心靈
def: n. (Greek mythology) a beautiful princess loved by Cupid who visited her at night and told her she must not try to see him; became the personification of the soul

tr: a. 殘渣的, 剩餘的
n. 殘渣, 剩餘, 餘數
殘留的；剩餘的
def: n. (often plural) a payment that is made to a performer or writer or director of a television show or commercial that is paid for every repeat showing
a. relating to or indicating a remainder
remaining after most of something has gone or been removed

ex.en: Residual heat kept the kitchen warm after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚飯後，餘熱讓廚房仍然暖和。

ex.en: Residual chemicals in agricultural soil may affect water quality long after farmers stop using them.
ex.zh: 即使農民停止使用化學品很久，農田土壤中的殘留物仍可能影響水質。

words.tip: 常用於技術語境，強調處理後仍殘留。

tr: n. 閣樓, 鴿房, 樓上
vt. 儲存於閣樓上
vi. 將球高擊
def: n. floor consisting of a large unpartitioned space over a factory or warehouse or other commercial space
n. floor consisting of open space at the top of a house just below roof; often used for storage
n. (golf) the backward slant on the head of some golf clubs that is designed to drive the ball high in the air

tr: n. 板條箱, 裝貨箱
[建] 簍, 筐
板條箱；運輸箱
把……裝入運輸箱
def: n. a rugged box (usually made of wood); used for shipping
n. the quantity contained in a crate
v. put into a crate; as for protection

ex.en: We carried a crate of apples into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我們把一箱蘋果搬進了廚房。

ex.en: Reusable plastic crates can reduce packaging waste when food suppliers establish reliable systems for collecting empty containers.
ex.zh: 如果食品供應商建立可靠的空箱回收機制，可重複使用的塑料週轉箱就能減少包裝廢棄物。

col: a crate of fruit｜一箱水果
words.tip: 可指木製或塑料運輸箱；a crate of表示一箱。

tr: n. 奇異事物, 罕見例子
vt. 驚異於
vi. 驚異
令人驚歎的人或事物
感到驚歎
def: v. express astonishment or surprise about something
Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise
To feel great surprise or admiration

ex.en: We marvelled at the tiny bird's beautifully woven nest.
ex.zh: 那隻小鳥精巧編織的巢讓我們驚歎不已。

ex.en: The new bridge is an engineering marvel that connects isolated communities and improves access to essential services.
ex.zh: 這座新橋是一項工程奇蹟，連接了偏遠社區，並讓居民更方便地獲得基本服務。

col: a marvel of nature｜自然奇觀
words.tip: 動詞常接at；英式過去式marvelled，美式marveled。

tr: a. 陶瓷的
n. 陶瓷製品
陶瓷的
陶瓷材料；陶瓷製品
def: n. an artifact made of hard brittle material produced from nonmetallic minerals by firing at high temperatures
a. of or relating to or made from a ceramic
Made from clay or similar materials hardened by heat.

ex.en: She keeps fresh flowers in a blue ceramic vase.
ex.zh: 她把鮮花插在一個藍色陶瓷花瓶裡。

ex.en: Ceramic tiles are widely used in public buildings because they are durable and relatively easy to clean.
ex.zh: 陶瓷磚耐用且較易清潔，因此廣泛用於公共建築。

words.tip: ceramics可指陶瓷製品，也可指陶藝或陶瓷工藝。

tr: n. 珠寶, 寶石, 珍貴之物
vt. 飾以寶石
寶石
精品；難得的好人或事物
def: n. art highly prized for its beauty or perfection
n. a crystalline rock that can be cut and polished for jewelry
a valuable stone, often cut and polished for jewellery

ex.en: The tiny blue gem sparkled in her silver ring.
ex.zh: 她銀戒指上的那顆小藍寶石閃閃發光。

ex.en: Small regional museums often contain hidden gems that reveal important aspects of a community's cultural history.
ex.zh: 地方小型博物館往往藏有鮮為人知的珍品，展現一個社區文化歷史的重要方面。

col: a gem of a book｜一本難得的好書
words.tip: hidden gem常指尚未廣為人知的好地方或精品。

tr: a. 慈悲的, 富於同情心的, 照顧性的
vt. 憐憫, 同情
def: a. showing or having compassion

tr: vt. 集合, 召集, 召喚
vi. 聚集, 集合
def: v. meet formally

tr: vi. 渴望, 立志於
渴望；立志
def: v have an ambitious plan or a lofty goal
To strongly want to achieve something important.

ex.en: My younger sister aspires to become a wildlife photographer.
ex.zh: 我妹妹立志成為一名野生動物攝影師。

ex.en: Many young people aspire to careers that offer both financial security and opportunities to contribute to society.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人嚮往既能提供經濟保障，又能讓自己為社會作貢獻的職業。

col: aspire to do something｜立志做某事
aspire to a career in medicine｜立志從醫
words.tip: aspire to do表立志做；aspire to後也可接名詞。

tr: n. 碼頭, 橋墩, 支框, 防波堤
[醫] 橋基, 基牙
def: n. a platform built out from the shore into the water and supported by piles; provides access to ships and boats
n. (architecture) a vertical supporting structure (as a portion of wall between two doors or windows)
n. a support for two adjacent bridge spans

tr: n. 斷崖, 絕壁, 嚇唬
a. 直率的
v. 嚇唬, 欺騙
def: n. a high steep bank (usually formed by river erosion)
n. pretense that your position is stronger than it really is
n. the act of bluffing in poker; deception by a false show of confidence in the strength of your cards

tr: a. 光滑的, 熟練的, 聰明的, 華而不實的, 老套的, 陳腐的
adv. 靈活地, 聰明地
vt. 使光滑, 使漂亮
vi. 打扮整潔
n. 光滑平面, 平滑器, 修光工具
def: n. a magazine printed on good quality paper
n. a film of oil or garbage floating on top of water
n. a trowel used to make a surface slick

tr: n. 裂口, 違背, 破壞, 違反, 突破, 破裂
vt. 攻破, 突破
vi. 跳出水面
def: n. a failure to perform some promised act or obligation
n. an opening (especially a gap in a dike or fortification)

tr: n. 蹲, 窩
a. 蹲著的, 矮胖的
vi. 蹲下, 蹲坐, 蹲伏
vt. 使蹲下, 擅自佔有
def: n. the act of assuming or maintaining a crouching position with the knees bent and the buttocks near the heels
v. sit on one's heels
v. be close to the earth, or be disproportionately wide

tr: n. 摸索, 笨拙的行動, 漏球
vt. 摸索, 亂摸, 笨拙的處理, 漏接(球)
vi. 摸索, 笨手笨腳, 漏球
笨拙地摸索；亂摸
失手漏接；笨拙處理
def: n. (sports) dropping the ball
v. make one's way clumsily or blindly
v. handle clumsily

ex.en: I fumbled for my keys in the dark hallway.
ex.zh: 我在漆黑的走廊裡摸索著找鑰匙。

ex.en: Users often fumble with unfamiliar controls, highlighting the importance of intuitive design in public transport systems.
ex.zh: 使用者操作不熟悉的控制裝置時常常手忙腳亂，這凸顯了公共交通系統中直觀設計的重要性。

col: fumble for keys｜摸索著找鑰匙
fumble with a lock｜笨手笨腳地擺弄鎖
words.tip: fumble for表示摸索尋找；with表示笨拙擺弄。

tr: n. 沉澱物, 沉積
[化] 沉降物; 沉積物
def: n. matter that has been deposited by some natural process
v. deposit as a sediment
v. settle as sediment

tr: n. 記憶, 回想, 回憶
def: n. something recalled to the mind

tr: vi. 蒸發, 失去水分, 消失
vt. 使蒸發, 使脫水, 使消失
蒸發；使蒸發
逐漸消失；消散
def: v. lose or cause to lose liquid by vaporization leaving a more concentrated residue
v. cause to change into a vapor
v. change into a vapor

ex.en: The puddles evaporated quickly in the warm afternoon sun.
ex.zh: 水窪裡的水在溫暖的午後陽光下很快蒸發了。

ex.en: As temperatures rise, water evaporates more rapidly from reservoirs, increasing pressure on supplies in drought-prone regions.
ex.zh: 隨著氣溫升高，水庫中的水蒸發得更快，加劇了易旱地區的供水壓力。

words.tip: 蒸發不一定要沸騰；evaporate也可比喻希望等消失。

tr: vi. 屈從, 屈服, 死
def: v. be fatally overwhelmed

tr: a. 經驗豐富的, 老練的
def: a. aged or processed
s. rendered competent through trial and experience

tr: vt. 模擬, 假裝, 模仿
[法] 偽裝的, 模擬的; 假裝的, 偽裝的, 冒充
模擬
假裝；裝出
def: v. make a pretence of
To reproduce conditions or processes for testing, training, or study.
To pretend to have a feeling or condition.

ex.en: This driving game simulates icy roads surprisingly well.
ex.zh: 這款駕駛遊戲把結冰路面模擬得出奇逼真。

ex.en: Researchers simulate extreme weather conditions to assess how new building materials perform under environmental stress.
ex.zh: 研究人員模擬極端天氣條件，以評估新型建築材料在環境壓力下的表現。

col: simulate an emergency｜模擬緊急情況
simulate the effects of｜模擬……的影響
words.tip: 模擬環境用simulate；刺激發展用stimulate。

tr: n. 身材, 身高, 高度
[醫] 身材, 身高
def: n. high level of respect gained by impressive development or achievement
n. (of a standing person) the distance from head to foot

tr: n. 陰謀, 複雜的事
vi. 密謀, 私通
vt. 激起...的興趣, 用詭計取得
激起好奇心；引起興趣
陰謀；密謀
def: n. a crafty and involved plot to achieve your (usually sinister) ends
n. a clandestine love affair
v. cause to be interested or curious

ex.en: The locked wooden box intrigued everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 那個上鎖的木盒引起了屋裡所有人的好奇。

ex.en: Unexplained archaeological discoveries continue to intrigue researchers and encourage further investigation into the lives of ancient communities.
ex.zh: 尚未得到解釋的考古發現持續引起研究者的興趣，推動他們進一步探索古代社群的生活。

col: a web of intrigue｜錯綜複雜的陰謀
words.tip: 激起興趣時是及物動詞；常用 be intrigued by。

tr: n. 手榴彈
def: n. a small explosive bomb thrown by hand or fired from a missile

tr: n. 戰慄, 發抖
vi. 戰慄, 發抖
def: v. tremble convulsively, as from fear or excitement

tr: n. 眨眼, 使眼色, 瞬間
vi. 眨眼, 使眼色, 閃爍
vt. 眨
眨一隻眼示意
眨眼示意
def: n. closing one eye quickly as a signal
v. signal by winking
v. force to go away by blinking

ex.en: My sister winked at me across the dinner table.
ex.zh: 姐姐隔著餐桌朝我眨了一隻眼。

ex.en: A friendly wink may communicate shared understanding, although its meaning can vary considerably across different cultures.
ex.zh: 友善的眨眼可能傳達彼此的默契，但其含義在不同文化間可能有很大差異。

col: give someone a wink｜向某人眨眼示意
not sleep a wink｜一夜沒閤眼
words.tip: wink常指單眼示意；blink指自然眨眼。

tr: a. 星的, 似星的, 星球的, 主要的
def: a. being or relating to or resembling or emanating from stars

tr: a. 粗糙的, 下等的, 粗俗的
[計] 粗略的
粗糙的；粗顆粒的
粗俗的；粗魯的
def: a. of textures that are rough to the touch or substances consisting of relatively large particles
s. lacking refinement or cultivation or taste
s. of low or inferior quality or value

ex.en: The coarse wool scratched my neck all afternoon.
ex.zh: 那件粗糙的羊毛衣讓我的脖子整個下午都刺癢。

ex.en: Coarse particles in urban air can irritate the lungs and worsen existing respiratory conditions among vulnerable residents.
ex.zh: 城市空氣中的粗顆粒物會刺激肺部，並加重易感居民原有的呼吸系統疾病。

words.tip: 與course同音；coarse形容質地粗或言語粗俗。

tr: a. 現任的, 依靠的, 負有義務的
n. 領聖俸者, 在職者
def: n. the official who holds an office
s. lying or leaning on something else
s. necessary (for someone) as a duty or responsibility; morally binding

tr: a. 馳名的, 有名的
def: s. widely known and esteemed
s. having an illustrious past

tr: pl. 收益
[經] 收入, 收款, 所得
def: n the income or profit arising from such transactions as the sale of land or other property
v continue talking
v move ahead; travel onward in time or space

tr: n. 哀叫聲, 嘎嘎聲, 哀鳴
vi. 哭訴, 嘎嘎響, 發嗚嗚聲
vt. 哀訴
def: v. move with a whining sound
v. make a high-pitched, screeching noise
v. complain whiningly

tr: n. 胎兒
[醫] 胎, 胎兒
def: n. an unborn or unhatched vertebrate in the later stages of development showing the main recognizable features of the mature animal

tr: n. 觸媒, 接觸劑, 催化劑, 刺激因素, 促進因素
[計] 催化劑
促成變化的人或事
催化劑
def: n. (chemistry) a substance that initiates or accelerates a chemical reaction without itself being affected
n. something that causes an important event to happen
A person or thing that triggers or accelerates change.

ex.en: That conversation became the catalyst for our neighbourhood cleanup.
ex.zh: 那次談話促成了我們社區的清潔行動。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can act as a catalyst for wider economic growth in disadvantaged regions.
ex.zh: 公共交通投資可以推動欠發達地區更廣泛的經濟增長。

col: a catalyst for change｜變革的推動因素
act as a catalyst｜起推動作用
words.tip: 比喻推動變化時常用a catalyst for。

tr: [經] 偏激份子
def: n. a person who holds extreme views
s. (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm

tr: n. 衣櫥, 衣室, 全部衣服
衣櫃；衣櫥
某人的全部衣物
def: n. a tall piece of furniture that provides storage space for clothes; has a door and rails or hooks for hanging clothes
n. collection of clothing belonging to one person
n. collection of costumes belonging to a theatrical company

ex.en: Her winter coats fill most of the wardrobe.
ex.zh: 她的冬季外套佔了衣櫃的大部分空間。

ex.en: Building a smaller wardrobe with durable clothing can reduce the environmental impact of fashion consumption.
ex.zh: 減少衣物數量並選擇耐穿的服裝，可以降低時尚消費對環境的影響。

words.tip: 既指衣櫃，也可指某人擁有的全部衣物。

tr: n. 法令, 條例, 聖餐禮
[經] 法令, 條款, 條例
def: n. a statute enacted by a city government

tr: n. 脂肪, 獸脂, 油脂, 賄賂
vt. 塗脂於, 賄賂
油脂；潤滑脂
給……塗油脂
def: n. a thick fatty oil (especially one used to lubricate machinery)
v. lubricate with grease
thick oily material used for lubrication or produced during cooking

ex.en: There was grease on my hands after fixing the bicycle.
ex.zh: 修完自行車後，我的手上沾滿了油汙。

ex.en: Restaurants should prevent cooking grease from entering drains because it can block pipes and increase maintenance costs.
ex.zh: 餐館應防止烹飪油脂流入下水道，因為這會堵塞管道並增加維護費用。

col: grease a baking tin｜給烤模塗油
words.tip: 名詞讀/ɡriːs/；動詞也常讀/ɡriːz/。

tr: a. 悲哀的, 可憐的, 感傷的, 差勁的
[醫] 感情的
差勁的；令人鄙夷的
可憐的；令人憐憫的
def: s. inspiring mixed contempt and pity
s. inspiring scornful pity
so poor or ineffective that it deserves strong criticism

ex.en: The broken shower produced only a pathetic trickle.
ex.zh: 壞掉的淋浴器只能流出少得可憐的一點水。

ex.en: Residents described the council's response to repeated flooding as pathetic, demanding immediate investment in better drainage.
ex.zh: 居民認為市政委員會應對反覆洪災的表現差勁，要求立即投資改善排水設施。

words.tip: 常帶強烈貶義，不宜隨意用來形容他人。

tr: vt. 吐露, 委託
vi. 信賴
def: v. reveal in private; tell confidentially

tr: n. 蜜餞, 果醬
vt. 保存, 使(能量等)守恆
節約；避免浪費
保護；保存
def: n. fruit preserved by cooking with sugar
v. keep constant through physical or chemical reactions or evolutionary change
v. keep in safety and protect from harm, decay, loss, or destruction

ex.en: We collect rainwater to conserve water in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們收集雨水，以節約花園用水。

ex.en: Governments should encourage efficient farming methods that conserve water without reducing the supply of affordable food.
ex.zh: 政府應鼓勵高效的耕作方式，在節水的同時保障平價食品的供應。

words.tip: conserve強調節約或保護；reserve強調預留。

tr: n. 慷慨, 寬大
慷慨；大方
寬宏大量
def: n. the trait of being willing to give your money or time
n. acting generously
Willingness to give money, time, or help freely.

ex.en: Thanks to your generosity, everyone has a warm coat.
ex.zh: 多虧你的慷慨相助，每個人都有了一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Community projects often depend on the generosity of residents who contribute both money and valuable practical skills.
ex.zh: 社區項目往往依靠居民的慷慨支持，他們既捐款，也貢獻寶貴的實用技能。

col: an act of generosity｜慷慨之舉
generosity towards others｜對他人的慷慨
words.tip: 通常不可數；一次慷慨之舉用an act of generosity。

tr: vt. 以大寫字母寫, 使資本化, 估計...的價值
[經] 資本化, 收益的現值化
def: v. draw advantages from
v. supply with capital, as of a business by using a combination of capital used by investors and debt capital provided by lenders
v. write in capital letters

tr: vt. 篩, 過濾, 撒, 詳查
vi. 篩, 被篩下, 精選
篩；篩分
仔細檢查；篩選
def: v. move as if through a sieve
v. separate by passing through a sieve or other straining device to separate out coarser elements
To pass material through a sieve to separate its parts.

ex.en: Sift the flour before adding it to the bowl.
ex.zh: 把麵粉篩過後再加入碗中。

ex.en: Researchers must sift through large amounts of evidence before drawing reliable conclusions about the causes of unemployment.
ex.zh: 研究人員必須仔細篩查大量證據，才能對失業原因得出可靠的結論。

col: sift through evidence｜仔細審查證據
words.tip: sift through表示仔細查看，尋找有用信息。

tr: n. 保釋, 拎環, 杓, 柵欄
vt. 保釋, 舀水
def: n. (criminal law) money that must be forfeited by the bondsman if an accused person fails to appear in court for trial
n. the legal system that allows an accused person to be temporarily released from custody (usually on condition that a sum of money guarantees their appearance at trial)
v. release after a security has been paid

tr: n. 墩座, 矮隔牆, 指揮台
[醫] 足, 吸足
def: n a platform raised above the surrounding level to give prominence to the person on it

tr: n. 新奇, 新鮮, 新奇的事物
新奇；新穎
新鮮事物
新奇小玩意兒
def: n. originality by virtue of being new and surprising
the quality of being new, unusual, or unfamiliar
something new or unusual that attracts interest

ex.en: The novelty of sleeping in a tent soon wore off.
ex.zh: 睡帳篷的新鮮感很快就消退了。

ex.en: Although the novelty of new technology attracts consumers, long-term adoption depends on practical benefits and affordability.
ex.zh: 雖然新技術的新穎性會吸引消費者，但長期採用仍取決於實際益處和價格是否可負擔。

col: novelty value｜新奇帶來的吸引力
the novelty wears off｜新鮮感消退
words.tip: 指新奇感時不可數；指新鮮事物或小玩意兒時可數。

tr: n. 箍, 鐵環, 呼呼聲
vt. 加箍於, 包圍
vi. 發呼呼聲
def: n. a light curved skeleton to spread out a skirt
n. a rigid circular band of metal or wood or other material used for holding or fastening or hanging or pulling
v. bind or fasten with a hoop

tr: n. 著手, 開頭, 最初
開始；開端
def: n the time at which something is supposed to begin
The beginning of an activity, process, or period.

ex.en: We agreed on a budget at the outset.
ex.zh: 我們一開始就商定了預算。

ex.en: Community members should be involved from the outset when local authorities plan major housing developments.
ex.zh: 地方政府規劃大型住宅開發項目時，就應從一開始讓社區成員參與。

words.tip: 常用於at/from the outset，不用於set outset。

tr: a. 戰爭的, 軍事的, 尚武的, 威武的
[醫] 含鐵的
軍事的；戰爭的
def: n. Roman poet noted for epigrams (first century BC)
s. of or relating to the armed forces
Related to war, soldiers, or military life.

ex.en: The band played martial music as soldiers marched past.
ex.zh: 士兵列隊走過時，樂隊奏起了軍樂。

ex.en: Although martial arts originated as fighting techniques, many people now practise them for fitness and self-discipline.
ex.zh: 雖然武術起源於格鬥技巧，如今許多人練習武術是為了健身和培養自律。

words.tip: martial是軍事的；marital是婚姻的，勿混。

tr: n. 粉蠟筆, 粉蠟筆畫, 隨筆
a. 彩色蠟筆的, 蠟筆畫的, 柔和的, 纖弱的
def: n. any of various pale or light colors
s. lacking in body or vigor
s. delicate and pale in color

tr: vt. 危害, 使受危困, 使陷危地
危及；使陷入危險
def: v pose a threat to; present a danger to
v put at risk
To put something valuable at risk of harm or loss.

ex.en: Skipping these safety checks could jeopardize the whole trip.
ex.zh: 省略這些安全檢查可能危及整個行程。

ex.en: Excessive use of groundwater could jeopardize future food production in regions already affected by drought.
ex.zh: 過度開採地下水可能危及已受乾旱影響地區未來的糧食生產。

words.tip: 直接接賓語；英式英語也常拼作jeopardise。

tr: n. 芽, 萌芽
vt. 使發芽, 摘去芽
vi. 長芽, 抽條
def: n. any new growth of a plant such as a new branch or a bud
n. a newly grown bud (especially from a germinating seed)
v. put forth and grow sprouts or shoots

tr: n. 緯度, 範圍
[化] 寬容度; 偉度
緯度
自主決定的自由；餘地
def: n. the angular distance between an imaginary line around a heavenly body parallel to its equator and the equator itself
n. freedom from normal restraints in conduct
n. an imaginary line around the Earth parallel to the equator

ex.en: Our geography teacher showed us latitude on a globe.
ex.zh: 地理老師用地球儀給我們講解緯度。

ex.en: Regions at higher latitudes generally experience greater seasonal variations in daylight than those near the equator.
ex.zh: 高緯度地區的日照時長通常比赤道附近地區有更明顯的季節變化。

col: give someone latitude｜給予某人自主權
words.tip: latitude是緯度，longitude是經度。

tr: vt. 使相等, 視為平等
vi. 等同
def: v. be equivalent or parallel, in mathematics

tr: vi. 渴望, 想念, 懷念, 同情
渴望；思念
def: v. have affection for; feel tenderness for
To want something deeply, especially something difficult to obtain

ex.en: After months abroad, she yearned for her mother's cooking.
ex.zh: 在國外待了幾個月後，她十分想念母親做的飯菜。

ex.en: Many urban residents yearn for quieter surroundings, which may explain the growing appeal of rural tourism.
ex.zh: 許多城市居民渴望更安靜的環境，這或許能解釋鄉村旅遊日益增長的吸引力。

words.tip: 用yearn for sth或yearn to do，表達強烈渴望。

tr: n. 製陶術
[化] 陶瓷學
陶藝；陶瓷製作
陶瓷製品
def: n. the art of making and decorating pottery
the art and process of making objects from fired clay
objects made from clay and hardened by heat

ex.en: I started learning ceramics at a local studio.
ex.zh: 我開始在當地一家工作室學習陶藝。

ex.en: Traditional ceramics can attract tourists while providing a reliable source of income for local craftspeople.
ex.zh: 傳統陶瓷製品既能吸引遊客，也能為當地手藝人提供可靠的收入來源。

words.tip: 指陶藝時作單數；指多件陶瓷製品時作複數。

tr: vt. 裝飾, 使生色
裝飾；使增色
def: v make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
v be beautiful to look at
v furnish with power or authority; of kings or emperors

ex.en: Fresh flowers adorned every table at the family celebration.
ex.zh: 家庭慶典上，每張桌子都用鮮花裝點。

ex.en: Public artworks adorn many urban spaces, making neighbourhoods more attractive and encouraging residents to explore their surroundings.
ex.zh: 公共藝術作品裝點著許多城市空間，使街區更具吸引力，並鼓勵居民探索周邊環境。

col: adorn something with flowers｜用鮮花裝飾某物
words.tip: 用adorn A with B表示“用B裝飾A”。

tr: v. 統一, 使成一體
統一；使聯合
def: v. become one
To bring separate parts or groups together as one.

ex.en: The neighbourhood festival helped unify our divided community.
ex.zh: 鄰里節慶幫助我們這個存在隔閡的社區團結起來。

ex.en: A shared public transport network could unify the region while improving access to employment.
ex.zh: 共享的公共交通網絡既能將該地區連成一體，也能讓人們更方便地獲得就業機會。

col: unify different groups｜使不同群體團結
words.tip: unify強調把分散部分合成整體，可用於制度或群體。

tr: a. 就任的, 開幕的
n. 就職演講
def: a. occurring at or characteristic of a formal investiture or induction
s. serving to set in motion

tr: n. 古魯(印度教導師)
[醫] 柯拉子
def: n. a Hindu or Buddhist religious leader and spiritual teacher
n. each of the first ten leaders of the Sikh religion
n. a recognized leader in some field or of some movement

tr: n. 賣弄風騷的人, 急動, 急扔
vt. 忽然彈出, 輕快擺動, 揮動
vi. 調情, 玩弄, 擺動, 輕率地對待
def: n. playful behavior intended to arouse sexual interest

tr: n. 元首, 獨立國
a. 具有主權的, 至高無上的, 國王的, 完全的
def: n. a nation's ruler or head of state usually by hereditary right
s. greatest in status or authority or power

tr: n. 殘暴, 兇惡, 暴行
[法] 暴行, 殘酷, 殘忍
def: n. the quality of being shockingly cruel and inhumane
n. an act of atrocious cruelty

tr: n. 擺動, 鼓翼, 煩擾
vi. 擺動, 鼓翼, 煩擾
vt. 拍(翅), 使焦急
[計] 顫動
飄動；振翅；顫動
def: n. abnormally rapid beating of the auricles of the heart (especially in a regular rhythm); can result in heart block
v. flap the wings rapidly or fly with flapping movements
Move with quick, light movements, especially through air

ex.en: The curtains fluttered gently beside the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 窗簾在敞開的廚房窗邊輕輕飄動。

ex.en: Butterflies flutter among native flowers in urban gardens, demonstrating how small green spaces can support biodiversity.
ex.zh: 蝴蝶在城市花園的本土花卉間翩翩飛舞，展示了小型綠地如何支持生物多樣性。

col: flutter in the breeze｜在微風中飄動
a flutter of excitement｜一陣激動
words.tip: 強調輕而快的反覆運動，可用於翅膀、布料或心跳。

tr: vt. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇
[經] 招致, 蒙受, 擔負
招致；產生費用或損失
def: v. make oneself subject to; bring upon oneself; become liable to
to experience costs or something unpleasant because of your actions

ex.en: Late returns may incur an extra charge at this library.
ex.zh: 在這家圖書館，逾期歸還可能產生額外費用。

ex.en: Businesses may incur substantial costs when replacing outdated equipment, but modern technology can improve productivity over time.
ex.zh: 企業更換過時設備時可能產生大量費用，但現代技術能逐步提高生產效率。

words.tip: 過去式 incurred，現在分詞 incurring，均雙寫 r。

tr: n. 閃爍, 閃光, 顫動
vi. 閃動, 閃爍, 搖動, 撲動翅膀
vt. 使搖曳, 使閃爍
閃爍；搖曳
閃光；搖曳的光
def: n. a momentary flash of light
n. North American woodpecker
v. move back and forth very rapidly

ex.en: The candle flickered when she opened the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 她打開廚房門時，燭光搖曳起來。

ex.en: When streetlights flicker or fail, pedestrians may feel less secure in urban public spaces.
ex.zh: 路燈閃爍不定或熄滅時，行人可能會覺得城市公共空間不夠安全。

col: a flicker of hope｜一絲希望
a flicker of recognition｜一瞬間認出的神情
words.tip: a flicker of 可接 hope 等，表示一絲短暫情感。

tr: n. 吹牛
v. 吹牛
吹噓；誇耀
def: n. an instance of boastful talk
to talk too proudly about your achievements or possessions

ex.en: He always brags about how fast he can swim.
ex.zh: 他總是吹噓自己游泳有多快。

ex.en: Social media can encourage users to brag about personal achievements rather than discuss everyday challenges honestly.
ex.zh: 社交媒體可能鼓勵用戶誇耀個人成就，而不是坦誠討論日常挑戰。

col: brag that you won｜吹噓自己贏了
words.tip: 常接 about 或 that；過去式 bragged 雙寫 g。

tr: a. 假設的, 有待證實的, 假定的, 有前提的
[計] 理想的
def: n. a hypothetical possibility, circumstance, statement, proposal, situation, etc.

tr: n. 厚木板, 支架, 木板製品, 衝浪板, 救急物, 政綱條目
vt. 在...上鋪板, 撂下, 立即付款
厚木板
政綱要點；政策核心
平板支撐
def: n. an endorsed policy in the platform of a political party
v. cover with planks
v. set (something or oneself) down with or as if with a noise

ex.en: We laid a plank across the muddy ditch.
ex.zh: 我們在泥濘的溝上架了一塊厚木板。

ex.en: Investment in affordable housing should be a central plank of any strategy to reduce urban inequality.
ex.zh: 投資可負擔住房應成為任何縮小城市不平等的戰略的核心內容。

col: a central plank of policy｜政策的核心內容
hold a plank｜保持平板支撐
words.tip: a central plank of可比喻政策的核心內容。

tr: n. 熟悉, 精通, 親密
def: n. usualness by virtue of being familiar or well known
n. close or warm friendship
n. an act of undue intimacy

tr: a. 生理學的, 生理學上的, 生理機能的
[醫] 生理學的, 生理的
def: a. of or relating to the biological study of physiology

tr: a. 富有魅力的, 迷人的
def: s. having an air of allure, romance and excitement

tr: n. 板岩, 頁岩, 提名名單, 人選, 記錄, 石板
a. 石板色的
vt. 鋪石板, 責罵, 痛打
def: n. (formerly) a writing tablet made of slate
n. thin layers of rock used for roofing
n. a fine-grained metamorphic rock that can be split into thin layers

tr: n. 鬆弛, 放鬆, 減輕, 緩和, 休息, 休養
[化] 鬆弛; 馳豫
放鬆；休息
肌肉鬆弛
規定的放寬
def: n. (physiology) the gradual lengthening of inactive muscle or muscle fibers
n. (physics) the exponential return of a system to equilibrium after a disturbance
n. an occurrence of control or strength weakening

ex.en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
ex.zh: 下班後，我喜歡泡個熱水澡放鬆一下。

ex.en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
ex.zh: 學校應教授放鬆技巧，幫助學生緩解重要考試前的焦慮。

words.tip: 表示放鬆、休息時通常不可數：for relaxation。

tr: n. 紀念品
紀念品
def: n something of sentimental value
n a reminder of past events
An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.

ex.en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
ex.zh: 我們買了一隻小木船作為紀念品。

ex.en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
ex.zh: 購買當地製作的紀念品可以支持傳統工藝，併為依靠旅遊業的社區帶來收入。

words.tip: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活動的紀念品。

tr: n. 弟子, 門徒
def: n. someone who believes and helps to spread the doctrine of another

tr: n. 修道院, 僧侶
def: n. the residence of a religious community

tr: n. 實習生, 被拘留者
vi. 作實習醫師(教師、實習生)
vt. 拘留, 扣留
def: n. an advanced student or graduate in medicine gaining supervised practical experience (`houseman' is a British term)
v. deprive of freedom
v. work as an intern

tr: n. 鄉愁, 嚮往過去, 懷舊之情
[醫] 懷鄉病
懷舊；對往昔的眷戀
def: n. longing for something past
warm, sometimes sad feelings about happy times in the past

ex.en: That old song fills me with nostalgia for school.
ex.zh: 那首老歌讓我滿懷對學生時代的眷戀。

ex.en: Nostalgia can encourage communities to preserve historic buildings, even when modern developments promise greater convenience.
ex.zh: 即使現代開發項目有望帶來更多便利，懷舊之情也能促使社區保護歷史建築。

col: nostalgia for the past｜對往昔的眷戀
a wave of nostalgia｜一陣懷舊之情
words.tip: 通常不可數；nostalgia for後接懷念的時期或事物。

tr: vt. 預先排除, 預防, 阻止, 妨礙
[法] 預防, 排除, 消除
使不可能；阻止；排除
def: v. make impossible, especially beforehand
to prevent something or make it impossible

ex.en: The heavy rain precluded our planned picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 大雨讓我們原定的湖邊野餐無法進行。

ex.en: High tuition fees may preclude students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education without financial support.
ex.zh: 高昂的學費可能使弱勢家庭的學生在沒有經濟資助的情況下無法接受高等教育。

col: preclude someone from doing something｜使某人無法做某事
preclude further discussion｜使進一步討論無法進行
words.tip: 正式用詞；可用preclude sb from doing sth。

tr: a. 精緻的, 細膩的, 敏銳的
精美的；精緻的
極強烈的；極敏銳的
def: s. intense or sharp
s. lavishly elegant and refined
s. of extreme beauty

ex.en: She keeps an exquisite porcelain bowl on the shelf.
ex.zh: 她把一隻精美的瓷碗放在架子上。

ex.en: Museums preserve exquisite examples of traditional craftsmanship, allowing future generations to appreciate their cultural and artistic value.
ex.zh: 博物館保存傳統工藝的精美作品，讓後代能夠欣賞其文化與藝術價值。

words.tip: 常形容精美工藝；修飾pain時表示極其強烈。

tr: vt. 沉浸, 使陷入
[醫] 浸[入]
使沉浸；使專心於
浸沒；浸入
def: v. thrust or throw into
v. enclose or envelop completely, as if by swallowing
to involve someone deeply in an activity or experience

ex.en: On rainy afternoons, I immerse myself in a novel.
ex.zh: 下雨的午後，我會沉浸在小說中。

ex.en: Exchange programmes allow students to immerse themselves in another culture and develop greater independence.
ex.zh: 交流項目讓學生深入體驗另一種文化，並培養更強的獨立性。

col: immerse yourself in｜使自己沉浸於
words.tip: 沉浸於某事用immerse yourself in，注意反身代詞。

tr: n. 石油
[化] 石油
def: n. a dark oil consisting mainly of hydrocarbons

tr: n. 保鏢, 護衛
def: n. someone who escorts and protects a prominent person
n. a group of men who escort and protect some important person

tr: n. 妒忌, 猜忌, 羨慕
[法] 妒忌, 嫉妒, 猜忌
def: n. a feeling of jealous envy (especially of a rival)
n. zealous vigilance

tr: n. 屈服, 服從, 謙恭, 呈遞, 提交, 意見
[經] 提交, 提出, 提交公斷
提交；提交的文件
屈服；服從
def: n. something (manuscripts or architectural plans and models or estimates or works of art of all genres etc.) submitted for the judgment of others (as in a competition)
n. the act of submitting; usually surrendering power to another
n. the condition of having submitted to control by someone or something else

ex.en: Please check your application carefully before submission tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 請在明早提交前仔細檢查你的申請。

ex.en: Online submission of assignments can reduce paper consumption and allow teachers to provide feedback more efficiently.
ex.zh: 在線提交作業可以減少紙張消耗，並讓教師更高效地提供反饋。

col: submission of an application｜申請的提交
a written submission｜提交的書面材料
submission to authority｜對權威的服從
words.tip: 表示提交行為通常不可數；一份提交材料可數。

tr: n. 軍官學校學生
[法] 軍校學生
def: n. a military trainee (as at a military academy)

tr: a. 激烈的
[醫] 峻瀉藥, 劇烈的
激烈的；大幅度的
def: s. forceful and extreme and rigorous
Extreme or severe, causing a major change

ex.en: We took drastic action and sold our second car.
ex.zh: 我們採取了大刀闊斧的措施，賣掉了家裡的第二輛車。

ex.en: Drastic cuts to public transport funding could leave many low-income households without affordable access to essential services.
ex.zh: 大幅削減公共交通資金，可能讓許多低收入家庭無法以可負擔的費用獲得基本服務。

words.tip: 強調程度大、影響強，不等於表示速度快的rapid。

tr: n. 辭別, 再見, 再會
interj. 再會
告別；辭別
再見；珍重
告別的；送別的
def: n. an acknowledgment or expression of goodwill at parting
n. the act of departing politely
An act of saying goodbye, especially before a long separation.

ex.en: We gathered at the station for a final farewell.
ex.zh: 我們聚在車站，作最後的告別。

ex.en: A farewell ceremony can help graduating students reflect on their achievements and prepare for future challenges.
ex.zh: 告別儀式可以幫助畢業生回顧自己的成就，併為未來的挑戰做好準備。

words.tip: 比goodbye正式，常用於長久分別或鄭重告別。

tr: n. 悲哀, 悲痛, 苦痛
def: n. intense mournfulness

tr: n. 漣波, 漣漪, 波紋, 粗鋼梳
vt. 使起漣漪
vi. 起微波, 起潺潺聲
漣漪；細小波紋
泛起漣漪；使起波紋
def: n. a small wave on the surface of a liquid
n. (electronics) an oscillation of small amplitude imposed on top of a steady value
v. stir up (water) so as to form ripples

ex.en: A falling leaf sent ripples across the pond.
ex.zh: 一片落葉在池塘水面上激起了圈圈漣漪。

ex.en: The closure of a major factory can have a ripple effect throughout the local economy.
ex.zh: 一家大型工廠的關閉可能對整個當地經濟產生連鎖影響。

col: ripples on the water｜水面上的漣漪
a ripple of laughter｜一陣輕輕傳開的笑聲
words.tip: ripple比wave小；ripple effect指連鎖效應。

tr: n. 愛國心, 愛國精神, 愛國主義
愛國精神；愛國主義
def: n. love of country and willingness to sacrifice for it
Love for and loyalty to your country.

ex.en: Her patriotism shines through whenever she discusses her country's achievements.
ex.zh: 每當談起祖國的成就，她的愛國之情便溢於言表。

ex.en: Schools can encourage patriotism while also teaching students to respect other nations and understand global responsibilities.
ex.zh: 學校可以培養愛國精神，同時教導學生尊重其他國家並理解全球責任。

col: a sense of patriotism｜愛國情懷
words.tip: 強調愛國情感，不宜直接等同於nationalism民族主義。

tr: n. 來到, 來臨
出現；到來
def: n. arrival that has been awaited (especially of something momentous)
n. the season including the four Sundays preceding Christmas
The arrival of an important new invention, event, or period

ex.en: The advent of smartphones changed how we take photos.
ex.zh: 智能手機的出現改變了我們拍照的方式。

ex.en: The advent of affordable renewable energy has encouraged governments to reconsider their dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 價格可負擔的可再生能源的出現，促使各國政府重新審視對化石燃料的依賴。

col: with the advent of｜隨著……的到來
since the advent of｜自……出現以來
words.tip: 常用the advent of，指重要新事物的出現。

tr: n. 縫合線, 銜接口, 接縫, 線縫, 傷疤
vt. 縫合, 接合, 焊合, 使留下傷痕
vi. 裂開, 發生裂痕
def: n. joint consisting of a line formed by joining two pieces
n. a stratum of ore or coal thick enough to be mined with profit
v. put together with a seam

tr: vt. 使疏遠, 離間, 轉讓
[法] 轉讓, 讓與, 疏遠
使疏遠；使失去支持
def: v. make withdrawn or isolated or emotionally dissociated
Make someone feel unwelcome or unwilling to support you

ex.en: His constant complaints alienated even his closest friends.
ex.zh: 他不停地抱怨，連最親近的朋友都疏遠了他。

ex.en: Public transport policies may alienate residents if local authorities fail to explain their benefits clearly.
ex.zh: 如果地方政府未能清楚解釋公共交通政策的好處，這些政策可能會失去居民的支持。

col: alienate someone from｜使某人與……疏遠
words.tip: 常指使人疏遠或失去支持，不表示挪用。

tr: n. 叮, 刺痛, 刺激, 諷刺
vt. 叮, 刺痛, 刺激, 使苦惱
vi. 叮, 刺痛
蜇；刺痛
蜇傷；刺痛
def: n. a kind of pain; something as sudden and painful as being stung
n. a painful wound caused by the thrust of an insect's stinger into skin
v. deliver a sting to

ex.en: A bee stung my ankle while I watered the flowers.
ex.zh: 我澆花時，一隻蜜蜂蜇了我的腳踝。

ex.en: Harsh criticism can sting young learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 嚴厲的批評會傷害年幼學習者的感情，使他們不願參與課堂討論。

words.tip: 過去式、過去分詞均為stung；蜇用sting，咬用bite。

tr: n. 涼鞋, 拖鞋, 檀香木
vt. 穿以便鞋
涼鞋
def: n. a shoe consisting of a sole fastened by straps to the foot
A light shoe with straps that leaves much of the foot uncovered.

ex.zh: 我們在山谷上方一片長滿青草的高原上露營。

ex.zh: 語言學習者常會進入平臺期，可能需要改變學習方法才能繼續進步。

To kill animals, usually for food

ex.en: The farmer explained why some animals are slaughtered for food.
ex.zh: 農場主解釋了為什麼有些動物會被宰殺供人食用。

ex.en: Strict regulations on how animals are slaughtered can improve welfare standards throughout the food production industry.
ex.zh: 嚴格規範動物屠宰方式，可以提高整個食品生產行業的動物福利標準。

tr: v. (使)混合

ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香氣與烘焙咖啡的香氣交織在一起。

ex.en: Community festivals allow residents from different backgrounds to mingle, helping build trust and a stronger sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 社區節慶讓不同背景的居民有機會交流，有助於建立信任並增強歸屬感。

words.tip: mingle with既可指與某物混合，也可指與人交往。

tr: n. 矮種馬

ex.en: The little pony gently ate a carrot from my hand.
ex.zh: 那匹小矮種馬輕輕地吃著我手裡的胡蘿蔔。

ex.en: Supervised pony riding can help children develop confidence while teaching them how to care responsibly for animals.
ex.zh: 在指導下騎矮種馬可以幫助兒童建立信心，同時教會他們負責任地照顧動物。

col: a Shetland pony｜設得蘭矮種馬
words.tip: pony指小型品種的馬；幼馬是foal。

tr: a. 周邊的, 周圍的, 圓周的, 無關緊要的, 膚淺的

ex.zh: 油漆顏色在我們的廚房維修中是次要問題。

ex.en: Funding debates should not allow peripheral issues to distract attention from the central goal of improving education.
ex.zh: 資金討論不應讓次要問題分散人們對改善教育這一核心目標的關注。

words.tip: peripheral to表示對……而言次要或非核心。

簧片

ex.zh: 一隻小鳥穩穩地停在池塘邊的一根蘆葦上。

ex.en: Reed beds provide shelter for wetland wildlife and can help remove pollutants from water flowing through them.
ex.zh: 蘆葦叢為溼地野生動物提供庇護，還能幫助去除流經其中的水裡的汙染物。

words.tip: 與read的原形同音；也指樂器中振動發聲的簧片。

ex.zh: 這種藥必須冷藏保存。

ex.en: As urban populations grow, it is imperative that governments invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 隨著城市人口增長，政府迫切需要投資建設可靠且價格合理的公共交通。

col: it is imperative that｜……至關重要
imperative to act｜必須採取行動
moral imperative｜道義上必須做的事
words.tip: 常用It is imperative to do或that從句。

tr: a. 漠不關心的, 無重要性的, 中立的

平庸的；不出色的

s. marked by no especial liking or dislike or preference for one thing over another

ex.en: Our cat remained indifferent to its expensive new toy.
ex.zh: 我們家的貓對昂貴的新玩具仍然毫無興趣。

ex.en: People may appear indifferent to environmental problems when they believe their individual actions cannot make a difference.
ex.zh: 當人們認為個人行動無法帶來改變時，可能會顯得對環境問題漠不關心。

words.tip: 常用be indifferent to；這裡的to是介詞。

tr: n. 引用, 引證, 引用文

ex.zh: 空氣溼度很高，我的襯衫摸起來潮潮的。

ex.en: High humidity can reduce comfort in classrooms, making effective ventilation particularly important during warmer months.
ex.zh: 高溼度會降低教室的舒適度，因此在較熱的月份，有效通風尤為重要。

words.tip: 通常不可數；溼度高低用high或low。

tr: n. 烈士, 受苦者, 受難者

ex.zh: 陰沉得令人不安的烏雲聚攏過來，我們趕忙往家走。

ex.zh: 對於依賴授粉的生態系統而言，昆蟲數量迅速下降是一個不祥的徵兆。

ex.zh: 大家都太忙，我們的週末旅行最終沒能成行。

ex.en: The promised economic benefits may not materialize unless governments also invest in education and transport.
ex.zh: 除非政府也投資教育和交通，否則承諾的經濟效益可能無法實現。

words.tip: 常作不及物動詞，指計劃實現；英式也寫materialise。

ex.zh: 新頒佈的法令意味著今晚我們這條街將繼續封閉。

ex.zh: 政府頒佈法令，要求工廠將廢水處理後再排入河流。

words.tip: 動詞可接that從句；名詞指有權威的正式命令。

ex.zh: 我終於鼓起勇氣尋求幫助。

ex.zh: 地方政府在對城市交通系統作出重大調整之前，必須爭取足夠的公眾支持。

ex.zh: 醫生開了一種麻醉性鎮痛藥，用於緩解術後劇痛。

ex.zh: 對麻醉性藥品的嚴格管控應防止濫用，同時不妨礙劇痛患者獲得藥物。

ex.zh: 城市規劃者為不斷增長的人口設計經濟適用住房時，必須考慮眾多因素。

ex.zh: 為當地收容所編織毯子的社區團體，將實際援助與社交機會結合起來。

ex.zh: 走陡坡時，我總是落在姐姐後面。

ex.zh: 隨著風暴猛烈襲擊沿海社區，更堅固的海防設施對保護住房和重要基礎設施愈發重要。

ex.zh: 在市郊建設可負擔住房可能降低住房成本，卻會增加居民對私家車的依賴。

ex.zh: 所有使用泳池的人都必須遵守泳池規定。

ex.zh: 企業應遵守環保法規，即使這樣做會增加生產成本。

ex.zh: 某些家用清潔產品含有會刺激皮膚並導致呼吸困難的化學物質。

ex.zh: 城市開發項目若未能回應當地居民的關切，緊張局勢就可能驟然加劇。
