ex.en: Public ceremonies commemorate historical events and help younger generations understand the experiences that shaped their communities.
ex.zh: 公共紀念儀式緬懷歷史事件，幫助年輕一代理解塑造其社區的經歷。

words.tip: 直接接紀念對象；不一定含有慶祝的喜悅。

tr: n. 馬伕, 新郎, 男僕
vt. 餵馬, 使...整潔, 推薦
vi. 打扮, 穿戴
梳洗；梳理毛髮
新郎
def: n. a man participant in his own marriage ceremony
n. a man who has recently been married
v. care for one's external appearance

ex.en: We groom our pony every morning before riding.
ex.zh: 我們每天早上騎馬前都會給小馬梳毛。

ex.en: Some organisations groom promising employees for leadership roles through structured training and regular mentoring.
ex.zh: 一些機構通過系統培訓和定期指導，培養有潛力的員工擔任領導職務。

col: groom someone for leadership｜培養某人擔任領導
words.tip: 培養某人任職用groom someone for a role。

tr: a. 同時的, 同時發生的
[計] 同時的
同時發生的；同步的
def: s occurring or operating at the same time
happening or existing at exactly the same time

ex.en: Simultaneous cheers erupted from both sides of the street.
ex.zh: 街道兩邊同時爆發出歡呼聲。

ex.en: Simultaneous investment in public transport and cycling infrastructure can reduce congestion more effectively than isolated measures.
ex.zh: 同時投資公共交通和自行車基礎設施，比採取單一措施更能有效緩解交通擁堵。

words.tip: 強調時間重合；副詞simultaneously表示同時地。

tr: vi. 推遲, 延期, 聽從
vt. 使推遲, 使延期
def: v hold back to a later time
v yield to another's wish or opinion

tr: a. 猖獗的, 蔓生的, 猛烈的, 躍立作撲擊狀的
猖獗的；氾濫的
瘋長的；蔓生的
def: s. unrestrained and violent
s. rearing on left hind leg with forelegs elevated and head usually in profile
s. (of a plant) having a lush and unchecked growth

ex.en: Rampant weeds have taken over our vegetable patch.
ex.zh: 瘋長的雜草已經佔據了我們的菜地。

ex.en: Where oversight is weak, rampant corruption can undermine public trust and divert resources away from essential services.
ex.zh: 在監管薄弱的地方，猖獗的腐敗會損害公眾信任，並使資源偏離基本公共服務。

words.tip: 常形容腐敗、疾病等失控蔓延；run rampant指肆虐。

tr: n. 古老, 古代, 古代人, 古物
def: n. the historic period preceding the Middle Ages in Europe
n. an artifact surviving from the past

tr: vi. 舒適地坐定, 挨靠, 偎依
vt. 抱, 安置
def: v. lie in a sheltered position
v. position comfortably

tr: n. 碎布條, 細片, 少量
v. 撕碎
def: n. a tiny or scarcely detectable amount
v. tear into shreds

tr: vi. 轉向
vt. 使轉向
n. 轉向
def: v. shift to a clockwise direction

tr: n. 領導人會議, 核心會議
vi. 開核心會議
def: n. a closed political meeting
v. meet to select a candidate or promote a policy

tr: n. 病痛, 疾病
[醫] 疾病
疾病；小病
def: n. an often persistent bodily disorder or disease; a cause for complaining
An illness, especially one that is not serious.

ex.en: The pharmacist suggested a remedy for my stomach ailment.
ex.zh: 藥劑師為我的胃部不適推薦了一種藥。

ex.en: Treating minor ailments at local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals and improve access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 在社區診所治療小病能減輕醫院壓力，並讓人們更方便地獲得醫療服務。

words.tip: 可數名詞，通常指小病，常搭配 minor。

tr: a. 多才多藝的, 萬用的, 萬向的
多才多藝的；多用途的
def: s. having great diversity or variety
s. changeable or inconstant
s. competent in many areas and able to turn with ease from one thing to another

ex.en: This versatile pan works well for soups and stir-fries.
ex.zh: 這個多用途鍋做湯、炒菜都很好用。

ex.en: Employers increasingly value versatile graduates who can adapt to different roles and learn new skills.
ex.zh: 僱主越來越重視能適應不同崗位並學習新技能的多面手畢業生。

col: a versatile performer｜多才多藝的表演者
words.tip: 既可形容人多才多藝，也可形容物用途廣泛。

tr: n. 營, 軍隊, 集團
def: n. an army unit usually consisting of a headquarters and three or more companies
n. a large indefinite number

tr: n. 隆隆聲, 轆轆聲
vi. 發隆隆聲, 轆轆響
vt. 使隆隆響, 低沉地說
def: n. a loud low dull continuous noise
n. a servant's seat (or luggage compartment) in the rear of a carriage
n. a fight between rival gangs of adolescents

tr: a. 故意的, 與目的有關的
[法] 故意的, 有意的
def: s. characterized by conscious design or purpose

tr: n. 吠聲, 咆哮聲
v. 怒吠, 咆哮, 吼
def: n. the sound of growling (as made by animals)

tr: n. 純淨, 純正, 純粹
[化] 純度
純淨；純度
純潔；純粹
def: n. being undiluted or unmixed with extraneous material
n. the state of being unsullied by sin or moral wrong; lacking a knowledge of evil
the state of containing no unwanted or harmful substances

ex.en: The jeweller checked the purity of my gold ring.
ex.zh: 珠寶匠檢測了我那枚金戒指的純度。

ex.en: Regular monitoring of water purity is essential for preventing disease and maintaining public confidence in local supplies.
ex.zh: 定期監測水的純淨程度，對於預防疾病和維持公眾對當地供水的信心至關重要。

words.tip: 不可數名詞；表示具體純度常用the purity of。

tr: vt. 吐出, 嘔吐
vi. 嘔吐
n. 嘔吐, 嘔吐物, 催吐劑
嘔吐；吐出
嘔吐物
def: n. the matter ejected in vomiting
n. the reflex act of ejecting the contents of the stomach through the mouth
v. eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth

ex.en: The rough boat ride made several passengers vomit.
ex.zh: 船在航行中劇烈顛簸，導致幾位乘客嘔吐。

ex.en: Patients who vomit repeatedly may become dehydrated and should seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
ex.zh: 反覆嘔吐的患者可能出現脫水，若症狀持續，應諮詢醫生。

words.tip: 名詞指嘔吐物；嘔吐這一過程常用vomiting。

tr: vt. 反覆地說, 重申, 反覆地做
[法] 重述, 重申, 反覆地做
重申；再次強調
def: v to say, state, or perform again
to say something again to make it clear or emphasise it

ex.en: Before we left, Dad reiterated the importance of staying together.
ex.zh: 出發前，爸爸再次強調了不要走散的重要性。

ex.en: The report reiterates that investment in public transport is essential for reducing urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 該報告重申，投資公共交通對減少城市空氣汙染至關重要。

words.tip: 是動詞，不是形容詞；可接名詞或 that 從句。

tr: a. 有韻律的, 有節奏的
def: a recurring with measured regularity

tr: n. 緩衝器, 緩衝區
vt. 緩衝
[計] 緩衝區, 緩衝器
def: n. (chemistry) an ionic compound that resists changes in its pH

n. (computer science) a part of RAM used for temporary storage of data that is waiting to be sent to a device; used to compensate for differences in the rate of flow of data between components of a computer system
n. a power tool used to buff surfaces

tr: a. 不法的, 不正當的, 禁止的
[法] 違法的, 違禁的, 被禁止的
def: a. contrary to accepted morality (especially sexual morality) or convention

tr: a. 永久的, 不斷的, 無期限的, 沒完沒了的, 四季開花的
[經] 永遠的, 終身的, 持續的
持續不斷的；永久的
一再發生的；沒完沒了的
def: s continuing forever or indefinitely
s uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing
continuing all the time or lasting forever

ex.en: The dripping tap is a source of perpetual irritation.
ex.zh: 水龍頭不停滴水，讓人一直心煩。

ex.en: The pursuit of perpetual economic growth raises questions about how societies can protect limited natural resources.
ex.zh: 對持續經濟增長的追求引出了社會如何保護有限自然資源的問題。

words.tip: 可指永不停止，也常誇張表示某事沒完沒了。

tr: n. 權宜之計, 臨時代用品
a. 權宜的, 臨時代用的
def: n. something contrived to meet an urgent need or emergency

tr: n. 友好, 好意, 善意, 親善, (企業享有的)信譽, 聲譽
[經] (企業的)商譽, 信譽
def: n (accounting) an intangible asset valued according to the advantage or reputation a business has acquired (over and above its tangible assets)
n the friendly hope that something will succeed
n a disposition to kindness and compassion

tr: a. 隱蔽的, 偷偷摸摸的, 隱密的
n. 樹叢, 隱藏處
def: n. a flock of coots
a. secret or hidden; not openly practiced or engaged in or shown or avowed
s. (of a wife) being under the protection of her husband

tr: n. (多面體的)面, 方面, 琢面
[醫] 小平面, 小面
方面；側面
寶石等的切面
def: n. a smooth surface (as of a bone or cut gemstone)
One part or aspect of a complex subject.
A small flat surface on a cut stone.

ex.en: Cooking together revealed a new facet of her personality.
ex.zh: 一起做飯展現了她性格中新的一面。

ex.en: Public transport affects almost every facet of urban life, from employment opportunities to air quality.
ex.zh: 公共交通幾乎影響城市生活的每個方面，從就業機會到空氣質量。

col: a facet of life｜生活的一個方面
words.tip: 常用 a facet of，指複雜事物的一個方面。

tr: vt. 解除武裝, 裁軍, 緩和
vi. 放下武器
def: v. remove offensive capability from
v. make less hostile; win over
v. take away the weapons from; render harmless

tr: v. 招手示意, 召喚, 吸引
n. 表召喚的點頭(或手勢)
def: v. signal with the hands or nod
v. appear inviting
v. summon with a wave, nod, or some other gesture

tr: vt. 即席創作, 臨時做
def: v. perform without preparation
v. manage in a makeshift way; do with whatever is at hand

tr: n. 候選人的地位, 候選資格
[法] 候選人的身份, 資格
def: n the campaign of a candidate to be elected

tr: n. 搶先佔據, 先人之見, 入神
[醫] 成見, 注意散漫, 心不在焉
def: n. an idea that preoccupies the mind and holds the attention
n. the mental state of being preoccupied by something

tr: vt. 妨礙, 阻礙, 阻止
阻礙；妨礙
def: v. be a hindrance or obstacle to
To make movement or progress slower or more difficult.

ex.en: Fallen branches impeded our progress along the narrow path.
ex.zh: 掉落的樹枝阻礙了我們沿著狹窄小路前進。

ex.en: Limited access to reliable internet services can impede educational progress in rural communities and widen existing inequalities.
ex.zh: 難以獲得可靠的互聯網服務可能阻礙農村社區的教育發展，並擴大現有的不平等。

words.tip: 強調使進展困難或緩慢，不一定完全阻止。

tr: n. 畏縮, 退避
vi. 畏縮, 退縮, 退避
def: n. the facial expression of sudden pain
n. a reflex response to sudden pain
v. make a face indicating disgust or dislike

tr: vi. 沉澱, 沉降, 平息
def: v. wear off or die down
v. sink to a lower level or form a depression
v. sink down or precipitate

tr: a. 貧窮的, 貧困的, 生活艱苦的
def: n. needy people collectively
s. demanding or needing attention, affection, or reassurance to an excessive degree

tr: n. 花瓣
[醫] 花瓣
def: n. part of the perianth that is usually brightly colored

tr: n. 抗體
[化] 抗體
def: n. any of a large variety of proteins normally present in the body or produced in response to an antigen which it neutralizes, thus producing an immune response

tr: a. 不育的, 貧瘠的
n. 荒地
貧瘠的；不毛的
無成果的；缺乏的
def: n. an uninhabited wilderness that is worthless for cultivation
s. not bearing offspring
s. completely wanting or lacking

ex.en: Only a few bushes grew on the barren hillside.
ex.zh: 貧瘠的山坡上只長著幾叢灌木。

ex.en: Unsustainable farming can turn productive fields into barren land, threatening food security and forcing rural communities to relocate.
ex.zh: 不可持續的耕作方式會使良田變成荒地，威脅糧食安全，並迫使農村社區遷移。

words.tip: barren強調不生長或無產出；bare強調裸露、無遮擋。

tr: n. 鉸鏈, 關鍵, 樞紐
vt. 裝鉸鏈
vi. 靠鉸鏈移動, 依...而轉移
鉸鏈；合頁
取決於
def: n. a joint that holds two parts together so that one can swing relative to the other
n. a circumstance upon which subsequent events depend
v. attach with a hinge

ex.en: The rusty hinge squeaks whenever I open the cupboard.
ex.zh: 每次我打開櫥櫃，生鏽的合頁都會吱吱作響。

ex.en: The success of public transport reforms may hinge on reliable funding and sustained support from local residents.
ex.zh: 公共交通改革的成功可能取決於可靠的資金來源和當地居民的持續支持。

words.tip: hinge on 後接名詞或從句，表示“取決於”。

tr: a. 天的, 天國的, 天空的
[法] 天的, 天空的, 天國的
def: a. of or relating to the sky
a. relating to or inhabiting a divine heaven
s. of heaven or the spirit

tr: n. 牢牢抓住, 釘緊, 敲彎釘尖
vt. 緊握, 牢牢地抓住, 確定, 敲彎
vi. 握緊, 釘牢
握緊；咬緊
def: v. hold in a tight grasp
v. squeeze together tightly
To close your hands or press your teeth together tightly.

ex.en: Arun clenched his fists as the cold wind blew.
ex.zh: 寒風吹來，阿倫握緊了雙拳。

ex.en: People under prolonged stress may clench their teeth during sleep, potentially causing pain in the jaw.
ex.zh: 長期承受壓力的人可能在睡眠中咬緊牙齒，從而引發下頜疼痛。

words.tip: clench指握緊或咬緊；clin​​ch才可指贏得、敲定。

tr: a. 現世的, 世俗的, 宇宙的
def: s. concerned with the world or worldly matters
s. belonging to this earth or world; not ideal or heavenly; yet a mundane wonder of unimagined kind"

tr: a. 審慎的, 三思而後行的, 精明的, 節儉的
謹慎的；穩妥的
def: a. careful and sensible; marked by sound judgment
Careful and sensible about risks and future consequences.

ex.en: Taking an extra jacket seemed prudent before our mountain walk.
ex.zh: 去山裡徒步前，多帶一件外套似乎很穩妥。

ex.en: Prudent financial planning can help households cope with unexpected expenses during periods of economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 審慎的財務規劃能幫助家庭在經濟不穩定時期應付意外開支。

col: prudent financial management｜穩健的財務管理
prudent to do something｜做某事是明智的
words.tip: 強調考慮風險和後果，不只是膽小或節儉。

tr: n. 殘骸, 失事, 破壞
[經] (船雙等的)失事遭難
def: n. the remaining parts of something that has been wrecked

tr: a. 意見一致的, 無異議的
全體一致同意的
def: s in complete agreement
s acting together as a single undiversified whole
agreed on by every person in a group

ex.en: Our family was unanimous about adopting the little cat.
ex.zh: 我們全家一致同意收養那隻小貓。

ex.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision to improve public transport rather than expand the existing road network.
ex.zh: 委員會一致決定改善公共交通，而不是擴建現有道路網。

words.tip: 強調所有人都同意，不是僅指多數人贊成。

tr: vt. 蝕刻, 蝕鏤
vi. 施行蝕刻法
n. 腐蝕劑
[計] 刻蝕; 侵蝕
def: v. make an etching of
v. cause to stand out or be clearly defined or visible
v. selectively dissolve the surface of (a semiconductor or printed circuit) with a solvent, laser, or stream of electrons

tr: n. 繼續, 續集, 補編
[醫] 連續
def: n the act of continuing an activity without interruption
n a part added to a book or play that continues and extends it
n a Gestalt principle of organization holding that there is an innate tendency to perceive a line as continuing its established direction

tr: vt. 塗, 擦上, 玷汙, 把...擦模糊
vi. 被弄髒
n. 汙點, 汙跡, 汙衊
def: n. slanderous defamation
n. a thin tissue or blood sample spread on a glass slide and stained for cytologic examination and diagnosis under a microscope
v. stain by smearing or daubing with a dirty substance

tr: a. 得到靈感的, 有靈感的, 官方授意的
def: v heighten or intensify
v supply the inspiration for
v serve as the inciting cause of

tr: n. 智力, 出眾的才華, 知識分子
[醫] 智力, 才智
智力；理解力
才智出眾的人
def: n knowledge and intellectual ability
n the capacity for rational thought or inference or discrimination
n a person who uses the mind creatively

ex.en: Her sharp intellect makes difficult puzzles seem surprisingly easy.
ex.zh: 她思維敏銳，解起難題來顯得格外輕鬆。

ex.en: Education should develop students' intellect while also nurturing creativity, emotional awareness, and the ability to collaborate.
ex.zh: 教育應發展學生的智力，同時培養創造力、情感意識和協作能力。

words.tip: intellect側重理解與推理能力，不等同於知識。

tr: vt. 注入, 使充滿, 泡製, 鼓舞
vi. 泡
def: v. undergo the process of infusion
v. introduce into the body through a vein, for therapeutic purposes

tr: n. 滴, 細流
vi. 滴, 細細地流
vt. 使滴, 使小量流動
[計] 信息透露
def: v. run or flow slowly, as in drops or in an unsteady stream

tr: vt. 使膨脹, 使得意, 使通貨膨脹, 使充氣
vi. 充氣, 膨脹
def: v. exaggerate or make bigger
v. fill with gas or air
v. cause prices to rise by increasing the available currency or credit

tr: a. 常年的, 長期的, 反覆的
[醫] 多年生的
def: n. (botany) a plant lasting for three seasons or more
a. lasting three seasons or more
s. lasting an indefinitely long time; suggesting self-renewal

tr: n. 重疊, 重複, 部分的同時發生
vt. 重疊, 重複, 與...同時發生
vi. 迭蓋, 部分的同時發生
[計] 重疊
部分重疊；有共同之處
def: n. a representation of common ground between theories or phenomena
n. the property of partial coincidence in time
v. coincide partially or wholly

ex.en: The curtains overlap slightly in the middle of the window.
ex.zh: 窗簾在窗戶中間略有重疊。

ex.en: University courses often overlap in content, allowing students to explore connections between different academic disciplines.
ex.zh: 大學課程的內容常有重疊，使學生能夠探索不同學科之間的聯繫。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後，名詞在前；過去式overlapped。

tr: n. 長命, 長壽, 壽命
[醫] 長壽
def: n. duration of service
n. the property of being long-lived

tr: n. 沉思, 冥想
v. 沉思, 冥想, 若有所思地凝望或說
def: n. in ancient Greek mythology any of 9 daughters of Zeus and Mnemosyne; protector of an art or science
n. the source of an artist's inspiration

tr: a. 荒廢的, 成廢物的, 陳舊的, 老式的
n. 廢詞, 廢物
def: s no longer in use

tr: n. 犯人, 罪犯, 刑事被告
[法] 犯罪者, 犯人, 罪犯
def: n someone who perpetrates wrongdoing

tr: n. 破產者
a. 破產的
vt. 使破產
破產的
使破產
def: n. someone who has insufficient assets to cover their debts
v. reduce to bankruptcy
s. financially ruined

ex.en: The little furniture shop went bankrupt last winter.
ex.zh: 那家小傢俱店去年冬天破產了。

ex.en: Small businesses may go bankrupt if rising energy costs are combined with a prolonged decline in consumer demand.
ex.zh: 如果能源成本上漲又遇上消費需求長期下降，小企業可能會破產。

col: declare someone bankrupt｜宣告某人破產
words.tip: 常說go bankrupt；名詞“破產”是bankruptcy。

tr: n. 不規則, 反常事物, 畸形
[醫] 異常, 反常
def: n. deviation from the normal or common order or form or rule
n. a person who is unusual
n. (astronomy) position of a planet as defined by its angular distance from its perihelion (as observed from the sun)

tr: n. 大人物, 有權勢的人
def: n. a bump on a ski slope
n. a member of the Muslim dynasty that ruled India until 1857

tr: n. 慟哭, 哀號, 嚎啕, 呼嘯(聲)
vi. 慟哭, 呼嘯, 悲嘆, 哀號, 嚎啕
哀號；大聲哭叫
哀號聲；尖厲長鳴
def: v. cry weakly or softly
to cry loudly in pain, sadness, or distress
a long, high cry or sound expressing distress

ex.en: The baby began to wail when her toy fell.
ex.zh: 玩具掉了，寶寶便放聲大哭起來。

ex.en: Residents heard sirens wailing throughout the night as emergency teams responded to the severe flooding.
ex.zh: 應急隊伍應對嚴重洪災時，居民整夜都聽到警報器的長鳴聲。

col: wail in pain｜痛得大聲哭叫
a piercing wail｜刺耳的哀號聲
the wail of sirens｜警報器的長鳴聲
words.tip: 強調持續而尖厲的哭聲，也可形容警報器長鳴。

tr: n. 隱藏所, 隱藏的糧食或物資, 貯藏物, 高速緩衝存儲器
vt. 隱藏, 窖藏
[計] 高速緩衝存儲器, 高速緩衝

tr: n. 替代者, 代用品
vt. 代理, 替代

tr: a. 原因的, 因果關係的, 表示原因或理由的
n. 表示原因的連詞
def: s. involving or constituting a cause; causing

tr: n. 海上救助, 搶救, 打撈, 搶救出來的財物
vt. 海上救助, 搶救, 打撈, 營救
[計] 文件恢復程序
搶救；打撈
挽救；挽回
def: n. property or goods saved from damage or destruction
n. the act of saving goods or property that were in danger of damage or destruction
n. the act of rescuing a ship or its crew or its cargo from a shipwreck or a fire

ex.en: We managed to salvage some books after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水過後，我們設法搶救出了一些書。

ex.en: Construction companies can salvage valuable materials from old buildings, reducing waste and demand for new resources.
ex.zh: 建築公司可以從舊建築中回收有價值的材料，減少廢物以及對新資源的需求。

words.tip: 多指搶救財物；救人通常用rescue。

tr: a. 根本不同的, 全異的, 不相干的
n. 無法相比的東西(或人)

s. including markedly dissimilar elements

tr: n. 詭辯, 老於世故, 複雜(性)
[醫] 摻假
精密；複雜程度
老練；世故；高雅
def: n. being expert or having knowledge of some technical subject
n. the quality or character of being intellectually sophisticated and worldly through cultivation or experience or disillusionment
n. falsification by the use of sophistry; misleading by means of specious fallacies

ex.en: I was surprised by the sophistication of her camera.
ex.zh: 她的相機如此精密，讓我很驚訝。

ex.en: The growing sophistication of medical equipment allows doctors to identify certain diseases at an earlier stage.
ex.zh: 醫療設備日益精密，使醫生能夠在更早階段發現某些疾病。

col: a high degree of sophistication｜高度精密
words.tip: 不可數名詞；既指技術精密，也指處世老練。

tr: a. 脆弱的, 虛弱的, 意志薄弱的
n. 少女, 少婦, 燈心草簍
def: n. the weight of a frail (basket) full of raisins or figs; between 50 and 75 pounds
n. a basket for holding dried fruit (especially raisins or figs)
a. physically weak

[法] 訴訟的, 爭執的, 引起爭論的

s. involving or likely to cause controversy

tr: n. 喇叭, 小號, 喇叭聲
vi. 吹喇叭
vt. 用喇叭吹出, 吹噓
小號
大肆宣揚；鼓吹
def: v. proclaim on, or as if on, a trumpet
v. play or blow on the trumpet
v. utter in trumpet-like sounds

ex.en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
ex.zh: 那位樂手舉起小號，吹奏了一支歡快的曲子。

ex.en: Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.
ex.zh: 在學校管絃樂隊學習小號可以提升學生的專注力及與他人合作的能力。

words.tip: 樂器義是“小號”；動詞可指大肆宣揚。

tr: a. 完成的, 實現的, 有造詣的, 熟練的, 善社交的
def: s. highly skilled
s. successfully completed or brought to an end
s. settled securely and unconditionally

def: n. clothing in general

小冊子；宣傳冊
def: n a small book usually having a paper cover
n a brief treatise on a subject of interest; published in the form of a booklet
A thin booklet giving information or arguments about a subject

ex.en: The nurse handed me a pamphlet about healthy eating.
ex.zh: 護士遞給我一本關於健康飲食的小冊子。

ex.en: Public health pamphlets should use clear language and illustrations to explain preventive measures to a broad audience.
ex.zh: 公共衛生宣傳冊應使用清晰的語言和插圖，向廣大受眾解釋預防措施。

col: a pamphlet on health｜健康宣傳冊
words.tip: 通常指介紹專題的薄冊子，比普通書籍篇幅短。

tr: n. 皮帶扣, 釦子

vi. 扣住, 變彎曲, 屈服

v. fasten with a buckle or buckles
v. fold or collapse

tr: n. 無信用, 丟臉, 不名譽

def: v. cause to be distrusted or disbelieved
v. damage the reputation of

tr: n. 畸形人, 畸形物, 不正常的事物, 反覆無常
a. 奇異的, 反常的
異常的；罕見的
狂熱愛好者
驚慌；嚇壞
def: n. a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed
Very unusual and unexpected
Someone extremely interested in a particular activity or subject

ex.en: A freak hailstorm covered our garden in white ice.
ex.zh: 一場罕見的冰雹把我們的花園蓋上了一層白冰。

ex.en: A freak weather event can expose weaknesses in urban infrastructure and disrupt essential public services.
ex.zh: 異常天氣事件可能暴露城市基礎設施的薄弱環節，並擾亂基本公共服務。

col: a freak accident｜離奇的意外事故
a fitness freak｜健身狂熱愛好者
words.tip: 形容詞通常置於名詞前；動詞常用freak out。

tr: a. 事實的, 實際的
[法] 事實的, 與事實有關的, 實際的
基於事實的；事實性的
def: a. of or relating to or characterized by facts
Based on facts rather than opinions or invented details.

ex.en: Her account of the accident was brief and factual.
ex.zh: 她對事故的敘述簡短且符合事實。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish factual information from personal opinion when evaluating sources for academic assignments.
ex.zh: 學生在評估學術作業所用的資料來源時，應學會區分事實信息與個人觀點。

words.tip: 強調依據事實，不等於actual所指的實際存在。

tr: n. 蕨類植物
[醫] 蕨類植物
def: n. any of numerous flowerless and seedless vascular plants having true roots from a rhizome and fronds that uncurl upward; reproduce by spores

tr: n. 題字, 碑銘
[醫] 劃, 藥量記載
def: n. letters inscribed (especially words engraved or carved) on something
n. the activity of inscribing (especially carving or engraving) letters or words

tr: n. 群, 大群, 蜂群, 分蜂群
vi. 分群, 群集, 聚集一塊, 雲集, 攀
vt. 擠滿, 爬, 攀
蜂群；成群的昆蟲
蜂擁；成群移動
def: n. a group of many things in the air or on the ground
A large group of insects moving or gathering together.
Move or gather somewhere in large numbers.

ex.en: A swarm of bees gathered on the apple tree.
ex.zh: 一群蜜蜂聚集在蘋果樹上。

ex.en: Visitors swarm into coastal towns during summer, increasing demand for public transport and waste collection services.
ex.zh: 遊客在夏季湧入沿海城鎮，增加了對公共交通和垃圾收集服務的需求。

col: a swarm of bees｜一群蜜蜂
words.tip: be swarming with表示某處擠滿人或昆蟲。

tr: n. 葡萄乾
def: n. dried grape

tr: n. 惡化, 衰退, 退化
[醫] 變壞, 變質, 頹廢, 衰退
惡化；退化；損壞
def: n. a symptom of reduced quality or strength
n. process of changing to an inferior state
The process of becoming worse in condition or quality.

ex.en: Cracks in the ceiling showed the building's gradual deterioration.
ex.zh: 天花板上的裂縫表明這棟樓正逐漸破損。

ex.en: A deterioration in urban air quality can increase respiratory illness and place additional pressure on healthcare services.
ex.zh: 城市空氣質量惡化會增加呼吸系統疾病，並給醫療服務帶來額外壓力。

col: a deterioration in health｜健康狀況惡化
prevent further deterioration｜防止進一步惡化
words.tip: 常用a deterioration in表示某方面的惡化。

tr: vt. 溫和, 緩和, 減輕
[醫] 緩和, 減輕
減輕；緩和
def: v. make less severe or harsh
To make something harmful, unpleasant, or serious less severe

ex.en: Thick curtains helped mitigate the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 厚窗簾幫助減輕了街上傳來的噪聲。

ex.en: Planting trees in urban areas can mitigate the effects of extreme heat and improve residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 在城市地區植樹可以減輕酷熱的影響，並改善居民的生活質量。

col: mitigate the effects of｜減輕……的影響
mitigate climate change｜緩解氣候變化
mitigating circumstances｜可減輕處罰的情節
words.tip: 正式用詞，直接接風險、損害或影響，不表示徹底消除。

tr: vt. 緩和, 使安靜, 安慰, 奉承
vi. 起安慰作用
def: v. cause to feel better

tr: n. 釦子, 鉤, 緊握
v. 扣緊, 緊握
緊握；抱緊
搭扣；釦環
緊握；緊抱
def: n. a fastener (as a buckle or hook) that is used to hold two things together
n. the act of grasping
v. hold firmly and tightly

ex.en: She clasped my hand as we crossed the bridge.
ex.zh: 過橋時，她緊緊握住我的手。

ex.en: Young children may clasp a familiar toy during medical appointments because it provides comfort in unfamiliar surroundings.
ex.zh: 幼兒就診時可能會緊抱熟悉的玩具，因為它能在陌生環境中帶來安慰。

col: clasp someone's hand｜緊握某人的手
clasp your hands together｜雙手緊握
words.tip: clasp作動詞強調握緊；作名詞也可指首飾搭扣。

tr: n. 障礙, 妨礙, 閉塞物
[醫] 梗阻, 不通
障礙物；阻塞
阻撓；妨礙
def: n. any structure that makes progress difficult
n. the physical condition of blocking or filling a passage with an obstruction
n. the act of obstructing

ex.en: A fallen branch caused an obstruction on the narrow path.
ex.zh: 一根掉落的樹枝擋住了狹窄的小路。

ex.en: Removing unnecessary administrative procedures can reduce obstruction to the development of small businesses in rural areas.
ex.zh: 取消不必要的行政程序可以減少農村地區小企業發展面臨的阻礙。

words.tip: 實體障礙物通常可數；阻撓這一行為常不可數。

tr: vi. 臉紅, 羞愧
vt. 弄成紅色
n. 臉紅
臉紅
臉紅；紅暈
def: n. sudden reddening of the face (as from embarrassment or guilt or shame or modesty)
v. turn red, as if in embarrassment or shame
v. become rosy or reddish

ex.en: He began to blush when everyone praised his singing.
ex.zh: 大家誇讚他的歌聲時，他開始臉紅了。

ex.en: Students who blush during presentations may benefit from supportive feedback and regular opportunities to practise speaking.
ex.zh: 演講時容易臉紅的學生可能會受益於鼓勵性的反饋和經常練習口頭表達的機會。

words.tip: 動詞通常不及物；使某人臉紅用make someone blush。

tr: n. 優勢, 有利情況
def: n. place or situation affording some advantage (especially a comprehensive view or commanding perspective)

tr: n. 砂礫, 粗砂石
vt. 覆以砂礫, 咬牙切齒地說
vi. 摩擦作聲
砂礫；細沙
毅力；勇氣
def: n. a hard coarse-grained siliceous sandstone
v. cover with a grit
v. clench together

ex.en: I shook the grit out of my walking boots.
ex.zh: 我把徒步靴裡的砂礫抖了出來。

ex.en: Although talent matters, students often need grit and consistent support to overcome persistent learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 雖然天賦很重要，但學生往往需要毅力和持續支持才能克服長期的學習困難。

col: grit the roads｜在道路上撒砂礫
words.tip: 砂礫和毅力義均不可數；grit不是通常意義的“研磨”。

tr: n. 半島, 突出的地方, 伊比利亞半島
半島
def: n. a large mass of land projecting into a body of water
Land almost surrounded by water but connected to a larger landmass.

ex.en: We cycled around the peninsula and stopped at a beach.
ex.zh: 我們騎車繞著半島遊覽，在一處海灘停了下來。

ex.en: Tourism on the peninsula provides local employment, but excessive development could damage its fragile coastal habitats.
ex.zh: 半島上的旅遊業為當地提供了就業機會，但過度開發可能破壞其脆弱的沿海棲息地。

col: the tip of the peninsula｜半島的尖端
words.tip: 半島與大陸相連；island指四面環水的島。

tr: n. 小池, 水坑, 膠土
vt. 攪濁, 攪煉
vi. 在泥汙中打滾, (把黏土等)搗製成膠土
def: n. a mixture of wet clay and sand that can be used to line a pond and that is impervious to water when dry
v. wade or dabble in a puddle
v. subject to puddling or form by puddling

tr: a. 幻像的, 幻想的, 夢想的
n. 有眼力的人, 空想家, 夢想者
def: n. a person given to fanciful speculations and enthusiasms with little regard for what is actually possible
n. a person with unusual powers of foresight

tr: vt. 輕視
def: v look down on with disdain

tr: a. 假裝的, 做作的, 受影響的
def: a. acted upon; influenced
a. speaking or behaving in an artificial way to make an impression

tr: n. 沮喪
vt. 使驚愕, 使氣餒
驚愕；沮喪
使驚愕；使沮喪
def: v. fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
Shock and disappointment caused by something unexpected and unpleasant.
To make someone feel shocked and disappointed.

ex.en: To my dismay, the cake collapsed in the oven.
ex.zh: 令我沮喪的是，蛋糕在烤箱裡塌了。

ex.en: Residents expressed dismay at plans to replace their local park with a large commercial development.
ex.zh: 對於將當地公園改建成大型商業項目的計劃，居民們表示震驚和失望。

col: to someone's dismay｜令某人沮喪的是
be dismayed at｜對……感到驚愕沮喪
words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；to one's dismay意為令人沮喪的是。

tr: vt. 效法, 盡力趕上, 同...競爭
[計] 仿真
def: v. strive to equal or match, especially by imitating
v. imitate the function of (another system), as by modifying the hardware or the software
v. compete with successfully; approach or reach equality with

tr: n. 重複的話, 疊句, 副歌
vi. 節制, 避免, 剋制
剋制；避免做
副歌；反覆出現的話
def: n. the part of a song where a soloist is joined by a group of singers
v. resist doing something
To deliberately stop yourself from doing something.

ex.en: Please refrain from feeding the ducks near the bridge.
ex.zh: 請不要給橋邊的鴨子餵食。

ex.en: Visitors should refrain from touching fragile exhibits so that museums can preserve them for future generations.
ex.zh: 參觀者應避免觸碰易損展品，以便博物館將其保存下來，留給後代。

col: refrain from doing something｜避免做某事
words.tip: 動詞常用refrain from doing，語氣較正式。

tr: a. 大方的, 豐富的, 浪費的
vt. 浪費, 濫用, 慷慨給予
奢華的；豐盛的
慷慨給予；大量傾注
def: v. expend profusely; also used with abstract nouns
s. very generous
s. characterized by extravagance and profusion

ex.en: They prepared a lavish feast for the whole family.
ex.zh: 他們為全家準備了一頓豐盛的大餐。

ex.en: Critics argue that lavish spending on official ceremonies diverts public funds from essential services such as healthcare.
ex.zh: 批評者認為，在官方儀式上大肆花費會擠佔醫療等基本服務的公共資金。

col: a lavish lifestyle｜奢華的生活方式
lavish praise on someone｜大加讚揚某人
lavish attention on someone｜給予某人大量關注
words.tip: 動詞常用lavish sth on sb，表示大量給予。

tr: n. 旅行者, 朝聖者, 香客
vi. 朝聖
def: n. someone who journeys in foreign lands
n. one of the colonists from England who sailed to America on the Mayflower and founded the colony of Plymouth in New England in 1620
n. someone who journeys to a sacred place as an act of religious devotion

tr: n. 里程碑, 里程石, 里程標
重要階段；里程碑
里程標
def: n. stone post at side of a road to show distances
n. a significant event in your life (or in a project)
An important event or stage in development.

ex.en: Getting her first job was a milestone for Sara.
ex.zh: 找到第一份工作是薩拉人生中的一個里程碑。

ex.en: The opening of the railway marked a significant milestone in the region's economic development.
ex.zh: 這條鐵路的開通標誌著該地區經濟發展的一個重要里程碑。

col: reach a milestone｜達到重要階段
mark a milestone｜標誌著重要進展
words.tip: 常指發展中的重要節點，常搭配in。

tr: vt. 縮減, 剝奪, 簡略
[法] 剝奪特權
def: v place restrictions on
v terminate or abbreviate before its intended or proper end or its full extent

tr: n. 食籃, 阻礙物, 食盒
vt. 阻礙, 使困累, 妨礙, 牽制
阻礙；妨礙
有蓋大籃；食品禮籃
def: n. a basket usually with a cover
v. prevent the progress or free movement of
to make progress or an activity more difficult

ex.en: Heavy rain hampered our efforts to repair the fence.
ex.zh: 大雨妨礙了我們修理圍欄。

ex.en: Limited access to reliable internet services can hamper economic development in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 可靠互聯網服務的缺乏可能阻礙偏遠農村社區的經濟發展。

words.tip: 動詞後直接接賓語；名詞還可指食品籃或洗衣籃。

tr: n. 血統, 直系
[法] 血統, 世系
def: n. the descendants of one individual

tr: n. 宴會
def: n. a ceremonial dinner party for many people
n. a meal that is well prepared and greatly enjoyed

tr: a. 現象的, 能知覺的, 異常的, 顯著的, 驚人的
def: a. of or relating to a phenomenon
s. exceedingly or unbelievably great

tr: n. 平衡, 平靜, 均衡
[化] 平衡
平衡；均衡狀態
心情平靜；心理平衡
def: n. a stable situation in which forces cancel one another
n. a sensory system located in structures of the inner ear that registers the orientation of the head
A stable state in which opposing forces or influences balance.

ex.en: The hanging mobile regained equilibrium when I moved one ornament.
ex.zh: 我移動了一個飾物後，懸掛的裝飾架恢復了平衡。

ex.en: Removing a major predator can disturb the equilibrium of an ecosystem and cause unexpected changes in animal populations.
ex.zh: 移除主要捕食者可能破壞生態系統的平衡，並導致動物種群出現意想不到的變化。

words.tip: 通常不可數；常用於經濟、生態或物理中的平衡。

tr: a. 豪華的, 奢侈的, 放縱的
豪華的；奢華舒適的
def: s displaying luxury and furnishing gratification to the senses
s rich and superior in quality
Very comfortable and expensive, often with beautiful surroundings or materials.

ex.en: Our hotel room had a luxurious bath overlooking the sea.
ex.zh: 我們的酒店客房裡有一個可欣賞海景的豪華浴缸。

ex.en: Although luxurious resorts attract wealthy visitors, their high water consumption can place pressure on local resources.
ex.zh: 儘管豪華度假村能吸引富裕遊客，但其高耗水量會給當地資源帶來壓力。

words.tip: luxurious指豪華舒適；luxuriant多指植物繁茂。

tr: vt. 批准, 認可
[經] 證實, 肯定, 確認
def: v approve and express assent, responsibility, or obligation

tr: a. 令人難忘的, 壯麗的, 威風的
def: v compel to behave in a certain way
v impose something unpleasant
v impose and collect

tr: n. 中產階級分子, 商人, 資產階級
a. 中產階級的, 平庸的
n. 九點活字
def: n. a member of the middle class
s. (according to Marxist thought) being of the property-owning class and exploitive of the working class
s. conforming to the standards and conventions of the middle class

tr: a. 黝暗的, 陰沉的, 朦朧的
def: s. dark or gloomy

tr: n. 舉起, 隆起, 大變動, 劇變
def: n. (geology) a rise of land to a higher elevation (as in the process of mountain building)

tr: adv. 漫不經心地, 疏忽地; 非故意地
def: r without knowledge or intention

tr: n. 調味品, 作料, 佐料, 鍛練
[化] 天然時效
def: n. the act of adding a seasoning to food

tr: n. 熒光
a. 熒光的
發熒光的；熒光燈的
顏色鮮亮的；熒光色的
def: n. a lighting fixture that uses a fluorescent lamp
s. emitting light during exposure to radiation from an external source
s. brilliantly colored and apparently giving off light

ex.en: The fluorescent lamp flickered above the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 廚房水槽上方的熒光燈閃爍不定。

ex.en: Replacing fluorescent lighting with more efficient alternatives can lower electricity consumption in schools and offices.
ex.zh: 用效率更高的照明設備替換熒光燈，可以降低學校和辦公室的用電量。

words.tip: 注意拼寫是fluorescent，常搭配lamp或tube。

tr: a. 要求高的, 費力的
費力的；要求高的
苛求的；難以滿足的
def: a. requiring more than usually expected or thought due; especially great patience and effort and skill
Requiring considerable effort, skill, time, or attention.
Expecting a great deal of attention or effort from others.

ex.en: After a demanding shift, I fell asleep on the bus.
ex.zh: 忙完一班累人的工作後，我在公交車上睡著了。

ex.en: Physically demanding jobs may require additional safety measures to protect workers from injuries and long-term health problems.
ex.zh: 體力要求高的工作可能需要額外的安全措施，以保護勞動者免受傷害和長期健康問題的影響。

words.tip: 修飾任務指費力；修飾人指要求高、難滿足。

tr: n. 熔岩, 火山岩
[醫] 火山石(一種順勢療法藥)
def: n. rock that in its molten form (as magma) issues from volcanos; lava is what magma is called when it reaches the surface

tr: n. 花束
[醫] 叢, 酒香, 末梢分極
花束
酒香
def: n. an arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present
n. a pleasingly sweet olfactory property
A group of flowers arranged together, usually as a gift.

ex.en: She brought a bright bouquet to her grandmother's birthday dinner.
ex.zh: 她帶著一束鮮豔的花來參加祖母的生日晚餐。

ex.en: Choosing a bouquet of locally grown flowers can reduce the environmental impact associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 選擇一束本地種植的鮮花，可以減少長途運輸帶來的環境影響。

col: a bouquet of flowers｜一束鮮花
a bouquet of roses｜一束玫瑰
words.tip: 末尾t不發音；一束花用a bouquet of flowers。

tr: vi. 牛拉貨車, 艱苦跋涉
n. 牛車旅行, 艱苦跋涉
長途艱苦跋涉
長途跋涉；徒步遠行
def: n. a journey by ox wagon (especially an organized migration by a group of settlers)
n. any long and difficult trip
v. journey on foot, especially in the mountains

ex.en: Our trek through the forest ended beside a waterfall.
ex.zh: 我們穿越森林的徒步旅程在一處瀑布旁結束。

ex.en: Visitors who trek through remote mountain regions can support local economies by hiring guides and purchasing local supplies.
ex.zh: 在偏遠山區徒步的遊客可以通過僱用嚮導和購買當地物資來支持當地經濟。

col: a mountain trek｜山地徒步旅行
trek through the forest｜徒步穿越森林
go on a trek｜去長途徒步
words.tip: 現代常指艱苦徒步；trekked、trekking要雙寫k。

tr: n. 火爐, 熔爐, 考驗
vt. 在爐中燒
熔爐；工業爐
暖氣爐
def: n. an enclosed chamber in which heat is produced to heat buildings, destroy refuse, smelt or refine ores, etc.
An enclosed structure producing intense heat for industrial processes.
A device that heats air or water to warm a building.

ex.en: We watched molten metal pour from the glowing furnace.
ex.zh: 我們看著熔化的金屬從熾熱的熔爐中傾瀉而出。

ex.en: Replacing an inefficient furnace can reduce household energy consumption and lower heating costs during winter.
ex.zh: 更換低效的暖氣爐可以減少家庭能源消耗，並降低冬季取暖費用。

words.tip: 工業語境指熔爐；美式家居語境常指暖氣爐。

tr: n. 色素, 色質, 顏料
[化] 顏料
def: n. dry coloring material (especially a powder to be mixed with a liquid to produce paint, etc.)
n. any substance whose presence in plant or animal tissues produces a characteristic color
v. acquire pigment; become colored or imbued

tr: n. 細微差別
細微差別
def: n. a subtle difference in meaning or opinion or attitude
a small difference in meaning, feeling, sound, or appearance

ex.en: Her smile added a playful nuance to the apology.
ex.zh: 她的微笑讓這句道歉多了一絲俏皮意味。

ex.en: Language learners need cultural knowledge to recognise nuances that dictionaries may not fully explain.
ex.zh: 語言學習者需要文化知識，才能辨別詞典可能無法充分解釋的細微差別。

col: nuances of meaning｜意義上的細微差別
capture the nuances｜捕捉細微差別
words.tip: 常用複數nuances，指意義、語氣等細微差別。

tr: n. 小配件, 小玩意, 詭計
小器具；小裝置
def: n a device or control that is very useful for a particular job
A small device designed to perform a particular useful task

ex.en: This handy gadget removes apple cores in seconds.
ex.zh: 這個方便的小器具幾秒鐘就能去掉蘋果核。

ex.en: Although a new electronic gadget may offer convenience, frequent replacement contributes to growing amounts of electronic waste.
ex.zh: 雖然新的電子小裝置可能帶來便利，但頻繁更換會導致電子垃圾不斷增加。

words.tip: 指有特定用途的小裝置，不一定是電子產品。

tr: n. 特技, 絕技, 花招, 噱頭, 手腕, 發育不良
vt. 阻礙成長
vi. 表演特技
def: n. a difficult or unusual or dangerous feat; usually done to gain attention
n. a creature (especially a whale) that has been prevented from attaining full growth
v. check the growth or development of

tr: a. 直覺的
def: s. spontaneously derived from or prompted by a natural tendency
s. obtained through intuition rather than from reasoning or observation

tr: vt. 根除, 撲滅, 根絕, 消滅
根除；徹底消滅
def: v kill in large numbers
v destroy completely, as if down to the roots
To completely remove or destroy something harmful.

ex.en: We removed every root to eradicate weeds from the garden.
ex.zh: 我們清除了每一處草根，以徹底除去花園裡的雜草。

ex.en: International vaccination programmes aim to eradicate infectious diseases by ensuring that vulnerable populations receive adequate protection.
ex.zh: 國際疫苗接種計劃旨在確保易感人群得到充分保護，從而根除傳染病。

words.tip: 強調徹底消除，語氣強於reduce，常用於疾病或貧困。

tr: n. 底切, 牛腰部下側嫩肉, 下口, 下旋削球
vt. 廉價出售, 底切, 雕出, 下旋削球
vi. 切除底部
def: n. the material removed by a cut made underneath
n. a notch cut in the trunk of tree in order to determine the direction of its fall
n. a cut made underneath to remove material

tr: v. 增加, 增長
[計] 增加; 增量; 添加
增加；增強
def: v. enlarge or increase
v. grow or intensify
To increase something by adding to it.

ex.en: She sells homemade jam to augment her income.
ex.zh: 她出售自制果醬來增加收入。

ex.en: Digital resources can augment classroom teaching, but they should not replace meaningful interaction between teachers and students.
ex.zh: 數字資源能增強課堂教學效果，但不應取代師生之間有意義的互動。

col: augment existing resources｜補充現有資源
words.tip: 較正式，通常作及物動詞，強調通過添加來增加。

tr: vt. 避開, 規避, 避免
刻意避開；迴避
def: v. avoid and stay away from deliberately; stay clear of
To deliberately avoid someone or something.

ex.en: My neighbours shun crowded shops and buy food online.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居們避開擁擠的商店，在網上購買食品。

ex.en: Some graduates shun corporate careers because they value personal independence more than a high salary.
ex.zh: 一些畢業生不願進入企業工作，因為他們認為個人獨立比高薪更重要。

words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語；過去式shunned。

tr: a. 動人的, 令人同情的
感人的；動人的
觸摸；碰（現在分詞）
def: n the event of something coming in contact with the body
n the act of putting two things together with no space between them
v make physical contact with, come in contact with

ex.en: Her touching farewell brought tears to my eyes.
ex.zh: 她感人的道別讓我熱淚盈眶。

ex.en: The documentary offers a touching account of volunteers helping older residents overcome loneliness in urban communities.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片動人地講述了志願者幫助城市社區的老年居民克服孤獨的故事。

words.tip: touching形容事情感人；touched形容人受到感動。

tr: n. 保衛, 保護措施, 防護設施
vt. 保衛, 保護
保護；保障
保護措施；保障
def: v. make safe
v. escort safely
To protect someone or something from harm or loss.

ex.en: These padded covers safeguard the furniture during the move.
ex.zh: 這些加厚護套在搬家時保護傢俱。

ex.en: Governments should introduce stronger regulations to safeguard personal information collected by online services and mobile applications.
ex.zh: 政府應出臺更嚴格的法規，保護在線服務和移動應用收集的個人信息。

col: safeguard personal information｜保護個人信息
a safeguard against fraud｜防範欺詐的措施
words.tip: 動詞常接權益等賓語；名詞常接against表示防範對象。

tr: n. 幼蟲
[醫] 幼蟲(昆蟲), 蚴(蠕蟲)
def: n. the immature free-living form of most invertebrates and amphibians and fish which at hatching from the egg is fundamentally unlike its parent and must metamorphose

tr: n. 胰島素
[化] 胰島素
def: n. hormone secreted by the isles of Langerhans in the pancreas; regulates storage of glycogen in the liver and accelerates oxidation of sugar in cells

tr: [計] 學科間的
def: a. drawing from or characterized by participation of two or more fields of study

tr: n. 注意, 留心
v. 注意, 留心
留意；聽從
注意；留心
def: v. pay close attention to; give heed to
To pay careful attention to advice or a warning.
Careful attention given to something, especially advice or warnings.

ex.en: We heeded the guide's warning and left the beach.
ex.zh: 我們聽從了導遊的警告，離開了海灘。

ex.en: Governments must heed scientific advice when developing policies to protect communities from extreme weather.
ex.zh: 政府制定保護社區免受極端天氣影響的政策時，必須重視科學建議。

words.tip: 動詞直接接賓語；名詞常用於pay heed to。

tr: a. 令人毛骨悚然的, 感到恐懼的
def: s grossly offensive to decency or morality; causing horror
s causing fear or dread or terror

tr: vt. 比喻, 比擬
def: v consider or describe as similar, equal, or analogous

tr: a. 不充分的, 不足的
vt. 減少, 吝嗇, 限制, 藐視, 忽略
不足的；少得可憐的
def: v. limit in quality or quantity
barely enough, or less than is needed

ex.en: We had scant time to pack before the taxi arrived.
ex.zh: 出租車到達前，我們幾乎沒時間收拾行李。

ex.en: There is scant evidence that longer working hours consistently lead to higher productivity across different industries.
ex.zh: 幾乎沒有證據表明，延長工時能在不同行業中持續帶來更高的生產率。

col: scant regard for｜對……幾乎不重視
words.tip: 強調少到不夠，多用於名詞前，如scant evidence。

tr: n. 慘敗, 傾斜, 挫折, 舉步蹣跚, 徘徊
vi. 慘敗, 傾斜, 徘徊
vt. 擊敗
def: n. an unsteady uneven gait
n. a decisive defeat in a game (especially in cribbage)
n. abrupt up-and-down motion (as caused by a ship or other conveyance)

tr: n. 賭博, 冒險
v. 賭博, 孤注一擲
賭博；打賭
冒險；碰運氣
冒險之舉
def: n. money that is risked for possible monetary gain
n. a risky act or venture
v. take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome

ex.en: He refuses to gamble because he values his savings.
ex.zh: 他珍惜自己的積蓄，因此拒絕賭博。

ex.en: Relying entirely on tourism is a gamble for regions vulnerable to extreme weather and changing travel patterns.
ex.zh: 對容易受極端天氣和旅遊趨勢變化影響的地區而言，完全依賴旅遊業是一種冒險。

words.tip: gamble on後接所押注或冒險指望的事物。

tr: a. 強烈的, 寒冷而乾燥的, 活潑的
vt. 使活潑
vi. 活躍起來
輕快的；迅速有力的
生意興隆的；交易活躍的
def: v. become brisk
s. very active
Quick and energetic.

ex.en: A brisk walk before breakfast always wakes me up.
ex.zh: 早餐前快步走一走，總能讓我清醒起來。

ex.en: Regular brisk walking can improve cardiovascular health without requiring expensive equipment or access to specialist facilities.
ex.zh: 經常快步走能改善心血管健康，無需昂貴的器材或專業設施。

words.tip: brisk walk指輕快有力的快走，不是跑步。

tr: n. 刺激, 煩惱, 刺激物
[醫] 刺激[作用], 興奮
惱怒；煩躁
刺激；發炎不適
def: n. the psychological state of being irritated or annoyed
n. (pathology) abnormal sensitivity to stimulation
the feeling of being annoyed

ex.en: He sighed with irritation when the phone rang again.
ex.zh: 電話又響了，他煩躁地嘆了口氣。

ex.en: Exposure to household cleaning products may cause skin irritation, especially among people with sensitive skin.
ex.zh: 接觸家用清潔產品可能引起皮膚刺激，皮膚敏感者尤其如此。

col: a source of irritation｜令人惱火的事物
words.tip: 既可指情緒上的惱怒，也可指皮膚等受到刺激。

tr: vt. 安慰, 藉慰
n. 控制台
[計] 控制台
安慰；慰藉
控制台；遊戲機
def: n. a scientific instrument consisting of displays and an input device that an operator can use to monitor and control a system (especially a computer system)
n. an ornamental scroll-shaped bracket (especially one used to support a wall fixture)
To comfort someone who feels sad or disappointed.

ex.en: Lena tried to console her brother after his team lost.
ex.zh: 弟弟的球隊輸了比賽後，莉娜試著安慰他。

ex.en: Teachers should console disappointed students while helping them develop practical strategies for improving their academic performance.
ex.zh: 教師應安慰失落的學生，同時幫助他們制定切實可行的策略來提高學習成績。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後；名詞重音在前，英音/ˈkɒnsəʊl/。

tr: n. 昏迷, 麻木, 彗發
[化] 彗差; 彗形像差
def: n. a state of deep and often prolonged unconsciousness; usually the result of disease or injury
n. (botany) a usually terminal tuft of bracts (as in the pineapple) or tuft of hairs (especially on certain seeds)
n. (astronomy) the luminous cloud of particles surrounding the frozen nucleus of a comet; forms as the comet approaches the sun and is warmed

tr: n. 讚美詩, 聖歌
v. 唱讚美歌
def: n. a song of praise (to God or to a saint or to a nation)
v. sing a hymn
v. praise by singing a hymn

tr: a. 嚴肅的, 鄭重的, 莊嚴的
def: s dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises
s characterized by a firm and humorless belief in the validity of your opinions

tr: n. 舉, 拋, 起伏, 鼓起
vt. 用力舉起, 使舉起, 使鼓起
vi. 拋出, 起伏, 喘息, 凸起
def: n. an upward movement (especially a rhythmical rising and falling)
n. (geology) a horizontal dislocation
n. the act of lifting something with great effort

tr: vi. 同意, 一致, 同時發生
[法] 同時發生, 併發, 同意
同意；意見一致
def: v. happen simultaneously
to agree with someone or share the same opinion

ex.en: I concur with your suggestion to leave before lunch.
ex.zh: 我同意你午飯前出發的建議。

ex.en: Most researchers concur that investment in early childhood education brings substantial benefits to society.
ex.zh: 大多數研究人員一致認為，投資幼兒教育能為社會帶來顯著益處。

col: concur in a decision｜贊同一項決定
words.tip: 正式用詞，常用concur with某人或concur that從句。

tr: n. 忽視, 漠視
vt. 忽視, 不顧
無視；不理會
漠視；不顧
def: n. lack of attention and due care
n. willful lack of care and attention
To ignore something or treat it as unimportant.

ex.en: Please disregard my earlier message; the picnic is still happening.
ex.zh: 請忽略我之前的消息，野餐仍會照常舉行。

ex.en: Companies that disregard environmental regulations may reduce short-term costs but create lasting damage to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 無視環保法規的企業可能降低短期成本，卻會對當地生態系統造成持久損害。

col: complete disregard for｜對……的完全漠視
disregard for safety｜對安全的漠視
words.tip: 動詞直接接賓語；名詞常用disregard for。

tr: n. 釉, 上光, 光滑面
vt. 裝以玻璃, 上釉於
vi. 變得光滑, (目光)變呆滯
def: n. any of various thin shiny (savory or sweet) coatings applied to foods
n. a glossy finish on a fabric
n. a coating for ceramics, metal, etc.

tr: a. 迫切的, 嚴厲的, 銀根緊的
[醫] 約束的, 緊迫的
def: s demanding strict attention to rules and procedures

tr: a. 暴露的, 顯露的, 揭露的
def: s. disclosing unintentionally
a. showing or making known

tr: n. 剝奪, 剝奪官職, 免職
[醫] 喪失, 剝奪, 缺乏
def: n a state of extreme poverty
n the disadvantage that results from losing something
n act of depriving someone of food or money or rights

tr: n. 怒火, 發火, 燃燒, 發炎
[醫] 炎[症]
def: n. a response of body tissues to injury or irritation; characterized by pain and swelling and redness and heat
n. arousal to violent emotion

tr: n. 石灰石
[化] 石灰石; 石灰岩
石灰岩
def: n. a sedimentary rock consisting mainly of calcium that was deposited by the remains of marine animals
A rock mainly composed of calcium carbonate, often from marine remains.

ex.en: The old cottage was built from pale local limestone.
ex.zh: 這座舊鄉間小屋是用當地淺色的石灰岩建成的。

ex.en: Limestone formations attract tourists, but heavy visitor traffic can damage delicate cave environments over time.
ex.zh: 石灰岩地貌吸引遊客，但大量遊客往來可能逐漸破壞脆弱的洞穴環境。

words.tip: limestone通常不可數；lime還可指石灰或青檸。

tr: a. 擴張性的, 使擴大的, 廣闊的
[化] 膨脹的; 可以膨脹的
def: a. able or tending to expand or characterized by expansion
s. of behavior that is impressive and ambitious in scale or scope
s. marked by exaggerated feelings of euphoria and delusions of grandeur

tr: vt. 登記, 銘記於, 題寫, 雕刻
[電] 書寫
題寫；刻寫
def: v. draw within a figure so as to touch in as many places as possible
v. write, engrave, or print as a lasting record
v. address, (a work of literature) in a style less formal than a dedication

ex.zh: 我們的鄰居精通雙語，英語和中文都說得很流利。

ex.en: Bilingual education can help children maintain their cultural identity while developing skills for an increasingly connected world.
ex.zh: 雙語教育有助於孩子保持文化認同，同時培養適應日益互聯世界所需的技能。

words.tip: 表示精通哪兩種語言，可用bilingual in A and B。

tr: v. (巧妙地)逃脫, 規避, 逃避
def: v. practice evasion
v. use cunning or deceit to escape or avoid

tr: a. 神智健全的, 穩健的, 沒病的, 合理的
[醫] 精神健全的
理智的；明智的
心智健全的
def: a. mentally healthy; free from mental disorder
Showing reasonable judgment rather than extreme or foolish thinking.
Able to think clearly and understand reality.

ex.en: Taking a short break seemed like the only sane choice.
ex.zh: 稍微休息一下似乎是唯一明智的選擇。

ex.en: A sane approach to urban planning balances economic growth with residents' need for green spaces.
ex.zh: 明智的城市規劃方式會兼顧經濟增長與居民對綠地的需求。

col: a sane approach｜明智的處理方式
keep someone sane｜使某人保持理智
words.tip: 表示明智時近於sensible；並非所有心理疾病都影響理智。

tr: n. 君主政體, 君主國, 君主政治
[法] 君主政體, 君主制度, 君主國
def: n. an autocracy governed by a monarch who usually inherits the authority

tr: n. 新陳代謝, 變態
[化] 新陳代謝; 代謝
def: n. the organic processes (in a cell or organism) that are necessary for life

tr: a. 昏暗的, 陰天的, 嚴峻的, 憂鬱的
def: s. grave or even gloomy in character

tr: vt. 捲入, 吸進, 吞沒, 使全神貫注
吞沒；完全籠罩
使陷入；壓倒
def: v. flow over or cover completely
to surround or cover something completely
to overwhelm someone or something with a powerful situation

ex.en: A sudden wave engulfed our sandcastle on the beach.
ex.zh: 一個突如其來的浪頭吞沒了我們在沙灘上堆的沙堡。

ex.en: Rising sea levels could engulf low-lying coastal settlements unless governments invest in effective flood protection.
ex.zh: 除非政府投資建設有效的防洪設施，否則海平面上升可能淹沒地勢低窪的沿海居民區。

col: be engulfed in flames｜被火焰吞沒
be engulfed by floodwater｜被洪水淹沒
a crisis engulfs a country｜危機席捲一個國家
words.tip: 常用被動結構be engulfed in/by，強調完全覆蓋。

tr: vt. 使移動, 攪亂, 使動搖, 使不安寧
vi. 動盪不定, 離開固定位置
def: v disturb the composure of

tr: n. 抑制, 牽制, 遏制
[法] 抑制, 牽制, 遏制
def: n. a policy of creating strategic alliances in order to check the expansion of a hostile power or ideology or to force it to negotiate peacefully
n. (physics) a system designed to prevent the accidental release of radioactive material from a reactor
n. the act of containing; keeping something from spreading

tr: vt. 放大, 擴大, 讚美, 誇大
vi. 有放大能力
放大
誇大；加劇
def: v. increase in size, volume or significance
To make something appear larger, especially through a lens.
To make something seem more important or become more serious.

ex.en: This lens magnifies tiny insects so we can examine them.
ex.zh: 這個鏡頭能放大小昆蟲，方便我們觀察。

ex.en: Social media can magnify public concerns by repeatedly exposing users to dramatic accounts of rare events.
ex.zh: 社交媒體反覆向用戶展示對罕見事件的誇張描述，可能放大公眾的擔憂。

words.tip: 既可指視覺放大，也可指誇大問題或加劇影響。

tr: n. 不當治療, 不端行為, 瀆職
[醫] 療法失當, 醫療差錯
職業失當；瀆職
def: n. professional wrongdoing that results in injury or damage
n. a wrongful act that the actor had no right to do; improper professional conduct
careless, improper, or illegal professional conduct, especially in medicine

ex.en: The family consulted a lawyer about possible medical malpractice.
ex.zh: 這家人就可能存在的醫療失當諮詢了律師。

ex.en: Independent oversight can help prevent malpractice in healthcare and strengthen public confidence in medical institutions.
ex.zh: 獨立監督有助於防止醫療行業的職業失當，並增強公眾對醫療機構的信任。

words.tip: 多指專業人員失職，尤用於醫療，並非普通錯誤。

tr: a. 不吉利的, 兇惡的, 左邊的
[醫] 左的
def: s. on or starting from the wearer's left

tr: n. 聽眾席, 禮堂
[醫] 大講堂, 大會堂
禮堂；會堂
觀眾席
def: n. the area of a theater or concert hall where the audience sits
a large room or building for an audience
the part of a theatre where the audience sits

ex.en: Families filled the auditorium for the school concert.
ex.zh: 家長們坐滿了禮堂，觀看學校音樂會。

ex.en: A modern auditorium allows the university to host public lectures and strengthen links with the local community.
ex.zh: 現代化的禮堂讓大學能夠舉辦公開講座，並加強與當地社區的聯繫。

words.tip: 可指整座禮堂，也可專指劇院的觀眾席。

tr: a. 顯微鏡的, 用顯微鏡可見的, 微觀的, (非正式)極微小的, 細微的
[計] 微觀的
def: a. of or relating to or used in microscopy
s. visible under a microscope; using a microscope
s. extremely precise with great attention to details

tr: n. 轎車
def: n. large luxurious car; usually driven by a chauffeur

tr: vt. 轉移, 使偏斜
vi. 偏斜
def: v. turn from a straight course, fixed direction, or line of interest
v. turn aside and away from an initial or intended course

tr: n. 蔑視, 挑戰
[法] 挑戰, 藐視, 違抗
def: n. intentionally contemptuous behavior or attitude
n. a hostile challenge
n. a defiant act

tr: n. 修剪, 剪下的東西, 大剪刀, 切變, 剪切機, 切
vt. 修剪, 割, 剝奪, 橫越, 削剪
vi. 剪, 修剪, 剪羊毛, 切斷
def: n. (physics) a deformation of an object in which parallel planes remain parallel but are shifted in a direction parallel to themselves
n. a large edge tool that cuts sheet metal by passing a blade through it
v. cut with shears

tr: vt. 增強, 放大, 擴大, 詳述
vi. 引伸
放大聲音或信號
增強；擴大影響
詳述；補充說明
def: v. increase the volume of
to make a sound or electrical signal stronger
to increase the strength or effect of something

ex.en: This small speaker amplifies music from my phone.
ex.zh: 這個小音箱把我手機播放的音樂放大了。

ex.en: Social media can amplify public concerns about pollution, encouraging local authorities to respond more quickly.
ex.zh: 社交媒體能夠放大公眾對汙染的擔憂，促使地方政府更迅速地回應。

words.tip: 既可放大實際聲音，也可增強影響或情緒。

tr: a. 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高級的, 玄虛的
崇高的；雄心勃勃的
高聳的
高傲的；傲慢的
def: s of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
s of imposing height; especially standing out above others
s having or displaying great dignity or nobility

ex.en: She has lofty ambitions but works hard every day.
ex.zh: 她志向遠大，同時每天都在努力。

ex.en: Governments often announce lofty goals for reducing inequality, but meaningful progress requires sustained investment and practical policies.
ex.zh: 政府常常宣佈減少不平等的宏大目標，但實質性進展需要持續投入和切實可行的政策。

words.tip: 修飾理想時可表讚許，也可暗示目標過高、不切實際。

tr: n. 門廳, 入門大堂
def: n a large entrance or reception room or area

tr: n. 臭氣, 煙, 激怒
vt. 燻
vi. 冒煙
十分惱怒；生悶氣
有害或刺鼻的煙氣
def: v. be mad, angry, or furious
v. emit a cloud of fine particles
To feel or express strong anger.

ex.en: He fumed when muddy shoes stained his clean carpet.
ex.zh: 泥鞋弄髒了他乾淨的地毯，他氣壞了。

ex.en: Exposure to exhaust fumes can worsen respiratory conditions, particularly among children living near busy roads.
ex.zh: 接觸汽車尾氣可能加重呼吸系統疾病，尤其會影響住在繁忙道路附近的兒童。

col: fume over something｜為某事大發脾氣
words.tip: 表示煙氣通常用複數fumes；動詞常指十分惱怒。

tr: a. 質量差的, 貧乏的, 不毛的, 瘦的
def: a. deficient in amount or quality or extent

tr: n. 正當理由, 授權, 擔保, 保證, 根據
[經] 保單, 擔保書, 保證書
保修承諾；保修單
def: n a written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications
A written promise to repair or replace faulty goods within conditions.

ex.en: The shop repaired my camera because it was under warranty.
ex.zh: 因為相機還在保修期內，商店為我修好了它。

ex.en: A longer warranty may encourage consumers to choose durable appliances rather than cheaper products that require frequent replacement.
ex.zh: 更長的保修期可能促使消費者選擇耐用電器，而不是需要頻繁更換的廉價產品。

col: a manufacturer's warranty｜製造商保修承諾
words.tip: 在保修期內用under warranty，不用in warranty。

tr: n. 凹痕
vt. 使凹下, 削弱
vi. 塌陷
凹痕；凹坑
使凹陷；凹陷
def: n. an appreciable consequence (especially a lessening)
n. an impression in a surface (as made by a blow)
A hollow in a surface caused by pressure or impact

ex.en: My bike has a dent in its metal basket.
ex.zh: 我的自行車金屬車籃上有一處凹痕。

ex.en: Repeated delays in public transport can dent passengers' confidence and encourage greater reliance on private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通反覆延誤會削弱乘客的信心，使人們更加依賴私家車。

col: dent someone's confidence｜打擊某人的信心
make a dent in｜削減；取得初步進展
words.tip: dent不是“牙齒”；make a dent in可指削減或取得進展。

tr: n. 花粉
vt. 傳授花粉給
def: n. the fine spores that contain male gametes and that are borne by an anther in a flowering plant

tr: n. 地球上的人
a. 地球的, 陸生的, 陸地的, 人間的
陸生的；陸地的
地球的
地面廣播的
def: a. operating or living or growing on land
living on or relating to land rather than water
relating to Earth rather than other planets

ex.en: Unlike fish, terrestrial animals spend their lives on land.
ex.zh: 與魚類不同，陸生動物在陸地上生活。

ex.en: Protecting terrestrial habitats is essential because many species cannot survive outside their original ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保護陸地棲息地至關重要，因為許多物種離開原有生態系統就無法生存。

words.tip: 陸生義與aquatic（水生的）相對。

tr: vt. 瀰漫, 滲透, 充滿, 影響, 感染
vi. 透入, 散佈
瀰漫；遍佈
滲入；滲透
def: v. spread or diffuse through
Spread throughout a place, group, or situation.
Pass into or through the tiny spaces in a material.

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread permeated the entire house.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味瀰漫了整棟房子。

ex.en: Digital technology now permeates almost every aspect of education, changing how students access information and collaborate with others.
ex.zh: 數字技術如今滲透到教育的幾乎各個方面，改變了學生獲取信息和與他人合作的方式。

col: permeate every aspect of｜滲透……的各個方面
words.tip: 可直接接賓語；氣味瀰漫房間無需加介詞。

tr: a. 海的, 海上的, 海事的, 沿海的, 海員的
[經] 海事的, 海上的, 海員的
def: s. bordering on or living or characteristic of those near the sea

tr: n. 槍眼, 小窗, 換氣孔
def: n. an ambiguity (especially one in the text of a law or contract) that makes it possible to evade a difficulty or obligation
n. a small hole in a fortified wall; for observation or discharging weapons

tr: vt. 使認識, 介紹
使瞭解；使熟悉
def: v. inform
Give someone knowledge of or familiarity with something.

ex.en: Please acquaint yourself with the kitchen before you start cooking.
ex.zh: 開始做飯前，請先熟悉一下廚房。

ex.en: Universities should acquaint new students with available support services to help them adjust to campus life.
ex.zh: 大學應讓新生了解可用的支持服務，幫助他們適應校園生活。

words.tip: 較正式，常用acquaint sb/oneself with sth。

tr: vt. 使苦惱, 折磨
使受折磨；困擾
def: v. cause great unhappiness for; distress
v. cause physical pain or suffering in
Cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty

ex.en: Seasonal allergies afflict my brother whenever the flowers bloom.
ex.zh: 每到鮮花盛開時，季節性過敏就讓我的哥哥備受困擾。

ex.en: Water shortages continue to afflict rural communities, limiting agricultural production and increasing the burden on local families.
ex.zh: 缺水問題持續困擾農村社區，限制農業生產，並加重當地家庭的負擔。

words.tip: 常用被動be afflicted with，後接疾病或困境。

tr: n. 黃褐色, 鞣料, 馬戲團
a. 黃褐色的, 鞣皮的
vi. 曬成棕褐色
vt. 把...曬黑, 鞣(革), 狠狠鞭打
曬成的棕褐膚色
def: n. a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun
n. a light brown the color of topaz
v. treat skins and hides with tannic acid so as to convert them into leather

ex.en: His summer tan had faded by the middle of winter.
ex.zh: 到了隆冬，他夏天曬出的棕褐膚色已經褪去。

ex.en: Although a tan is sometimes considered attractive, prolonged exposure to sunlight increases the risk of skin damage.
ex.zh: 雖然曬成棕褐色有時被認為很有吸引力，但長時間日曬會增加皮膚受損的風險。

words.tip: tan不只指曬黑；作形容詞也可描述鞋包的淺褐色。

tr: n. 民意調查人, 民意測驗經辦人
def: n. someone who conducts surveys of public opinion

tr: v. 瀏覽, 吃草
n. 瀏覽, 吃草
[計] 瀏覽
def: n. vegetation (such as young shoots, twigs, and leaves) that is suitable for animals to eat
n. reading superficially or at random
n. the act of feeding by continual nibbling

tr: vt. 積聚, 堆積
def: v collect or gather
v get or gather together

tr: n. 越過, 橫貫, 橫斷物, 屏障, 否認, 反駁
vt. 橫過, 穿過, 經過, 詳細研究, 反對, 在...來回移動
vi. 橫越, 橫斷, 旋轉, 來回移動
a. 橫亙的, 橫貫的
橫越；穿過
def: v. travel across or pass over
v. deny formally (an allegation of fact by the opposing party) in a legal suit
To travel across or through an area.

ex.en: We traversed the snowy valley before reaching the mountain hut.
ex.zh: 我們穿過積雪覆蓋的山谷，才到達山間小屋。

ex.en: New railway routes traverse remote regions, connecting isolated communities with essential services and larger markets.
ex.zh: 新鐵路線路穿越偏遠地區，讓孤立的社區能夠獲得基本服務並進入更大的市場。

col: traverse rough terrain｜穿越崎嶇地形
words.tip: 正式用詞，直接接地點賓語：traverse the desert。

tr: n. 蔑視
vt. 蔑視, 鄙棄
def: n lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
n a communication that indicates lack of respect by patronizing the recipient
v look down on with disdain

tr: v. 理解, 領悟
n. 理解能力, 機智, 悟性
def: n the cognitive condition of someone who understands
v get the meaning of something

tr: n. 先驅者, 前導, 前兆
[化] 前體; 前身; 產物母體
def: n. a substance from which another substance is formed (especially by a metabolic reaction)
n. a person who goes before or announces the coming of another

tr: a. 辛酸的, 尖銳的, 劇烈的
def: s. keenly distressing to the mind or feelings

tr: vi. 振動, 顫動, 激動, 搖擺, 躊躇
vt. 使顫動, 使振動, 使擺動
振動；使振動
def: v. shake, quiver, or throb; move back and forth rapidly, usually in an uncontrolled manner
To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.

ex.en: My phone vibrated against the keys in my pocket.
ex.zh: 手機在口袋裡振動，碰得鑰匙直響。

ex.en: Heavy traffic can cause nearby buildings to vibrate, affecting residents' comfort and potentially damaging older structures.
ex.zh: 繁忙的交通會使附近建築物振動，影響居民的舒適度，並可能損壞老舊建築。

words.tip: 指快速、小幅度振動，不等於大幅搖擺。

tr: a. 法令的, 法定的, 可依法懲處的
[經] 法定的
def: a. relating to or created by statutes
s. prescribed or authorized by or punishable under a statute

tr: a. 有限的, 有窮的, 限定的
n. 有限物
有限的
限定的（動詞形式）
def: a. bounded or limited in magnitude or spatial or temporal extent
a. of verbs; relating to forms of the verb that are limited in time by a tense and (usually) show agreement with number and person
Having a limit in size, amount, or duration

ex.en: Our holiday budget is finite, so choose carefully.
ex.zh: 我們的度假預算有限，所以要仔細選擇。

ex.en: Governments must recognise that natural resources are finite and encourage industries to reduce unnecessary consumption.
ex.zh: 政府必須認識到自然資源是有限的，並鼓勵各行業減少不必要的消耗。

words.tip: 讀音重音在首音節；勿按finish的元音讀。

tr: vt. 給予, 傳授, 告知
傳授；告知
賦予；增添
def: v. transmit (knowledge or skills)
v. transmit or serve as the medium for transmission
To communicate knowledge, information, or skills to someone

ex.en: My grandmother loves to impart her gardening knowledge.
ex.zh: 我奶奶很喜歡傳授她的園藝知識。

ex.en: Schools should impart practical skills that enable young people to manage their finances independently.
ex.zh: 學校應傳授實用技能，使年輕人能夠獨立管理個人財務。

words.tip: 常用impart sth to sb，意為把某事傳授給某人。

tr: a. 意見不同的, 持不同政見的
n. 意見不同的人, 持不同政見者
def: s. characterized by departure from accepted beliefs or standards

tr: n. 折衷主義者
a. 選擇的, 折衷的
def: n. someone who selects according to the eclectic method
s. selecting what seems best of various styles or ideas

tr: a. 狡猾的, 詭密的, 俏皮的, 偷偷摸摸的
狡猾的；詭秘的
會意的；暗自得意的
def: s marked by skill in deception
Secretive and clever, often to gain an unfair advantage.
Showing secret amusement or knowledge.

ex.en: The sly cat stole a biscuit while I turned away.
ex.zh: 我一轉身，那隻狡猾的貓就偷走了一塊餅乾。

ex.en: Sly attempts to hide additional charges can damage consumer trust and harm a company's reputation.
ex.zh: 偷偷隱瞞額外費用的做法會損害消費者的信任，並傷及公司的聲譽。

words.tip: on the sly是固定短語，意為偷偷地。

tr: vt. 驅逐, 使降低地位, 把...歸類, 把...委託給
[法] 流放, 判流放刑, 驅逐
def: v. refer to another person for decision or judgment
v. assign to a class or kind

tr: vi. 陰謀, 協力, 共謀
vt. 圖謀
def: v. engage in plotting or enter into a conspiracy, swear together
v. act in unison or agreement and in secret towards a deceitful or illegal purpose

tr: n. 學者, 梵文學者, 博學的印度人, 權威
def: n someone who has been admitted to membership in a scholarly field

tr: vt. 逐出, 罷黜, 剝奪, 驅逐
[法] 驅逐, 剝奪, 免職
罷黜；趕下臺；驅逐
def: v. remove from a position or office
v. remove and replace
To force someone out of a position or place.

ex.en: Club members voted to oust their unpopular chair.
ex.zh: 俱樂部成員投票罷免了不受歡迎的主席。

ex.en: Shareholders may seek to oust company directors who repeatedly fail to meet environmental commitments or financial targets.
ex.zh: 股東可能尋求罷免那些屢次未能履行環保承諾或實現財務目標的公司董事。

col: oust someone from office｜將某人趕下臺
be ousted as chair｜被罷免主席職務
words.tip: 常用oust someone from office，強調被迫離職。

tr: vt. 誘騙, 引誘, 慫恿
def: v. provoke someone to do something through (often false or exaggerated) promises or persuasion

tr: a. 思索性的, 投機的, 推測的
[經] 投機的, 冒險的
def: s not financially safe or secure
s not based on fact or investigation
s showing curiosity

tr: n. 分割, 隔離物, 隔牆, 財產分割
vt. 區分, 瓜分, 隔開, 分割
[計] 分區; 劃分
隔牆；隔板
分割；分治
def: n. a vertical structure that divides or separates (as a wall divides one room from another)
n. (computer science) the part of a hard disk that is dedicated to a particular operating system or application and accessed as a single unit
n. (anatomy) a structure that separates areas in an organism

ex.en: A wooden partition separates our kitchen from the dining area.
ex.zh: 一道木隔板將我們的廚房與用餐區隔開。

ex.en: Movable partitions allow schools to adapt classroom spaces for group discussions, independent study, and larger community events.
ex.zh: 可移動隔牆讓學校能夠調整教室空間，以滿足小組討論、自主學習和較大型社區活動的需要。

col: the partition of a country｜國家的分治
words.tip: partition off指隔出空間，如隔出一間辦公室。

tr: vt. 毀壞, 破壞, 粉碎

徹底駁倒

v. defeat soundly
To completely destroy a building or other structure.

ex.en: Workers demolished the old garage behind our house.
ex.zh: 工人拆除了我們房子後面的舊車庫。

ex.en: Cities should consider restoring historic buildings rather than demolishing them to make space for new developments.
ex.zh: 城市應考慮修復歷史建築，而不是將其拆除以騰出空間進行新開發。

col: demolish an argument｜徹底駁倒論點
words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接賓語；也可指徹底駁倒論點。

tr: n. 髓, 骨髓, 精華, 活力, 配偶
[醫] 髓(尤指骨髓)
def: n. the fatty network of connective tissue that fills the cavities of bones
n. any of various squash plants grown for their elongated fruit with smooth dark green skin and whitish flesh
n. very tender and very nutritious tissue from marrowbones

tr: n. 一針, 疼痛, 針法, 碎布條, 針腳
v. 縫, 縫合, 裝訂
一針；針腳；縫線
縫；縫合
運動時肋部的岔氣痛
def: n. a link or loop or knot made by an implement in knitting, crocheting, embroidery, or sewing
n. a sharp spasm of pain in the side resulting from running
a loop of thread holding fabric or a wound together

ex.en: A few neat stitches fixed the hole in my sleeve.
ex.zh: 整齊地縫上幾針，我袖子上的破洞就補好了。

ex.en: Teaching students to stitch torn clothing could reduce textile waste and encourage more sustainable consumption habits.
ex.zh: 教學生縫補破損衣物可以減少紡織品浪費，並鼓勵更可持續的消費習慣。

words.tip: get a stitch指運動時岔氣，不是“縫一針”。

tr: n. 超新星
def: n. a star that explodes and becomes extremely luminous in the process

表示；指代
def: v. be a sign or indication of
v. have as a meaning
To represent or indicate something.

ex.en: On this map, blue lines denote rivers and streams.
ex.zh: 在這張地圖上，藍色線條表示河流和溪流。

ex.en: In scientific diagrams, different colours often denote distinct materials, allowing readers to interpret complex structures more easily.
ex.zh: 在科學示意圖中，不同顏色通常代表不同材料，便於讀者理解複雜結構。

col: denote a category｜表示一個類別
words.tip: 常用於符號、顏色或詞語表示某種含義。

tr: a. 全無的, 缺乏的
def: s completely wanting or lacking

tr: n. 授權, 許可
[經] 授權, 許可, 批准
def: n. the act of conferring legality or sanction or formal warrant

tr: a. 各種各樣的, 分類的
def: s. consisting of a haphazard assortment of different kinds
s. of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity

tr: vt. 使悲傷
vi. 悲痛, 傷心
悲痛；哀悼
使悲傷
def: v. feel grief
v. cause to feel sorrow
To feel deep sadness, especially after someone's death

ex.en: We still grieve for our cat, who died last spring.
ex.zh: 我們仍在為去年春天去世的貓難過。

ex.en: Employers should offer compassionate leave so that workers have time to grieve after losing a family member.
ex.zh: 僱主應提供喪假，讓員工在失去家人後有時間哀悼。

col: grieve over a loss｜為失去而悲傷
words.tip: grieve for常接逝者；grieve over常接損失或不幸。

tr: a. 能接納的
[醫] 接受的, 感受的
def: s. open to arguments, ideas, or change
a. ready or willing to receive favorably
s. able to absorb liquid (not repellent)

tr: n. 神學院, 發源地
def: n. a private place of education for the young
n. a theological school for training ministers or priests or rabbis

tr: n. 馬具, 挽具狀帶子, 甲冑
vt. 給...上挽具, 駕馭, 披上甲冑, 利用...以產生動力
def: n. a support consisting of an arrangement of straps for holding something to the body (especially one supporting a person suspended from a parachute)
n. stable gear consisting of an arrangement of leather straps fitted to a draft animal so that it can be attached to and pull a cart
v. put a harness

tr: n. 強迫, 威壓, 高壓統治

v. 下毛毛雨

v. rain lightly
v. moisten with fine drops

消散；使消散
揮霍；浪費

To gradually disappear or cause something to spread and disappear.
To waste money, energy, or resources through careless use.

ex.en: The morning mist began to dissipate as sunlight warmed the valley.
ex.zh: 陽光溫暖了山谷，晨霧開始消散。

ex.en: Urban green spaces help dissipate heat, reducing the discomfort caused by high temperatures in densely populated areas.
ex.zh: 城市綠地有助於散熱，減輕人口密集地區高溫帶來的不適。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物：霧自行消散或風使霧消散。

tr: vt. 宣傳
def: v. make public

tr: a. 無能力的, 無資格的, 機能不全的, 不勝任的
n. 無能力者
def: n. someone who is not competent to take effective action
a. legally not qualified or sufficient
a. not qualified or suited for a purpose

tr: n. 結局, 最後樂章, 終曲
def: n. the closing section of a musical composition
n. the concluding part of any performance

tr: n. 脹, 膨脹
vi. 凸出
vt. 使膨脹
def: n. something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings
v. swell or protrude outwards
v. bulge out; form a bulge outward, or be so full as to appear to bulge

tr: n. 採石場, 方形石, 獵物, 被追求物, 來源

採石場
開採石料

A large open pit where stone is dug from the ground.
To dig stone out of the ground.

ex.en: Huge trucks carried pale stone out of the quarry.
ex.zh: 巨型卡車把淺色石料運出了採石場。

ex.en: Restoring an abandoned quarry can create valuable wildlife habitats while reducing risks to nearby communities.
ex.zh: 修復廢棄採石場可以創造寶貴的野生動物棲息地，同時降低周邊社區面臨的風險。

words.tip: 採石場義可數；獵物義常用單數形式。

[經] 缺乏, 不足
def: n. a small and inadequate amount

tr: n. 現場, 場所
[計] 場所
def: n the scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)

tr: a. 狂暴的, 騷亂的, 紊亂的
動盪的；混亂的
湍急的；氣流紊亂的
def: s characterized by unrest or disorder or insubordination
s (of a liquid) agitated vigorously; in a state of turbulence
Full of conflict, uncertainty, or sudden disruptive changes.

ex.en: After a turbulent week, our family needed a quiet evening.
ex.zh: 經歷了動盪的一週後，我們一家需要一個安靜的夜晚。

ex.en: During turbulent economic periods, governments may increase public spending to protect jobs and support vulnerable households.
ex.zh: 在經濟動盪時期，政府可能增加公共支出，以保障就業並支持脆弱家庭。

words.tip: 既形容社會局勢動盪，也形容水流或氣流紊亂。

tr: n. 肥料, 糞肥
vt. 施肥於
糞肥
給土地施糞肥
def: n. any animal or plant material used to fertilize land especially animal excreta usually with litter material
v. spread manure, as for fertilization
Animal waste used to improve soil and help plants grow.

ex.en: The farmer spread manure around the young apple trees.
ex.zh: 農民在幼小的蘋果樹周圍撒上糞肥。

ex.en: Using manure can improve soil fertility, but excessive application may pollute nearby rivers and groundwater.
ex.zh: 施用糞肥可以提高土壤肥力，但過量施用可能汙染附近河流和地下水。

words.tip: 名詞通常不可數；fertilizer泛指肥料，範圍更廣。

tr: n. 信條, 教義, 宗旨, 原則

tr: vt. 使惡化, 使更嚴重, 加重
def: v make worse
v exasperate or irritate

tr: n. 瘋狂, 愚頑, 精神錯亂
[醫] 精神病
def: n. relatively permanent disorder of the mind

tr: n. 鄉下人, 鄉巴佬
a. 鄉村的, 純樸的, 手工粗糙的
def: n. an unsophisticated country person

tr: n. 斗篷, 罩子, 披風
vt. 罩住, 覆蓋
vi. 覆蓋, 臉紅

地幔
def: n. the cloak as a symbol of authority
n. United States baseball player (1931-1997)
n. the layer of the earth between the crust and the core

ex.en: A mantle of snow covered the garden overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之間，花園披上了一層白雪。

ex.en: Younger researchers must take on the mantle of leadership as experienced scientists retire from their positions.
ex.zh: 隨著資深科學家退休，年輕研究人員必須承擔起領導職責。

col: a mantle of snow｜一層積雪
assume the mantle of｜承擔……的職責
words.tip: mantle也可指披風；壁爐架通常拼作mantel。

def: n something hard to endure
n the quality of being valid and rigorous
n excessive sternness

tr: n. 流出, 漲潮, 變遷
vi. 熔化, 流出
vt. 使熔融
[計] 助焊劑
def: n. the rate of flow of energy or particles across a given surface
n. a flow or discharge
n. a substance added to molten metals to bond with impurities that can then be readily removed

tr: n. 疑問, 疑問號, 質問, 查詢
v. 詢問, 質問
[計] 查詢
詢問；疑問
詢問；對……提出質疑
def: n an instance of questioning
v pose a question
A question or request for information

ex.en: The receptionist answered my query about the swimming pool.
ex.zh: 接待員回答了我關於游泳池的詢問。

ex.en: Consumers should query unexpected charges on their bills rather than assume that automated payment systems are always accurate.
ex.zh: 消費者應對賬單上的意外收費提出疑問，而不是認為自動支付系統總是準確的。

col: query a charge｜質疑一筆收費
words.tip: query作動詞可直接接所質疑的費用或決定。

tr: a. 抑沉的, 憂悶的, 黑暗的, 悲觀的
def: s. filled with melancholy and despondency

tr: a. 可任意處理的
[法] 可任意處理或處置的, 可自由使用的
一次性的；用後丟棄的
稅後可支配的
def: n. an item that can be disposed of after it has been used
a. free or available for use or disposition
a. designed to be disposed of after use

ex.en: We packed disposable plates for the picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 我們為湖邊野餐帶上了一次性盤子。

ex.en: Reducing the use of disposable packaging could significantly decrease the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 減少使用一次性包裝可以顯著減少送往垃圾填埋場的廢棄物量。

words.tip: disposable income指稅後收入，不是扣除生活費後的餘額。

tr: n. 投石器, 拋擲, 吊索, 吊鉤
vt. 用投石器投擲, 用吊鉤吊上, 吊起
def: n. a highball with liquor and water with sugar and lemon or lime juice

n. bandage to support an injured forearm; consisting of a wide triangular piece of cloth hanging from around the neck

獨立的；分離的
def: s. constituting a separate entity or part
Separate and distinct rather than joined or continuous.

ex.en: We divided the project into three discrete tasks.
ex.zh: 我們把這個項目分成了三項獨立的任務。

ex.en: Researchers classified participants into discrete groups to compare the effects of different teaching methods.
ex.zh: 研究人員將參與者分成不同的組，以比較不同教學方法的效果。

words.tip: 勿混 discreet（謹慎的）；兩詞讀音相同。

v. 潦草地書寫, 亂寫, 濫寫
def: n. poor handwriting
n. an aimless drawing
v. write down quickly without much attention to detail

[化] 機殼; 外殼
圍場；圍起來的區域
信函附件
圍住；圈地
def: n. a structure consisting of an area that has been enclosed for some purpose
n. the act of enclosing something inside something else
n. a naturally enclosed space

ex.en: The goats rested in their enclosure beside the barn.
ex.zh: 山羊在穀倉旁的圍欄裡休息。

ex.en: Wildlife parks should provide each enclosure with enough space for animals to display natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 野生動物園應為每個圍場提供足夠空間，讓動物展現自然行為。

words.tip: 紙質信函附件可用enclosure；郵件附件用attachment。

猥褻；性騷擾
騷擾；侵擾
def: v. harass or assault sexually; make indecent advances to
To subject someone to unwanted sexual touching or behaviour.
To bother or attack someone, especially in older usage.

ex.en: The club bans anyone who tries to molest guests.
ex.zh: 這傢俱樂部禁止任何企圖猥褻賓客的人進入。

ex.en: Public transport authorities should provide clear reporting procedures for passengers targeted by individuals who molest others.
ex.zh: 公共交通管理部門應為遭到猥褻的乘客提供明確的舉報流程。

words.tip: 現代英語多指性猥褻，勿用於普通的打擾。

tr: n. 裁判員, 仲裁人
vt. 對...進行仲裁, 當...的裁判
vi. 當裁判
def: n. an official at a baseball game

s. (usually followed by `of') pointing out or revealing clearly
Showing that something exists or is likely to be true.

ex.en: These dark clouds are indicative of an approaching storm.
ex.zh: 這些烏雲預示著暴風雨即將到來。

ex.en: Rising demand for public transport may be indicative of changing attitudes towards car ownership in urban areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通需求的上升可能表明，城市居民對擁有私家車的態度正在改變。

words.tip: 常用be indicative of，表示“是……的跡象”。

tr: a. 功能失調的
def: s. impaired in function; especially of a bodily system or organ
s. (of a trait or condition) failing to serve an adjustive purpose

tr: n. 環礁湖, 近海岸的淺水區, 瀉湖, 鹹水湖

tr: n. 矛盾情緒

def: n. mixed feelings or emotions

tr: n. 大風雪, 暴風雪
暴風雪
def: n. a storm with widespread snowfall accompanied by strong winds
A severe snowstorm with strong winds.

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the blizzard shook our windows.
ex.zh: 暴風雪吹得窗戶直響，我們一直待在屋裡。

ex.en: A severe blizzard can disrupt public transport and leave rural communities without electricity for several days.
ex.zh: 嚴重的暴風雪可能擾亂公共交通，並使農村社區連續數天斷電。

col: a severe blizzard｜猛烈的暴風雪
words.tip: 比普通snowstorm更強調強風和惡劣天氣。

def: n. intense anger (usually on an epic scale)
n. belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong (personified as one of the deadly sins)

tr: a. 相關的, 中肯的, 切題的

相關的；切題的
def: s. having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand
directly related to the matter being discussed

ex.en: Lena asked a pertinent question about the repair costs.
ex.zh: 莉娜問了一個關於維修費用的切題問題。

ex.en: Evidence about local air quality is particularly pertinent to discussions of expanding public transport networks.
ex.zh: 有關當地空氣質量的證據與擴大公共交通網絡的討論尤其相關。

words.tip: 常用pertinent to表示與某事相關，語體較正式。

tr: vi. 畏縮, 退縮, 畏首畏尾

def: v. draw back, as with fear or pain

tr: n. 講道壇
def: n a platform raised above the surrounding level to give prominence to the person on it

tr: n. 專橫, 放肆, 假定, 推測
[法] 假定, 推測, 設想
def: n. (law) an inference of the truth of a fact from other facts proved or admitted or judicially noticed
n. audacious (even arrogant) behavior that you have no right to
n. a kind of discourtesy in the form of an act of presuming

tr: vt. 捐贈, 捐助, 賦予
[法] 贈送財產給, 分給寡婦一份遺產, 授與
捐資設立；資助
賦予品質或能力
def: v. give qualities or abilities to
v. furnish with an endowment
give money to support an institution or position permanently

ex.en: Her family endowed a scholarship at the local college.
ex.zh: 她的家人在當地學院捐資設立了一項獎學金。

ex.en: Private donations can endow research centres that investigate long-term solutions to urgent public health problems.
ex.zh: 私人捐款可以資助研究中心，為緊迫的公共衛生問題探索長期解決方案。

col: endow a scholarship｜捐資設立獎學金
endow a chair｜捐資設立教授席位
words.tip: be endowed with常指天生具備某種才能或品質。

tr: vt. 不予重視
def: v represent as less significant or important
v understate the importance or quality of

tr: n. 職業, 天命, 天職, 才能, 行業
[法] 行業, 職業, 職業上的才能
志業；使命感
職業
def: n the particular occupation for which you are trained
n a body of people doing the same kind of work
work you feel strongly suited or called to do

ex.en: Caring for injured animals became her vocation early in life.
ex.zh: 照顧受傷動物很早就成為她立志從事的事業。

ex.en: Career guidance should help young people discover a vocation that matches their abilities and values.
ex.zh: 職業指導應幫助年輕人找到符合自身能力和價值觀的志業。

col: find one's vocation｜找到自己的志業
a sense of vocation｜職業使命感
a vocation for teaching｜從事教學的志向
words.tip: 常含使命感或天職之意；勿與vacation（假期）混淆。

tr: n. 早朝, 大堤

def: n. a formal reception of visitors or guests (as at a royal court)
n. a pier that provides a landing place on a river
n. an embankment that is built in order to prevent a river from overflowing

物流；後勤組織
def: n. handling an operation that involves providing labor and materials be supplied as needed
The organization of transporting goods, equipment, or people where needed.

ex.en: My brother handles the logistics of our camping trips.
ex.zh: 我們露營出行的後勤安排由我哥哥負責。

ex.en: Efficient logistics can reduce food waste by ensuring fresh produce reaches urban markets quickly.
ex.zh: 高效的物流能確保新鮮農產品迅速運抵城市市場，從而減少食物浪費。

col: handle the logistics｜負責後勤安排

tr: a. 裝飾的, 華麗的
def: s marked by elaborate rhetoric and elaborated with decorative details

tr: a. 病毒的, 病毒引起的
[醫] 病毒的
def: a. relating to or caused by a virus

tr: n. 愛國者, 愛國主義者
def: n. one who loves and defends his or her country

tr: vt. 花費, 消耗, 用光
def: v use up, consume fully
v pay out

tr: a. 彈回的, 有彈力的
[醫] 回彈的, 回能的
適應力強的；能復原的
有回彈力的
def: s. recovering readily from adversity, depression, or the like
Able to recover quickly after difficulties or damage
Able to return to its original shape after being bent

ex.en: These resilient plants recovered quickly after the summer drought.
ex.zh: 這些生命力頑強的植物在夏季乾旱後很快恢復了生機。

ex.en: Investing in local support networks can help communities become more resilient to economic and environmental shocks.
ex.zh: 投資地方支持網絡可以幫助社區更好地應對經濟和環境衝擊。

col: resilient to shocks｜能抵禦衝擊的
words.tip: 既可形容人或經濟的韌性，也可指材料回彈。

tr: n. 古怪的人, 漂泊無定的人
a. 不穩定的, 奇怪的
def: s. liable to sudden unpredictable change
s. having no fixed course
s. likely to perform unpredictably; sometimes it would start and sometimes it wouldn't"

tr: a. 互惠的, 相互的, 相等的, 倒數的, 彼此相反的
n. 倒數, 互相起作用的事物
def: n. something (a term or expression or concept) that has a reciprocal relation to something else
a. concerning each of two or more persons or things; especially given or done in return
s. of or relating to the multiplicative inverse of a quantity or function

tr: a. 喜不自禁的, 歡鬧的, 引人發笑的
極其好笑的
def: s. marked by or causing boisterous merriment or convulsive laughter
extremely funny and likely to make people laugh

ex.en: Her hilarious story made everyone laugh throughout dinner.
ex.zh: 她那個特別好笑的故事讓大家吃飯時笑個不停。

ex.en: Although hilarious advertisements can attract attention, humour does not always help consumers remember the product being promoted.
ex.zh: 雖然令人捧腹的廣告能夠吸引注意，但幽默並不總能幫助消費者記住所推銷的產品。

words.tip: 強調“極其好笑”，不只是熱鬧或開心。

v. spray or irrigate (a body part) with a syringe

tr: vt. 崇敬, 敬畏, 尊敬
def: n. American silversmith remembered for his midnight ride (celebrated in a poem by Longfellow) to warn the colonists in Lexington and Concord that British troops were coming (1735-1818)

tr: vt. 拒絕, 放棄, 否認, 墊牌
vi. 墊牌, 聲明放棄權利
n. 墊牌
def: v give up, such as power, as of monarchs and emperors, or duties and obligations
v leave (a job, post, or position) voluntarily
v turn away from; give up

tr: v. (使)移居, (使)移民
移居國外
def: v. leave one's country of residence for a new one
To leave your country to live permanently in another

ex.en: Her grandparents emigrated to Canada when they were young.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母年輕時移居到了加拿大。

ex.en: Skilled workers may emigrate when their home countries offer limited opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 當本國提供的職業發展機會有限時，技術人才可能會移居國外。

words.tip: emigrate強調遷出，immigrate強調遷入；搭配from或to。

tr: n. 賄賂
vt. 賄賂, 收買
vi. 行賄
向……行賄
賄賂；賄賂物
def: n. payment made to a person in a position of trust to corrupt his judgment
v. make illegal payments to in exchange for favors or influence
Offer rewards to make someone act dishonestly in your favour.

ex.en: The driver tried to bribe the officer with cash.
ex.zh: 那名司機試圖用現金賄賂警察。

ex.en: Strict penalties for companies that bribe public officials can help restore trust in government institutions.
ex.zh: 嚴懲向公職人員行賄的公司，有助於恢復公眾對政府機構的信任。

col: bribe someone into doing something｜賄賂某人做某事
words.tip: bribe的賓語是受賄者；bribery指行賄受賄行為。

tr: v. 扭動著行進, 擺動
n. 扭動, 擺動
def: n. the act of wiggling

tr: vt. 誇大的敘述, 誇張, 過分強調
[經] 多計, 高估
def: v. to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth

tr: n. 畏縮, 奉承
vi. 畏縮, 抖縮, 阿諛
def: v draw back, as with fear or pain
v show submission or fear

tr: n. 知識, 眼光

tr: n. 宣言, 公佈, 佈告, 公告
[法] 宣告, 宣佈, 佈告

tr: n. 高潮, 極點, 層進法
