高潮；最精彩的部分
達到高潮
def: n. the highest point of anything conceived of as growing or developing or unfolding
n. the decisive moment in a novel or play
n. the most severe stage of a disease

ex.en: The concert reached its climax when the whole choir joined.
ex.zh: 整個合唱團加入演唱時，音樂會達到了高潮。

ex.en: The film reaches its climax when the community unites to protect the forest from destruction.
ex.zh: 當社區居民團結起來保護森林免遭破壞時，影片達到了高潮。

col: a dramatic climax｜扣人心絃的高潮
words.tip: climactic指高潮的；別與climatic（氣候的）混淆。

tr: vt. 使犧牲, 使受害
[法] 使受害, 使作犧牲, 欺騙
def: v. make a victim of
v. punish unjustly
v. deprive of by deceit

tr: vt. 發掘, 掘出, 從洞中趕出, 揭露, 發現
def: v. bring to light

tr: a. 矛盾的, 模稜兩可的
[醫] 矛盾情緒的
心情矛盾的；態度搖擺的
def: s. uncertain or unable to decide about what course to follow
having conflicting feelings about someone or something

ex.en: I feel ambivalent about moving away from my family.
ex.zh: 對於搬離家人這件事，我的心情很矛盾。

ex.en: Many consumers remain ambivalent about online shopping because convenience must be balanced against concerns about privacy.
ex.zh: 許多消費者對網購仍持矛盾態度，因為便利與隱私方面的擔憂需要權衡。

words.tip: 常接about；指好壞感受並存，不是毫不在意。

tr: a. 潮溼的, 溼潤的, 多溼氣的
空氣潮溼的
def: s. containing or characterized by a great deal of water vapor
containing a lot of moisture in the air

ex.en: It feels so humid that my shirt sticks to me.
ex.zh: 天氣溼熱得我的襯衫都貼在身上了。

ex.en: In humid climates, buildings require effective ventilation to prevent mould growth and protect residents' health.
ex.zh: 在潮溼氣候中，建築物需要有效通風，以防止黴菌滋生並保護居民健康。

words.tip: humid主要形容空氣或氣候潮溼，不用於溼衣服。

tr: vt. 阻隔, 妨礙, 阻塞, 遮沒
vi. 設障礙
def: v. hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
v. block passage through
v. shut out from view or get in the way so as to hide from sight

tr: n. 沉重的步伐, 長途跋涉

vt. 跋涉
def: n. a long difficult walk

tr: v. 拾落穗, 收集
def: v gather, as of natural products

tr: vt. 一般化, 概括, 推廣

def: v. draw from specific cases for more general cases

v. become systemic and spread throughout the body

電磁感應

training or formal introduction when someone joins an organisation

ex.en: Our induction included a tour of the whole office.
ex.zh: 我們的入職培訓包括參觀整個辦公室。

ex.en: A structured induction programme can help new employees understand workplace expectations and adapt to their roles.
ex.zh: 系統的入職培訓可以幫助新員工瞭解工作要求並適應崗位。

words.tip: 入職常用induction；歸納與deduction演繹相對。

tr: a. 提示性的, 影射的, 暗示的
[醫] 暗示的
def: s. tending to suggest something improper or indecent

tr: n. 龍頭, 開關, 旋塞
def: n. a regulator for controlling the flow of a liquid from a reservoir

tr: vt. 藏起來
n. 隱藏處, 隱藏物
def: n a secret store of valuables or money
v save up as for future use

def: n. a broken piece of a brittle artifact

def: n. a boneless steak cut from the tenderloin of beef

A language variety used in a particular region or community.

ex.en: My grandmother speaks a dialect I sometimes struggle to understand.
ex.zh: 我奶奶說一種我有時聽不太懂的方言。

ex.en: Schools can help preserve local dialects while teaching students the standard language needed for wider communication.
ex.zh: 學校可以在教授學生廣泛交流所需的標準語的同時，幫助保護當地方言。

words.tip: dialect涉及詞彙和語法，accent主要指口音。

s. lacking vitality or spirit; lifeless

tr: vi. 減少, 縮小, 衰落
vt. 使縮小
逐漸減少；逐漸縮小
def: v. become smaller or lose substance
Gradually become smaller in amount, size, or number.

ex.en: Our savings dwindled while we searched for new jobs.
ex.zh: 我們找新工作期間，積蓄逐漸減少了。

ex.en: As freshwater supplies dwindle, governments must invest in efficient irrigation and encourage households to reduce unnecessary consumption.
ex.zh: 隨著淡水供應逐漸減少，政府必須投資高效灌溉，並鼓勵家庭減少不必要的用水。

words.tip: 不及物動詞，強調逐漸減少，不能直接接賓語。

tr: n. 瞬, 短期居留者, 過境鳥, 瞬變現象
a. 短暫的, 易變的, 瞬變的, 路過的
[計] 瞬變過程; 過渡過程; 過渡的; 瞬變的; 瞬時峰值電壓

n. (physics) a short-lived oscillation in a system caused by a sudden change of voltage or current or load

tr: vt. 使歡喜
vi. 欣喜, 高興, 慶祝
欣喜；歡慶
def: v. feel happiness or joy
Feel or show great happiness about something.

ex.en: We rejoiced when our missing cat finally came home.
ex.zh: 失蹤的貓終於回家了，我們欣喜不已。

ex.en: Residents rejoiced at the reopening of their local library, which provides valuable educational resources.
ex.zh: 當地居民為圖書館重新開放而歡欣鼓舞，因為它提供了寶貴的教育資源。

col: rejoice at the news｜為消息感到欣喜
rejoice in someone's success｜為某人的成功歡喜
words.tip: 較正式；常用rejoice at/in或接that從句。

tr: n. 母馬, 母驢, 月球表面陰暗部
[法] 海
def: n. female equine animal
n. a dark region of considerable extent on the surface of the moon

tr: n. 諷刺畫, 漫畫, 漫畫手法
vt. 畫成漫畫諷刺
def: n. a representation of a person that is exaggerated for comic effect
v. represent in or produce a caricature of

推進；推進力
def: n. a propelling force
n. the act of propelling
The force or process that moves something forward

ex.en: This small boat relies on electric propulsion to move quietly.
ex.zh: 這艘小船靠電力推進，行駛時很安靜。

ex.en: Advances in electric propulsion could reduce both noise pollution and fuel consumption in coastal shipping.
ex.zh: 電力推進技術的進步有望減少沿海航運的噪聲汙染和燃料消耗。

words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞，常用於船舶、飛機和航天器。

n. (linguistics) a word that is derived from another word
s. resulting from or employing derivation

def: a. relating to or constituting or bearing or giving a name
s. insignificantly small; a matter of form only (`tokenish' is informal)
a. pertaining to a noun or to a word group that functions as a noun

凝聚力；團結
篇章銜接
def: n. (botany) the process in some plants of parts growing together that are usually separate (such as petals)
n. (physics) the intermolecular force that holds together the molecules in a solid or liquid
The strength of connection that keeps a group together

ex.en: Our weekly team lunches helped build cohesion at work.
ex.zh: 我們每週的團隊午餐有助於增強工作中的凝聚力。

ex.en: Shared public spaces can strengthen social cohesion by encouraging regular interaction between residents from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 共享公共空間能促進不同背景的居民經常交流，從而增強社會凝聚力。

words.tip: 寫作中cohesion指語言銜接，coherence指邏輯連貫。

tr: a. 繪畫的, 插圖的, 用圖畫表示的, 形象化的, 有象形文字特徵的
n. 畫報, 畫刊, 有圖郵票, 插圖雜誌, 插圖報紙
def: n. a periodical (magazine or newspaper) containing many pictures
a. pertaining to or consisting of pictures

tr: n. 狂熱者, 盲信
a. 狂熱的, 盲信的
狂熱愛好者
狂熱信奉者
def: n. a person motivated by irrational enthusiasm (as for a cause)
s. marked by excessive enthusiasm for and intense devotion to a cause or idea
Someone who is extremely enthusiastic about an activity or interest.

ex.en: My cousin is a fitness fanatic who exercises daily.
ex.zh: 我表親是個健身迷，每天都鍛鍊。

ex.en: A political fanatic may reject reasonable debate, making it harder for communities to resolve disagreements peacefully.
ex.zh: 政治狂熱者可能拒絕理性辯論，使社會群體更難和平解決分歧。

words.tip: 愛好語境可輕鬆使用；信仰語境常含貶義。

def: n. a coat of stucco applied to a masonry wall
n. perspective drawing of an architect's design
n. giving in acknowledgment of obligation

def: n. inherited properties shared with others of your bloodline

[醫] 消退[法], 消腫[法], 浮動診胎法

tr: a. 輕佻的, 妄動的, 瑣碎的

n. a hollow metal rod that is wielded or twirled by a drum major or drum majorette

tr: a. 馴服的, 柔順的, 被開墾的, 順從的, 乏味的, 平淡的

馴服的；不怕人的
馴服；控制

s. flat and uninspiring
a. very restrained or quiet

ex.en: The tame rabbit ate directly from my hand.
ex.zh: 那隻溫順的兔子直接吃我手裡的食物。

ex.en: Even tame animals require careful handling, especially when young children are learning to interact with them.
ex.zh: 即使是馴服的動物也需要謹慎對待，尤其是在幼兒學習與它們互動時。

words.tip: tame指不怕人或被馴服，不等於天生無害。

tr: n. 衛生保健, 衛生學, 保健法
[醫] 衛生, 衛生學
def: n. a condition promoting sanitary practices
n. the science concerned with the prevention of illness and maintenance of health

tr: vt. 舉止, 驅逐出境
[法] 放逐, 驅逐, 遞解
def: v behave in a certain manner
v hand over to the authorities of another country
v expel from a country

tr: n. 崩潰, 大失敗

n. flooding caused by a tumultuous breakup of ice in a river during the spring or summer

tr: a. 有害的

屬（生物分類單位）

n. (biology) taxonomic group containing one or more species
a biological group containing closely related species

ex.en: These two garden plants belong to the same genus.
ex.zh: 這兩種園藝植物屬於同一個屬。

ex.en: Scientists classified the newly discovered frog within an existing genus after comparing its genetic characteristics with related species.
ex.zh: 科學家將新發現的青蛙與近緣物種的遺傳特徵進行比較後，把它歸入了一個已有的屬。

ex.en: These thick curtains reduce the penetration of sunlight.
ex.zh: 這些厚窗簾減少了陽光的透入。

ex.en: Greater internet penetration in rural areas can improve access to education and support the growth of small businesses.
ex.zh: 提高農村地區的互聯網普及率，有助於改善教育獲取條件並支持小企業發展。

tr: n. 鬼臉, 怪相

ex.zh: 關於錢的爭吵讓這家人紛爭不斷。

ex.en: Economic inequality can fuel social strife when communities feel excluded from opportunities for a better life.
ex.zh: 當一些群體覺得自己被排除在改善生活的機會之外時，經濟不平等可能加劇社會衝突。

鞏固；加強

v. become solid
To become solid, or make something become solid.

ex.en: Leave the melted chocolate to solidify before adding decorations.
ex.zh: 等融化的巧克力凝固後再加裝飾。

ex.en: Joint research projects can solidify partnerships between universities and encourage the exchange of specialist knowledge.
ex.zh: 聯合研究項目能鞏固大學之間的合作關係，並促進專業知識的交流。

col: solidify into a mass｜凝固成塊

tr: vt. 歸因於, 歸咎於
[法] 歸咎於
把…歸因於
認為…具有；認定出自
def: v attribute or credit to
To consider something to be caused by a particular factor
To assign a quality, work, or statement to someone

ex.en: I ascribe my better sleep to regular evening walks.
ex.zh: 我認為睡眠改善得益於每晚定時散步。

ex.en: Researchers should not ascribe differences in academic performance solely to individual effort without considering social circumstances.
ex.zh: 研究人員不應在未考慮社會環境的情況下，將學業表現的差異完全歸因於個人努力。

col: ascribe success to｜將成功歸因於
ascribe a work to｜認定作品出自
words.tip: 固定結構ascribe A to B：把A歸因於B。

tr: a. 怪誕的, 可怕的, 離奇的, 神秘的

n. (in some countries) a military officer of highest rank
v. place in proper rank

ex.en: A volunteer marshalled the runners into a neat line.
ex.zh: 一名志願者把跑步者組織成了整齊的一隊。

ex.en: Governments must marshal resources effectively to provide emergency housing for communities affected by severe flooding.
ex.zh: 政府必須有效調集資源，為遭受嚴重洪災的社區提供應急住房。

words.tip: 英式過去式marshalled，美式marshaled；勿混淆martial。

tr: a. 不受歡迎的, 不合乎社會道德標準的
[法] 不受歡迎的人, 不良份子, 不法份子
def: n. one whose presence is undesirable
a. not wanted
s. not worthy of being chosen (especially as a spouse)

駭人的；可怕的

s. so extremely ugly as to be terrifying
extremely ugly or unpleasant

ex.en: That hideous carpet clashes with everything in the room.
ex.zh: 那塊難看的地毯與房間裡的一切都不搭。

ex.en: Poorly planned developments can create hideous buildings that damage the visual character of historic neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 規劃不當的開發項目可能造出極其難看的建築，破壞歷史街區的視覺風貌。

words.tip: 語氣很強，常形容極醜的外觀或可怕的事。

tr: n. 啞子, 啞音字母, 弱音器

明確規定；約定

v. give a guarantee or promise of
v. make an oral contract or agreement in the verbal form of question and answer that is necessary to give it legal force

ex.en: The rental rules stipulate that pets must stay downstairs.
ex.zh: 租賃規定明確要求寵物必須待在樓下。

ex.en: Employment contracts should stipulate working hours clearly to prevent disputes between employers and their staff.
ex.zh: 勞動合同應明確規定工作時間，以防止僱主與員工發生爭議。

col: stipulate a deadline｜規定截止日期
words.tip: 正式用詞，常用於合同；可接名詞或that從句。

tr: n. (事物的)主體, 文集, 本金, 語料庫
[醫] 體
def: n. a collection of writings
n. the main part of an organ or other bodily structure

tr: n. 具體化, 化身
def: n. a new personification of a familiar idea
n. giving concrete form to an abstract concept

tr: a. 過期的, 未兌的, 遲到的, 早就成熟的
[經] 過期未付的
逾期的；延誤的
早該發生的
def: s past due; not paid at the scheduled time
Not paid, returned, or completed by the expected time.
Needed or deserved much earlier than now.

ex.en: I found an overdue library book under my bed.
ex.zh: 我在床底下發現了一本逾期未還的圖書館藏書。

ex.en: Investment in rural public transport is long overdue, as many residents still lack reliable services.
ex.zh: 農村公共交通早就該得到投資，因為許多居民至今仍缺乏可靠的交通服務。

col: an overdue library book｜逾期未還的圖書館書籍
words.tip: long overdue強調“早就該有或該做”，不只是遲到。

tr: a. 有生殖力的, 多產的, 豐富的
[醫] 多育的, 多產的, 繁殖的
多產的；成果豐碩的
繁殖旺盛的

Producing many works, results or achievements.
Producing many young, flowers, fruits or seeds.

ex.en: My aunt is a prolific painter with two studios.
ex.zh: 我姑姑是位多產的畫家，擁有兩間畫室。

ex.en: Prolific researchers can contribute substantially to scientific progress, but publication quantity should not outweigh quality.
ex.zh: 成果豐碩的研究者能大力推動科學進步，但發表數量不應比質量更受重視。

col: a prolific breeder｜繁殖力強的動物
words.tip: 強調產出多，不等於作品質量一定高。

n. a person who is authorized to read publications or correspondence or to watch theatrical performances and suppress in whole or in part anything considered obscene or politically unacceptable
v. subject to political, religious, or moral censorship

vi. 作句法分析
n. 直譯
理解；解釋
def: v make sense of; assign a meaning to
To understand a statement or action in a particular way.

ex.en: Please don't construe my silence as a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 請不要把我的沉默理解為不感興趣。

ex.en: A failure to consult local residents may be construed as disregard for their concerns about urban development.
ex.zh: 未徵詢當地居民的意見，可能被理解為漠視他們對城市發展的擔憂。

col: construe something as｜將某事理解為
be construed as criticism｜被理解為批評
words.tip: 常用construe A as B，表示“把A理解為B”。

tr: vt. 分解檢查, 翻修, 精細檢查, 徹底革新
n. 分解檢查, 精細檢查, 大檢修

v. make repairs, renovations, revisions or adjustments to

人群；大群人

a large crowd of people gathered closely together
to gather somewhere in large numbers

ex.en: We pushed through the throng to reach the exit.
ex.zh: 我們擠過人群，來到出口。

ex.en: Throngs of visitors can place considerable pressure on historic sites during the peak tourist season.
ex.zh: 在旅遊旺季，大批遊客可能給歷史遺址帶來相當大的壓力。

a. 最優的, 最適宜的

def: n. most favorable conditions or greatest degree or amount possible under given circumstances
s. most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied
best suited to achieving a particular result

ex.en: This sunny windowsill provides optimum conditions for my herbs.
ex.zh: 這個陽光充足的窗臺為我種的香草提供了最適宜的條件。

ex.en: Maintaining the optimum classroom temperature can help students concentrate and reduce the energy required for heating.
ex.zh: 保持最適宜的教室溫度有助於學生集中注意力，並減少供暖能耗。

def: n. normal or sound powers of mind

tr: n. 陷阱, 誘惑, 陰謀, 易犯的錯誤, 意想不到的困難

匕首；短劍

ex.zh: 一把古代匕首陳列在博物館的玻璃展櫃裡。

ex.zh: 一把帶裝飾的匕首的發現，證明了這個古代聚居地具備先進的金屬加工技藝。

[計] 判定

n. a square matrix used to solve simultaneous equations

tr: a. 精明的, 銳利的, 劇烈的, 機靈的, 厲害的
精明的；判斷敏銳的
def: s marked by practical hardheaded intelligence
s used of persons
good at judging situations and making decisions that bring advantages

ex.en: That shrewd purchase saved us money on heating.
ex.zh: 那次明智的購買為我們節省了取暖費用。

ex.en: Shrewd investment in renewable energy can help governments reduce future costs while improving national energy security.
ex.zh: 對可再生能源進行精明投資，可以幫助政府降低未來成本，同時提升國家能源安全。

col: a shrewd investor｜精明的投資者
words.tip: 強調判斷精明、善於謀利，不等於單純聰明。

大洞穴；大山洞

v. hollow out as if making a cavern

ex.zh: 手電筒照出了大洞穴裡的一潭深水。

ex.zh: 石灰岩洞穴內的旅遊活動必須受到妥善管理，以保護脆弱的岩層構造和地下棲息地。

tr: a. 自然而然的, 無意識的, 不知不覺的, 偶然的, 不隨意的

a. controlled by the autonomic nervous system; without conscious control

tr: n. 叢林, 草叢

n. a stiff hair
v. rise up as in fear

停戰；休戰協議
def: n a state of peace agreed to between opponents so they can discuss peace terms
An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time

ex.en: After arguing all morning, the neighbours called a truce.
ex.zh: 爭吵了一上午後，鄰居們暫時休戰了。

ex.en: A temporary truce can allow aid workers to deliver essential supplies to communities affected by conflict.
ex.zh: 臨時停戰可以讓援助人員向受衝突影響的社區運送必需物資。

col: agree to a truce｜同意停戰
break a truce｜破壞休戰協議
words.tip: 通常指暫時停止衝突，不等於永久和平。

tr: a. 先決條件的, 必要的
n. 先決條件, 必備條件

s. required as a prior condition or course of study

男爵
行業巨頭；大亨

n. a very wealthy or powerful businessman

ex.en: The baron welcomed his guests into the castle courtyard.
ex.zh: 男爵迎接客人們來到城堡庭院。

ex.en: Media barons can influence public debate through their ownership of major newspapers and television networks.
ex.zh: 傳媒大亨可以憑藉對主要報紙和電視網的所有權影響公共討論。

tr: a. 稀薄的, 微細的, 纖細的, 脆弱的
[醫] 細薄的, 纖細的
def: s. having thin consistency
s. very thin in gauge or diameter

tr: n. 愁容, 陰沉臉色

vt. 怒視
def: v. frown with displeasure

tr: n. 貯藏所, 貯物器, 倉庫, 博物館, 店鋪, 陳列室, 資源豐富地區, 墓地, 親信, 知己
[經] 倉庫, 棧房, 貯藏所
def: n. a person to whom a secret is entrusted
n. a burial vault (usually for some famous person)

ex.zh: 這些照片證明，關於我們大門損壞的說法不實。

ex.en: Reliable scientific evidence can refute misleading claims about nutrition and help consumers make informed dietary choices.
ex.zh: 可靠的科學證據能夠駁倒有關營養的誤導性說法，幫助消費者作出明智的飲食選擇。

Extremely careful and attentive to every small detail.

ex.en: He made meticulous notes while repairing the old clock.
ex.zh: 他修理舊鐘時做了細緻的記錄。

ex.en: Meticulous planning is essential when researchers conduct experiments involving complex equipment and sensitive environmental measurements.
ex.zh: 研究人員開展涉及複雜設備和精密環境測量的實驗時，周密規劃至關重要。

ex.zh: 她敲開核桃，小心地取出果仁。

ex.zh: 導遊指著一隻在樹枝間盪來盪去的靈長類動物。

ex.zh: 保護熱帶森林對許多因棲息地喪失而受到威脅的靈長類物種的生存至關重要。

ex.zh: 她挑了柔軟的藍色毛線來織嬰兒毯。

ex.zh: 使用再生材料製成的紗線可以減少紡織業的廢棄物。

ex.zh: 提供免費零食是吸引顧客的一種策略。

ex.en: Critics described the sudden price reduction as a marketing ploy rather than a genuine commitment to affordability.
ex.zh: 批評者認為，突然降價是一種營銷手段，而非真正致力於讓消費者買得起。

ex.zh: 我們等火車時輕聲交談。

ex.zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，一名騎士殺死了一條龍。

ex.en: Traditional legends often celebrate heroes who slay monsters to protect their communities from danger.
ex.zh: 傳統傳說常常頌揚那些殺死怪物、保護社區免受危險的英雄。

ex.zh: 我們的美術老師鼓勵創造，而不是一味墨守成規。

ex.zh: 他因為逃避那次談話而罵自己是個懦夫。

ex.zh: 稱某人為膽小鬼，可能會使其不願談論自己的恐懼或尋求適當支持。

words.tip: coward是名詞，形容詞用cowardly；稱人時含貶義。

ex.zh: 這些植物會保持休眠狀態，直到天氣轉暖。

ex.zh: 儘管這座火山已經休眠了數百年，科學家仍持續監測它是否有再次活動的跡象。

words.tip: 指暫不活動但可能恢復；休眠火山不等於死火山。

ex.zh: 每位徒步者都裝好了一天份的堅果和果乾。

ex.zh: 在長期乾旱期間，地方當局可能會定量供水，以確保每戶都能獲得足夠的水。

ex.zh: 我在樓上找到了一本落滿灰塵的園藝專著。

ex.zh: 這位哲學家的教育論著主張，實踐經驗應在學習中發揮核心作用。

ex.zh: 小狗走過溼滑的地板時，雙腿微微發抖。

ex.zh: 即使為公開演講做了充分準備，演講者的聲音也可能因壓力而顫抖。

ex.zh: 他用舊瓶子做了一套巧妙的澆水裝置。

ex.en: Ingenious designs can help architects create comfortable homes on small plots without sacrificing natural light.
ex.zh: 巧妙的設計可以幫助建築師在小塊土地上建造舒適住宅，同時不犧牲自然採光。

啟發；使瞭解

v. give spiritual insight to; in religion
to give someone information that helps them understand something

ex.zh: 你能給我講講這臺相機怎麼用嗎？

ex.en: Public health campaigns should enlighten citizens about the benefits of vaccination while addressing common concerns respectfully.
ex.zh: 公共衛生宣傳應讓公眾瞭解接種疫苗的益處，同時以尊重的態度回應常見顧慮。

ex.zh: 他的皮膚毛孔周圍冒出了細小的汗珠。

ex.zh: 研究人員仔細研讀歷史記錄，以瞭解過去的社會如何應對嚴重乾旱時期。

ex.zh: 我叔叔因為迷信，不願從梯子下面走過。

ex.en: Animals that burrow underground can improve soil quality by allowing air and water to penetrate deeper layers.
ex.zh: 在地下挖洞的動物能讓空氣和水進入更深的土層，從而改善土壤質量。

ex.zh: 這對姐妹在音樂會上演唱了一首優美的二重唱。

ex.en: Performing a duet encourages music students to listen carefully and coordinate their timing with another musician.
ex.zh: 表演二重奏能鼓勵音樂專業學生仔細聆聽，並與另一位演奏者協調節奏。

ex.zh: 經過幾個月的練習，她的縫紉技術變得很熟練。

ex.zh: 熟練掌握第二語言的畢業生可能更容易獲得國際就業機會。

ex.zh: 不具備必要資歷的申請者或可受益於旨在幫助人們進入技術崗位的培訓項目。

ex.zh: 整個下午，斷斷續續的雨讓我們不時跑回屋裡。

ex.zh: 她的祖父雖然不識字，卻很會講睡前故事。

ex.zh: 免費的成人教育能夠幫助不識字的公民掌握基本技能，更充分地參與社會生活。
